title: LIC-Audit: How Comparable Are Reported Gains in Learned Image Compression?
summary: Learned image compression (LIC) papers often report BD-rate improvements of only a few percent. They are measured against VTM reference software whose version keeps changing: the claims we audit name 7 versions, 5 in 2025 papers alone. But how comparable are these numbers across papers, and what evidence should future papers give for such small gains? We introduce LIC-Audit, an analysis of 353 released rate-distortion curves from 36 repositories, and a controlled re-evaluation of eight public codec releases with 28,193 encode-decode records. We identify three problems. First, different VTM reference runs change BD-rates by up to 3.56 percentage points, and on CLIC Pro published numbers order 10 of 55 method pairs differently from a common computation; comparing codecs directly over a fixed quality range removes this dependence. Second, releases use different and mostly undocumented conventions for counting bits, computing PSNR, and padding images. Under consistent measurement, the GLIC method's 1.00% lead over the HPCM method on Tecnick becomes a 1.43% deficit, changing only the padding reverses the comparison of HPCM and CMIC, and most gaps narrow when MS-SSIM replaces PSNR. Third, average curves hide how much results vary from image to image, so whether a small gain is statistically significant depends on the assumed variation. An optimistic assumption calls 12.0% of comparisons between equally good codecs significant on test sets as small as Kodak, instead of 5%; a cautious one leaves 18 of 45 differences between recent codecs undecided, yet per-image results show 12 of them to be significant. Beyond auditing past results, LIC-Audit provides a versioned evaluation protocol, a public leaderboard website with a scoring tool, source-linked benchmark data, per-image measurements, and reporting guidelines, to help future LIC papers make comparable and verifiable claims of progress.

AI.tldr: LIC-Audit 审计了 353 条已发表的率失真曲线与 8 个公开编解码器发布（28,193 条编解码记录），揭示 VTM 参考版本、比特/PSNR/填充约定、以及平均曲线掩盖的图像间方差三大问题，导致小幅度 BD-rate（几个百分点）结论不可复现、甚至方向反转；并提出版本化评估协议、排行榜与报告指南。
AI.motivation: 学习型图像压缩（LIC）论文常只报告几个百分点的 BD-rate 改进，但这些数字分别相对不同版本的 VTM 参考软件计算（审计中出现 7 个版本，2025 年论文就占 5 个），且各发布在比特计数、PSNR 计算、图像填充等测量约定上不同且多无文档说明。因此这些微小增益在跨论文比较时是否可比、未来论文应提供何种证据，缺乏系统审视。
AI.method: 1) LIC-Audit 分析：从 36 个仓库收集 353 条公开率失真曲线，量化不同 VTM 参考运行对 BD-rate 的影响，并在 CLIC Pro 上比较"发表数字"与"统一计算"对 55 组方法配对排序的差异；2) 受控再评估：对 8 个公开编解码器发布做统一化重测，产生 28,193 条编解码记录，控制比特计数、PSNR 计算与 padding 约定，并对比 PSNR 与 MS-SSIM 指标下的结论；3) 统计显著性分析：比较乐观/谨慎两种图像间方差假设下显著差异判定比例，并用逐图像结果交叉验证。
AI.result: 不同 VTM 参考运行使 BD-rate 变动最多 3.56 个百分点，CLIC Pro 上 55 组方法配对中有 10 组排序与统一计算不一致；在一致测量下，GLIC 相对 HPCM 在 Tecnick 上由 1.00% 领先变为 1.43% 落后，仅改变 padding 即反转 HPCM 与 CMIC 的比较，且多数差距在改用 MS-SSIM 后缩小；统计层面，乐观假设在 Kodak 规模测试集上把同等质量编解码器间 12.0% 的比较误判为显著（而非 5%），谨慎假设下 45 组近期编解码器差异中 18 组无法判定，而逐图像结果显示其中 12 组实际显著。
AI.conclusion: 小的 BD-rate 增益在现有报告惯例下往往不可验证甚至方向可逆；跨方法直接在同一质量区间比较可消除对 VTM 版本的依赖，且必须统一比特/PSNR/padding 约定并报告逐图像统计。作者发布版本化评估协议、带评分工具的公开排行榜网站、源链接基准数据、逐图像测量与报告指南。

title: TETHER: Training-Free, Elastic, ToC-Anchored Hierarchy Extraction and Recovery in Design-Driven Long Documents
summary: Converting complex documents into structured knowledge constitutes the critical infrastructure urgently required for deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in downstream research. However, blind to the Table of Contents (ToC) as a macro-structure, existing bottom-up paradigms rely on localized visual cues, inducing heuristic fragility in high-entropy layouts where visual prominence decouples from logical depth; meanwhile, direct LLM extraction lacks spatial grounding, triggering hallucinations in long contexts. To address this, we introduce TETHER, a training-free framework that elevates the ToC from discarded noise to a vital structural prior, enabling robust adaptation across design-driven long documents. TETHER operates via a two-stage neuro-symbolic mechanism: first, it constructs a document skeleton from the raw ToC using a Large Multimodal Model (LMM) empowered by spatio-semantic constraints; second, it employs an anchor-based alignment strategy to tether content blocks to this skeleton, effectively resolving boundary ambiguities. Evaluated across a multilingual benchmark of ESG reports, product manuals, and annual reports, TETHER delivers highly precise, state-of-the-art (SOTA) zero-shot hierarchy recovery, outperforming deep hierarchical recovery models, dedicated parsers, and general-purpose LMMs. Moreover, stress tests highlight TETHER's resilience to sparse omissions and textual noise, demonstrating that its precise semantic alignment is fundamentally anchored in topological and depth fidelity. Crucially, ablations confirm the framework's architectural irreducibility, while achieving 90% token reduction and drastic speedups over end-to-end baselines, establishing a compelling equilibrium between structural precision and deployment scalability.

AI.tldr: TETHER: 训练免训练框架，将文档目录(ToC)作为结构先验，通过"骨架构建+锚点对齐"两阶段神经-符号机制实现长文档零样本层级结构恢复，SOTA且token减少90%。
AI.motivation: LLM落地研究需将复杂文档转为结构化知识。现有自底向上方法忽视目录这一宏观结构，仅依赖局部视觉线索，在高熵版式中视觉显著性与逻辑深度脱钩导致启发式脆弱；直接LLM抽取缺乏空间锚定，长上下文易幻觉。
AI.method: 两阶段神经-符号机制：(1) 用带时空-语义约束的大型多模态模型从原始ToC构建文档骨架；(2) 基于锚点的对齐策略将内容块"系"到骨架上，消解边界歧义。全程无需训练。
AI.result: 在多语言ESG报告、产品手册、年报基准上取得SOTA零样本层级恢复，优于深层级恢复模型、专用解析器与通用LMM；压力测试显示对稀疏缺失与文本噪声鲁棒；消融验证架构不可约简；token减少90%，相对端到端基线显著加速。
AI.conclusion: 利用目录作为宏观结构先验可显著提升长文档结构化解析的精度与效率，兼顾结构精确性与部署可扩展性。

title: EgoPass-Bench: Identifying Objects That May Affect the Wearer's Passage in Egocentric Video
summary: Understanding an egocentric environment requires reasoning about how surrounding entities affect the observer's actions. Existing evaluations of multimodal foundation models (MFMs) examine observer localization, motion trajectories, and action feasibility, but leave the discovery and interpretation of evolving observer-entity interactions insufficiently assessed. We introduce EgoPass-Bench, a benchmark for observer-relative interaction understanding in real-world egocentric video. EgoPass-Bench comprises 284 manually reviewed evaluation clips recorded using Ray-Ban Meta (Gen 2) smart glasses and 2,201 distinct questions across five tasks assessing motion perception, interaction judgments about specified entities, and relevant-entity discovery without target cues. Our evaluation of eight frame-based and six native-video configurations reveals a pronounced discrepancy between motion perception and interaction understanding. The strongest evaluated model, GPT-6 Astra, correctly recognizes object motion in 91.37% of 394 comparisons involving the same targets, but correctly identifies changes in passage constraints in only 66.50%. Across all 574 entity-discovery questions, it trails the two-person human baseline by $23.65 \pm 7.45$ percentage points (paired 95% CI), while exceeding the always-empty baseline (36.76%) by at least 18.9 percentage points. Further analysis reveals frequent inclusion of entities that neither pose a plausible physical conflict nor constrain passage, showing that accurate motion recognition does not ensure reliable relevant-entity discovery.

AI.tldr: EgoPass-Bench：基于Ray-Ban Meta智能眼镜真实第一人称视频的284段人工审核片段、2201个问题、5项任务，评估MFM的观察者-实体交互理解，发现运动感知强（91.37%）但交互理解与相关实体发现弱（66.50%；比人类低23.65pp）。
AI.motivation: 现有对多模态基础模型（MFM）的评测覆盖观察者定位、运动轨迹与动作可行性，但对"不断演化的观察者-实体交互"的发现与解释评估不足，无法判断模型是否真正理解哪些实体构成通行约束或物理冲突。
AI.method: 构建EgoPass-Bench：Ray-Ban Meta (Gen 2) 采集的真实第一人称视频，284段人工审阅评测片段，2201个问题，5类任务（运动感知、指定实体交互判断、无目标线索下的相关实体发现等）。评测8种基于帧的配置与6种原生视频配置，并与双人人均基线和always-empty基线对比。
AI.result: 最强模型GPT-6 Astra在394个同目标比较中运动识别正确率91.37%，但通行约束变化识别仅66.50%；在574道实体发现问题中低于双人人类基线23.65±7.45个百分点（配对95% CI），高于always-empty基线（36.76%）至少18.9个百分点；模型频繁纳入既无物理冲突也不约束通行的无关实体。
AI.conclusion: 准确的运动识别不等同于可靠的交互理解与相关实体发现；现有MFM存在"运动感知—交互理解"显著落差。该工作属benchmark-only，未提出可迁移方法，对Physical AI研究主要是评测性参考。

title: Density Feedback Control for Transferability of Generative Sparse Adversarial Attacks
summary: Generator-based sparse adversarial attacks train encoder--decoder networks to produce transferable sparse perturbations for black-box robustness evaluation. Their perturbation density, however, is set only indirectly by a fixed sparsity coefficient whose mapping to density is unknown and shifts during training, so reaching a target density requires re-tuning; this fixed pressure also yields little transferability gain once density reduction begins. We propose Density Feedback Control (DFC), which tightens or relaxes this coefficient at the end of each epoch according to the gap between the observed hard-mask density and the target, without changing the generator architecture or loss. At a 10\% target density, DFC brings the mean density of three base attacks within one percentage point of the target in a single run and improves the transfer attack success rate (ASR) of two of them on CNN and Transformer targets, including under per-image $\ell_0$ budgets, while perturbing fewer pixels. Tracing GPG's training, we observe that as DFC relaxes the coefficient, the transfer ASR recovers with the density and overtakes the fixed-coefficient baseline with fewer pixels. For EGS-TSSA, which restricts perturbations to source-model feature-importance regions, DFC yields no consistent gain; we analyze how this restriction interacts with density feedback.

AI.tldr: 提出密度反馈控制（DFC），在每个epoch末根据观测到的硬掩码稀疏度与目标密度之差，自适应收紧或放松生成器稀疏系数，使稀疏对抗攻击的扰动密度可单次运行达到目标。
AI.motivation: 生成器式稀疏对抗攻击中，扰动密度仅由固定稀疏系数间接决定，系数与密度的映射未知且随训练漂移，需反复调参才能达到目标密度；且固定压力在开始降密度后几乎不再带来迁移性提升。
AI.method: DFC：不改动生成器结构与损失，仅在每个epoch结束时按"观测硬掩码密度与目标密度之差"反馈调节稀疏系数（超出则收紧、不足则放松）。在三种基攻击上验证，并追踪GPG训练动态；另对限制扰动于源模型特征重要性区域的EGS-TSSA进行交互分析。
AI.result: 10%目标密度下，三种基攻击的平均密度单次运行即落在目标±1个百分点内；其中两种在CNN与Transformer目标上迁移ASR提升（含逐图ℓ₀预算设定），且扰动的像素更少。GPG中随系数放松，迁移ASR随密度回升并超越固定系数基线。EGS-TSSA无一致收益。
AI.conclusion: 以轻量级反馈控制替代人工调参，可实现目标密度精确可控的稀疏攻击并附带迁移性收益；但密度反馈与特征重要性区域限制存在冲突，需权衡。

title: Inhabitant: An Agent Framework for Long-Horizon Human-Scene Interaction with Spatial Control and Quantitative Feedback
summary: Recent work on human-scene interaction (HSI) generation moves from single interactions to long-horizon interaction, where a language-model agent plans and executes a sequence of interactions in a 3D scene under one instruction. However, existing agents struggle in challenging everyday scenarios (e.g., picking up a toy and throwing it into a basket) because they lack spatial control over the motion and quantitative feedback on its execution, and they often fail to complete the interaction sequence. To address these gaps, we present Inhabitant, a training-free agent framework in which the agent specifies each motion through positions, paths and poses, measures how the executed interaction deviates from its intent, and revises the control specification accordingly. For an extensive evaluation in such scenarios, we build Inhabit, a benchmark of 75 household tasks in 31 furniture layouts of an apartment, in which every task chains one to three goals on movable objects and is carried out by the whole body, excluding fingers. On Inhabit, Inhabitant completes 98.7\% of the tasks with Claude Opus 5.5, and 93.3\% and 82.7\% with Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon, respectively. Ablations confirm that without spatial control the agent fails most tasks, and without quantitative feedback its motion becomes less precise. Code is available on the project page.

AI.tldr: Inhabitant：免训练的人类-场景交互（HSI）长时序智能体框架，通过「位置+路径+姿态」的空间控制规格与执行偏差的定量反馈迭代修正；并构建 Inhabit 基准（75 个家务任务、31 种家具布局、全身（不含手指）执行）。Inhabit 上完成率 98.7%（Claude Opus 5.5）、93.3%（Sonnet 5.5）、82.7%（Gemini 4 Argon）。
AI.motivation: 现有长时序 HSI 生成智能体在需要精细空间控制的日常任务（如抓起玩具投进篮子）中表现差：缺乏对运动的定量空间控制、缺乏对执行结果的量化反馈、长序列任务常无法完成。
AI.method: 免训练智能体框架：LLM 智能体以位置、路径、姿态显式指定每段运动（空间控制规格）；执行后用度量（意图与执行偏差）做定量自评，并据此修订控制规格，形成闭环重规划；配套构建 Inhabit 基准与评估协议。
AI.result: Inhabit 上任务完成率 98.7%/93.3%/82.7%（Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 / Gemini 4 Argon）；消融表明去掉空间控制后多数任务失败，去掉定量反馈后运动精度下降。
AI.conclusion: 显式空间控制规格 + 定量执行反馈是提升长时序 HSI 智能体可靠性的关键；免训练即可获得高完成率，但主要证据来自基准仿真而非真实机器人/真实场景泛化验证。

title: Infer3D: Inverse Generative Modeling Enables Robust 3D Reconstruction
comment: 23 pages, 12 figures, 15 tables. Includes references and appendices. Project page: this https URL
summary: Humans can understand the 3D structure of scenes even from highly unfamiliar or extreme viewpoints. Cognitive science suggests this generalization stems from a top-down generative inference strategy. In contrast, state-of-the-art 3D reconstruction neural networks typically rely on amortized, feedforward inference. While fast, this pattern-matching approach degrades when faced with out-of-distribution (OOD) scene conditions unseen during training. Inspired by the generative nature of human vision, we propose Infer3D, an inverse generative modeling framework that recovers the latent variables of a generative model to best match the monocular input. To prevent degenerate flat outputs, we couple the generative image prior with a frozen 3D lifting network that constrains the optimization space to a valid, multi-view-consistent 3D manifold. Across a variety of controlled synthetic and real-world tasks, Infer3D demonstrates superior OOD reconstruction accuracy compared to feedforward networks trained on equal or larger datasets. Furthermore, mirroring how human perception requires more time to process confusing stimuli, we introduce an adaptive inference strategy that expends more test-time compute on ambiguous OOD examples while efficiently routing in-distribution inputs. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: Infer3D 提出逆生成式建模框架：通过优化一个生成模型的隐变量来匹配单目输入图像，并用冻结的 3D 提升网络将优化空间约束为多视角一致的 3D 流形，从而显著提升 OOD 场景下的单目 3D 重建精度，并引入自适应测试时计算分配策略。
AI.motivation: 人类视觉具有自上而下的生成式推理能力，可从陌生/极端视角泛化理解 3D 场景；而主流前馈式（amortized）3D 重建网络依赖模式匹配，在分布外（OOD）场景下性能显著退化。作者受人类生成式视觉启发，试图用逆生成式推理替代前馈摊销推理以获得更好的泛化性。
AI.method: 提出 Infer3D：不训练新的前馈映射，而是对一个生成模型做逆问题求解，优化其隐变量使生成结果最匹配单目输入。为防止退化的平面解，将生成式图像先验与一个冻结的 3D 提升网络耦合，把优化空间约束到有效且多视角一致的 3D 流形上。进一步引入自适应推理策略，按输入歧义度分配测试时计算：对 OOD 困难样本投入更多计算，对分布内样本走高效路由。
AI.result: 在多种受控合成任务和真实世界任务上，Infer3D 的 OOD 重建精度优于在同等甚至更大数据集上训练的前馈网络；自适应推理在保持分布内效率的同时提升了对歧义 OOD 样本的处理表现，与"人类处理困惑刺激需要更多时间"的现象相呼应。
AI.conclusion: 将生成式先验与冻结 3D 提升网络耦合的逆生成式推理，是提升单目 3D 重建 OOD 泛化性的有效途径；推理时按难度自适应分配计算量可作为前馈模型的重要补充范式。局限在于推理需逐样本优化、速度较慢，且依赖预训练生成模型与 3D 提升网络的质量。

title: Mapping the Wind to Find the Source: Online Physics-Informed Gas Source Localization with Mobile Robots
summary: Gas Source Localization (GSL) with mobile robots is challenging because wind and gas measurements are spatially sparse, noisy, and potentially affected by robot motion. Indoor airflow can vary substantially across space, while detailed environmental layouts, boundary conditions, or precomputed airflow fields are often unavailable. Moreover, hazardous sources must be localized as quickly as possible, making exhaustive exploration impractical. This paper presents a lightweight physics-informed probabilistic framework for efficient GSL under spatially varying indoor airflow. As the robot navigates, it continuously collects wind and gas measurements and reconstructs the spatially varying airflow field online. The estimated wind field drives a forward dispersion model that predicts the gas pattern for each candidate source location. These predictions are compared with the measured gas pattern to update a probabilistic belief over the source location. As the wind field is reconstructed incrementally, the framework also accounts for the spatially non-uniform reliability of wind field estimation and its influence on the source estimation. The resulting belief map is then used for informative path planning to guide the robot toward informative regions. High-fidelity simulations provide a comprehensive evaluation of the individual components and their integrations within the complete system, while physical indoor experiments assess the system performance under realistic sensing, motion, and airflow conditions. The results demonstrate that incorporating lightweight physical knowledge significantly improves localization robustness under spatially complex airflow and enables more efficient exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级物理知情概率框架：机器人边走边在线重建空间变化风场，用前向扩散模型为每个候选源生成气团模式并与实测比较，更新源位置信念图，并考虑风场估计的空间非均匀可靠性，最后以信息增益路径规划引导搜索。仿真+真实室内实验验证。
AI.motivation: 室内气流空间变化剧烈、布局与边界条件/预计算流场常不可得；风与气体测量稀疏含噪且受机器人运动扰动；危险源需尽快定位，穷举探索不可行。因此需要不依赖先验流场、可在线、轻量且高效的GSL方法。
AI.method: 在线增量重建空间变化风场；以估计风场驱动前向气体扩散模型，对每个候选源位置预测气体分布；与实测气体模式比对以贝叶斯式更新源位置概率信念；将风场估计置信度（空间非均匀可靠性）纳入似然/权重；由信念图构造信息增益型路径规划，指导机器人向高信息区域移动。
AI.result: 高保真仿真中逐组件消融及整体系统集成评估；真实室内物理实验中在真实感知、运动与气流条件下验证；结果表明融入轻量物理知识显著提升空间复杂气流下的定位鲁棒性，并带来更高效探索。
AI.conclusion: 在缺少先验流场的复杂室内气流下，将在线风场重建、物理扩散预测、不确定性加权与信息驱动规划结合，可高效、鲁棒地完成气体源定位，且计算开销低。

title: VisAlloc: Allocating Visual Supervision for On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers a promising approach to improving visual reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, not all samples benefit equally from privileged visual guidance, and uniform token supervision can dilute visually grounded signals. We propose VisAlloc, a dual-level framework combining sample-level visual filtering with token-level counterfactual reweighting. A fixed paired-teacher filter retains samples answered correctly from an evidence-centered positive crop but incorrectly from a spatially displaced negative crop. At the token level, both EMA teachers score the same student-generated response, and their absolute log-probability differences measure view sensitivity. Additional supervision targets tokens admitted by sensitivity or teacher-distribution disagreement, with shared frozen-prior, template-bigram, and student--teacher divergence gates. Inverse-frequency redistribution preserves the total additional weight within each micro-batch, while the positive teacher remains the sole distillation target. Inference requires only the full-image student. Across eight benchmarks, our 4B and 9B models achieve macro-averages of 81.44 and 84.92, outperforming Vision-OPD reproductions by 0.97 and 0.52 points, respectively. Code on GitHub: this https URL

AI.tldr: VisAlloc：面向多模态大模型视觉推理的 on-policy 自蒸馏框架，样本级用证据区正/负裁剪配对教师过滤样本，token 级用双 EMA 教师对数概率差做反事实重加权，仅训练时需要教师，推理仅用全图学生。
AI.motivation: on-policy 自蒸馏（OPSD）可提升 MLLM 视觉推理，但并非所有样本都能从特权视觉引导中获益，且逐 token 均匀监督会稀释真正依赖视觉的证据信号。需要同时做样本级筛选与 token 级加权。
AI.method: 双层框架：（1）样本级：固定配对教师过滤，仅保留“以证据为中心的正裁剪答对、而空间位移的负裁剪答错”的样本；（2）token 级：两个 EMA 教师对同一学生生成回复打分，其绝对对数概率差度量视角敏感性，结合冻结先验、模板 bigram、学生-教师散度三种门控，对高敏感或教师分布分歧的 token 追加监督；用逆频率重分配在每个 micro-batch 内保持额外权重总量不变，且正教师仍是唯一蒸馏目标。
AI.result: 在八个基准上，4B 与 9B 模型宏平均分别为 81.44 和 84.92，较 Vision-OPD 复现结果提升 0.97 与 0.52 分；推理阶段只需全图学生，无额外开销。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过样本级反事实筛选加 token 级反事实重加权，可让特权视觉监督更集中于真正视觉依赖的信号，在几乎零推理成本下稳定提升 MLLM 视觉推理表现，属于可迁移的训练侧数据/信号分配技巧。

title: MAWAM: A Multi-Agent World-Action Model for Coordinated Manipulation
summary: Every move in a robot team changes the world in which its teammates must act. Coordinated manipulation therefore calls for predicting the team's actions together with the physical future they jointly create. We introduce MAWAM, a multi-agent world-action model that jointly generates each robot's future views and executable action chunks in a single sample. Built from a pretrained single-robot world-action backbone, MAWAM jointly denoises all robots' action and future-view tokens through cross-agent attention, while preserving a separate control interface for each robot. MAWAM achieves the highest success on all three real-robot tasks (laundry-bag collection, bath-towel folding, and umbrella handover), with 67.8% mean success, 18.9 percentage points above MA-VLA trained on the same demonstrations and cameras. In simulation, MAWAM reaches 90.3% mean success on eight tasks with teams of up to four arms. Ablations show that cross-agent attention and team-stage future-video supervision both improve coordinated control: without attention, a four-arm relay falls from 95.0% to 39.0%, and without this supervision, Place Food falls from 78.0% to 47.0%.

AI.tldr: MAWAM：基于预训练单机器人world-action backbone的多智能体world-action模型，用cross-agent attention联合去噪所有机器人的动作token与未来视角token，单次采样同时生成各机器人的未来视图与可执行动作块。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协同操作中，每个机器人的动作会改变队友所处的物理世界，因此需将团队动作与共同创造的物理未来联合预测，而非独立规划。
AI.method: 在预训练单机器人world-action骨干上加cross-agent attention，对所有智能体的动作token与未来视频token做联合去噪，同时为每个机器人保留独立控制接口；引入团队阶段未来视频监督。
AI.result: 三个真实机器人任务（收洗衣袋、叠浴巾、递伞）均最优，平均成功率67.8%，比同数据同相机的MA-VLA高18.9个百分点；仿真八个任务平均90.3%（最多四臂）。消融：去掉cross-agent attention，四臂接力95.0%→39.0%；去掉团队阶段未来视频监督，Place Food 78.0%→47.0%。
AI.conclusion: joint world-action建模与跨智能体注意力对多机器人协同控制至关重要，未来视图监督提供有效的团队级物理先验。

title: Long-Range Video Presentation Attack Detection: A Three-Class Benchmark Across 1-100 m and Two Sensor Types
summary: Face presentation attack detection (PAD) systems deployed in border control and airport surveillance are constrained by a critical assumption: subjects are captured at close range, typically under one meter. No existing benchmark systematically addresses multi-distance capture, diverse environmental conditions, and concurrent spoofing and occlusion-based attacks, leaving deployed models underprepared for real-world scenarios. We introduce a video-based PAD dataset of 374,000+ frames from 261 unique identities collected across five standoff distances (1 m-100 m) under indoor and outdoor conditions using a DSLR camera (C) and a mobile sensor (M), with three-class labels: live, spoof, and props (occlusions); models are trained and evaluated on video clips rather than single frames. We fine-tune and benchmark four CNN architectures: MobileNetV3, MobileNet, EfficientNet, and ResNet-50. The higher-resolution DSLR maintains near-perfect spoof classification rate across all distances, while the lower-resolution mobile sensor degrades sharply beyond 50 m, with props classification rate dropping to 55% at 75 m for MobileNetV3. EfficientNet achieves the best overall performance (98.48% accuracy, ACER 2.01%). Generalization tests on unseen attack datasets yield 89-94% accuracy, validating cross-domain robustness. These results establish capture distance and sensor resolution as critical but underexplored axes of PAD difficulty. The dataset will be publicly released under an End-User License Agreement to support reproducible long-range PAD research.

AI.tldr: 提出一个面向远距离（1–100 m）人脸呈现攻击检测（PAD）的视频数据集：374K+帧、261个身份、5档距离、室内外、DSLR与手机双传感器，三分类标签（live/spoof/props遮挡），并基准测试四种CNN（以视频片段为输入）。
AI.motivation: 现有人脸PAD基准均假设近距（<1 m）采集，缺乏对多距离、多环境以及伪造与遮挡并发攻击的系统评测，导致部署在边检、机场监控等远距场景的模型准备不足。
AI.method: 构建多距离视频PAD基准数据集（5档距离、室内外、DSLR+移动传感器、三分类：真脸/伪造/道具遮挡），以视频片段而非单帧训练与评测；微调并对比 MobileNetV3、MobileNet、EfficientNet、ResNet-50 四种CNN骨干，并在未见攻击数据集上做跨域泛化测试。
AI.result: 高分辨率DSLR在各距离上伪造分类近乎完美；低分辨率移动端在50 m以远显著退化，MobileNetV3在75 m处props分类率降至55%。EfficientNet整体最优（98.48%准确率，ACER 2.01%），跨域泛化准确率89–94%，验证了传感器分辨率与拍摄距离是PAD难度的关键但未被充分研究的维度。
AI.conclusion: 确立了采集距离与传感器分辨率为远距PAD的核心挑战维度，数据集将按EULA公开，支撑可复现的远距离PAD研究；方法层面为常规CNN基准，无新架构或新学习范式。

title: Do Deep Stereo Models Learn Shape Priors?
summary: Localizing object boundaries is important for embodied visual systems, since small boundary errors can change the inferred geometry of physical surfaces. We study whether deep stereo models produce boundaries consistent with simple shape priors when local image and disparity cues are weak. We create a synthetic stereo dataset consisting of objects drawn from a highly constrained family of shapes, with randomized depth, slant, color and texture. Despite the simplicity of this shape space, we find that several state-of-the-art stereo models retain systematic boundary errors, even when finetuned or trained from scratch on the dataset. We then introduce a simple generative stereo model that jointly predicts disparity and a distance field representing object boundaries. The model improves boundary localization and produces contours that adhere more closely to the underlying shape space. These results expose limitations in the boundary predictions of current stereo architectures when local evidence is weak, and motivate further study of whether generative models can better combine regional grouping evidence with global geometric structure.

AI.tldr: 本文构造高约束形状空间的合成双目数据集，揭示SOTA立体匹配模型在局部证据弱时仍存在系统性边界误差，并提出联合预测视差与边界距离场的生成式立体模型以改善边界定位。
AI.motivation: 具身视觉系统需精确物体边界，微小边界误差会改变物理表面几何推断；而深度立体网络在弱局部线索下是否遵循简单形状先验尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建合成双目数据集：物体来自高度受限的形状族，随机化深度、倾斜、颜色与纹理。测试多种SOTA立体模型（微调与从头训练）；提出简单生成式立体模型，联合预测视差图与表示物体边界的距离场。
AI.result: 即使在简单形状空间上，多种SOTA模型仍保留系统边界误差，微调/重训亦无法消除；所提生成模型改善边界定位精度，轮廓更贴合潜在形状空间。
AI.conclusion: 当前立体架构在局部证据弱时边界预测存在固有局限，生成式建模有望更好地结合区域分组证据与全局几何结构。

title: TALD: Transferability-Aware Logit Disentanglement for Cross-Modal Knowledge Distillation
summary: Cross-modal knowledge distillation can incur negative transfer when source-modality supervision conflicts with the target modality's discriminative characteristics. We propose TALD, a two-stage framework for Transferability-Aware Logit Disentanglement in class-aligned logit space. Guided by task-dependent self-benefiting and cross-modal exclusivity criteria, a Residual Disentangler decomposes logits from a teacher and an independently trained target-modality reference student into modality-general and modality-specific components. A Sample-Adaptive Modulator regulates decomposition constraints and sample-specific fusion weights. The learned modality-general components are then adaptively fused to supervise the final student. Across five benchmarks spanning vision, audio, and text, TALD achieves the largest mean accuracy gain and highest positive-transfer frequency among the compared methods. Across ten transfer directions with five runs each, TALD improves over training without distillation in 84% of evaluations, compared with at most 70% for the baselines, while offering a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. We plan to release the code.

AI.tldr: TALD: 两阶段跨模态知识蒸馏框架，在类别对齐的logit空间中分解教师与目标模态参考学生的logit为模态通用/特有分量，并用样本自适应调制器控制分解约束与融合权重，以缓解负迁移。
AI.motivation: 跨模态知识蒸馏在源模态监督与目标模态判别特性冲突时会产生负迁移，需要"可迁移性感知"地筛选可用知识。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：Residual Disentangler 依据任务相关"自益性"与"跨模态排他性"准则，将教师和独立训练的目标模态参考学生的logit分解为模态通用与模态特有两部分；Sample-Adaptive Modulator 调节分解约束与样本级融合权重；再以自适应融合后的模态通用分量监督最终学生。
AI.result: 在覆盖视觉、音频、文本的五项基准上取得最大平均精度提升与最高正迁移频率；10个迁移方向×5次运行中，84%的评估优于无蒸馏训练（基线最高70%），并具良好精度-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过logit层面的可迁移性分解与样本自适应调制，可显著提升跨模态蒸馏的正迁移比例，方法通用且高效，代码将开源。

title: GEMS: Generation and Experience Memory for Subgoal-Guided Long-Horizon World Model Planning
summary: Visual world models enable effective short-horizon goal-conditioned planning, such as reaching nearby targets and pushing objects over short distances, by predicting candidate action outcomes and comparing their representations with a goal representation. However, extending this approach to long-horizon tasks is challenging: prediction errors accumulate over extended rollouts, while latent-space similarity to distant goals provides limited guidance for ranking candidate outcomes. Existing methods address these limitations by introducing intermediate subgoals, either generated by learned models or selected from experience memory. Generated subgoals can contain hallucinations or be inaccurate in aspects such as object positions and timing. Memory-based approaches are constrained by experience coverage and may lack precise guidance for selecting appropriate intermediate states from stored observations. We introduce GEMS, which generates temporally structured subgoals to guide action search and state selection from Latent Experience Memory (LEM). A distance gate determines whether predicted outcomes are evaluated against the generated subgoal or the selected memory state. Experiments across six tasks and task suites spanning manipulation, navigation, and reaching demonstrate the effectiveness of GEMS for long-horizon planning. GEMS outperforms state-of-the-art world-model planning baselines across different manipulation settings, achieving success rates of 92.8% on Cube, 68.4% on Push-T, and 54.1% on Meta-World. It improves over the strongest evaluated baseline on these tasks by 24.0, 7.3, and 22.2 percentage points, respectively. These results demonstrate that generated subgoals and experience memory can jointly strengthen long-horizon planning with a frozen world model.

AI.tldr: GEMS 结合"时间结构化生成子目标"与"潜空间经验记忆(LEM)检索状态"，并用距离门(distance gate)决定候选动作结果是比对生成子目标还是检索到的记忆状态，从而在冻结世界模型下实现长时程规划。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界模型擅长短时程目标条件规划，但长时程任务面临两个问题：多步 rollout 的预测误差累积，以及与远距离目标在潜空间的相似度不足以对候选结果排序。已有的生成式子目标存在幻觉与位置/时序不准，经验记忆法受覆盖度限制、缺乏精确的子目标选择依据。
AI.method: GEMS 生成时序结构的子目标引导动作搜索，同时从潜经验记忆中选择状态；由距离门决定预测结果是对齐生成的子目标还是选定的记忆状态，两者互补合用，且维持世界模型冻结。
AI.result: 在涵盖操作、导航、到达的六类任务及任务集上，GEMS 优于现有世界模型规划基线：Cube 成功率 92.8%（+24.0）、Push-T 68.4%（+7.3）、Meta-World 54.1%（+22.2 个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: 生成式子目标与经验记忆可协同增强冻结世界模型下的长时程规划，为世界模型规划提供了一种轻量、无需重训练世界模型的改进途径。

title: Old-School Planners Drive (Sometimes) Better Than Learned Ones
summary: End-to-end driving models learn to plan from data, and hand-written planners are widely treated as a thing of the past. We test whether this is justified: we implement sixteen textbook planners, each combining a path source (reference line, A*, hybrid A*, RRT*) with a trajectory method (Frenet lattice, nonlinear optimization, $s$--$t$ search, dynamic window), and evaluate them on three benchmarks: open loop on nuScenes, closed loop on nuPlan with ground-truth perception, and photorealistic closed loop on HUGSIM. On HUGSIM, they replace only the planner of the end-to-end model UniAD and read its frozen perception, without an HD map or other privileged information. On nuScenes and nuPlan, the best textbook planners are competitive (L2 error of 0.735\,m against 0.947\,m for UniAD's planner; a nuPlan score of 79.3 against 76.1 for the rule-based PDM-Closed on Test14-hard with reactive agents). On HUGSIM, nine of the sixteen score above UniAD's learned planner on the same perception,. The best, a hybrid A* path followed by nonlinear trajectory optimization, raises HUGSIM's driving score (HD-Score) from 32.0 to 41.8. The gain is largest with standing and oncoming cars; against cars that steer at the ego, there is none. In 31 of the 182 runs in which UniAD's planner hits a car, the best textbook planner completes the route on the same perception: these crashes are due to the planner, not the perception.

AI.tldr: The paper re-implements 16 classic (textbook) planners and plugs them into a frozen end-to-end driving stack (UniAD perception), showing they match or beat learned planners on nuScenes, nuPlan and HUGSIM.
AI.motivation: End-to-end driving models are assumed to make hand-written planners obsolete, but this claim is rarely tested fairly under identical perception.
AI.method: Sixteen planners combining a path source (reference line, A*, hybrid A*, RRT*) with a trajectory method (Frenet lattice, nonlinear optimization, s-t search, dynamic window). Evaluation: open-loop nuScenes, closed-loop nuPlan with GT perception, and photorealistic closed-loop HUGSIM where only UniAD's planner is replaced (frozen perception, no HD map/privileged info).
AI.result: Best textbook planner: L2 0.735 m vs 0.947 m for UniAD; nuPlan Test14-hard score 79.3 vs 76.1 for PDM-Closed; on HUGSIM 9/16 planners beat the learned planner on the same perception, best (hybrid A* + nonlinear optimization) lifts HD-Score 32.0→41.8; gains concentrated on standing/oncoming cars, none for steer-at-ego cases; 31/182 UniAD crash runs are completed by the best classic planner, attributing these failures to planning rather than perception.
AI.conclusion: Claiming obsolete status for hand-written planners is not justified; strong classical planning remains a competitive baseline and a diagnostic tool for isolating planner vs. perception errors.

title: CoRelate: Coordinated Human-Object Motion Synthesis through Interaction Relations
summary: Human-object motion synthesis requires coordinated human participation as objects move toward specified goals. However, reaching object targets does not ensure that contact is established and maintained, while adjustments that improve contact may interfere with task completion. We introduce CoRelate, a diffusion framework that coordinates full-body human-object motion through explicit interaction relations and task feedback for rigid and articulated objects. We represent intended participation through hand-part relations that specify the participating hand, its part-relative reference position, and participation interval. These relations serve both as generation conditions and as references for measuring interaction realization. At each denoising step, a temporal refiner trained jointly with the generator combines relation deviations, task residuals, and motion features from the current prediction to jointly update human and object motion across the sequence. After generation, temporal motion correction addresses remaining contact failures by optimizing local motion segments while preserving object trajectories and protected human motion. Experiments demonstrate improved object-goal satisfaction, contact F1, and complete interaction success over the evaluated baselines. Ablation studies support the benefits of relation conditioning and the complementary roles of task and relation feedback.

AI.tldr: CoRelate：基于扩散框架的人-物运动联合生成，用手-部件交互关系作条件与度量，并在去噪过程中融合任务残差与关系偏差进行时序细化，显著提升接触F1与任务完成率。
AI.motivation: 人-物运动合成需人手与物体协调：物体到达目标不等于接触建立并保持，而为改善接触所做的调整又可能破坏任务完成。现有方法缺乏对"预期参与方式"的显式刻画与对交互是否实现的闭环反馈。
AI.method: 提出显式手-部件关系（指定参与的手、部件相对参考位置、参与时间区间），既作为生成条件又作为交互实现度的度量参考。扩散去噪的每步中，与生成器联合训练的时间细化器融合关系偏差、任务残差与当前预测的运动特征，跨整段序列联合更新人体与物体运动（支持刚体与铰接物体）。生成后再进行时序运动校正，在保持物体轨迹与受保护人体片段的前提下优化局部运动段以修复残留接触失败。
AI.result: 实验在物体目标达成度、接触F1与完整交互成功率上优于基线；消融验证了关系条件的收益以及任务反馈与关系反馈的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: 将"交互关系"显式化并与任务残差共同作为去噪过程的反馈信号，可有效解决接触与任务目标之间的冲突，是接触丰富人-物运动生成的一种可控、可校正方案。

title: What a Calibrated Probability Hides: Belief-Level Post-Training for Decision Models
summary: A calibrated decision model can predict how often each answer is chosen. The same prediction can reflect disagreement among people who are confident in their choices or uncertainty among people who share a belief. Disagreement calls for identifying whose perspective applies, while uncertainty calls for gathering more evidence. Standard post-training scores a single prediction against one observed choice at a time, learning the pooled distribution without distinguishing these two sources of uncertainty. We introduce Belief-Grouped Policy Optimization (BGPO). The policy proposes a list of beliefs, estimates their prevalence, and predicts a choice distribution for each. During training, BGPO uses Bayes' rule to estimate how likely each belief was to generate an observed choice. These estimates weight the choice's contribution to each belief's log-score reward. To discover rare beliefs, the policy also proposes lists after seeing a few observed choices and retains them only if they predict held-out choices well. At inference, the policy uses only the question and combines the belief-specific distributions by prevalence to produce a calibrated aggregate prediction. On benchmarks covering opinions, conversation safety, emotions elicited by artwork, and photo aesthetics, BGPO achieves the lowest conditional, worst-group, and overall Jensen-Shannon divergence across model initializations. It improves conditional divergence on both text and image tasks. On a synthetic image task with known beliefs, BGPO recovers the underlying groups more accurately than baselines trained with belief labels.

AI.tldr: 提出 BGPO：策略显式提出一组“信念”（belief）、估计其流行度，并为每个信念预测选择分布；训练时用贝叶斯规则推断观测选择由各信念生成的后验并加权 log-score 奖励，从而区分“认知不确定性”与“人际分歧”，推理时仅凭问题按流行度加权聚合出校准预测。
AI.motivation: 校准决策模型给出的单一预测分布无法区分两种不确定性来源：高置信人群之间的分歧（disagreement）与同一信念下的人群不确定性（uncertainty）。二者应对策略不同（前者需识别适用视角，后者需更多证据），而标准后训练逐条样本对单一预测打分，只学到池化分布，掩盖了这一区别。
AI.method: 1) 策略生成信念列表并对每个信念输出条件选择分布及流行度估计；2) 训练中用贝叶斯规则计算观测选择由各信念生成的后验概率，作为该样本对各信念 log-score 奖励的加权系数；3) 为发现稀有信念，策略在观察少量真实选择后提出候选信念列表，仅当能很好预测留出选择时才保留（类似在线信念发现/验证）；4) 推理时无需额外选择信息，仅用问题与各信念分布按流行度混合，得到校准的聚合预测。
AI.result: 在观点、对话安全性、艺术品引发情绪、照片美学等基准上，跨多种模型初始化均取得最低的条件 JS 散度、最差组 JS 散度与总体 JS 散度；在文本与图像任务上条件散度均有改善；在具备真实信念标签的合成图像任务上，无标签的 BGPO 比使用信念标签训练的基线更准确地恢复潜在群体。
AI.conclusion: 将“信念分组+贝叶斯样本归属”引入偏好后训练，可在无信念标注下得到可解释、可区分的分歧与不确定性建模，并显著提升条件化校准与最差组鲁棒性；属于对齐/偏好学习方向的方法贡献，与具身智能核心议题关联较弱。

title: MV-JEPA: Post-Training Video Encoders for Cross-View Understanding
summary: JEPA-based video encoders learn strong representations for video and image understanding through prediction in latent space. However, their standard pretraining predicts features within individual images or video clips, without explicitly exploiting paired camera views of the same object or moment. Consequently, the learned representations may not reliably support matching across different camera viewpoints. To solve this problem, we introduce multi-view predictive post-training to strengthen cross-view instance and temporal correspondence while retaining independent single-view inference. A shared encoder processes masked context views independently, and a training-time predictor jointly predicts latent tokens for masked context regions and a fully held-out view. We alternate cross-view prediction with single-view masked prediction on general image and video data to help retain the encoder's pretrained capabilities. After only 9,000 post-training updates on a single GPU, MV-JEPA improves cross-view instance retrieval and coarse cross-camera moment retrieval on various datasets, with further gains in zero-shot action-phase retrieval and frozen-feature classification on AE2. Frozen-probe evaluations further indicate that post-training largely preserves motion recognition, image recognition, and dense semantic segmentation performance on the evaluated benchmarks. Together, these results demonstrate that multi-view predictive post-training can strengthen instance and coarse temporal correspondence in JEPA video encoders without modifying the encoder architecture or single-view inference interface.

AI.tldr: MV-JEPA 提出多视角预测式后训练：共享编码器独立处理被掩码的上下文视角，训练期预测器联合预测被掩码区域的潜变量 token 与一个完全留出的视角，并与单视角掩码预测交替训练，仅用单卡 9000 步即提升跨视角实例与粗粒度时刻检索。
AI.motivation: 现有 JEPA 类视频编码器预训练只在单图像/单片段内部做潜空间预测，未显式利用同一物体或同一时刻的配对相机视角，导致表示在跨视角匹配任务上不可靠。
AI.method: 以共享编码器处理掩码上下文视角保持单视角推理接口不变；引入仅在训练时使用的预测器，联合预测掩码上下文区域的潜 token 和整段完全留出的视角；将跨视角预测与通用图像/视频数据上的单视角掩码预测交替进行以保留原预训练能力；后训练规模为单 GPU 9000 次更新，不修改编码器结构。
AI.result: 跨视角实例检索与粗粒度跨相机时刻检索在多个数据集上均有提升，零样本动作阶段检索与 AE2 上冻结特征分类进一步提升；冻结探针评测显示运动识别、图像识别与稠密语义分割性能基本保持。
AI.conclusion: 多视角预测式后训练可在不改变编码器架构与单视角推理接口的前提下，增强 JEPA 视频编码器的跨视角实例与粗时间对应能力，且开销极低。

title: Phantom Success, Silent Failure: Auditing the Success Checkers of Simulated Manipulation Benchmarks
summary: Simulated manipulation benchmarks measure policy performance using hand-written success checkers that label each episode as a success or failure. Passing an expert demonstration shows that a checker accepts one way of completing the task. Learned policies, however, may stop after partial progress or complete the task in a different way. A checker may then accept an incomplete execution (phantom success) or reject an execution that satisfies the instruction (silent failure). In this paper, we introduce SimAudit, an LLM-based pipeline that audits success checkers against task instructions. SimAudit analyzes the instruction and checker code to identify scenarios where the two may disagree, recreates those scenarios in simulation, and runs the original checker. Multi-view renderings are then used to verify whether the observed behavior satisfies the instruction. Across RoboTwin 2.0, RoboCasa365, and RoboDojo, 183 simulated test cases produced the predicted checker verdict. Visual verification and deduplication yielded 61 distinct defects across 49 tasks, including 40 phantom successes and 21 silent failures. Most defects in RoboCasa365 accepted incomplete executions, most in RoboDojo rejected valid executions, and both error types were common in RoboTwin 2.0. These findings suggest that validating success checkers requires testing both incomplete executions and valid alternatives to expert demonstrations, and motivate more rigorous evaluation protocols for future benchmarks.

AI.tldr: SimAudit：用LLM流水线审计机器人仿真benchmark的成功检查器，发现49个任务中61个检查器缺陷（40例幻影成功、21例静默失败）。
AI.motivation: 手写success checker依赖专家演示即判定正确，但学习策略可能中途停止或走另一条合法路径，导致checker把不完整执行判成功（phantom success）或把合法执行判失败（silent failure），污染benchmark结论。
AI.method: LLM分析任务指令与checker代码，找出二者可能冲突的场景；在仿真中重建这些场景并运行原始checker；再用多视角渲染验证观测行为是否真正满足指令，从而确认缺陷。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0、RoboCasa365、RoboDojo共183个测试用例中，实际checker判定与预测一致；经视觉校验与去重得到49个任务上的61个不同缺陷（40 phantom success、21 silent failure）。RoboCasa365多为接受不完整执行，RoboDojo多为拒绝合法执行，RoboTwin 2.0两类均常见。
AI.conclusion: 验证成功判定器需同时测试不完整执行与专家演示之外的合法替代方案；现有主流操作benchmark的成功率指标存在系统性偏差，需更严格的评测协议。

title: From Self-Play RL to Constrained Control: Distilling DiffMPC Students with DAgger
comment: 18 pages, 10 main content pages, 3 figures, L4DC submission
summary: Self-play reinforcement learning (RL) produces strong driving policies, but these policies are hard to verify or interpret. Differentiable model predictive control (DiffMPC) can enforce explicit constraints, but it is usually trained by imitating logged data or with costly RL. To add constraints to an already trained policy, we keep a PPO teacher's backbone and replace its action head with a DiffMPC that enforces road boundary half-planes and agent ellipses. We then distill the student with DAgger in the teacher's self-play simulator. Over 9 seeds, the constrained student of a smaller teacher matches its teacher on nuPlan and beats it on CARLA and on out-of-distribution Waymo scenes. For a stronger teacher, the student has fewer failures on nuPlan and Waymo, while staying level on CARLA. Its distillation takes no more than 30% of the teacher's training time.

AI.tldr: 保留PPO教师骨干网络，将其动作头替换为带硬约束（道路边界半平面、智能体椭圆）的可微MPC层，在教师自博弈仿真器中用DAgger蒸馏学生，实现可控约束驾驶策略。
AI.motivation: 自博弈RL驾驶策略性能强但难以验证/解释；DiffMPC可施加显式约束，但通常依赖模仿日志数据或昂贵RL训练。作者希望在已训练策略上"追加"约束而不重训。
AI.method: 教师为学生结构：教师PPO骨干 + 学生用DiffMPC约束动作头（道路边界半平面+智能体椭圆约束）；在教师的自博弈模拟器中用DAgger逐步蒸馏学生，无需RL微调。
AI.result: 9个随机种子下：小教师的学生在nuPlan上追平教师，在CARLA与OOD Waymo场景上超过教师；强教师的学生在nuPlan和Waymo失败更少、CARLA持平；蒸馏耗时≤教师训练时间的30%。
AI.conclusion: 将显式约束MPC层作为可替换动作头+DAgger蒸馏，可在远低于完整RL成本下为既有驾驶策略注入可验证约束，并带来分布外鲁棒性提升，为"约束可解释性"提供低成本后处理方案。

title: VG-Steer: Visual-Geometric Policy Steering from In-Context Aligned Abstractions
summary: Adapting robot policies to out-of-distribution (OOD) settings with limited real-world data remains a key bottleneck to generalist robots. The multimodality and scarcity of robotics data lead end-to-end approaches to overfit and break under small distribution shifts. Test-time adaptation can alleviate this by correcting frozen policies at inference, but most methods ground their correction in a signal learned implicitly from robotic datasets, making it susceptible to the same shifts as the policy it corrects. Recent methods that instead exploit explicit spatial information are typically limited to coarse corrections, missing the nuanced, task-relevant motion most manipulation tasks require. We propose VG-Steer, which corrects existing policies by transferring the nuanced motion of successful in-distribution rollouts, captured along meaningful geometric axes, known here as object-relational distance pairs. VG-Steer leverages the semantic understanding of Large Vision Models (LVMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) reasoning, which combines the task-relevant entity pairs and their object-relational distance projections into a single tailored visual-geometric guidance signal. In a simulation benchmark, it efficiently corrects flow-matching policies under pose and task-goal shifts; on a real robot experiment, it widens the region of the workspace the frozen policy covers, more than doubling its success rate on cable placements one grid step outside the training positions, and steers a single-task policy toward objects it was never trained on while nearly eliminating object confusion. Project website: this https URL

AI.tldr: VG-Steer 利用 LVM/VLM 语义理解，构建"物体-关系距离对"（object-relational distance pairs）的视觉-几何引导信号，将成功且分布内的 rollout 中的细腻运动迁移到冻结策略上，实现测试时自适应，纠正位姿与任务目标偏移下的流匹配策略。
AI.motivation: 机器人数据稀缺且多模态，端到端策略易过拟合，小分布偏移即失效。现有测试时自适应方法的纠正信号多隐式学自机器人数据，与策略同样受分布偏移影响；而利用显式空间信息的方法纠正过于粗糙，难以刻画操作任务所需的细腻、任务相关的运动。
AI.method: 提出 VG-Steer：冻结原策略，从分布内成功 rollout 中提取沿几何轴（物体-关系距离对）的运动特征；用 LVM/VLM 推理选出任务相关实体对，并投影其物体-关系距离，组合成定制化的视觉-几何引导信号，在推理时引导（steer）策略动作输出。
AI.result: 仿真基准中可高效纠正姿态偏移与任务目标偏移下的 flow-matching 策略；真机实验中扩展冻结策略覆盖的工作空间区域，在训练位置外一个网格步的线缆放置任务上成功率提升一倍以上，并可将单任务策略导向从未训练过的物体，几乎消除物体混淆。
AI.conclusion: 以显式视觉-几何关系作为纠正信号，可在极少真实数据下实现细粒度测试时自适应，兼顾泛化与精度；为核心策略泛化问题提供了一种轻量、可插拔的框架。

title: Crisis Governance at the Joints. Mapping the Ethical and Societal Territory of Crisis Management Technologies: The Case of Human-Swarm Teaming
summary: Crisis and disaster governance increasingly relies on technologies that sense, classify and act faster than humans can. Drone swarms coordinated with human operators, known as human-swarm teaming, provide a productive case to review the field of crisis governance. They promise better situational awareness in disaster response, but they also raise questions about human control, responsibility, surveillance, triage, dual use and public legitimacy. This report maps the ethical and societal territory that HST opens up. It unpacks this territory with a 3i-framework, the Interface, where operators and swarms work together, the Infrastructure, where organisations distribute tasks, decisions and blame, and the Imaginary, where law, policy and shared societal assumptions define what a crisis is and which interventions it justifies. The central claim is that these concerns cannot be addressed one level at a time. Many of the most pressing problems, such as responsibility gaps and the erosion of meaningful human control, arise at the joints between levels, through four translations, habits harden, routines become stories, principles become procedures, and procedures become prompts. Drawing on a critical review of literature across philosophy of technology, political theory, moral psychology, philosophy of mind, AI ethics, and critical disaster and security studies, the report develops this framework, illustrates it with two worked examples, and derives design and governance implications and a set of questions for developers, emergency organisations and policymakers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"3i框架"（Interface接口、Infrastructure基础设施、Imaginary想象层）以系统梳理人-集群协同（HST）在危机与灾难治理中的伦理与社会问题，主张责任缺口与"有意义的人类控制"侵蚀等问题发生在层级之间的四种"转译"环节（习惯固化为规则、常规化为叙事、原则化为程序、程序化为提示）。
AI.motivation: 危机治理日益依赖比人类感知与决策更快的技术（如无人机集群），HST虽有提升态势感知的潜力，但同时带来人类控制、责任归属、监控、分诊筛选、双重用途与公共合法性等伦理问题，既有讨论往往逐层处理而忽视跨层耦合，缺少统一的分析框架。
AI.method: 批判性文献综述，横跨技术哲学、政治理论、道德心理学、心灵哲学、AI伦理以及批判性灾难研究与安全研究，构建三层级3i框架并识别四类跨层"转译"机制，配以两个具体案例（worked examples）加以阐释。
AI.result: 框架说明多数最紧迫的问题（责任缺口、有意义人类控制的侵蚀）并非源于单一层级，而是产生于界面—基础设施—想象层之间的接缝，经"习惯→规则、常规→叙事、原则→程序、程序→提示"的转译而固化。
AI.conclusion: 伦理与治理议题不能逐层孤立解决；据此推导出面向开发者、应急机构与政策制定者的设计与治理启示，并提出一组待答问题清单。

title: Identity World Model: Recognizing People in an Imagined Latent World
summary: Whole-body human recognition has advanced rapidly with large vision models. However, existing methods remain fragile under real-world variations, as they tie identity to transient cues such as clothing, texture, pose, or viewpoint. We argue that a robust recognizer should not merely learn to ignore these cues, but imagine how a person would be represented if they changed. To this end, we propose IDWorld, an identity world model: just as a latent world model predicts the features of a scene after an action, IDWorld predicts how a person would be represented under a changed condition. In a single forward pass, IDWorld imagines these counterfactual features under shared canonical conditions, such as the same outfit, a fixed view, or a bare silhouette, without rendering any pixels. Compared with explicit imagination in pixels, this latent imagination keeps nearly the same accuracy while being over 11x faster, at 5.9 ms per frame. Since each imagined condition has its own strengths, IDWorld then fuses them adaptively, weighting each condition for every probe-gallery pair. Extensive experiments show that IDWorld achieves state-of-the-art results on CCPG and CCGR-MINI, outperforms the compared methods on MEVID, and generalizes best to CASIA-B* and SUSTech1K, with the best mAP on CCVID. These results suggest identity world models offer a simple yet effective path to robust recognition. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: IDWorld 将"身份世界模型"应用于全身行人重识别：在潜空间中一次性预测同一身份在统一规范条件（同衣着、固定视角、裸轮廓）下的反事实特征，并自适应融合多条件结果。
AI.motivation: 现有全身行人识别依赖大视觉模型，但把身份绑定在衣着、纹理、姿态、视角等瞬态线索上，真实场景下脆弱。作者主张不应仅"学会忽略"这些线索，而应"想象"人物在这些条件改变后的表示。
AI.method: 类比潜世界模型预测动作后场景特征，IDWorld 在单次前向中以纯潜空间方式预测反事实特征（不渲染像素），共享规范条件包括同套服装、固定视角、裸轮廓；随后对每个 probe-gallery 对按条件自适应加权融合，利用各条件互补优势。
AI.result: 潜空间想象相比像素级显式想象精度几乎不降，速度提升 11 倍以上（5.9 ms/帧）。在 CCPG、CCGR-MINI 上取得 SOTA，在 MEVID 上优于对比方法，在 CASIA-B*、SUSTech1K 上泛化最佳，CCVID 上取得最佳 mAP。
AI.conclusion: 身份世界模型为鲁棒的全身行人识别提供了一条简单有效的路径，验证了"潜空间反事实想象+多条件自适应融合"的范式价值。代码将开源。

title: Recurrent Vision Language Models Solve the Shell Game
summary: Tracking a hidden object through a video is effortless for humans, yet it remains a bottleneck for vision language models (VLMs). In the shell game, where a ball is hidden under one of several identical cups that are then swapped, VLMs that answer directly stay near chance, thinking models fail on long games, and fine-tuning learns only the lengths it has seen. We argue that the limit is serial computation: each swap must be composed with the last result, and a VLM of fixed depth has only a fixed number of state transitions for it. To address this, we propose RecurrentVLM, which makes every attention layer of a pretrained VLM recur over time by computing the keys and values of finished frame groups from the layer's own output. With a single answer token, RecurrentVLM reaches 100% on VET-Bench and 99.6% on MET-Bench, and 99% on 50-swap games after training on at most 30 swaps. We also observe several interesting phenomena: length generalization emerges suddenly at an aha moment; without recurrence, each swap costs an attention layer; the ball's state forms in the first four attention layers; and recurrence keeps the latest state at the cost of details of earlier moments. These results suggest that recurrent VLMs are a potential solution for tracking the states of unobserved objects in video. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出 RecurrentVLM：让预训练 VLM 每层注意力沿时间对已完成帧组的 KV 做循环计算，实现串行状态追踪（shell game 隐藏球追踪），单答案 token 达 VET-Bench 100%、MET-Bench 99.6%，30 swap 训练后在 50 swap 上 99%。
AI.motivation: 视频中追踪被遮挡/隐藏物体的状态需要串行计算：每次交换必须与上次结果复合，而固定深度 VLM 的状态转移次数受层数限制，因此直接回答接近随机、推理模型在长序列上失败、微调只学到训练过的长度。
AI.method: 在预训练 VLM 的每个注意力层上引入时间维度的循环：用时序上已完成帧组在该层自身输出计算 keys/values 并递推，使每层承担一次状态转移，从而把串行状态更新显式化。
AI.result: 单答案 token 下 VET-Bench 100%、MET-Bench 99.6%；仅用 ≤30 次 swap 训练在 50 次 swap 达 99%。并观察到：长度泛化在"aha moment"突现；无循环时每次 swap 需一层注意力；球状态在前四层注意力已形成；循环保留最新状态但牺牲早期时刻细节。
AI.conclusion: 循环化 VLM 是追踪视频中未观测物体状态的可行方向，核心洞见是串行状态计算应按层展开；代码将开源。

title: Bridging vision-language reasoning and learned control for legged navigation in the wild
comment: 42 pages, 6 figures, 15 supplementary figures. Author's version of the article published in Science Robotics. Project page: this https URL
summary: Autonomous navigation in diverse real-world environments remains one of the greatest challenges in robotics. It demands both robust low-level motion control to handle diverse terrain and high-level reasoning to interpret environmental cues. We present ROAM (Robust Open-world Autonomous Mobility), a system that enables legged robots to perform kilometer-scale navigation in complex alpine and urban settings. ROAM combines the world knowledge of a Vision-Language Model (VLM), pre-trained on internet-scale data, with robust locomotion and local planning policies learned in simulation via reinforcement learning (RL). The VLM provides common-sense reasoning and semantic interpretation of the scene, assessing risks, interpreting signs, and producing semantic labels with associated navigation costs. An open-vocabulary segmentation module converts these labels into a dense, real-time risk map, which conditions two pre-trained RL policies responsible for agile locomotion and local navigation, effectively coupling high-level VLM reasoning with low-level physical control. Real-world experiments showed the system's ability to autonomously navigate a wide range of complex real-world environments. The robot completes kilometer-long hikes with minimal intervention, interprets signs to avoid danger, and evaluates its environment to identify safe areas on which to step. This work represents a step toward the reliable deployment of systems in unstructured environments. However, it also underscores the challenges that remain in VLM reliability and spatial reasoning, indicating that foundational models are a crucial component but not yet a complete solution for navigation in the wild.

AI.tldr: ROAM 将 VLM 的世界常识推理与仿真强化学习训练的足式运动/局部规划策略耦合，通过开放词表分割把语义标签转为实时稠密风险图，实现高山与城市场景公里级自主导航。
AI.motivation: 野外自主导航需同时具备应对多样地形的鲁棒底层运动控制与解读环境线索的高层推理能力，单一模块难以兼顾；作者希望把基础模型的语义常识与经典 RL 策略的物理可靠性结合，推进非结构化环境中的可靠部署。
AI.method: 系统由三部分构成：（1）互联网规模数据预训练的 VLM 负责场景语义理解、风险评估、标志牌解读，并输出带导航代价的语义标签；（2）开放词表分割模块将标签实时转成稠密风险图；（3）两个仿真 RL 预训练策略（敏捷运动策略与局部导航策略）以该风险图为条件进行低层控制，形成高层 VLM 推理与低层物理控制的紧耦合。论文未给出具体网络结构与训练细节。
AI.result: 真实世界实验表明系统可在高山与城市等多种复杂环境中自主导航：以极少人工干预完成公里级徒步，能解读标志牌以规避危险，并评估地形以选择安全落脚区域。论文同时指出 VLM 在可靠性与空间推理方面仍存在明显局限。
AI.conclusion: VLM+RL 分层耦合是野外长程足式导航的可行范式，基础模型是关键组成部分但尚非完整解；后续需重点提升 VLM 可靠性、空间推理能力及其与底层控制的闭环一致性。

title: Reject and Report: Forgery-Evident Undetectable Watermarks for Generative Image Models
summary: Provenance schemes such as those based on content watermarks let images from a generative model be traced back to it. A practical watermarking scheme must be accurate at a low false-positive rate (FPR), robust under content-preserving processing, and undetectable. In addition, it must resist forgery; otherwise, even from a single watermarked image and a surrogate model, an adversary can imprint the watermark onto an arbitrary image or regenerate new content that carries it, falsely attributing harmful content to a model or making authentic photographs appear AI-generated. We argue that a watermarking scheme should not only reject forgeries but also report them: a forgery rejected as unwatermarked leaves no trace of the attempt. State-of-the-art forgery-resilient undetectable watermarking schemes, such as SemBind, fall short on both counts. External anomaly detectors that do report forgeries either miss most of them or falsely flag genuine images after common processing. We propose Tripwire-WM, the first forgery-evident framework for undetectable watermarks. It commits the semantics of the generated image to the magnitudes of the initial latent noise, which the sign-based watermarks leave unused, through a distribution-preserving embedding; a forged image carries a valid watermark but with a commitment that does not match its content, so the detector both rejects it and reports it as forged. Built on the pseudorandom code (PRC) watermark and Gaussian Shading++, Tripwire-WM provably preserves their undetectability. On MS-COCO, with the owner's own model as the surrogate, it accepts no imprinting forgery, compared with up to 55.0% for SemBind, and reports all of them as forged; it also accepts at most 1.8% of reprompting forgeries, against up to 46.2% for SemBind. Meanwhile, it accepts at least 99% of genuine watermarked images at 10^{-6} FPR and matches the robustness of the base schemes.

AI.tldr: Tripwire-WM: the first forgery-evident framework for undetectable image watermarks, binding image semantics into the magnitudes of initial latent noise so forged watermarks are both rejected and reported.
AI.motivation: 现有不可检测水印（如 SemBind）只能拒伪但不能报告伪造，被拒绝的伪造尝试无痕迹；外部异常检测器又会漏报或误报真实图像。作者主张水印方案应同时"拒伪且举伪"。
AI.method: 利用 sign-based 水印（PRC、Gaussian Shading++）未使用的初始潜噪声幅值，通过保分布嵌入把生成图像语义承诺到幅值中；伪造图像虽带合法水印，但其承诺与内容不匹配，检测器据此既拒绝又判定为伪造。理论证明保持不可检测性。
AI.result: MS-COCO 上以攻击者自身模型为代理：imprinting 伪造接受率 0%（SemBind 最高 55.0%）且全部报告为伪造；reprompting 伪造接受率 ≤1.8%（SemBind 最高 46.2%）；10^-6 FPR 下真实水印图接受率 ≥99%，鲁棒性与基座方案持平。
AI.conclusion: 将"内容—噪声幅值"绑定作为伪造证据是一种轻量且可证明安全的思路，补齐了不可检测水印缺少伪造可追溯性的缺口。

title: MKA: Evaluating Multimodal Knowledge Agents on end-to-end professional tasks
summary: We introduce the Multimodal Knowledge Agent (MKA) benchmark, which measures how well autonomous agents perform end-to-end professional knowledge work that depends on visual understanding. Each task requires an agent to extract and combine information from multiple visually dense files, such as CAD blueprints, electronics schematics, radiographs, complex charts and geospatial maps, and to produce a standalone deliverable in .xlsx, .pptx, .pdf, .docx, .html or .png format. Existing benchmarks leave this capability largely untested: removing image-viewing tools leaves Gemini 4 Carbon's score on GDPval unchanged, and single-format evaluations such as GDP$.$pdf and GDP$.$xlsx do not require reasoning across files or modalities. MKA contains 200 tasks across 10 economic sectors. Deliverables are graded against expert-weighted rubrics by a sandboxed agentic autorater that agrees with human domain experts on 96.2% of criterion judgments in our expert-graded study (Cohen's $\kappa = 0.91$), scored by weighted satisfaction rate (WSR) overall and on frontier criteria unsaturated by prior-generation models (Climb-WSR). Across the frontier models we evaluate (Gemini 4 Carbon, Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Opus 5.5, and GPT-6 Astra), Claude Fable 5.2 (56.6% Climb-WSR, 73.3% Overall WSR) and Gemini 4 Carbon (54.3% Climb-WSR, 71.9% Overall WSR) achieve the highest scores, while Carbon uses $5.7\times$ fewer tokens. Even for the strongest models, Climb-WSR remains below 57%, leaving substantial headroom for multimodal agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 MKA 基准：200 个跨 10 个经济部门的任务，要求智能体从多份视觉密集文件（CAD 图纸、电路原理图、影像、图表、地理图）中抽取并融合信息，产出 xlsx/pptx/pdf/docx/html/png 交付物，用专家加权评分卡+沙箱化 agentic autorater 打分（与人类专家一致率 96.2%，κ=0.91）。
AI.motivation: 现有基准未测试"依赖视觉理解的专业知识工作"这一能力：移除图像查看工具后 Gemini 4 Carbon 在 GDPval 上分数不变；单格式评测（GDP.pdf、GDP.xlsx）不要求跨文件、跨模态推理。
AI.method: 构建 200 任务、10 行业的多模态知识工作基准；任务输入为多份视觉密集文件，输出为独立交付文件；用专家加权 rubric 与沙箱化 agentic autorater 自动判分，专家研究验证其与人类领域专家在 96.2% 的评分条目上一致（κ=0.91）；指标为加权满足率 WSR 及针对前代模型未饱和前沿条目的 Climb-WSR。
AI.result: 在 Gemini 4 Carbon、Claude Fable 5.2、Claude Opus 5.5、GPT-6 Astra 上评测：Claude Fable 5.2（Climb-WSR 56.6%，Overall WSR 73.3%）与 Gemini 4 Carbon（54.3%，71.9%）最优，且 Carbon 用量少 5.7 倍 token；即使最强模型 Climb-WSR 仍低于 57%。
AI.conclusion: 多模态视觉知识工作对当前前沿智能体仍是开放挑战，存在显著提升空间；MKA 提供了一个高保真、可扩展的自动评测框架，但本文未提供方法层面的建模创新。

title: Ferrofluid Shape Control with Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Ferrofluids are liquids containing magnetic nanoparticles, enabling shape control through external magnetic fields. This deformability supports their use as soft robotic bodies that can navigate confined spaces and manipulate objects. Their nonlinear continuum dynamics, however, make reliable control challenging. Existing work shows how spatial magnetic fields from electromagnet arrays can establish and maintain desired ferrofluid configurations. A complementary objective is to exploit the fluid's dynamics under limited actuation to reach prescribed shapes that may not be sustainable at equilibrium. Here, we use deep model-based reinforcement learning to control these transient shapes. Learning directly through physical interaction, our policies select current commands for a single fixed electromagnet based on visual observations, guiding the moving ferrofluid toward prescribed geometries. The learned policies repeatedly attain a variety of shapes spanning polygons, asterisks and pentominoes. These results demonstrate that learning directly from physical interaction enables reliable fluid shaping, opening new possibilities for controlling ferrofluid-based soft robots.

AI.tldr: 用深度基于模型的强化学习（直接物理交互）从视觉观测学习策略，对单个固定电磁铁施加电流指令，使铁磁流体到达多边形、星形、五格骨牌等瞬态目标形状。
AI.motivation: 铁磁流体可在外磁场下变形，适合作软体机器人本体，但其非线性连续介质动力学难以可靠控制；既有工作依赖多电磁铁阵列维持平衡构型，而如何在有限驱动条件下利用流体瞬态动力学到达不可稳态保持的指定形状仍是空白。
AI.method: 构建基于视觉观测的策略：输入图像观测，输出单个固定电磁铁的电流指令；采用深度基于模型的强化学习，直接在真实物理交互中训练，以引导运动中的铁磁流体逼近预设几何形状。属真实世界（in-world）策略学习，无仿真到真实的迁移环节。
AI.result: 学习到的策略可重复达到多种目标形状，包括多边形、星形（asterisks）和五格骨牌（pentominoes），表明在单磁铁有限驱动下仍可实现可靠的流体形状控制。
AI.conclusion: 直接从物理交互中学习可在有限驱动下实现可靠的铁磁流体瞬态形状控制，为铁磁流体软体机器人控制提供新途径；但结论基于单执行器设定，泛化性、形状精度量化与实时性未充分报告。

title: Beyond Restoration: Content-Degradation Factor Unfolding for Real-World Concealed Object Segmentation
summary: Reliable visual perception under degradation requires distinguishing task-relevant content from degradation-induced variations, especially in concealed object segmentation (COS), where foreground cues are inherently weak. The central challenge is not merely improving visibility, but identifying reliable content evidence amid degradation-induced variations. RGB-space segmentation often entangles content and degradation cues, while restoration-based methods primarily focus on image recovery and task interaction. This motivates explicit factorization to distinguish content evidence from degradation effects and assess its reliability. Retinex provides a spatially aligned basis for this separation but remains illumination-centric. We therefore extend it to content-degradation formation with task-asymmetric factor roles. The Factor Unfolding Network (FUN) uses the content factor R as the sole source of direct semantic evidence for segmentation, while the degradation factor L captures degradation-related variations and generates a spatial reliability map to calibrate this evidence. A unified energy couples observation formation with reliability-weighted foreground-background separation, and its alternating updates yield a coarse-to-fine network without clean-image supervision. In this way, FUN factorizes degradation for perception rather than removing it. Extensive experiments across clean and degraded conditions and diverse segmentation tasks demonstrate robust performance and generalization. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出因子展开网络FUN，将Retinex扩展为"内容-退化"成像分解（R为语义证据唯一来源，L生成空间可靠性图进行校准），通过统一能量交替优化展开为无需干净图监督的由粗到细网络，用于退化条件下伪装目标分割。
AI.motivation: 退化条件下的可靠视觉感知需要区分任务相关内容与退化引起的变异，在伪装目标分割（COS）中前景线索本就微弱。RGB空间分割易将内容与退化线索纠缠，恢复类方法侧重图像复原与任务交互而非显式解耦，因此需要显式分解并评估内容证据的可靠性。
AI.method: 将Retinex（空间对齐但以光照为中心）扩展为内容-退化形成模型，赋予因子任务非对称角色：内容因子R作为分割的直接语义证据来源，退化因子L刻画退化变异并生成空间可靠性图以校准该证据；构建耦合观测形成与可靠性加权前景-背景分离的统一能量泛函，其交替更新展开为粗到细网络，无需干净图像监督。
AI.result: 在干净与退化条件、以及多种分割任务上的广泛实验表明方法具有稳健性能与良好泛化能力（摘要未给出具体数值增益）。
AI.conclusion: FUN以"为感知而分解退化、而非先去除退化"的范式实现内容证据与退化效应的显式解耦及可靠性校准，为退化条件下的分割提供了可展开的优化驱动框架。

title: Verify2Act: Critic-Guided Latent World Models for Verifying Language-Conditioned Manipulation Plans
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) can propose multi-step manipulation plans, but they have no grounded model of how a scene will change, and the pixel-level world models that could check those plans are slow and drift over long horizons. We present Verify2Act, a modular verification framework that separates semantic action proposal from latent physical verification. A VLM proposes candidate plans, a latent world model (V2A-WM) imagines each of them in the DINOv2 feature space, and a dual-head critic checks the imagined rollouts for temporal consistency and goal satisfaction before anything is executed. V2A-WM extends recent flow-matching world models with cross-attention action grounding and a causal temporal history window. We deploy the full system on a low-cost robot arm, training the world model and critic only on data generated in a digital twin. Across six language-conditioned tasks, Verify2Act reaches 83.3\% task success, compared with 61.7\% for a latent world model without our architectural changes, 53.3\% for the VLM alone, and 46.7\% for a pixel-diffusion world model. It verified every plan it executed and incurred no planning-induced failures: all of its failed episodes were caused by low-level grasp or placement slips. In simulation, Verify2Act obtains the highest five-task chain success on CALVIN among the compared baselines with 30$\times$ fewer reflective VLM calls than pixel-diffusion verification, and the highest success on cluttered nut assembly.

AI.tldr: 提出 Verify2Act 模块化验证框架：VLM 生成候选操作计划，用潜空间世界模型（DINOv2 特征空间流匹配 + 动作交叉注意力 + 因果时序窗口）想象rollout，再由双头 critic 检查时序一致性与目标达成后才执行；仅在数字孪生数据训练，实机六任务达 83.3% 成功率（VLM 单独 53.3%，像素扩散世界模型 46.7%）。
AI.motivation: VLM 能提出多步操作计划，但缺乏对场景将如何变化的有依据建模；像素级世界模型验证计划速度慢且长时域漂移。需要一种快速、稳定的"先验证后执行"机制来抑制规划层失败。
AI.method: 将语义动作提议与潜空间物理验证解耦：VLM 给出候选计划 → V2A-WM 在 DINOv2 特征空间用流匹配世界模型想象每条计划的未来 → 双头 critic 分别评估时序一致性与目标满足度 → 通过后才下发执行。V2A-WM 在流匹配世界模型上引入交叉注意力动作条件与因果时序历史窗口。世界模型与 critic 仅用数字孪生合成数据训练，部署于低成本机械臂；另在 CALVIN 上与像素扩散验证基线对比反射式 VLM 调用次数。
AI.result: 实机六项语言条件任务成功率 83.3%，显著高于无架构改动的潜世界模型（61.7%）、VLM 单独（53.3%）与像素扩散世界模型（46.7%）；所有执行计划均通过验证，失败全部来自底层抓取/放置滑移。CALVIN 五任务链成功率居对比基线之首，反射式 VLM 调用量较像素扩散验证减少 30×；杂乱螺母装配任务成功率最高。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间验证 + 轻量 critic 可作为 VLM 规划与底层控制之间高效、低延迟的中间层，且可完全由数字孪生数据训练并迁移到真实低成本硬件，把失败从规划层转移到可控的底层执行层。

title: Branch Caching After Step Distillation in Four- and Eight-Step Image Generators
summary: Can a distilled image generator save time by reusing features between its few remaining denoising steps? We study a fixed branch cache that replaces selected attention and MLP evaluations while preserving the student's noise schedule. One full trajectory and one raw-cache trajectory from the same initial noise supply a scalar correction for each branch type and reuse position. At $1024^2$, one internal reuse reduces four-step Qwen-Image-Lightning denoising time from 1.279 to 0.977 seconds. Three reuses yield $1.51\times$ speedup on eight-step Lightning and $1.53\times$ on eight-step Hyper-FLUX. We evaluate image quality on all 200 DrawBench prompts. With the reuse positions held fixed, correction improves mean same-seed image fidelity over raw reuse by 0.66 and 0.87 dB on the two Lightning students. On Hyper-FLUX the PSNR difference is 0.01 dB, while LPIPS improves from 0.1625 to 0.1546. These results measure the effect of branch caching and correction while retaining each student's original sampling grid.

AI.tldr: 提出固定分支缓存（fixed branch cache）方法：在蒸馏后少步扩散生成器的去噪轨迹中复用注意力/MLP分支特征，并用一次全轨迹与一次原始缓存轨迹估计的标量修正项校正误差，从而在保留原采样网格的同时加速推理。
AI.motivation: 蒸馏后的图像生成器仅剩极少去噪步，逐步重算全部注意力与MLP开销占比高；希望借助步间特征冗余节省时间，但直接复用会带来明显质量损失，需要廉价校正。
AI.method: 沿学生模型原噪声调度，在选定位置跳过注意力/MLP分支求值，改用缓存特征；对每类分支与复用位置，用同一初始噪声跑一次完整轨迹和一次原始缓存轨迹，估计标量修正系数；复用位置固定。
AI.result: 1024²下单次复用使4步 Qwen-Image-Lightning 耗时从1.279s降至0.977s；三次复用在8步 Lightning 与8步 Hyper-FLUX 上分别达1.51×与1.53×加速。DrawBench 200条提示下，修正较原始复用提升同种子 PSNR 0.66/0.87 dB（两个 Lightning 学生）；Hyper-FLUX PSNR 差0.01 dB，LPIPS 由0.1625降至0.1546。
AI.conclusion: 分支缓存加标量修正是低代价、可控的图像生成推理加速手段，在不改动采样网格与不使用对抗训练的前提下兼顾速度与保真度。

title: A Synthetic Multi-Modal Testbed for Security Stress Testing of Agentic Counter-UAS Systems
summary: Agentic cyber-physical systems rely on perception and state estimation to support autonomous decisions. Degraded, inconsistent, or manipulated sensor observations can therefore propagate through an autonomous pipeline and create security-relevant failures. This work presents a synthetic Counter-Unmanned Aircraft System (C-UAS) testbed developed in NVIDIA Isaac Sim for repeatable stress testing of perception and tracking algorithms supporting agentic decision-making. A simplified quadrotor follows scripted trajectories while co-located virtual sensors generate synchronized RGB, RTX LiDAR, and illustrative IR-like observations. The testbed varies target range, motion, clutter, occlusion, and sensor availability, with future stress cases including sensor dropout, temporal misalignment, cross-modal disagreement, and false observations. As an initial exemplar, a nonlinear coordinated-turn Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) is evaluated over a 20-s maneuvering trajectory using LiDAR target-centroid measurements. Position error and uncertainty are compared as LiDAR observations degrade and are lost. The framework provides a reproducible environment for studying how sensing degradation affects downstream autonomous estimation and resilience in agentic C-UAS systems.

AI.tldr: 基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim构建合成C-UAS测试床（脚本化四旋翼+RGB/RTX LiDAR/类红外虚拟传感器），用于感知与跟踪算法的可复现压力测试；示例任务为LiDAR质心量测驱动的非线性协同转弯EKF在20秒机动轨迹上的退化与失锁评估。
AI.motivation: 自主C-UAS依赖感知与状态估计，退化、不一致或被操纵的传感器观测会在自主流水线中传播并引发安全相关失效，需要可重复、可控的应力测试环境。
AI.method: 在Isaac Sim中搭建合成仿真测试床：简化四旋翼按脚本轨迹飞行，共置虚拟传感器输出同步RGB、RTX LiDAR与示意性类红外观测；可参数化目标距离、运动、杂波、遮挡与传感器可用性，后续扩展传感器丢帧、时间错位、跨模态分歧与虚假观测。示例实验采用非线性协同转弯EKF，基于LiDAR目标质心量测。
AI.result: 在20秒机动轨迹上给出EKF位置误差与不确定度随LiDAR观测退化直至丢失的变化对比，验证测试床可复现地诱发并观察估计性能衰减。
AI.conclusion: 提供一个可复现的仿真框架，用于研究传感退化如何影响下游自主估计与智能体化C-UAS系统的韧性；属测试床/基础设施性质工作，尚缺真实系统验证与新颖估计方法。

title: WEVO: World Model-Enabled VLA Optimization for Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve vision-language-action (VLA) policies beyond imitation, but humanoid exploration is unsafe and simulator RL can exploit residual sim-to-real gaps. We present WEVO, a teleoperation-free framework for post-training a whole-body humanoid VLA in an action-conditioned video world model (WM). Simulated manipulation and locomotion play data improve contact-dynamics and viewpoint-change prediction. A VLA trained on synthetic demonstrations collects 20 autonomous real robot rollouts per task to align the WM with deployment observations. The VLA, whole-body controller (WBC), and video WM then form a closed-loop RL environment with dense progress rewards. Across three real robot tasks, play data improves every evaluated WM metric and downstream policy success; video WM RL raises mean success from 23.3% to 75.0%, compared with 48.3% for real robot RL. We therefore leverage the complementary strengths of both environments: simulation provides policy initialization and broad coverage, while the video WM offers a deployment-aligned environment for policy improvement. Project website: this https URL .

AI.tldr: WEVO：免遥操作的人形全身VLA后训练框架，用动作条件视频世界模型作为RL仿真环境，仿真play数据+20条真实部署轨迹对齐WM，闭环RL将真实任务平均成功率从23.3%提升到75.0%。
AI.motivation: VLA策略的强化学习后训练面临两难：真人形机器人上的探索不安全，纯仿真RL又会利用残差sim-to-real gap（动力学与视角分布偏差）产生策略漂移。作者希望构建一个既安全又与真实部署分布对齐的RL环境。
AI.method: 以动作条件视频世界模型作为可交互环境：(1) 用仿真操作与locomotion play data训练WM，提升接触动力学与视角变化预测；(2) 用合成演示训练VLA，采集每任务20条自主真机rollout，将WM与部署观测对齐；(3) 由VLA、全身控制器WBC与视频WM组成闭环RL环境，配以稠密进度奖励进行策略后训练。
AI.result: 在三个真机任务上，play data使所有评估的WM指标提升并改善下游策略成功率；视频WM中RL将平均成功率由23.3%提升至75.0%，显著高于真机RL的48.3%。
AI.conclusion: 仿真与视频世界模型具备互补优势：仿真提供策略初始化与广覆盖，视频WM提供与部署分布对齐的环境用于策略改进；该范式实现了免遥操作、低真机试错的人形全身VLA后训练。

title: Plan your Self-Adaptation! Ontology-Mediated Task and Architecture Co-adaptation Planning for Robots
summary: Autonomous robots may need to adapt both their task plans and architectural configurations as operating conditions change. These decisions are interdependent: architectural configurations determine which actions a robot can perform, while task plans determine which capabilities are required. This paper presents PLANTA, an ontology-mediated approach to task and architecture co-adaptation that considers these dependencies during mission planning. PLANTA uses an ontology expressed in the Web Ontology Language to represent architectural alternatives and their associated functional and quality requirements, while the Planning Domain Definition Language defines task actions and mission goals. By automatically translating and integrating these models, PLANTA enables joint planning of task and reconfiguration actions. The approach uses satisficing planning and replans when changes during execution invalidate the current plan. PLANTA is evaluated in two robotic scenarios involving underwater inspection and ground navigation. The results support the feasibility of runtime co-adaptation and show lower planning time and memory consumption compared with optimal-policy generation in the evaluated navigation scenario, while producing plans of similar quality.

AI.tldr: PLANTA 用 OWL 本体表示机器人的架构备选方案及其功能/质量需求，用 PDDL 表示任务动作与任务目标，自动翻译并融合两类模型，实现任务与架构重构的联合规划，支持执行中失效后的重规划。
AI.motivation: 机器人任务规划与架构配置相互依赖：架构决定可执行动作，任务计划决定所需能力；现有工作多单独处理，未在任务规划阶段考虑这种耦合。
AI.method: 基于 OWL 本体对架构备选方案及功能、质量需求建模；PDDL 描述任务动作与任务目标；通过自动模型翻译与集成生成统一规划问题，使用 satisficing planning 联合规划任务动作与重构动作，并在执行期变化导致计划失效时重规划。
AI.result: 在水下检测与地面导航两个机器人场景中验证了运行时协同自适应的可行性；在导航场景中相比最优策略生成，规划时间与内存消耗更低，计划质量相近。
AI.conclusion: Ontology-PDDL 集成可支撑任务—架构联合规划与在线重规划，兼顾效率与计划质量，适用于运行条件多变的自主机器人系统。

title: Keel: A Frontier Model Teaches a Vision-Language Model by Rewriting Its Weights
summary: Can a frontier model repair a vision-language model (VLM) by rewriting its weights? Small reasoning VLMs such as Qwen3.5 need such a repair: in thinking mode they fall into loops on many image questions, repeating themselves until the token limit, spending the whole budget and losing the answer. The usual remedies act on the decoding, leaving the looping model as it was, or must be told what to change. Yet the cause is written in the weights. Keel, the first agentic weight-editing method for VLMs on image tasks, finds and removes it there. Told only the symptom, an editor, a frontier multimodal LLM acting as an agent, locates the cause, edits the weights and tests them, with a failure census and instruments showing it the failing images and where the VLM attends; among several editors, the harness keeps only edits that clearly reduce the failure without lowering accuracy on questions no editor saw. The repair needs no training, keeps the model's size and per-token cost, and applies to already-edited weights. The editors expose where the loops live: from the original weights, independent editors on both models trace them to the attention outputs of the middle layers, and the smaller VLM stops consulting the image inside a loop. On Qwen3.5-0.8B and Qwen3.5-2B, across six image benchmarks from visual mathematics to GUI grounding, the edit removes most loops on every benchmark and shortens answers, and the edited models are significantly more accurate than the thinking models on average; the larger one gains most on GUI grounding, a task absent from the practice questions. Because the repair lives in the weights, it combines with budget forcing where held-out questions favor it: on the best available weights, Keel has the best average accuracy on both models, significantly above every training-free baseline we compare on the larger one.

AI.tldr: Keel 是首个面向 VLM 图像任务的"智能体式权重编辑"方法：由前沿多模态大模型作为编辑器充当 agent，仅根据"思考模式下陷入循环"的症状，定位并改写权重中的致因，配合失败普查与注意力探针验证，保持模型规模与推理成本不变。
AI.motivation: 小型推理型 VLM（如 Qwen3.5）在 thinking 模式下对许多图像问题陷入自我重复循环，耗尽 token 预算而丢失答案；现有方案只作用于解码端（模型本身未修）或需人工指定改哪里。作者主张致因实际写在权重里，因此应直接在权重层面修复。
AI.method: 提出 Keel 智能体式权重编辑框架：以 frontier 多模态 LLM 作编辑器 agent，输入仅为症状描述；借助失败普查（failure census）锁定失败图像子集，并用可视化工具暴露 VLM 的注意力位置；agent 定位致因层后直接编辑权重并在留出问题上测试，harness 仅在"显著降低失败率且不损害未见问题准确率"时保留该次编辑。无需训练，不改变模型体量与 per-token 成本，可作用于已被编辑过的权重，且可与 budget forcing 组合。
AI.result: 多个独立编辑器在两个模型上一致将循环溯源到中间层注意力输出；较小编码 VLM 在循环中停止参考图像信息。在 Qwen3.5-0.8B 与 Qwen3.5-2B、六个图像基准（视觉数学到 GUI grounding）上，编辑基本消除各基准上的循环并缩短回答长度，平均准确率显著高于 thinking 模型，较大模型在未出现在练习题中的 GUI grounding 上提升最大；与 budget forcing 组合后，在最佳可用权重上两模型平均准确率最优，较大模型显著优于所有无训练基线。
AI.conclusion: 循环失败是可定位、可编辑的权重级缺陷，权重编辑可作为解码端手段（如 budget forcing）的正交补充；agent 驱动的"症状→工具诊断→权重编辑→留出验证"闭环为 VLM 修复提供无需训练的新范式，但目前证据限于小模型与图像基准。

title: Real Cameras are Radiometric
summary: We propose the radiometric camera, a model that lifts any central geometric camera model to a radiometric one. The lifted model keeps the projection of the geometric model and adds a finite aperture, a free-form focus surface and a generic vignetting function. We calibrate it by inverse rendering directly on the relative irradiance of the sensor, from the same images of standard calibration targets used in geometric calibration. Geometric calibration absorbs the bias of its feature detections. The proposed radiometric calibration uses no features, and our radiometric cameras have lower reprojection errors on held-out test sets. The focus surface extends defocus modeling from the thin lens to any central camera, and we use it in a first multi-view radiometric reconstruction, which recovers the in-focus reflectance of a texture from defocused images. The vignetting is estimated jointly and accurately reproduces a flat field measured through a diffuser. Because every standard camera model lifts to a radiometric one, the radiometric camera naturally and directly extends generative scene models beyond multi-view geometry to multi-view radiometric ones, where phenomena such as lighting and attenuation can be accurately estimated.

AI.tldr: 提出"辐射度相机"(radiometric camera)：将任意中心几何相机模型提升为辐射度模型，保留原投影并加入有限孔径、自由形式对焦面与通用渐晕函数，通过逆渲染标定。
AI.motivation: 传统几何相机标定只建模投影，忽略孔径、离焦与渐晕等辐射度效应；特征检测带来的偏差会被几何标定吸收。作者希望用同一套标准标定板图像、无需特征地同时恢复几何与辐射度参数。
AI.method: 将几何模型"提升"：在投影之上叠加有限孔径、自由形式焦曲面和通用渐晕函数；直接对传感器相对辐照度做逆渲染标定，不使用特征点，采用与几何标定相同的标定板图像。
AI.result: 辐射度相机在留出测试集上重投影误差低于特征驱动的几何标定；首次实现多视角辐射度重建，从离焦图像恢复纹理的清晰反射率；联合估计的渐晕能准确复现通过漫射板测得的平场。
AI.conclusion: 由于任何标准相机模型都能提升为辐射度模型，该方法可将生成式场景模型从多视角几何自然扩展到多视角辐射度，从而准确估计光照、衰减等物理现象。

title: Accord: Universal Online Metric Localization and Dense Mapping from one Camera and an IMU
summary: Dense metric mapping from a single camera and IMU remains challenging: visual-inertial odometry (VIO) provides metric motion but sparse geometry, whereas feed-forward depth models predict dense structure without ensuring metric scale. We present Accord, which constructs an accurate online dense metric map from any camera with an IMU. A VIO filter publishes metric poses, a depth foundation model conditioned on them predicts depth for short keyframe windows, and a factor graph fuses the resulting submaps. Recent work has explored several approaches to this problem. What is essential is the multi-view agreement (Accord), which is considered in SLAM as a source of geometric self-consistency. Accord anchors each keyframe window to metric 3D points triangulated from the filter poses, then exploits bidirectional dense depth agreement between co-visible images to estimate and correct per-image scale errors while preserving the metric scale established by the anchors. Context keyframes further improve depth prediction, and the resulting submaps are fused in a factor graph. We evaluate a single mapping configuration across five public camera-IMU setups and a new Phone-rig/GoPro dataset. With nothing tuned per dataset/setup and every map aligned only by Accord's own trajectory, Accord achieves consistently best/second-best mean F-score at 5 cm on every platform. Accord is open-source along with the phone-rig dataset for the benefit of the research community

AI.tldr: Accord 用 VIO 度量位姿锚定深度基础模型，并通过双向多视图深度一致性估计并校正逐图尺度误差，在因子图中融合子图，实现单目+IMU 的在线稠密度量建图。
AI.motivation: VIO 提供度量运动但几何稀疏，前馈深度模型给出稠密结构却缺乏度量尺度；如何以单一配置在任意相机+IMU 上获得准确、度量一致的在线稠密地图仍是难题。
AI.method: VIO 滤波器输出度量位姿；以其为条件驱动深度基础模型对短关键帧窗口预测深度；用滤波位姿三角化出的度量 3D 点锚定每个窗口，利用共视图像间双向稠密深度一致性估计并校正逐图尺度误差（保持锚点给出的度量尺度）；引入上下文关键帧提升深度预测质量；最终在因子图中融合各子图。
AI.result: 单一建图配置、无任何数据集/硬件调参，仅用 Accord 自身轨迹对齐，在五个公开相机-IMU 平台及新提出的 Phone-rig/GoPro 数据集上，5 cm 阈值平均 F-score 均达到最优或次优。
AI.conclusion: 多视图一致性（Accord）是稠密度量 SLAM 的有效几何自洽来源；方法具备跨平台的零调参泛化能力，并开源代码与新数据集，可作为相机-IMU 稠密建图的实用基线。

title: Persistent Identity in Person Tracking: Online Enrollment and Registered Recognition
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. An earlier version of this paper was submitted to an IEEE conference
summary: We extend PoseTReID with online appearance-bank matching (Gallery) and a residual-conflict guard for registered SVM recognition. All methods use supplied ground-truth (GT) person boxes. We average all-box assessment IDF1/HOTA equally across videos. On six SportsMOT clips, StrongSORT leads standalone trackers (79.44/84.72%) and exceeds both Gallery variants. Over eleven videos, Gallery AIN (83.29/85.44%) and COPE (84.66/86.38%) exceed standalone trackers with complete results. This lead depends on two retrospectively added GTA development compilations and is absent on the original nine videos.
