Registered SVMs lead both cohorts among complete results, with AIN at 95.72/94.82% over eleven videos. They use every GT crop from approximately 20% of frames, including future appearances. On MOT20-03, registered AIN reached 96.80% IDF1 and assigned the correct enrolled name to 90.72% of assessment GT observations. Gallery and standalone trackers receive no per-video labelled enrollment. Both identity routes restore identities across internal title cards, but Gallery trails SORT on three videos (four in HOTA) and both SVMs trail SORT on MOT16-04/MOT20-03. Under six-clip persistent-only scoring, native Gallery gains 2.39 percentage points in mean IDF1 over a matched control, with lower correct-P coverage and 5.02 times as many encoder attempts. Pose gating is mixed; the guard's metric effect is not isolated.

AI.tldr: 该文在多行人跟踪身份识别框架PoseTReID上加入在线外观库(Gallery)匹配与残差冲突守卫，并用注册SVM完成已知身份识别；结论显示SVM路线(ain 95.72/94.82%)明显强于多目标跟踪器，而Gallery相对SORT的优势依赖事后追加的GTA数据编译，不稳健。
AI.motivation: 现有MOT/ReID流程对跨遮挡、跨标题卡的身份恢复能力不足，且不同身份路线(Gallery匹配 vs 注册SVM分类)缺乏统一、公平的评估；作者希望在统一GT框与均匀加权的IDF1/HOTA协议下，澄清各路线真实有效性与增益来源。
AI.method: 在PoseTReID基础上扩展在线外观库匹配(Gallery AIN、COPE两变体)与残差冲突守卫；注册SVM使用每段视频约20%帧的全部GT裁剪(含未来外观)作为注册样本；统一使用给定GT人物框、按视频等权平均all-box IDF1/HOTA；对照StrongSORT等独立跟踪器，并在6段SportsMOT、11段视频、MOT16-04/MOT20-03上比较，另设六段persistent-only评分与匹配对照实验(含正确P覆盖率与编码尝试次数统计)。
AI.result: 6段SportsMOT上StrongSORT(79.44/84.72%)优于独立跟踪器并超过两种Gallery变体；11段视频上Gallery AIN(83.29/85.44%)、COPE(84.66/86.38%)在完整结果中超过独立跟踪器，但该优势依赖两个事后追加的GTA开发编译，在原始9段视频上消失。注册SVM在完整结果中最优，AIN达95.72/94.82%；MOT20-03上AIN IDF1 96.80%，正确命名率90.72%。Gallery在3段(4段HOTA)落后SORT，两SVM在MOT16-04/MOT20-03落后SORT。persistent-only评分下Gallery较匹配对照IDF1提升2.39个百分点，但正确P覆盖率更低、编码尝试次数为5.02倍；姿态门控效果混杂，守卫的指标贡献未被单独隔离。
AI.conclusion: 身份识别性能高度依赖评估协议与数据划分：注册SVM因使用未来GT裁剪与逐视频标注注册而在指标上领先，并不代表可直接部署的在线能力；Gallery增益不稳健且计算代价高，守卫与姿态门控的作用缺乏消融证据。后续应报告无未来信息、无标注注册条件下的结果并做严格消融。

title: CalibCache: Cache-to-Full Feature Dynamics Calibration for Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers generate high-quality images, but iterative sampling remains computationally expensive. Feature caching reduces the number of full network evaluations, yet its approximation error can become more severe under short sampling schedules, where fewer full-compute steps and a coarser sampling grid can make history-based extrapolation less reliable. In this paper, we propose CalibCache, a lightweight offline calibration method that corrects systematic discrepancies between cached and full-compute feature dynamics. Specifically, CalibCache calibrates feature acceleration, defined as the second-order finite difference across sampling steps. Using only a single pair of full-compute and naive-cache trajectories at each setting, CalibCache fits scalar acceleration maps offline by centered least squares. These maps are then applied during sampling without additional full-network evaluations or online optimization. Across FLUX.1-dev and Qwen-Image on DrawBench and DiT-XL/2 on ImageNet-256, CalibCache consistently improves fidelity or generation quality over TaylorSeer under 20-step sampling at cache intervals $N=3,4,5$. At $N=5$, it reduces FLUX.1-dev LPIPS from $0.563$ to $0.429$ while achieving a $2.86\times$ denoising speedup over full-compute sampling, and lowers DiT-XL/2 FID from $16.39$ to $10.37$ relative to TaylorSeer.

AI.tldr: CalibCache: 一种离线标定方法，用单次标定轨迹拟合标量"加速度图"，校正特征缓存中二阶有限差分的系统偏差，在短采样步数下提升 DiT 采样加速的保真度。
AI.motivation: 扩散 Transformer 迭代采样开销大；特征缓存可减少全网络评估次数，但在短采样调度下（全计算步更少、采样网格更粗），基于历史外推的近似误差加剧，缓存与全计算特征动态之间存在系统性偏差。
AI.method: 将"特征加速度"定义为采样步间的二阶有限差分；在每个设置下仅用一对全计算与朴素缓存轨迹，通过中心化最小二乘离线拟合标量加速度映射；采样时直接应用该映射，无额外全网络评估或在线优化。
AI.result: 在 FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image（DrawBench）与 DiT-XL/2（ImageNet-256）上，20 步采样、缓存间隔 N=3,4,5 时均优于 TaylorSeer；N=5 时 FLUX.1-dev LPIPS 由 0.563 降至 0.429，实现 2.86× 去噪加速；DiT-XL/2 FID 由 16.39 降至 10.37。
AI.conclusion: 轻量离线标定可有效纠正缓存外推的偏差，为扩散 Transformer 采样加速提供即插即用、低成本的改进方案。

title: ScaleDiag: Diagnosing the Limits of Test-Time Scaling in GUI Grounding
comment: Accepted by ICDM@D2AI 2026 Best Paper Award
summary: GUI grounding maps a screenshot and a natural language instruction to the coordinates of the intended interface element. Existing approaches improve grounding through visual scaling, instruction scaling, and sampling scaling, yet it remains unclear which grounding bottlenecks these strategies address and where their gains saturate. To address this gap, we introduce ScaleDiag, a controlled diagnostic framework that isolates the effects of visual input, instruction information, and prediction sampling on GUI grounding by independently varying target scale and surrounding context, target-specific information and auxiliary descriptions, and candidate coverage and selection, respectively. We evaluate ScaleDiag across five benchmarks and up to eight vision-language models and find that each scaling strategy operates within a much narrower regime than commonly assumed. (1) Visual scaling is governed by target occupancy rather than a fixed crop ratio, with full-screen errors typically rescued once the target occupies only 0.32% of the cropped view, while further zooming eventually becomes harmful. (2) Instruction scaling is driven by information that identifies the target rather than description richness itself, as even ground-truth-derived attributes such as color, size, and shape are often neutral or harmful, while appearance and spatial descriptions account for over 90% of the achievable gain. (3) Repeated sampling exposes a different limitation, as correct coordinates are frequently generated but remain difficult to select, leaving 5.1--11.0 points of oracle headroom while geometric consensus provides almost no improvement. Together, these results show that test-time scaling is constrained by distinct operating regimes rather than benefiting monotonically from more visual focus, richer instructions, or additional samples. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出 ScaleDiag 诊断框架，独立控制目标尺度/上下文、指令信息量、采样覆盖率与选择三个变量，在5个基准、最多8个VLM上实测GUI grounding的三类test-time scaling的有效区间与饱和点。
AI.motivation: 现有GUI grounding工作普遍通过视觉缩放（裁剪/放大）、指令增强与重复采样提升性能，但缺乏对"这些策略究竟缓解哪个瓶颈、收益在何处饱和"的系统性归因分析。
AI.method: 构建受控诊断框架ScaleDiag，分别独立操纵（1）目标尺度和周围上下文，（2）目标特定信息与辅助描述，（3）候选覆盖与选择，从而解耦三类缩放因素的影响；在5个基准、最多8个VLM上进行大规模评测与oracle headroom分析。
AI.result: (1) 视觉缩放由目标占裁剪视图的比例（occupancy）而非固定裁剪比决定，全屏错误在目标占0.32%时基本可被纠回，继续放大会有害；(2) 指令缩放收益来自可定位目标的信息，属性描述（颜色/尺寸/形状）常中性甚至有害，外观与空间描述贡献>90%的可获得增益；(3) 重复采样下正确坐标常已被生成但难以选出，存在5.1–11.0分的oracle headroom，几何一致性投票几乎无增益。
AI.conclusion: test-time scaling对GUI grounding并非单调收益，而是受各自不同的有效区间约束；未来改进应聚焦目标占位感知的视觉调度、空间/外观定位信息注入，以及更好的候选选择/验证器而非单纯增加样本。

title: VoxForge: A Unified Foundation Model for Dense 3D Features Across MRI, CT and PET
comment: 34 pages (8-page main paper, references, and 23-page supplementary material), 7 figures. Rushil Anirudh and Jayaraman J. Thiagarajan contributed equally
summary: A unified 3D medical foundation model promises reusable, frozen features that serve a wide variety of tasks such as segmentation, classification and registration on MRI, CT and PET as well as specialist models do. Generalist models still need separate backbones for localized and global tasks, specialist models are confined to a single modality, with the concern that spanning modalities under-emphasizes fine anatomy, and both typically rely on end-to-end fine-tuning to be competitive. We present VoxForge, a single encoder that integrates recent advances in 3D architecture, self-distillation and cross-modal curricula to learn transferable features from permissively licensed MRI and CT volumes. We evaluate it strictly frozen, the test a reusable foundation model must pass, against state-of-the-art generalist and specialist models on segmentation, classification and registration across MRI and CT, and on PET, which it never sees. VoxForge has the best or tied-best average rank in every task group, serves localized and global tasks across modalities at the level of state-of-the-art specialists, and is extremely label-efficient, matching top-performing models on TotalSegmentator CT with a tenth of the labels.

AI.tldr: VoxForge：单一3D医学编码器，融合3D架构、自蒸馏与跨模态课程，从MRI/CT学习可迁移特征，冻结即可服务分割/分类/配准并跨到PET。
AI.motivation: 通用3D医学基础模型受限于局部/全局任务需不同骨干、专家模型绑定单一模态、跨模态训练易削弱细节解剖表征，且普遍依赖端到端微调才能达到竞争力。
AI.method: 构建统一3D编码器，结合近期3D架构改进、自蒸馏（self-distillation）与跨模态课程学习，在宽松许可的MRI与CT体数据上预训练；评估采用严格冻结特征（不微调），与通用及专科SOTA模型在分割、分类、配准上对比，并迁移至未见模态PET。
AI.result: 在各任务组均取得最优或并列最优平均排名；冻结特征在局部与全局任务上达到专科SOTA水平；标签效率极高，仅用1/10标注即在TotalSegmentator CT上与顶尖模型持平。
AI.conclusion: 单一冻结3D编码器可替代多骨干与多专家方案，实现跨模态、跨任务的通用医学特征复用，并显著降低标注需求。

title: Improving Imitation Policies for Multi-Phase Tasks through Residual Learning Allocation
summary: Residual reinforcement learning corrects an imitation-trained base policy using a limited budget of environment interaction. In a task with several phases, this budget must be divided among the phases, and the phase in which the base policy fails is not necessarily the phase in which a correction most improves task completion. We formalize this distinction through the completion gain: the change in full-task completion probability when, during a single phase, a state-feedback controller replaces selected components of the base policy's action. We decompose the completion gain into the probability of reaching the phase and the conditional improvement in completion from the start of the phase, and we estimate it from paired episodes. The positive estimates determine which action components the residual policy corrects and how training episodes are distributed across phases. In stochastic point-mass docking experiments, most failures occurred in the final docking phase, whereas the largest completion gain occurred in the preceding channel phase; gain-based allocation improved completion over allocation proportional to failure counts and, in a variant with a longer approach, over uniform allocation at half of the budget. In simulated bimanual robotic assembly, the completion-gain estimates were positive only for insertion and release, although few failures occurred during release; in a second assembly configuration, a residual policy trained in the release phase improved completion from held-out states at the start of release by 16.9%.

AI.tldr: 提出"完成增益"(completion gain)指标，将残余RL的预算按各阶段对任务完成概率的提升而非失败频次来分配。
AI.motivation: 残余RL的环境交互预算需在多阶段任务中分配，但基座策略失败最多的阶段不一定是纠正最能提升任务完成率的阶段，需要区分二者。
AI.method: 将完成增益定义为某阶段用状态反馈控制器替换基座策略部分动作分量时全任务完成概率的变化，并分解为到达该阶段的概率与阶段起点的条件提升，通过配对episode估计；正的增益估计决定残余策略纠正哪些动作分量及各阶段训练episode分配。
AI.result: 点质量对接实验中多数失败在最终对接阶段，但最大增益在先前通道阶段；基于增益的分配优于按失败计数和均匀分配。双臂装配仿真中仅插入与释放阶段增益为正，释放阶段失败很少；某配置下释放阶段残余策略使留出状态的完成率提升16.9%。
AI.conclusion: 失败频次与可纠正性并不一致，应以完成增益指导残余RL的预算分配与动作分量选择。

title: MoGloss: Joint Motion and Pseudo-Gloss Pretraining for American Sign Language Understanding
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: Sign language translation and recognition have been shown to benefit from various pretraining approaches. We propose a novel two-stage pretraining approach for the motion encoder, which first learns to reconstruct masked motion, followed by joint masked prediction of pseudo-gloss units and motion. Pseudo-glosses serve as an intermediate structured representation of natural language text and are obtained from the captions by a large language model. We curate a corpus of about 1,100 hours of American Sign Language from five public datasets, estimate 2D pose for all clips and define an evaluation protocol. We then reproduce state-of-the-art translation methods and evaluate them using the same train and test splits. We propose a translation model built on our pretraining strategy, and this model outperforms the previous state-of-the-art methods Uni-Sign and SHuBERT, as well as the YouTube-ASL baseline, on the How2Sign, ASL STEM Wiki and OpenASL datasets. Furthermore, the gain from the joint pretraining using motion and pseudo-gloss grows as translation data shrinks. A classifier built on the same encoder also achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on ASL Citizen isolated sign recognition and outperforms our reproduction of Uni-Sign on WLASL2000.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段运动编码器预训练方法（先掩码运动重建，再联合掩码伪语素与运动预测），并整合约1100小时ASL语料与统一评测协议。
AI.motivation: 手语翻译与识别可从预训练中获益，但缺乏合适的中层结构化监督信号与统一大规模评测基准。
AI.method: 第一阶段掩码运动重建；第二阶段用大语言模型从字幕生成伪语素单元，进行伪语素与运动的联合掩码预测；在五套公开数据集上估计2D姿态，构建约1100小时ASL语料并固定划分，复现SOTA方法做同条件对比。
AI.result: 在How2Sign、ASL STEM Wiki、OpenASL上超过Uni-Sign、SHuBERT及YouTube-ASL基线；数据越少联合预训练收益越大；同一编码器在ASL Citizen孤立手语识别达SOTA，并在WLASL2000上超过Uni-Sign复现结果。
AI.conclusion: 结构化伪语素与运动联合预训练是有效且数据高效的方案，配合统一切分评测为后续研究提供可比基线。

title: Breaking Noise Shortcuts in Self-Supervised Learning Via Noise-Aligned View Generation
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) is increasingly applied to scientific imaging domains, such as microscopy, where labels are scarce but noisy data is abundant. These domains exhibit significant signal-dependent noise, which can create a representational shortcut: since both augmented views derive from the same noisy image, the encoder can boost view agreement by also encoding noise patterns rather than semantic content. To enable noise-robust representation learning without knowledge of underlying noise models, we introduce Self-Aligned Noise Augmentation (SEANA), a drop-in module that generates noise-aware SSL views. SEANA learns an invertible variance-stabilizing transform (VST) from noisy data, then estimates the clean signal and resamples independent noise in learned VST space, requiring no clean targets, no dataset-specific denoiser training or use at inference, and no changes to the SSL objective or encoder. On CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-100 under synthetic Gaussian, Poisson-Gaussian, and multiplicative noise, SEANA improves clean-test linear-probe accuracy across contrastive/non-contrastive SSL methods, indicating higher-quality representations. On real fluorescence imaging, SEANA improves Jurkat cell-cycle stage classification by up to 28.6pp over standard SSL and 27.5pp over denoiser-preprocessed baselines. In all settings, SEANA outperforms the denoiser-preprocessed SSL pipelines, demonstrating that learned VST-space noise-aligned resampling yields more robust representations than denoising alone. Code is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: SEANA：从噪声数据学习可逆方差稳定变换(VST)，在VST空间估计干净信号并重采样独立噪声，生成"噪声对齐"的自监督视图，抑制编码器编码噪声的捷径，无需干净目标、无需去噪器。
AI.motivation: 科学成像（如显微）标注稀缺但噪声充足，SSL适用；然而信号依赖噪声使同一噪声图像的两个增强视图共享噪声模式，编码器可通过编码噪声而非语义内容提升视图一致性，形成表征捷径。
AI.method: 可插拔模块SEANA：从含噪数据学习可逆方差稳定变换（VST）；在VST空间估计干净信号并重采样独立噪声，构造噪声对齐的SSL视图；不改变SSL目标与编码器，推理时无需去噪器或干净目标。
AI.result: CIFAR-10与ImageNet-100在合成高斯、泊松-高斯、乘性噪声下，跨对比/非对比SSL方法提升干净测试集线性探针精度；真实荧光成像上Jurkat细胞周期分期分类较标准SSL提升最高28.6pp、较去噪器预处理基线提升27.5pp；所有设置均优于去噪器预处理SSL流程。
AI.conclusion: 在VST空间做噪声对齐重采样比单纯去噪更能获得噪声鲁棒的表示，为科学成像SSL提供了无噪声模型假设的通用轻量方案。

title: MoRE: Mixture-of-Experts for Multi-Physics Robotic World Models
summary: A robotic world model should predict how objects evolve under robot actions and physical dynamics. While recent 3D world models have shown strong predictive capabilities, they still struggle with the heterogeneous dynamics arising from diverse object interactions. To address this in a unified framework, we decompose robotic interactions into distinct physical regimes and assign each to a specialized motion expert. We introduce MoRE, a 3D world model with a mixture of motion experts organized around rigid, deformable, and prehensile dynamics. This design enables a single model to capture diverse physical behaviors while preserving regime-specific priors. Trained on mixed simulation and real-world data, MoRE integrates with Model Predictive Control (MPC) to support diverse manipulation tasks. Experiments show that MoRE improves prediction accuracy across physics regimes, leading to stronger real-world MPC performance. Code, data, and project website are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: MoRE：将机器人交互分解为刚性、可变形、抓持三类物理机制，用运动专家混合（MoE）的3D世界模型统一建模，并与MPC结合提升真实操作任务表现。
AI.motivation: 现有3D世界模型在异构物体交互产生的多样动力学（刚性运动、形变、接触式抓持）上预测能力不足，单一参数化难以兼顾不同物理先验。
AI.method: 按物理机制分解交互并分派给专门的运动专家，构建基于刚性/可变形/抓持三类专家的MoE式3D世界模型；混合仿真与真实数据训练，输出预测接入MPC用于操作规划。
AI.result: 在各物理机制下预测精度均有提升，并带来更强的真实世界MPC操作性能。
AI.conclusion: 按物理机制分解的专家混合是世界模型统一建模异构动力学的有效路径；摘要层面证据偏定性，缺少量化指标与基线细节。

title: VideoRNG: Relightable Neural Gaussians from Generative Video Models
summary: Generating realistic 3D assets remains constrained by classical representations: surface meshes and compact physically based materials struggle to express objects whose appearance arises from fine geometry or complex light transport, while existing Gaussian-splatting generators typically bake fixed illumination into appearance. We introduce VideoRNG, a two-stage method that generates complete, relightable 3D assets from a text prompt or a single image without prescribing a mesh or analytic material model. A video generator fine-tuned from a pretrained video diffusion backbone first produces a structured RGBA turntable sequence under a known pose, camera, and illumination. A feed-forward large reconstruction model initialized from a pretrained video diffusion backbone then maps the video-VAE latent frames of selected turntable frames directly to millions of anisotropic Gaussians with learned neural appearance features. A shared directional decoder and stochastic Gaussian ray tracer turn this representation, which we call ray-traced Relightable Neural Gaussians (rtRNG), into radiance under novel viewpoints and illumination. To preserve high-frequency appearance while learning geometry, we introduce depth-anchored appearance training, and we make million-Gaussian reconstruction practical through foreground token selection and cost-aware distributed sampling. VideoRNG generates complex assets such as fur, feathers, and spider webs that can be interactively rendered, relit, and integrated into scenes.

AI.tldr: VideoRNG 提出两阶段流水线：先用微调的视频扩散模型生成已知位姿/光照下的 RGBA 环视序列，再用前馈大重建模型将视频 VAE 潜变量直接映射为数百万各向异性高斯（带神经外观特征），配合方向解码器与随机高斯光线追踪实现可重光照的完整 3D 资产生成。
AI.motivation: 传统网格+紧凑 PBR 材质难以表达由细几何（毛发、羽毛、蛛网）或复杂光传输决定的外观；现有 Gaussian-splatting 生成器把光照烘焙进外观，无法重光照，且依赖预设网格或解析材质模型。
AI.method: 1) 基于预训练视频扩散骨干微调的视频生成器，在已知位姿、相机、光照下输出结构化 RGBA 环视视频；2) 前馈大重建模型（同样由视频扩散骨干初始化）将选中帧的 video-VAE 潜变量直接回归为百万级各向异性高斯 + 学习到的神经外观特征（rtRNG）；3) 共享方向解码器 + 随机高斯光线追踪在新视角与新光照下渲染辐射；4) 深度锚定外观训练以在学几何时保留高频外观；5) 前景 token 选择与代价感知分布式采样使百万高斯重建可行。
AI.result: 可生成毛发、羽毛、蜘蛛网等复杂资产，支持交互式渲染、重光照与场景集成；为文本/单图到完整可重光照 3D 资产的端到端生成提供了可行方案。
AI.conclusion: 以显式高斯+神经外观替代网格与解析材质，将重光照能力引入前馈生成式 3D，对细几何与复杂光传输对象表现突出，但需视频生成先验的质量作前置条件。

title: SceneAnything: Agentic Reconstruction of Large-Scale Mesh Scenes from a Single Video
summary: Reconstructing an editable 3D scene from video requires matching visible structure while plausibly completing unseen surfaces. Agents can write scene-construction programs, but direct reconstruction attempts often produce errors in layout, scale, and lighting. We introduce SceneAnything, an automated system for reconstructing mesh scenes from real and generated videos, enabling text-to-scene construction when paired with video generation. A software harness coordinates agents, pretrained vision models, and graphics tools through an explicit reconstruction protocol. Shared camera, depth, and segmentation estimates ground component construction: a scene-owner agent plans the environment and briefs authors, who write parameterized Blender programs. A visibility- and fit-based level-of-detail rule selects the construction level, while unseen regions are completed and marked as inferred. Assembled scenes use fitted lighting and supported motion, and revisions undergo programmatic checks and independent visual comparisons. Accepted programs and lessons are reused across scenes. We evaluate on 100 scenes; subset comparisons show improved original-view fidelity over direct-agent reconstruction and higher novel-view content similarity than the compared video-to-3D methods. We will release the harness, agent instructions, reusable libraries, and scenes.

AI.tldr: SceneAnything：用软件框架编排智能体、预训练视觉模型与Blender工具，通过显式重建协议从真实/生成视频重建可编辑3D网格场景。
AI.motivation: 智能体直接写场景构建程序重建视频场景时，常在布局、尺度、光照上出错；需要一个可控、可验证的自动化重建流程，并支持文本到场景生成。
AI.method: 以共享的相机、深度、分割估计作为接地；场景所有者智能体规划环境并向作者智能体下达简报，作者编写参数化Blender程序；采用基于可见性与拟合度的LOD规则选择构建层级；对不可见区域补全并标注为推断；组装时拟合光照与受支持的物体运动；修订经程序化检查与独立视觉比较；被接受的程序与经验跨场景复用。
AI.result: 在100个场景上评测：子集对比显示原始视角保真度优于直接智能体重建，新视角内容相似度高于对比的视频到3D方法。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体+工具+协议式流程可显著降低直接生成式重建的错误，产出可编辑且标注推断区域的场景，并沉淀可复用库；将开源harness、指令、库与场景。

title: Search or Scoring? Diagnosing Why Visual World-Model Planners Fail
comment: 43 pages, 10 figures, 30 tables; supplementary material included
summary: Visual world models such as DINO-WM and JEPA-WM plan with an optimizer that searches for actions whose predicted outcome has the lowest cost, its distance to a goal image. A plan can thus fail in two ways: the optimizer never tries a good action that the cost would prefer (a search failure), or the cost, computed on predictions, ranks a bad action first (a scoring failure). The two need different remedies, more search or a better model, but a planner does not record which one occurred. We tell them apart by executing the optimizer's candidates, scoring a known solution with the planner's own cost, and comparing costs on predicted and real outcomes. An error model explains when each arises and so how to use retrieved demonstration windows (DemoProp): start the search from them (a warm start) when prediction errors are small, and average them without the model when large errors make the optimizer pick overrated actions. Across four simulated environments and three world models, on short tasks whose goals the planner can represent, PushT and Wall fail mostly by search, while Metaworld and RoboCasa fail by scoring because the cost, sound on real outcomes (AUROC 0.94 on Metaworld), is at chance on predictions (0.54). The diagnosis tells which remedy pays off: a four times larger search lowers the real-outcome cost only where failures come from search (clearly for DINO-WM), and where they come from scoring, averaging the windows without the model solves 127 of 168 new Metaworld tasks, against at most 87 when the model chooses among them. Within PushT, degrading only the model flips which use is better, and our rule, frozen in advance, follows the flip and solves 678 of 960 new episodes, against 530 for the best fixed use.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种诊断方法区分视觉世界模型规划失败的两种来源（搜索失败 vs 评分失败），并据此设计DemoProp策略决定检索演示窗口是用于热启动还是无模型平均，在4个模拟环境、3个世界模型上验证诊断可指导补救方案选择。
AI.motivation: 视觉世界模型（DINO-WM、JEPA-WM）通过优化器搜索预测代价最低的动作来规划。失败可能来自搜索（没试到好动作）或评分（代价在预测上排序错误），两者需要不同补救（更多搜索 vs 更好模型），但规划器不记录失败类型。
AI.method: 通过执行优化器候选动作、用规划器自身代价给已知解打分、对比预测与实际结果代价来区分两类失败；建立误差模型解释各自何时发生，并据此使用检索到的演示窗口（DemoProp）：预测误差小时热启动搜索，误差大时无模型地平均演示窗口。
AI.result: PushT和Wall主要因搜索失败；Metaworld和RoboCasa因评分失败（代价在真实结果上AUROC 0.94，预测上仅0.54）。4倍大搜索只在搜索失败处降低真实代价；评分失败处无模型平均窗口在168个新Metaworld任务中解决127个（有模型选择时最多87）。PushT中仅退化模型即可翻转最优用法，预先冻结的规则跟随翻转，960个新episode中解决678个（最佳固定用法530）。
AI.conclusion: 诊断搜索/评分失败类型能预测哪种补救有效，为世界模型规划与演示增强的用法选择提供原则性规则。

title: Learning to Move from and for Manipulation Policies: Spatializing Latent Action Representations for Goal-Pose-Free Mobile Manipulation
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures. Project website: this https URL
summary: The success of manipulation policies is closely tied to the spatial relationship between the robot and the target object, as well as the task being performed, making the ability to adjust the robot's pose critical for successful execution. When the robot starts away from the task, such adjustments require coordinating navigation with local manipulation. Jointly training these capabilities incurs substantial computational and data costs, while navigating toward a predefined goal pose limits the flexibility needed to adapt to task-specific manipulation requirements. To address these challenges, we propose Learning to Move from and for Manipulation Policies (M4M), a framework that learns manipulation-aware mobility directly from pretrained manipulation policies. By leveraging the hidden representations of the policy's action-generating network as dense supervision, together with a limited number of manipulation execution outcomes, we learn a spatially conditioned embedding that captures task-dependent manipulation success across candidate robot poses. From the robot's current stereo observations, this representation estimates manipulation success at unvisited poses without rolling out the manipulation policy at each location. It is further integrated into navigation policy training, while a learned handoff policy decides when to transition from navigation to manipulation, enabling the robot to move and manipulate in a unified, task-aware manner. Across eight articulated-object tasks in unseen RoboCasa kitchens, M4M achieves 47.0% mean task success, compared with 26.5% for the strongest baseline and 19.2% for direct manipulation execution, and refrigerator-closing experiments show consistent improvements across four frozen manipulation policies.

AI.tldr: M4M learns manipulation-aware mobility from a frozen pretrained manipulation policy: it uses the policy's hidden action-encoder features as dense supervision plus sparse execution outcomes to learn a spatially conditioned success predictor over candidate robot poses, then integrates it into navigation training with a learned handoff policy.
AI.motivation: Manipulation success depends on robot-object spatial relation and the task, so pose adjustment matters; but jointly training navigation+manipulation is compute/data heavy, and navigating to a predefined pose over-constrains task-specific manipulation needs.
AI.method: Extract hidden representations from the pretrained manipulation policy's action-generating network as dense supervision, combined with a few real manipulation outcomes, to learn a spatially conditioned embedding predicting manipulation success at candidate poses. Prediction is made from current stereo observations at unvisited poses without rolling out the policy at each location; this representation is integrated into navigation policy training, and a learned handoff policy decides when to switch from navigation to manipulation.
AI.result: On eight articulated-object tasks in unseen RoboCasa kitchens, 47.0% mean success vs. 26.5% for strongest baseline and 19.2% for direct manipulation; refrigerator-closing experiments show consistent gains across four frozen manipulation policies.
AI.conclusion: Pose selection for manipulation can be learned cheaply by reusing frozen manipulation policy internals, enabling unified task-aware navigation-plus-manipulation without joint training.

title: Fold the Loop: Decoding-Time KV Memory for Looped Vision-Language Models
summary: Looped vision-language models (VLMs) deepen visual reasoning by repeatedly applying weight-tied modules. However, their decoding memory grows with recurrent depth and limits the image size and batch size that fit in a fixed memory budget. Each recurrent step produces its own key-value (KV) states, so the cache holds several copies of the same image. We find that, after an exact prefill, earlier steps still need access to visual information but can reuse the final visual KV within the same module. We propose FoldCache, which compresses visual KV along the recurrent axis while preserving the full prefill computation. FoldCache partitions recurrent steps within each module into groups and retains the final visual KV of each group for its members to share during decoding. Sharing stays within module boundaries, while question and answer KV remain separate for each step. The grouping granularity controls the degree of compression, and folding can be combined with token eviction and quantization to further reduce memory use. On LoopVL, FoldCache approximately halves prefix KV memory while matching full-cache accuracy on five open-ended benchmarks. These memory savings support batch sizes up to 1.7 times those of a full cache under the same GPU memory budget, and up to 2.6 times with the more aggressive FoldCache-Lite.

AI.tldr: FoldCache 提出沿循环深度轴压缩循环视觉语言模型的视觉 KV 缓存：在每个模块内将循环步分组，组内成员共享该组最终的视觉 KV，从而在解码时几乎减半前缀视觉 KV 内存。
AI.motivation: 循环 VLM（如 LoopVL）通过权重共享模块的多次迭代增强视觉推理，但每个循环步都会生成一份独立的 KV 状态，导致解码缓存随循环深度线性增长，缓存中重复保存同一图像的多份副本，限制了固定显存下可用的图像分辨率与批大小。
AI.method: 观察到经过精确 prefill 后，较早循环步仍需视觉信息但可在同一模块内复用最终的视觉 KV。FoldCache 保留完整 prefill 计算，仅在解码阶段沿循环轴折叠视觉 KV：将每个模块内的循环步划分成组，每组只保留最后一个循环步的视觉 KV 供组内其余步共享；共享严格限制在模块边界内，问题与答案的 KV 仍按步独立保存。分组粒度可调节压缩率，并可与 token 驱逐、量化叠加使用；激进配置为 FoldCache-Lite。
AI.result: 在 LoopVL 上，FoldCache 将前缀 KV 内存约减半，同时在五个开放式基准上与全缓存精度持平；相同 GPU 显存预算下支持最高 1.7 倍（FoldCache-Lite 达 2.6 倍）的批大小。
AI.conclusion: 沿循环深度复用视觉 KV 是一种低代价、近似无损的显存优化手段，可提升循环 VLM 的可扩展性；但工作属于通用多模态推理效率优化，未涉及具身、3D 重建或世界模型等方向。

title: A Unified Framework for Image Manipulation Localization Under Multi-Type Weak Supervision
summary: Existing weakly supervised image manipulation localization (IML) methods typically rely on annotation-specific training strategies, hindering the joint use of diverse annotations within a single model. This limits the scale of usable training data and constrains further progress. We propose UniIML, a teacher-student framework that maps diverse weak annotations into a unified representation to guide the Segment Anything Model (SAM) in generating multiple candidate masks. However, SAM is designed for general-purpose segmentation and has limited sensitivity to manipulation traces; its predicted quality scores alone may therefore fail to reliably identify the candidate that best delineates the manipulated region. We introduce Ordinal Safe Consensus (OSC), which first filters candidates using trusted weak-annotation constraints encoded in the unified representation. It then ranks the remaining candidates separately by consistency with weak annotations, SAM-predicted quality scores, and cross-view stability, aggregating these rankings for an initial selection. To assess how changes in the evaluation criteria affect candidate selection, OSC repeats ranking and selection while omitting one criterion at a time. The most frequently selected candidate is adopted as the final mask, and its relative selection frequency quantifies selection stability. We construct soft pseudo-labels from the selected candidate's predicted probabilities and estimate pixel-level supervision weights based on selection stability, pixel-level agreement among candidates, and predictive certainty. The student receives direct supervision in regions defined by weak annotations and learns from soft pseudo-labels elsewhere through reliability-weighted distillation, enabling unified training across weak annotation types. Experiments show that UniIML achieves superior average performance compared with state-of-the-art IML methods.

AI.tldr: UniIML 提出统一的师生框架，把多种弱标注映射为统一表示，引导 SAM 生成候选掩码，并用 Ordinal Safe Consensus (OSC) 做排序-留一选择，结合软伪标签与可靠性加权蒸馏实现跨弱标注类型的统一训练。
AI.motivation: 现有弱监督图像篡改定位方法依赖特定标注类型的训练策略，无法在单一模型中联合利用多种弱标注，限制了可训练数据规模与性能上限。
AI.method: 教师-学生框架生成掩码；用统一表示编码的可靠弱标注约束过滤 SAM 候选；按弱标注一致性、SAM 质量分、跨视角稳定性三种准则分别排序并聚合初步选择，再逐一剔除单一准则重复排序-选择，取最高频候选为最终掩码并以相对选择频率度量稳定性；据此构建软伪标签，依稳定性、候选像素一致性与预测确定度估计像素级监督权重，学生在标注区域直接监督、其余区域做可靠性加权蒸馏。
AI.result: 实验显示 UniIML 在平均性能上优于当前最先进的图像篡改定位方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一弱标注表示与稳定性驱动的候选选择及伪标签蒸馏，可在单一模型中融合异构弱监督，显著提升 IML 的通用性与可扩展性。

title: Differentiable Hydrodynamics for Whole-Body MPC of Underwater Robots
summary: Underwater vehicle-manipulator systems distribute actuation across thrusters and joint motors. Whole-body model predictive control (MPC), rather than separate vehicle and arm controllers, can coordinate both to extend the workspace and exploit the system's full kinematic capability. Doing so, however, requires a hydrodynamic model and derivatives throughout the prediction horizon. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) captures geometry-dependent forces and moments for such a model, but is too expensive to evaluate online. We present a differentiable analytical hydrodynamic model combining smooth spherical-harmonic force and moment fields with a coupled added-inertia matrix identified from CFD. It compactly represents velocity and acceleration-dependent loads and provides their derivatives in closed form. These derivatives are propagated through free-floating vehicle--manipulator dynamics for whole-body trajectory optimization and receding-horizon control, jointly optimizing thruster forces and joint torques for reaching and continuous tracking. Held-out CFD tests validate the principal translational-force and rotational-moment fields and the added-inertia response. The analytical Jacobians evaluate faster and avoid the step-size sensitivity of central finite differences. Closed-loop Stonefish experiments demonstrate whole-body MPC in an independent marine simulator. By making geometry-dependent hydrodynamics directly available to gradient-based control, the model incorporates water forces and their sensitivities into motion allocation between the vehicle and arm, rather than treating them only as disturbances.

AI.tldr: 提出可微分解析水动力模型（球谐力/力矩场+CFD辨识的耦合附加惯性矩阵），为水下车辆-机械臂系统提供闭式雅可比，嵌入全身MPC联合优化推进器与关节力矩。
AI.motivation: 全身MPC需在整个预测时域内获得水动力模型及其导数；CFD虽能刻画几何相关载荷但无法在线评估，而分离式车体/机械臂控制器无法充分利用系统全部运动学能力。
AI.method: 用平滑球谐函数表征速度依赖的力与力矩场，结合由CFD辨识的耦合附加惯性矩阵表达加速度相关载荷；对自由漂浮车辆-机械臂动力学解析求导，闭式传播雅可比用于全身轨迹优化与滚动时域控制，联合优化推力与关节力矩，支持到达与连续跟踪任务。
AI.result: 在留出CFD测试中验证了主要平移力、旋转力矩场及附加惯性响应；解析雅可比比中心有限差分更快且无步长敏感性；在独立海洋仿真器Stonefish中完成闭环全身MPC实验。
AI.conclusion: 将几何相关水动力直接提供给梯度型控制器，使水动力及其敏感性参与车体-机械臂的运动分配，而非仅作为扰动处理；局限在于验证限于仿真与CFD，尚无实机实验。

title: Text Lives in the Guidance: Preventing Silent Text Rewriting in Cached Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) now render long, legible text in images, and feature caching is a standard way to accelerate them. Caches are judged by image-level metrics, which do not check whether the rendered text is still correct. We find that caching silently rewrites this text. On Z-Image, TaylorSeer at 2.9x fewer FLOPs lowers word accuracy from 62% to 46%, while ImageReward and CLIP Score barely change. Sampling with fewer steps at the same compute keeps almost all of this text, so the loss comes from how the cache predicts the skipped steps. Decomposing the cache error along classifier-free guidance (CFG), we trace this loss mainly to the guidance term, the difference between the conditional and unconditional predictions, which caches extrapolate worst on text. Correcting the guidance inside the text alone recovers most of the lost text. We therefore propose GuideCache, which recomputes both CFG branches only on the tokens with the largest predicted guidance error, using the guidance terms that the cache already stores. At 2.4x fewer FLOPs, GuideCache restores full-compute prompt fidelity on Z-Image and Qwen-Image, and on Z-Image it renders text as well as or better than ToCa, TeaCache, and FasterCache while staying much closer to the full model's output. GuideCache works with caches of any order, and on top of fewer sampling steps it keeps more text than step reduction at a higher speedup. These results suggest that acceleration methods for text-rendering models should be evaluated on the text they render.

AI.tldr: DiT 加速中的 feature caching 会静默改写图像中渲染的文字；误差主要来自 CFG 引导项外推不准，GuideCache 仅在高引导误差 token 上重算两条 CFG 分支，2.4x FLOPs 加速下恢复全算力文字保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有 feature cache 仅用图像级指标（ImageReward、CLIP Score）评估，无法检测渲染文本是否仍正确；作者发现 TaylorSeer 在 2.9x 加速下词准确率从 62% 掉到 46%，而图像指标几乎无变化，说明加速评估存在盲区。
AI.method: 将 cache 预测误差沿 CFG 分解为条件项与引导项（条件-无条件预测之差），定位文本丢失主要源于引导项；提出 GuideCache：复用缓存已存的引导项，仅在预测引导误差最大的 token 上重算两条 CFG 分支，与任意阶数 cache 兼容，并可叠加步数削减。
AI.result: 对照同等算力的少步采样（几乎不掉文字），证明损失来自 cache 对跳过步的预测方式；GuideCache 在 2.4x FLOPs 削减下于 Z-Image 与 Qwen-Image 恢复到全算力的 prompt 保真度，Z-Image 上文字渲染优于 ToCa、TeaCache、FasterCache 且更接近全模型输出。
AI.conclusion: Caching 对文字渲染的损害被图像级指标掩盖；应沿 CFG 引导项做误差纠偏，并以渲染文本作为文字渲染类加速方法的评测指标。

title: Zero to Four Views: Unified Panorama Generation and Preference RL for Unobserved Regions
summary: Panoramas can serve as shared scene backgrounds for multi-shot video generation, but most existing panorama generators take text alone or a single input image. We present a single model that generates a full equirectangular panorama from a text caption and K in {0,...,4} perspective conditioning views taken by a four-camera rig at one viewpoint. We fine-tune a pretrained text-to-image rectified-flow transformer in two stages. In the first stage, each conditioning view is appended to the token sequence together with the ID of its camera slot, and the number of views varies during training, so one set of weights serves every input setting. In the second stage, we improve the region not covered by any conditioning view. Supervised training computes its loss on noisy latents of the ground truth and never scores a panorama the model has generated and decoded, so we propose Uncovered-Region GRPO (UR-GRPO), a reinforcement-learning recipe that rewards the candidates a vision-language model prefers in pairwise comparisons on crops around this region. Because the slot ID alone does not tell the model which way the rig points, we also offer an optional variant that writes each view's camera direction into its position encoding, which lets the user decide where each view appears in the output. With one conditioning view, our model outperforms the previous state of the art, 360Anything, trained on the same data and evaluated with the same code, on Laval Indoor and gives mixed results on an indoor subset of SUN360; the second stage improves the results for every number of conditioning views.

AI.tldr: 提出单一模型，可从文本+0~4个透视视角输入生成等距柱状全景图，两阶段微调rectified-flow T2I Transformer，并用UR-GRPO强化学习改进未覆盖区域。
AI.motivation: 多镜头视频生成需要全景作为共享场景背景，但现有全景生成器只支持纯文本或单张输入图，缺乏多视角可控、且对未覆盖区域质量差的方案。
AI.method: 基于预训练T2I rectified-flow Transformer两阶段微调：阶段一将每个条件视角连同相机槽位ID拼入token序列，训练时视角数K在0~4间变化以共享权重；阶段二针对无覆盖区域，提出Uncovered-Region GRPO（UR-GRPO），用VLM在未覆盖区域裁剪块的成对比较偏好作为奖励，对模型生成并解码的结果做强化学习。可选变体将相机朝向写入位置编码，实现视角放置可控。
AI.result: 单条件视角下在Laval Indoor超过同数据同评测的360Anything（SOTA），SUN360室内子集结果互有胜负；第二阶段在K=0..4所有设置下均带来提升。
AI.conclusion: 统一的变视角数全景生成框架可行，且基于生成结果而非GT噪声latent的RL奖励能有效补全遮挡/未观测区域，对多镜头视频背景生成具有实用价值。

title: HOPD: Historical On-Policy Distillation for SAR MLLM Continual Learning
summary: Continual SAR interpretation requires multimodal large language models to learn incoming sources while retaining earlier task abilities. This is difficult when acquisition and geographic shifts alter visual evidence, regionally concentrated categories bias answers, and historical images are scarce. We address this problem with Historical On-Policy Distillation (HOPD), which reuses source-acquisition LoRA states as persistent teachers for one evolving student. Archiving each state before consolidation preserves a stable source reference. The teachers supervise student-generated prefixes, transferring historical behavior to the student's changing generation contexts. To enrich sparse replay, original-view teachers guide augmented historical student views while preserving spatial coordinates. This knowledge is consolidated into a single deployed adapter that requires no source identity. On SARVQA-CL, our source-incremental evaluation protocol, HOPD achieves the highest final mean score of 54.51 among the compared methods, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.96 points. It also improves the final source-macro score in every evaluated task over shared-memory Replay-SFT, with gains across source orders. These results support source-acquisition history as supervision for retaining earlier task performance during continual SAR adaptation. Code and data: this https URL .

AI.tldr: HOPD将各源域采集阶段的LoRA状态归档为持久教师，对演化中的单一学生做在线策略蒸馏，并用带视图增强的稀疏回放巩固历史能力，最终合并为一个无需源标识的部署适配器。
AI.motivation: 持续SAR解译中，多模态大模型面临采集与地理漂移导致的视觉证据变化、区域集中的类别偏置以及历史图像稀缺，难以在学新源的同时保留旧任务能力。
AI.method: 提出Historical On-Policy Distillation：在每个源LoRA状态合并前归档作为稳定源参考教师；教师监督学生自生成前缀以实现历史行为向变化生成上下文的迁移；原始视图教师指导学生增强后的历史视图并保持空间坐标，从而丰富稀疏回放；最终将知识整合为单一适配器，推理时无需源身份。
AI.result: 在自建的源增量评测协议SARVQA-CL上，最终平均分为54.51，比最强基线高2.96分；在所有评测任务上相比共享记忆的Replay-SFT都提升了最终source-macro分，且在不同源顺序下均有增益。
AI.conclusion: 源采集历史本身可作为监督信号，用于SAR持续适配中保留早期任务性能；单适配器部署、无源标识的设计具备实用性。

title: RefreshGrad: An Online Adaptive Data-sampling Method for Diffusion-based Visuomotor Learning
summary: Training vision-language-action (VLA) policies from demonstrations typically samples trajectory segments uniformly or relies on static offline data curation before training. However, we find that demonstration data vary sharply in supervision value across temporal windows, and that each window's value to the policy evolves substantially during training rather than being fixed or captured by raw loss alone. Motivated by this finding, we propose RefreshGrad, an online adaptive data-sampling framework that periodically scores temporal windows from the evolving policy using five policy-native signals and dynamically adjusts their sampling weights during training. RefreshGrad focuses optimization on informative, learnable windows without altering the policy architecture, training objective, or inference cost. Across ten LIBERO-Plus manipulation tasks, RefreshGrad boosts average success from 60.7% (Uniform) and 68.2% (FAKTUAL) to 76.1% under visual perturbations, and from 57.4% and 73.3% to 81.3% in clean scenes.

AI.tldr: RefreshGrad：面向VLA策略的在线自适应数据采样框架，用五个策略内源信号周期性评分时间窗口并按价值动态调整采样权重，提升LIBERO-Plus操作任务成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA策略从演示中训练时通常均匀采样轨迹片段或在训练前做静态离线数据筛选；但作者发现演示数据在不同时间窗口上的监督价值差异显著，且每个窗口对策略的价值随训练演化而动态变化，并非固定不变，也无法仅用原始loss刻画。
AI.method: 提出RefreshGrad：在训练过程中周期性用演化中的策略对时间窗口打分，基于五种policy-native（策略原生）信号计算窗口价值，并动态调整采样权重；不改变策略架构、训练目标与推理开销，仅聚焦于优化"有信息量且可学习"的窗口。
AI.result: 在10个LIBERO-Plus操作任务上，视觉扰动条件下平均成功率从60.7%（Uniform）与68.2%（FAKTUAL）提升至76.1%；干净场景下从57.4%与73.3%提升至81.3%。
AI.conclusion: 训练中动态、在线地重估演示数据窗口价值是一种低成本、即插即用的数据效率提升手段，可显著增强VLA策略在视觉扰动下的鲁棒性与整体成功率；但实验限于仿真基准，缺少真实机器人验证。

title: Dune: A Zeroth-Order Optimizer with Time-Conditioned Historical Error Regression for VLA Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) enables Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to handle distribution shifts during deployment without source-domain retraining. However, backpropagation-based adaptation incurs heavy memory overhead on resource-constrained robots, whereas zeroth-order (ZO) methods suffer from high estimation variance under limited perturbation budgets. We observe that while ZO estimation enables low-memory adaptation with rapid initial gains, it often stalls or degrades over long-horizon updates due to noisy gradient estimates. To address these limitations, we propose Dune, a zeroth-order optimizer that stabilizes long-horizon adaptation by coupling online historical error prediction with current perturbation observations. Specifically, Dune learns a lightweight, time-conditioned error predictor from past optimization dynamics and fuses its predictions with instantaneous ZO estimates, achieving effective variance reduction without backpropagation or extra forward passes. Additionally, we theoretically characterize how estimation variance restricts convergence in high-dimensional, small-population regimes, motivating the use of historical statistics. Extensive experiments on LIBERO and real-world robots demonstrate that Dune achieves superior success rates under a low memory footprint, with ablations confirming improved closed-loop stability and post-disturbance recovery.

AI.tldr: Dune：零阶（ZO）测试时适应优化器，用在线历史误差预测与当前扰动观测耦合，实现低内存、低方差的长程VLA适应。
AI.motivation: VLA模型部署时面临分布漂移，TTA可免源域重训；但反向传播适应在资源受限机器人上内存开销大，零阶方法在小扰动预算下方差高，长程更新易停滞或退化。
AI.method: 提出Dune零阶优化器：从过往优化动态中学习轻量级时间条件误差预测器，将其预测与瞬时ZO梯度估计融合，无需反传或额外前向即可降方差；并理论刻画高维小种群下估计方差对收敛的限制。
AI.result: LIBERO与真实机器人实验显示在低内存占用下取得更高成功率；消融实验证实闭环稳定性提升与扰动后恢复能力增强。
AI.conclusion: 历史统计可用于稳定零阶测试时适应，为机器人端低内存长程TTA提供有效方案。

title: Decision Boundaries Matter: Graph-Regularized Residual Adaptation for Cross-Domain Fake Image Detection
summary: Despite learning transferable features, fake image detectors may struggle on unseen domains due to mismatched decision boundaries. Our analysis shows that features extracted by the frozen forensic encoder remain discriminative, but the source-trained decision boundary does not fully exploit this information. However, correcting this boundary without source data or target labels remains challenging, as unreliable source predictions may lead to incorrect adaptation. To address this issue, we propose Graph-Regularized Residual Adaptation (GraRA), which refines the source decision boundary using only unlabeled target data. To determine which classifier directions to update, GraRA constructs a compact residual subspace from uncertainty-weighted target features and keeps it orthogonal to the source classification direction. To guide these updates, it uses source-score anchors to generate soft labels through target-graph diffusion, while neighborhood consistency regularizes residual learning within the constrained subspace. The learned correction is merged into the source classifier, requiring only 32 optimized coefficients and no additional inference branches. On diverse unseen OpenMMSec domains, GraRA achieves 84.36\% accuracy and 91.34\% AUC, improving over the source detector by 4.33 and 3.50 percentage points, respectively. Further analysis shows that reliable source predictions and locally consistent neighborhoods help guide residual learning, allowing GraRA to correct ranking errors that a simple threshold shift cannot address. \textcolor{cvprblue}{Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: GraRA：冻结取证编码器下，仅用无标签目标数据构建正交于源分类方向的残差子空间，并用源分数锚点做目标图扩散生成软标签以校正决策边界。
AI.motivation: 假图像检测器在未见域上因决策边界失配而性能下降；分析显示冻结取证编码器提取的特征仍具判别性，问题在于源训练边界未充分利用这些特征，但无源数据、无目标标签时校正边界易受不可靠源预测误导。
AI.method: 利用不确定性加权的目标特征构建紧凑残差子空间，并约束其与源分类方向正交；用源分数锚点经目标图扩散生成软标签引导更新，邻域一致性正则化约束子空间内残差学习；学习到的修正合并进源分类器，仅需32个可优化系数、无额外推理分支。
AI.result: 在多个未见OpenMMSec域上达到84.36%准确率与91.34% AUC，较源检测器分别提升4.33和3.50个百分点；分析表明可靠源预测与局部一致邻域可引导残差学习，纠正简单阈值偏移无法解决的排序错误。
AI.conclusion: GraRA表明源域决策边界的残差式、低参数校正即可显著提升假图像检测的跨域泛化，且无需源数据与目标标签。

title: FG-GraphBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Fine-Grained Visual Understanding with Multimodal Scene Graphs
summary: Fine-grained visual understanding requires multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to recognize small visual entities and understand their relationships. Scene graphs offer a natural way to represent this information, organizing visual entities as nodes and their relationships as edges. However, we identify two challenges: existing scene graph benchmarks provide insufficient coverage of fine-grained entities and the relationships among them, and existing methods for fine-grained visual understanding have yet to effectively leverage such graph-structured information in MLLMs. To address these challenges, we introduce Fine-Grained Multimodal Scene Graph Benchmark (FG-GraphBench) and FiGRA. FG-GraphBench is a benchmark comprising three complementary tasks: fine-grained visual question answering (FG-QA), image captioning (FG-Caption), and image description generation (FG-Description). We develop a two-stage construction pipeline that discovers and grounds fine-grained entities and establishes their relations to construct the fine-grained multimodal scene graphs (MSGs) in FG-GraphBench. Building on these MSGs, we propose FiGRA, a Fine-grained Graph Representation Augmentation method for MLLMs. FiGRA adopts a two-stage training strategy. It encodes multimodal entity and relation features as continuous graph tokens, and integrates them into the MLLM. Experiments show that FiGRA significantly outperforms strong baselines across three tasks of FG-GraphBench. Further analyses confirm the effectiveness of FG-GraphBench and highlight the importance of preserving fine-grained entity and relation information for visual understanding.

AI.tldr: 提出细粒度多模态场景图基准FG-GraphBench（含FG-QA、FG-Caption、FG-Description三任务）及FiGRA方法，将多模态实体与关系特征编码为连续图token注入MLLM，两阶段训练提升细粒度视觉理解。
AI.motivation: 细粒度视觉理解要求MLLM识别小尺度视觉实体及其关系；现有场景图基准对细粒度实体及实体间关系覆盖不足，且现有方法未有效利用图结构信息。
AI.method: 两阶段流水线构建细粒度多模态场景图（发现并定位细粒度实体、建立关系）；FiGRA采用两阶段训练，将多模态实体与关系特征编码为连续图token并集成进MLLM。
AI.result: FiGRA在FG-GraphBench三个任务上显著优于强基线；消融分析验证基准有效性及保留细粒度实体与关系信息的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 图结构化细粒度信息以连续token形式注入MLLM是提升细粒度视觉理解的有效途径，配套基准填补了覆盖空缺。

title: WAMotor: Accelerating World Action Models via Speculative Inference under Dual Nonuniform Denoising Dynamics
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) unify world modeling and action generation for robotic control by integrating flow-matching velocities, yet suffer from high multi-step denoising latency. Recent studies have explored speculative inference to accelerate WAMs by drafting and verifying denoising steps in parallel. However, existing methods either require training task-specific draft models or overlook critical WAM denoising dynamics when reusing past velocities as drafts. We revisit the denoising dynamics of WAMs and identify a dual nonuniformity that breaks standard velocity-reuse assumptions: velocity smoothness is nonuniform as adjacent velocity residuals differ sharply at early and final steps, so reuse there yields large residuals, which nonuniform integration time steps further translate into local state errors that accumulate into the final action distribution. Accordingly, we formalize this by theoretically deriving a trajectory error tolerance bound that characterizes how velocity residuals and integration time steps affect the final action distribution. Based on this, we propose WAMotor, the first speculative inference method tailored to the dual nonuniformity in WAMs. It selects reliable anchor velocities by deferring speculation and employs time-step-aware verification that scales acceptance thresholds by integration time step size. WAMotor offers plug-and-play benefits, enabling seamless integration with prior WAMs. Extensive evaluations on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and LIBERO-Plus show that WAMotor achieves 2.86$\times$--4.28$\times$ end-to-end speedups while maintaining task success rates. Our code is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: WAMotor 针对世界动作模型（WAM）去噪中的"双重非均匀性"，提出首个面向该特性的推测推理加速方法，实现 2.86×–4.28× 端到端加速且保持任务成功率。
AI.motivation: WAM 将世界建模与动作生成统一，借助 flow-matching 速度场做多步去噪，但迭代去噪延迟高。现有推测推理（speculative inference）方法要么需训练任务专属草稿模型，要么直接复用历史速度作为草稿，忽略了 WAM 去噪动力学的关键结构，导致加速后动作分布偏移。
AI.method: 作者重新审视 WAM 去噪动力学，指出"双重非均匀性"：相邻速度残差在早期与末段步急剧变化（速度平滑性非均匀），加之积分时间步本身非均匀，使局部状态误差累积到最终动作分布。理论上推导出刻画速度残差与积分步长如何影响最终动作分布的轨迹误差容忍界。据此设计 WAMotor：通过延迟推测（deferring speculation）选取可靠锚点速度，并采用时间步感知验证（threshold 随积分步长缩放）的接受准则；方法即插即用，可无缝接入已有 WAM。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0 与 LIBERO-Plus 上评测，端到端加速 2.86×–4.28×，任务成功率保持。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 推测推理需与 WAM 去噪动力学对齐：以误差容忍界指导锚点选取与时间步感知验证，可在不重训练草稿模型的前提下获得显著加速，且具备良好的通用可插拔性。

title: Watertight Mesh Optimization of Textured Objects
summary: When reconstructing high-quality 3D assets from images, existing approaches often excel at one objective while compromising another, and frequently overlook the intrinsic quality of the reconstructed surfaces. We present MODL, a framework that jointly optimizes geometry and view-dependent appearance directly on a watertight triangle mesh. Our approach combines Laplacian-preconditioned optimization for smooth vertex updates with curvature-adaptive remeshing to preserve fine details and well-shaped triangles. The triangle mesh is optimized subject to multi-view normalized cross-correlation constraints, but without segmentation, geometric supervision or alpha-blending. Evaluations on object reconstruction datasets demonstrate that MODL achieves competitive novel-view synthesis while producing geometrically accurate models with superior intrinsic mesh quality. Our results highlight the potential of direct mesh optimization to unify photorealistic rendering, geometric reconstruction, and practical 3D asset creation.

AI.tldr: MODL：在水密三角网格上联合优化几何与视角相关外观，用拉普拉斯预条件优化+NCC多视图约束，无分割/几何监督/alpha混合，得到高质量网格与竞争性新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 现有图像重建3D资产方法常在多个目标间取舍（如渲染质量高但几何差、网格质量差），并忽视重建表面内在的网格质量；作者希望统一光度渲染、几何重建与可用3D资产生成。
AI.method: 在固定拓扑的水密三角网格上做直接优化：顶点更新采用拉普拉斯预条件（Laplacian-preconditioned）优化以获得平滑更新；配合曲率自适应重网格化（curvature-adaptive remeshing）保持细节与形状良好的三角形；以多视图归一化互相关（NCC）为约束，不使用分割、几何监督或alpha混合，同时学习视角相关外观（隐式/网络表示）。
AI.result: 在物体重建数据集上，新视角合成性能与现有方法相当，同时几何精度更高，且网格内在质量（三角形形状、水密性）显著更优。
AI.conclusion: 直接网格优化可同时兼顾照片级渲染、几何重建与实用3D资产制作，是统一三类目标的有前景方向；但为逐物体优化范式，泛化/实时性未验证。

title: Stuck in Place: Stall Diagnosis and Remedies for JEPA Planners
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models plan from pixels with model predictive control, yet often fail on tasks their model should handle. Test-time adaptation attributes such failures to model error under distribution shift and updates the weights on the current episode, without checking this attribution against the planning loop itself. We follow the executed planning loop on pushing tasks. In most settings, with and without distribution shift, nearly all failures (at least 96%) are stalls, where the object stays in place while the model predicts progress. The warm-started gradient-descent (GD) planner then returns nearly the same plan, a fixed point where the agent mostly idles. We propose Unstick, which pairs on-policy fine-tuning before deployment with a fixed-weight loop breaker: a residual memory of the episode's prediction errors or random re-initialization at every replan. With GD, Unstick recovers most of the adaptation gain on pushing tasks with the memory, and with re-initialization most of it on shape shifts but much less on visual shifts. A large part of what limits these planners under GD is thus a fixed point of the planning loop, present with and without distribution shift, which a planner with fixed weights can break. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 该论文追踪JEPA世界模型在推动任务上的规划循环，发现96%以上的失败是"停滞"（物体未动而模型预测有进展），并指出这是热启动GD规划器在固定点上的退化，而非分布偏移导致的模型误差。提出Unstick：部署前on-policy微调 + 固定权重的断环机制（预测误差残差记忆 / 每次重规划随机重初始化）。
AI.motivation: 测试时自适应（TTA）默认把JEPA世界模型的规划失败归因于分布偏移下的模型误差，并据此更新权重，但未验证这一归因本身是否成立。作者希望沿规划循环本身做失败诊断，找出真正的瓶颈。
AI.method: 在推动类任务上逐帧追踪执行中的规划循环，对失败做分类（停滞 vs 其他）；分析热启动梯度下降规划器的收敛行为，识别其为固定点问题；提出Unstick：①部署前on-policy微调；②固定权重的断环器——episode级预测误差残差记忆，或每次重规划时随机重初始化，从而跳出规划固定点而不改动模型权重。
AI.result: 在有无分布偏移的多数设定下，至少96%的失败为停滞型失败，且规划器返回几乎相同的计划。采用残差记忆时，Unstick在推动任务上恢复大部分TTA自适应收益；采用随机重初始化时，在shape shift下恢复大部分收益，但在visual shift下收益明显较小。
AI.conclusion: GD下限制这类规划器的重要来源是规划循环自身的固定点，它与分布偏移无关；无需更新权重的固定权重规划器即可部分破解。这提示失败归因需针对规划/优化动态而非仅针对模型误差。

title: MIR-Depth: Multi-Range Refinement for Single-View RGB-D Depth Completion of Transparent Objects
summary: Recovering accurate visible-surface depth from a single RGB-D image and an object mask is essential for robotic grasping and manipulation of transparent objects. Specular reflections cause missing depth, while refraction corrupts nonzero returns with background depth, making raw measurements unreliable as surface anchors. Under a fixed sampling budget, refining an initial single-view prediction within a single search interval either misses large refraction offsets or sacrifices fine local resolution. To resolve this single-view trade-off, MIR-Depth constructs Coordinate-Aware Multi-Range Hypotheses: a 3D-aggregated global inverse-depth volume and depth-axis-filtered pixel-wise local volumes around a prior-guided initial depth. Selective Recurrent Refinement then introduces out-of-bounds lookup masking and validity-masked softmax fusion to iteratively update inverse depth from these volumes using a multi-scale ConvGRU. Finally, Spatially Gated Correction applies a learned per-pixel spatial gate to the full-resolution residual, preserving accurate initial geometry without imposing raw sensor readings as hard constraints. Experiments on TransCG, TODD, TRansPose, ClearPose, and HouseCat6D show that MIR-Depth achieves lower error than ReMake, DFNet, BP-Net, and PSD. Real-robot evaluations confirm accurate surface geometry for 6-DoF grasp pose prediction. Code and pretrained models will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: MIR-Depth 用"多区间坐标感知假设体 + 选择性循环细化 + 空间门控残差校正"从单张 RGB-D 与物体掩码恢复透明物体可见表面深度，在多个透明物体数据集上误差低于 ReMake/DFNet/BP-Net/PSD，并实机验证 6-DoF 抓取。
AI.motivation: 透明物体抓取需要准确可见表面深度。镜面反射导致深度缺失，折射使非零回波被背景深度污染，原始传感器值不可靠；固定采样预算下、在单一搜索区间内细化单视图初值，要么无法覆盖大折射偏移，要么牺牲局部分辨率——该单视图权衡需被打破。
AI.method: 1) 坐标感知多区间假设：构建 3D 聚合的全局逆深度体，并在先验引导初值附近构建沿深度轴滤波的逐像素局部体；2) 选择性循环细化：越界查找掩码 + 有效性掩码 softmax 融合，用多尺度 ConvGRU 迭代更新逆深度；3) 空间门控校正：学习逐像素空间门控作用于全分辨率残差，保留初值几何且不把原始读数当作硬约束。
AI.result: 在 TransCG、TODD、TRansPose、ClearPose、HouseCat6D 上误差低于 ReMake、DFNet、BP-Net、PSD；实机实验确认可为 6-DoF 抓取位姿预测提供准确表面几何；代码与预训练模型将公开。
AI.conclusion: 以多假设区间替代单一搜索区间，是缓解透明物体单视图深度细化中"覆盖范围 vs 局部精度"矛盾的有效途径，可直接服务于透明物体抓取。

title: Bilateral Evidence Selection and Reasoning for Mammography Vision--Language Models
summary: Medical vision--language models (VLMs) often need to identify small, subtle lesions within high-resolution images containing extensive normal anatomy and redundant visual information. Visual-token compression improves efficiency, but preserving salient regions alone can discard the context needed for diagnostic interpretation. This context can extend across images: in bilateral mammography, the opposite breast provides a patient-specific anatomical reference. Yet retaining such evidence does not ensure that the model uses it effectively. We propose Bilateral Evidence Selection and Reasoning (BESR), which connects evidence preservation with comparative assessment through a bilateral-guided token selector and a bilateral reward. Under a shared token budget, the selector jointly prioritizes lesion appearance and its local and bilateral context, while the reward encourages assessments that benefit from the preserved comparison. Experiments on a bilateral dataset constructed from CBIS-DDSM and on VinDr-Mammo demonstrate improved evidence retention and diagnostic performance under constrained visual-token budgets. Inference benchmarking further shows reduced prefill latency.

AI.tldr: BESR：用双边引导的视觉token选择器+双边奖励，在受限token预算下保留并利用乳腺影像中的病灶局部与对侧上下文，提升诊断性能并降低prefill延迟。
AI.motivation: 医学VLM需在高分辨率图像中识别微小病灶，视觉token压缩虽提效，但仅保留显著区域会丢失诊断所需的上下文；双边乳腺影像中对侧乳腺提供患者特异的解剖参照，且保留证据不等于模型会有效使用。
AI.method: 提出Bilateral Evidence Selection and Reasoning (BESR)：在共享token预算下，双边引导的token选择器联合优先化病灶外观及其局部与双边上下文；并设计双边奖励，鼓励评估受益于被保留的对比证据。
AI.result: 在基于CBIS-DDSM构建的双边数据集与VinDr-Mammo上，受限视觉token预算下证据保留率与诊断性能均提升；推理基准显示prefill延迟降低。
AI.conclusion: 将证据保留与比较推理耦合（选择器+奖励）可在压缩token预算下改善医学VLM的诊断效果与效率，思路可推广至其他需跨视图对照的医学检查。

title: DiLE: Discrimination-Aware Latent-Space Learning for Universal Multimodal Embeddings
summary: Multimodal large language models have greatly improved input understanding in universal multimodal embedding models. However, this understanding does not ensure that their embeddings preserve the evidence needed to distinguish relevant items from confusable alternatives. To preserve essential discriminative evidence in embeddings, this paper proposes DiLE, a discrimination-aware latent-space learning framework that combines task guidance with on-policy retrieval feedback. Specifically, a few learnable queries are used to encode task-relevant information in a compact latent space. Reasoning instructions and auxiliary answer-generation supervision shape these representations to support both task understanding and retrieval discrimination. To address task-specific discriminative needs, we design shared-private expert adaptation that integrates cross-task knowledge sharing with task-specific representation learning. Building on this, the on-policy hard-negative distillation is introduced: the student retrieves confusable candidates, and a reverse KL divergence objective aligns its embedding-based similarity distribution with the teacher's fine-grained relevance distribution over these candidates. Candidates are periodically refreshed using updated student snapshots, tying teacher supervision to the student's evolving retrieval behavior and confusions. Across four model configurations that span two backbone generations, DiLE achieves state-of-the-art performance on MMEB-v2, UVRB, and MRMR, demonstrating its effectiveness across modalities and tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出DiLE框架，用任务引导+on-policy检索反馈在紧凑隐空间中学习判别性多模态嵌入，在MMEB-v2、UVRB、MRMR上达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型虽提升输入理解，但其嵌入未必保留区分相关项与易混淆项所需的判别性证据，导致检索判别力不足。
AI.method: 可学习query在紧凑隐空间编码任务相关信息；推理指令与辅助答案生成监督塑造表征；共享-私有专家适配融合跨任务共享与任务特异表示；on-policy难负样本蒸馏：学生检索混淆候选，用反向KL将基于嵌入的相似度分布对齐教师细粒度相关性分布，并用学生快照周期性刷新候选。
AI.result: 跨两代骨干的四种模型配置下，在MMEB-v2、UVRB、MRMR上取得SOTA，覆盖多模态与多任务。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入判别性监督（on-policy难负样本蒸馏）可有效弥补多模态理解到检索判别之间的鸿沟，具跨骨干与跨任务泛化性。

title: Raptor: Rejection-aware Adaptive Tree based on Speculative Decoding
summary: Tree-structured speculative decoding accelerates vision-language models (VLMs) by verifying multiple candidate continuations in parallel. However, long visual contexts increase the cost of speculative computation, making candidate coverage and redundant expansion important considerations beyond tree topology adaptation. We propose Raptor, a training-free framework that uses rejection feedback to jointly regulate candidate coverage and drafting effort. Our key insight is that acceptance length alone cannot distinguish insufficient candidate coverage from excessive deep expansion, and these conditions require different allocation decisions. Raptor therefore extracts complementary rejection-aware signals to characterize speculative progress, frontier coverage, and redundant expansion. These signals jointly guide bounded, momentum-smoothed updates of tree depth, branching width, and drafting budget, together with execution control that limits unnecessary drafting and progressively restores expansion when appropriate. Extensive experiments with two VLMs across seven multimodal benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of Raptor, achieving up to 2.39x average speedup over autoregressive decoding.

AI.tldr: Raptor: training-free speculative decoding for VLMs using rejection feedback to jointly adapt tree depth/width and drafting budget, up to 2.39x speedup.
AI.motivation: 树状投机解码可并行验证多个候选续写，但长视觉上下文使投机计算代价上升，单纯依据接受长度无法区分"候选覆盖不足"与"过度深扩展"，两者需不同分配决策。
AI.method: 无训练框架：从拒绝反馈中提取互补信号（投机进展、前沿覆盖、冗余扩展），以有界、动量平滑方式联合更新树深、分叉宽度与起草预算，并加入执行控制以抑制无用起草、在适当时机恢复扩展。
AI.result: 在两个 VLM、七个多模态基准上验证有效，相对自回归解码平均加速最高 2.39x。
AI.conclusion: 拒绝感知信号可有效平衡候选覆盖与投机开销，实现无需训练的 VLM 推理加速。

title: Wearable Logo, Silent Hijack: Stealthy Cross-Modal Semantic Attacks on Visible--Infrared Vision-Language Models
summary: Logos appear naturally on clothing and daily necessities, where their recognizable shapes and semantic associations make them familiar visual cues. This familiarity helps them blend into real-world environments and remain visually inconspicuous. We ask whether an existing logo can serve as a carrier for coordinated targeted semantic attacks on visible-infrared (VIS-IR) vision-language models (VLMs) without changing its original outline. This setting requires expressive adversarial variation within a fixed shape while accounting for different appearance characteristics and model responses across modalities. We propose Logo-guided Semantic Attack (LoSA), a score-based black-box framework that optimizes a logo's interior appearance and placement while preserving its silhouette. LoSA uses a contour field and low-frequency graph spectral modes to structure the interior color layout, a frozen appearance adapter to couple VIS and IR appearances, and particle swarm optimization to jointly optimize shared design parameters. Experiments across four datasets demonstrate that LoSA consistently outperforms the evaluated baselines in simultaneous Top-1 targeted success. Cross-architecture experiments, visual naturalness ratings, and captioning/VQA transfer analyses further characterize its effectiveness and limitations. These findings reveal that familiar visual symbols from real-world environments can serve as shape-preserving carriers for coordinated targeted semantic attacks across imaging modalities.

AI.tldr: 提出 LoSA：一种基于分数（score-based）的黑盒框架，在保持 logo 原始轮廓不变的前提下，优化其内部外观与摆放位置，使其成为在可见光—红外（VIS-IR）视觉语言模型上协同生效的目标语义攻击载体。
AI.motivation: 现实环境中 logo 形状可辨识、语义关联强，天然不引人注意。作者希望探究现有 logo 能否不作轮廓修改即成为跨模态（VIS-IR）协同目标语义攻击的载体，难点在于"固定形状内的表达力"与"跨模态外观/模型响应差异"两重约束。
AI.method: 分数黑盒优化框架：用等值线场（contour field）与低频图谱（graph spectral）模态约束内部色彩布局结构；用冻结的外观适配器耦合 VIS 与 IR 外观；用粒子群优化（PSO）联合优化共享设计参数（内部外观与摆放位置）。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上，同时 Top-1 目标攻击成功率一致优于所评估基线；跨架构实验、视觉自然度评分、以及 captioning/VQA 迁移分析进一步刻画了方法的有效性与局限。
AI.conclusion: 现实中的熟悉视觉符号可作为保形载体，实现跨成像模态的协同目标语义攻击，暴露了 VIS-IR VLM 在自然物体层面的语义脆弱性。

title: VisualTalk-Bench: Evaluating Question-Driven Avatar-Led Video Explanations
summary: Advances in video generation and avatar synthesis enable new ways to answer user questions through visual explanations. This task requires a system to formulate a correct answer, translate relevant information into visual material, and deliver the explanation through an avatar's speech and actions. Existing benchmarks rarely assess whether avatars point to the visual content being discussed. We introduce VisualTalk-Bench for question-driven avatar-led video explanations in finance and Chinese and English education. It includes 800 curated reference videos and 100 independent evaluation requests, assessing Content Factuality, Speech-Visual Consistency, Visual Quality, Motion Smoothness, and Avatar-Content Pointing. Yet end-to-end video generators often struggle to align gestures with specific visual targets. To explore this challenge, we develop Avatar-O Agent, a modular reference implementation with explicit interaction planning. Experiments across six agents show that factual precision and visual quality do not guarantee accurate pointing. A 26-participant study comparing four agents finds that Avatar-O Agent receives the highest average ratings for visual guidance, perceived pointing accuracy, and explanation effectiveness. We will release the data and code.

AI.tldr: 提出VisualTalk-Bench基准（含800个参考视频与100个独立评测请求），从内容真实性、语音-视觉一致性、视觉质量、运动平滑度与Avatar指向准确性五个维度评估问答驱动的Avatar讲解视频；并提出模块化Agent参考实现Avatar-O Agent。实验显示事实准确与画质高并不保证指向准确。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成与数字人合成基准很少考察Avatar的手势/指示是否真正对准其正在讲解的视觉内容，缺乏对"问答驱动的视觉讲解"这一任务的系统性评测。
AI.method: 构建VisualTalk-Bench，覆盖金融与中英文教育场景，含800条精编参考视频和100条独立评测请求；设计五维评测协议（内容真实性、语音-视觉一致性、视觉质量、运动平滑度、Avatar-内容指向）；并实现模块化参考系统Avatar-O Agent，采用显式交互规划将回答、视觉材料与Avatar言语动作解耦对齐；通过6个Agent实验与26人用户研究验证。
AI.result: 6个Agent的对比表明事实精度与视觉质量不能保证指向准确；26人研究显示Avatar-O Agent在视觉引导、指向准确性和讲解有效性上获得最高平均评分。
AI.conclusion: 该工作指出并量化了"Avatar指向与内容对齐"这一被忽视的关键问题，提供了可复用的基准与模块化规划式参考实现，数据与代码将开源。

title: Stereo Visual Odometry with In-the-Loop Geometric Feed-Forward Models Towards Dense Metric Mapping
summary: We present a stereo visual odometry (SVO) framework that integrates geometric feed-forward models (GFMs) for dense depth prediction with factor-graph-based visual odometry to achieve accurate localisation and dense metric mapping. Our key idea is to exploit sparse but reliable metric geometry estimated from stereo and temporal multi-view observations to calibrate dense GFM predictions, while retaining the robustness and efficiency of model-based SVO. Rather than directly conditioning the GFM on potentially noisy stereo depth, optimised 3D landmarks are used to jointly estimate a scale-shift transformation over all keyframes within each local submap, yielding metrically consistent dense depth predictions. To balance accuracy and computational efficiency, we introduce a hierarchical factor-graph architecture. At the local level, sliding-window optimisation estimates high-frequency camera poses and multi-view-refined 3D landmarks. Dense predictions are generated only for selected keyframes and registered within each submap using SE(3) Generalised ICP. Consecutive submaps are further aligned in Sim(3) using their shared geometry, allowing residual scale inconsistencies to be corrected. These intra- and inter-submap constraints are incorporated into a global factor graph to produce a consistent trajectory and dense metric reconstruction. Extensive experiments on public and in-house datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive odometry accuracy against geometric and learning-based baselines while providing accurate dense metric reconstruction and improved robustness to failures in learned depth prediction.

AI.tldr: 将立体视觉里程计与几何前馈模型(GFM)稠密深度预测耦合：用优化后的3D路标在子图内联合估计尺度-平移变换来标定GFM预测，并构建局部滑窗+全局分层因子图(SE(3) GICP子图配准、Sim(3)子图对齐)实现轨迹与稠密度量重建。
AI.motivation: 几何前馈模型能产生稠密深度但缺乏度量一致性且对噪声/失效敏感；模型式SVO鲁棒高效但稀疏。希望用稀疏可靠的度量几何去校准稠密预测，兼得两者之长。
AI.method: 分层因子图：(1) 局部滑窗BA估计高频位姿与多视角精化路标；(2) 仅对关键帧生成GFM稠密深度，用该子图全部关键帧的路标联合求解尺度-平移变换完成度量标定；(3) 子图内以SE(3) Generalized ICP配准稠密预测，相邻子图以共有几何做Sim(3)对齐修正残余尺度差；(4) intra-/inter-submap约束汇入全局因子图。
AI.result: 在公开与自采数据集上，里程计精度与几何及学习类基线相当，同时输出准确的稠密度量重建，并提升了对学习式深度预测失效的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 以稀疏度量几何标定稠密GFM、并用Sim(3)子图间对齐消除尺度漂移，是融合模型式与学习式SLAM的有效范式；后续可扩展到更多动态/大尺度场景与在线失效检测。

title: Beyond Resemblance: Image Fusion Reimagined
summary: Image fusion often lacks ground-truth fused images, forcing existing deep methods to indirectly define fusion objectives by requiring the fused image to simultaneously resemble multiple source images. However, the distinct imaging characteristics of different modalities can impose competing constraints on the fused result, potentially limiting the effective integration of their complementary information. To address this long-standing challenge facing the image fusion community, we propose ApexFuse, a novel generative image fusion paradigm that moves beyond source-resemblance constraints toward learning a general distribution of high-quality scene representations. Specifically, we develop a human-LMM-in-the-loop pipeline that leverages large multimodal generative models and iterative human feedback to translate abstract fusion objectives into reliable visual references, thereby defining the target distribution of ideal fusion outcomes. Through target-distribution-guided adaptation, we transfer the rich generative priors of pretrained FLUX to image fusion, enabling high-quality scene reconstruction conditioned on multimodal observations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ApexFuse harmoniously integrates salient thermal targets, natural colors, and fine textures, achieving superior visual quality as well as semantic segmentation and object detection performance over previous source-resemblance methods. Moreover, ApexFuse exhibits remarkable cross-task generalization, extending from infrared-visible fusion to multi-exposure fusion, multi-focus fusion, and visible-depth fusion without additional fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: ApexFuse 提出一种摆脱“源图像相似性约束”的生成式图像融合范式：用人类在环的 LMM 流程构造理想融合结果的视觉参考以定义目标分布，再借助 FLUX 预训练生成先验做目标分布引导的适配，实现红外-可见等多模态融合并具备跨任务泛化。
AI.motivation: 图像融合缺乏 ground-truth 融合图像，现有深度方法只能间接地要求融合结果同时“像”多张源图像；而不同模态成像特性差异导致这些相似性约束相互竞争，削弱互补信息的有效整合，是图像融合领域的长期难题。
AI.method: 1) 构建 human-LMM-in-the-loop 流水线：用大型多模态生成模型加迭代人工反馈，把抽象融合目标转成可靠视觉参考，从而显式定义理想融合结果的目标分布；2) 通过目标分布引导的适配，把预训练 FLUX 的生成先验迁移到图像融合，在多模态观测条件下做高质量场景重建。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 ApexFuse 能协调整合显著热目标、自然色彩与细节纹理，视觉质量、语义分割与目标检测指标均优于此前的源相似性方法；且无需额外微调即可从红外-可见融合扩展到多曝光、多聚焦、可见-深度融合，跨任务泛化突出。
AI.conclusion: 把“定义高质量融合分布”替代“拟合源图像”，配合生成模型先验与分布引导适配，是可行且更强的融合路径；单一模型可泛化到多类融合任务，说明该范式具备通用性。

title: Lossless Latent Diffusion Models
summary: We study the problem of training image diffusion models while preserving pixel-exact reconstruction. Prior works typically address this problem by directly modeling images in pixel space, requiring modifications to the diffusion training objective or model architecture. In this work, we introduce a different paradigm: rather than modifying diffusion models, we construct a lossless transformation that maps pixels into a representation more amenable to diffusion modeling. We term our approach the Lossless Latent Diffusion Model (LLDM). We construct LLDM using residual latent transformation and uneven latent scaling, and explain its effectiveness through a proposed metric, semantic rank priority (SRP). Empirically, LLDM substantially outperforms prior pixel-space diffusion models in generation quality and even surpasses several widely used lossy VAEs. Furthermore, we show that SRP is strongly correlated with downstream generative performance.

AI.tldr: 提出无损潜空间扩散模型（LLDM）：不改扩散目标与架构，而是用残差潜变换与不均匀潜缩放构造可逆无损映射，使像素在更利于扩散建模的表示上训练，并用语义秩优先级（SRP）指标解释其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有像素精确重建的扩散模型需直接建模像素空间，必须改动扩散训练目标或模型架构；作者希望在不修改扩散模型本身的前提下改善其建模空间的可学习性。
AI.method: 构建无损（可逆）变换将图像映射到更适合扩散的表示：残差潜变换 + 不均匀潜缩放；提出语义秩优先级（SRP）指标用于刻画表示对扩散的友好程度并解释机理。
AI.result: 生成质量显著优于已有像素空间扩散模型，并超过若干常用有损 VAE；SRP 与下游生成性能强相关。
AI.conclusion: "不改模型、改表示"的范式可作为像素精确重建扩散的统一有效路径，SRP 可作为表示设计的指导性度量。

title: CANDOR: Contrastive Self-Denoising Rewards for Label-Free Text-to-Image Post-Training
summary: Post-training text-to-image generators with reinforcement learning usually relies on external reward models that need annotated preferences or auxiliary evaluators and are prone to reward hacking. We show that the generator's own denoising accuracy, used by a recent intrinsic reward, is a poor proxy for prompt fidelity. Within a same-prompt group, this absolute self-confidence is dominated by image complexity and ranks correct samples above incorrect ones near chance. We introduce CANDOR (Contrastive Alignment from Null-referenced Denoising lOg-Ratio), the log-ratio of unconditional to conditional denoising errors under shared noise probes, which measures how much the prompt helps the model denoise its own sample. It cancels prompt-independent difficulty that scales both errors and ranks the better of two same-prompt samples higher in 60% and 63% of pairs on compositional generation and text rendering. As the only Flow-GRPO reward for a flow-matching model, CANDOR improves text rendering, aesthetic and human-preference scores over the base model and a prior absolute self-confidence reward, with text-rendering and preference gains that stronger classifier-free guidance does not reproduce. On public Flow-GRPO adapters trained on external rewards, CANDOR further raises PickScore and ImageReward, so it can complement those rewards. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出CANDOR：用共享噪声探针下"无条件/条件去噪误差的对数比"作为生成器的内在奖励，衡量提示词对去噪的实际帮助，规避外部奖励模型与奖励黑客问题。
AI.motivation: 现有对文生图模型做RL后训练多依赖需人工偏好标注或辅助评估器的外部奖励模型，易被reward hacking。已有基于生成器自身去噪精度的"绝对自置信度"内在奖励，但同提示词组内该指标主要反映图像复杂度，区分正确/错误样本接近随机。
AI.method: 构造CANDOR奖励：在共享噪声探针下计算无条件去噪误差与条件去噪误差的对数比，即提示词让模型去噪自身样本的增益；该比值对提示词无关的难度项相消。作为流匹配模型的唯一Flow-GRPO奖励进行后训练，也可叠加于已有外部奖励训练的公开适配器。
AI.result: 在同提示词样本对中，CANDOR在组合生成与文字渲染上分别以60%和63%的成对准确率选出更优样本。仅用CANDOR作Flow-GRPO奖励，在文字渲染、美学与人类偏好分数上均优于基模型及先前的绝对自置信度奖励，且文字渲染与偏好增益无法通过更强的classifier-free guidance复现。在基于外部奖励训练的公开Flow-GRPO适配器上，进一步提升PickScore与ImageReward。
AI.conclusion: 将无条件/条件去噪误差比作为对比式内在奖励，是比绝对自置信度更可靠的提示词一致性信号，可独立用于RL后训练并与外部奖励互补。

title: RemoteVLPG: How to Obtain a Specific VLM for Language-Guided Path Generation on Remote Sensing Images?
summary: We study how to obtain a task-specific Vision-Language Model (VLM) for language-guided path generation between start and end points on remote sensing images. We explore this question from three aspects. First, we implement three widely used architectural approaches and compare their performance. Second, we design a scalable method for constructing pre-training data and build an effective pre-training dataset with a degree of diversity. Methods trained on this dataset achieve promising zero-shot performance. Third, we construct three benchmarks that support stratified evaluation and design three metrics for path generation. We investigate this problem through extensive experiments. The results show that the zero-shot performance of methods trained on the constructed pre-training dataset can exceed that of some advanced commercial VLMs. Code and Dataset can be available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何为遥感图像上"起终点间的语言引导路径生成"任务构建任务专用VLM，从架构对比、可扩展预训练数据构建、基准与指标三方面系统探索。
AI.motivation: 通用商用VLM在遥感语言引导路径生成这一任务特定场景上能力不足，作者希望系统性地获得该任务的专用VLM，并厘清架构选择、预训练数据与评测体系三个关键问题。
AI.method: 1) 实现并比较三种常用VLM架构方案；2) 设计可扩展的预训练数据构建方法，构建具一定多样性的预训练数据集；3) 构建三个支持分层评测的benchmark，设计三项路径生成指标；开展大量实验。
AI.result: 在所构建预训练数据集上训练的模型具备较好的零样本性能，其零样本表现可超过部分先进商用VLM；代码与数据集已开源。
AI.conclusion: 任务专用预训练数据构建是提升遥感语言引导路径生成零样本性能的有效途径，架构对比与分层基准为后续研究提供了参照。

title: ActMem: From Latent Memory Reasoning to Grounded Robotic Action
comment: 17 pages, 11 figures, 6 tables. Code and checkpoints: this https URL
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising results in real-world long-horizon manipulation, where memory plays a crucial role. However, existing memory-augmented VLAs either retrieve past observations without reasoning about what they imply, or reason over the full history in a shared context where it crowds out current perception. Cognitive science treats them as distinct systems: memory reconstructs past experience to decide what to do, while perception guides how to act. We therefore propose ActMem, an in-context memory framework that decouples memory reasoning from perceptual grounding within a single vision-language backbone. Built on a vision-language model with native video understanding, ActMem infers the current subtask from a timestamped interaction history and keeps the hidden states formed during this inference as a Latent Memory Chain-of-Thought (Memory CoT), which conditions a flow-matching action expert. Perception Attention further lets the expert attend directly to the current view. To keep inference fast under long histories, Efficient Memory CoT Inference reuses computation across consecutive decisions without changing the output. ActMem achieves 71.1% task success and 80.8% completion success on RoboMemArena, surpassing the strongest baseline by 7.5 and 8.7 percentage points, and 73.8% average success on MIKASA-Robo, the best among all compared methods. In the real world, it reaches 68.8% average success on exogenous, endogenous, and traceless memory tasks, 10.0 percentage points above the strongest memory-augmented VLA. Code and checkpoints will be released at this https URL and this https URL .

AI.tldr: ActMem 提出在单一视觉-语言骨干内解耦"记忆推理"与"感知接地"的 in-context 记忆框架：用原生视频理解 VLM 从带时间戳的交互历史推断当前子任务，保留推理过程中的隐状态作为 Latent Memory CoT，条件化流匹配动作专家；并通过 Perception Attention 让动作专家直接看当前视角，配合 Efficient Memory CoT Inference 复用计算降低长历史推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆增强 VLA 存在两难：要么直接检索过去观测而缺乏"这意味着什么"的推理，要么在共享上下文中对全历史推理，挤占当前感知。认知科学将记忆（重构过去经验以决定做什么）与感知（指导如何行动）视为不同系统，据此提出解耦设计。
AI.method: 基于具原生视频理解的 VLM：(1) 从时间戳交互历史推理当前子任务，将推理隐状态作为 Latent Memory CoT 条件化流匹配动作专家；(2) Perception Attention 令动作专家直接关注当前帧视觉 token，实现感知接地；(3) Efficient Memory CoT Inference 在连续决策间复用计算且不改变输出，加速长历史推理。
AI.result: RoboMemArena 上任务成功率 71.1%、完成成功率 80.8%，分别超最强基线 7.5 与 8.7 个百分点；MIKASA-Robo 平均成功率 73.8%，为对比方法中最佳；真实世界在外生、内生与无痕迹记忆任务上平均成功率 68.8%，高于最强记忆增强 VLA 10.0 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 显式解耦记忆推理与感知接地，并以潜空间 CoT 传递记忆、以感知注意力保留当前观测通路，是长时程记忆型 VLA 的有效范式，且可通过计算复用实现高效推理；代码与权重将开源。

title: Demonstration-Free Skill Composition for Navigation and Manipulation
comment: 10 pages. Accepted at the Australasian Conference on Robotics and Automation (ACRA 2026). Project page: this https URL
summary: Hierarchical reinforcement learning enables sequential tasks to be represented as compositions of separately trained skills. This paper evaluates demonstration-free hierarchical pipelines for MiniGrid navigation and robotic manipulation, comparing their training requirements and task performance with flat reinforcement learning baselines. The evaluation concerns complete pipelines with task-specific observation, reward and control structures. In navigation, two parameterised skills are reused across unseen FourRooms layouts under manually specified high-level plans. In manipulation, reaching, grasp alignment and lifting are trained separately, with downstream skills initialised from states collected during predecessor rollouts. Across unseen navigation layouts, the hierarchical pipeline substantially outperforms the evaluated flat DQN baselines while requiring fewer training interactions. In manipulation, the hierarchical chain requires fewer training steps than flat SAC and exhibits lower observed variation across seeds. The frozen Pick and Lift skills are further reused for stacking by training an additional Place skill.
