AI.tldr: 该文评估了无演示的分层强化学习流水线（MiniGrid导航与机械臂操作），比较其训练开销与任务表现同扁平RL基线的差异。
AI.motivation: 分层RL可将顺序任务表示为独立训练技能的组合，但缺少对端到端流水线（含任务特定观测、奖励与控制结构）训练需求与性能的系统对比。
AI.method: 导航任务：两个参数化技能在手工指定高层计划下复用于未见过的FourRooms布局；操作任务：reaching、grasp alignment、lifting分阶段单独训练，下游技能用前驱rollout采集的状态初始化，仅新增Place技能实现冻结Pick/Lift技能的堆叠复用。与扁平DQN、SAC基线对比。
AI.result: 未见导航布局上分层流水线显著优于扁平DQN且交互更少；操作链训练步数少于扁平SAC，跨随机种子方差更低。
AI.conclusion: 分层技能组合在仿真基准中展现出更好的样本效率与稳定性，支持技能复用，但依赖手工高层计划且仅有仿真证据。

title: A Wolf in Sheep's Pixels: Visual Camouflage Attacks via HDR Gain Maps
summary: An image can pass automated safety checks while showing harmful content to its human viewer. We introduce DRJanus, a visual camouflage attack that exploits the gap between standard dynamic range (SDR) processing and high dynamic range (HDR) display. Automated systems often read only an image's SDR base, whereas HDR viewers reconstruct its appearance using an auxiliary gain map. DRJanus inverts this reconstruction to embed two independently chosen color images in a single JPEG, without querying or optimizing against the target model. It preserves the chosen SDR base exactly and reconstructs HDR targets at an average PSNR of 43.03 dB across 400 images. On a benchmark of 100 sexual-content images, DRJanus evades detection by all six tested commercial moderation services and nine vision-language models. Across five agents, each evaluated on 120 task cases per threat setting, attack success ranges from 31.67% to 100% for moderation evasion and from 95% to 100% for task manipulation. We also explore cross-view consistency checks as a mitigation. These findings expose a gap in visual trust: securing what a machine reads does not secure what a user sees. A demo is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: DRJanus 利用 SDR 处理与 HDR 显示之间的重建差异，在单张 JPEG 中嵌入两幅独立彩色图像，实现视觉伪装攻击。
AI.motivation: 自动化安全检查读取图像的 SDR 基础层，而人类观看者通过 HDR 显示的增益图重建实际外观，二者之间存在可被利用的"视觉信任缺口"，使恶意图像能同时通过机器审核并欺骗人眼。
AI.method: 将 HDR 增益图的重建过程反向求解：精确保持选定的 SDR 基础图像不变，把目标 HDR 图像编码到辅助增益图中，从而在单个 JPEG 内嵌入两幅独立图像；无需查询或针对目标模型优化。
AI.result: 在 400 张图像上 HDR 目标重建平均 PSNR 达 43.03 dB；在 100 张图片的基准上绕过全部 6 家商用审核服务与 9 个视觉语言模型；5 个智能体中各 120 个任务案例的攻击成功率：审核规避 31.67%–100%，任务操纵 95%–100%。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了"保证机器所读安全"并不等于"保证用户所见安全"的视觉信任缺口，并初步探讨了跨视图一致性检查作为缓解手段；该工作属于安全问题研究，与具身智能/三维重建核心方向关联较弱。

title: TuringPAI: A Foundation for On-Device Physical AI
summary: Physical AI requires models that understand spatial relationships and dynamic environments and translate observations into actions under limited onboard compute. We present TuringPAI, a family of models for on-device Physical AI comprising TuringPAI-VL for shared vision-language understanding, TuringPAI-Drive for autonomous driving, and TuringPAI-Embodied for robotic manipulation. TuringPAI-VL is a 0.65B model built on HybridViT-MLQ, which combines convolutional local aggregation with Transformer-based global modeling. Multi-scale Latent Queries integrate spatial features and observation history within the same visual Transformer, providing a compact, structured interface to the language model. Training combines general vision-language data with geometric, cross-view, and temporal supervision. TuringPAI-VL supports general multimodal understanding and improves quantitative geometric perception over Qwen2-VL-2B, while providing a shared initialization for the two downstream VLA models. For autonomous driving, TuringPAI-Drive maintains all evaluated ADE/FDE metrics within 1.2\% of a full-token HybridViT baseline using the MLQ interface and achieves comparable aggregate scores in an in-house simulation evaluation. Using XPeng Native Runtime (XNRT) on a single NVIDIA Orin-X SoC, TuringPAI-Drive generates trajectories at 12\,Hz in on-vehicle operation. For robotic manipulation, TuringPAI-Embodied achieves a 96.8\% average success rate across the four LIBERO suites. These results demonstrate a shared vision-language foundation for driving and robotic manipulation under practical on-device constraints.

AI.tldr: TuringPAI 系列 0.65B 端侧 Physical AI 模型：TuringPAI-VL（HybridViT-MLQ + 多尺度潜查询）作为共享视觉-语言基座，向下游派生自动驾驶 TuringPAI-Drive（Orin-X 单芯片 12Hz 出轨迹）与机器人操作 TuringPAI-Embodied（LIBERO 四套件平均 96.8% 成功率）。
AI.motivation: Physical AI 需在有限车载/机载算力下同时具备空间关系理解、动态环境感知与观测到动作的映射能力，现有通用 VLM 参数量大、几何感知弱，且视觉 token 冗余难以满足端侧实时性；同时自动驾驶与机器人操作通常各自独立建模，缺乏共享的视觉-语言初始化。
AI.method: 构建 0.65B 的 TuringPAI-VL：HybridViT-MLQ 将卷积局部聚合与 Transformer 全局建模结合；Multi-scale Latent Queries 在同一视觉 Transformer 内融合空间特征与观测历史，形成面向语言模型的紧凑结构化接口，替代全量视觉 token；训练混合通用视觉-语言数据与几何、跨视角、时序监督。该基座共享初始化两个 VLA：TuringPAI-Drive（自动驾驶轨迹输出，部署于 XPeng XNRT、单 NVIDIA Orin-X）与 TuringPAI-Embodied（机器人操作策略）。
AI.result: VL 在定量几何感知上优于 Qwen2-VL-2B（模型仅 0.65B）；Drive 使用 MLQ 接口时 ADE/FDE 相对全 token HybridViT 基线偏差均在 1.2% 以内，自建仿真综合得分相当，车端以 12Hz 实时生成轨迹；Embodied 在 LIBERO 四个套件平均成功率 96.8%。
AI.conclusion: 验证了单一紧凑视觉-语言基座可同时支撑驾驶与操作两类 VLA，并在实际端侧算力约束下达成实时推理且精度几乎无损；但操作侧仅有仿真基准成绩、缺少真机演示，Drive 评测亦依赖自建仿真与相对基线比较。

title: SegAnyFruit: Learning Generalizable and Edge Deployable Fruit Instance Segmentation at Scale
summary: Deploying fruit instance segmentation in real agricultural settings requires generalizing across unseen species, orchards, and imaging conditions under strict onboard compute and annotation budgets. We introduce SegAnyFruit (SAF), a data construction and progressive training framework that distills foundation-model priors into lightweight, prompt-free segmenters. SAF combines generic mask pre-training, broad mid-training on automatically annotated web imagery from our curated WebFruits dataset, and human-verified agricultural refinement post-training on PaperFruits, together spanning 733K images and 9.66M whole-fruit masks across 165 fruit types. Across seven benchmarks, zero-shot SAF-RF-DETR-XL reaches 69.06 average mask AP50:95 (+4.76 over SAM 3) while remaining deployable on edge devices. SAF initialization also boosts few-shot to full-shot adaptation across five agricultural domains while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. Finally, we systematically analyze training stages, data scale, model capacity, and generative augmentation, and validate our pipeline's transferability to underwater, cell, and human segmentation. We will release our datasets, code, and SAF models.

AI.tldr: SegAnyFruit：以341系数据构建（733K图/9.66M掩膜/165种水果）与渐进式训练（通用掩膜预训练→WebFruits中等训练→PaperFruits人工校验精调）将基础模型先验蒸馏进轻量、免提示的分割器，零样本SAF-RF-DETR-XL在7个基准上达69.06 Avg mask AP50:95（超SAM 3 +4.76），可边缘部署。
AI.motivation: 真实农业场景的水果实例分割需在未见物种、果园与成像条件下泛化，同时受机载算力与标注预算严格约束；现有基础模型（如SAM系列）需提示且体积大，难以直接部署。
AI.method: 提出SegAnyFruit（SAF）数据构建与渐进训练框架：①通用掩膜预训练；②在自建WebFruits（网络图像自动标注）上进行广域中等训练；③在PaperFruits（人工校验农业数据）上做精调后训练；总计733K图像、9.66M整果掩膜、165种水果；模型为免提示轻量分割器（RF-DETR XL变体）。
AI.result: 7个基准零样本平均mask AP50:95达69.06（较SAM 3提升4.76），且可在边缘设备部署；SAF初始化在5个农业域上提升few-shot到full-shot适配并缓解灾难性遗忘；系统消融了训练阶段、数据规模、模型容量与生成式增强；管线可迁移至水下、细胞与人体分割。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型先验可通过“数据构建+渐进多阶段蒸馏”高效转化为免提示、边缘可部署的领域分割器，兼具强零样本泛化与少样本适配能力，数据、代码与模型将开源。

title: TAP: Tapping the Discriminative Potential of Frozen Representations for Class-Incremental Learning
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Code is included as an ancillary file
summary: Pre-trained models provide transferable representations for class-incremental learning (CIL). However, sequentially adapting these representations introduces optimization costs and may disrupt old-class feature structure. This motivates us to explore whether the discriminative potential of these representations can be further exploited by continually accumulating class information while keeping the encoders frozen. To this end, we propose TAP, a new and novel framework for tapping the discriminative potential of frozen representations in class-incremental learning. It accumulates visual and semantic class information in the frozen CLIP embedding space with only lightweight optimization. TAP comprises three modules: class-conditional visual distribution modeling, class-adaptive semantic calibration, and visual-semantic posterior fusion. The first module retains class means and within-class scatters, combining class-specific and shared covariances to stabilize distribution estimation. The second module learns class-specific weights over text templates from current-task images, adapting text representations to downstream classes. The third module combines the visual and semantic posteriors through a weighted product of experts for prediction over all seen classes without retaining images from previous tasks. Across nine datasets under two incremental protocols, TAP achieves state-of-the-art performance, attaining the highest average incremental and final-stage accuracies among the compared methods. The code is provided as an ancillary file.

AI.tldr: TAP：冻结CLIP编码器，仅在嵌入空间用轻量模块累积类条件视觉分布、类自适应文本模板权重与视觉-语义后验融合实现类增量学习。
AI.motivation: 顺序微调预训练表示成本高且破坏旧类特征结构，故探索在冻结编码器下持续积累类别信息以挖掘表示的判别潜力。
AI.method: 三模块框架：(1) 类条件视觉分布建模，保存类均值与类内散度，混合类特定与共享协方差稳定分布估计；(2) 类自适应语义校准，用当前任务图像学习文本模板的类特定权重；(3) 视觉-语义后验融合，以加权专家乘积在所有已见类上预测，无需保留旧任务图像。
AI.result: 在9个数据集、两种增量协议下取得SOTA，平均增量精度与最终阶段精度最高。
AI.conclusion: 冻结预训练表示的判别潜力可通过轻量统计与语义校准充分挖掘，是无回放的类增量学习高效方案。

title: Learning Ankle Exoskeleton Control for Reactive Standing Balance Through Neuromusculoskeletal Simulation
summary: Deficits in reactive balance can increase fall risk among older adults and individuals with neuromuscular impairments, motivating the need for interventions that improve balance recovery. Wearable robotic exoskeletons offer a promising approach to addressing this need by augmenting balance control. However, developing controllers that deliver appropriately timed and scaled assistance remains challenging, as evaluating each candidate strategy requires repeated exposure to destabilizing perturbations. We propose a simulation-to-real framework that combines motion imitation and reinforcement learning to develop balance-assistive ankle exoskeleton control. A muscle-driven neuromusculoskeletal model was trained using a small set of motion-capture data from a single subject to reproduce kinematic and kinetic responses to backward-translation perturbations. This model served as a virtual human for training a reinforcement-learning exoskeleton controller. The resulting controller generated bilateral ankle assistance using only inertial sensor measurements, without explicit perturbation detection. We implemented the controller on-board a bilateral ankle exoskeleton and evaluated it in five healthy subjects whose data were not used for training. Assistance increased the perturbation magnitude that subjects could withstand without stepping by 11.8% and reduced peak center-of-mass displacement and velocity by 13.5% and 28.2%, respectively. Individual benefits varied with baseline recovery strategy and body mass. These results indicate that a single virtual human can yield transferable balance assistance, and that more diverse virtual humans could further improve its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 提出仿真到实物的框架：用少量单受试者动捕数据训练肌肉驱动神经肌肉骨骼模型作为"虚拟人"，在其上训练强化学习踝关节外骨骼平衡辅助控制器，仅用IMU信号、无扰动检测，在5名未参与训练的健康受试者上验证。
AI.motivation: 老年人及神经肌肉损伤人群的反应性平衡缺陷导致跌倒风险上升，外骨骼可辅助平衡控制；但设计时机与幅度合适的辅助策略需反复施加扰动实验，成本高、风险大，故需可高效迭代的控制器开发范式。
AI.method: 运动模仿+强化学习的仿真到实物框架：以单受试者少量动捕数据训练肌肉驱动神经肌肉骨骼模型，复现后向平移扰动的运动学与动力学响应，作为虚拟人环境；在该环境中训练RL控制器，输出双侧踝关节辅助力矩，仅依赖惯性传感器观测；控制器部署于实体双侧踝外骨骼并在5名健康受试者上评估。
AI.result: 辅助使受试者在不迈步情况下可承受的扰动幅度提升11.8%，质心峰值位移和峰值速度分别降低13.5%和28.2%；个体收益与基线恢复策略及体重相关。
AI.conclusion: 单一虚拟人即可产出可迁移的平衡辅助控制策略，说明该仿真到实物框架有效；更丰富多样的虚拟人有望进一步提升泛化与效果。

title: PRIO: Pre-trained Representation for Interactive Objects in 4D Worlds
summary: 3D worlds can now be captured, reconstructed, and generated at scale, yet the objects in them stay still: a pressed pillow does not compress, and a pulled door does not swing. Bringing these objects into interactive 4D world models requires a representation of how they can move, deform, and respond physically to user actions in real time. We present PRIO, a pre-trained representation for interactive objects. Given static geometry, PRIO predicts an object-specific configuration space in a single forward pass. This space provides generalized coordinates for Lagrangian mechanics, allowing physical laws and user actions to govern motion. Configurations are linear in these coordinates, allowing the quantities needed by the dynamics to be precomputed. Dynamics then run at interactive rates without further network inference. Pre-trained on diverse 4D trajectories, PRIO learns priors over object configurations that generalize to unseen shapes. It supports meshes, point clouds, and 3D Gaussians, bringing objects in reconstructed and generated scenes into interaction. We demonstrate its use in real-to-sim workflows and robot manipulation. In addition, compared with existing 4D generation methods, PRIO generates dynamics faster and follows user actions more faithfully.

AI.tldr: PRIO 是一种预训练表示，能从静态几何单次前向预测物体专属的构型空间，该空间为拉格朗日力学提供广义坐标，使物理与用户交互实时驱动可压缩、可旋转的物体运动。
AI.motivation: 现有 3D 重建与生成世界中的物体是静止的，缺乏描述物体如何运动、形变并实时响应用户操作的表示；需要把静态物体带入可交互的 4D 世界模型。
AI.method: 给定静态几何，PRIO 单次前向输出物体专属构型空间；构型在该坐标下线性，因而动力学所需量可预计算；在多样 4D 轨迹上预训练获得可泛化的构型先验；推理时仅用轻量动力学积分，无需进一步网络前向；支持网格、点云与 3D Gaussian。
AI.result: 动力学以交互速率运行且无需额外网络推理；先验可泛化到未见形状；支撑 real-to-sim 流程与机器人操作；相较现有 4D 生成方法，生成动态更快且更忠实跟随用户操作。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习物体构型空间先验，PRIO 为交互式 4D 物体提供了高效、可控且可泛化的表示，可用于真实扫描与生成场景的交互化及机器人操作。

title: Carry the Fine Print: Budget-Aware Visual Token Compression for Document OCR
comment: 11 pages; supplementary material is included as an ancillary file
summary: Visual token compression often treats salience or similarity as a proxy for transcription importance. Complete document OCR breaks this assumption: small symbols and repeated entries can be indispensable to the transcript despite being visually inconspicuous. We present Select and Compensate, a two-stage framework built on a simple idea: choosing where to retain a token need not determine all the evidence it carries. Selection combines adaptive encoding resolution with global importance and local contrast to choose which tokens to retain as anchors. Compensation enriches these anchors with nearby discarded content and its relative position, without adding tokens. The OCR backbone remains frozen, and native coordinates and structural tokens are preserved. We evaluate complete page transcription across five backbones on OmniDocBench and document reconstruction on MPDocBench. With half the original visual tokens, our input-adapted configuration reaches 95.42 OmniDocBench Overall on Ovis versus 96.09 for the uncompressed model, and paired evaluations show gains over simply reducing the input resolution on both benchmarks. With the original input grid, our method stays within 0.17 points of the uncompressed model at 75% retention and exceeds a learned global selector by 4.70 points at 25%. On a fixed 200-page Ovis workload at the same 50% visual-token budget, only 3 of its outputs hit the length limit, versus 30-34 for the evaluated RTPrune, DivPrune, and HiPrune adaptations, and it finishes the batch 35-40% sooner. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: Select and Compensate：文档OCR视觉token压缩两阶段框架，用全局重要性+局部对比选锚点，再用邻近被丢弃内容与相对位置补偿，冻结OCR骨干，半token下OmniDocBench Overall 95.42（Ovis，未压缩96.09）。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token压缩把显著性/相似度当作转写重要性的代理，但完整文档OCR中微小符号与重复条目虽视觉不显著却不可或缺，该假设失效，需要新的保留/信息承载解耦思路。
AI.method: 两阶段：①Selection——自适应编码分辨率 + 全局重要性 + 局部对比度，决定保留哪些token作为anchor；②Compensation——用邻近被丢弃内容及其相对位置增强anchor而不增加token数；OCR骨干冻结，保留原生坐标与结构token。在OmniDocBench（5个骨干）与MPDocBench上评测。
AI.result: 半token预算下Ovis达95.42 Overall（未压缩96.09）；与原分辨率输入对比成对评测双基准均有增益；原输入网格下75%保留仅差0.17分，25%保留超出学习式全局选择器4.70分；固定200页工作负载、50%预算下仅3个输出触及长度上限（RTPrune/DivPrune/HiPrune适配为30–34），批处理快35–40%。
AI.conclusion: 将"选哪里保留"与"承载哪些证据"解耦是有效的文档OCR token压缩范式，兼顾精度、输出长度稳定性与吞吐。

title: Persona Lenses: What Makes a Vision-Language Model See Through Its Persona's Eyes?
comment: 29 pages, 9 figures, 14 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Vision-language models have been used to simulate where a user looks on a web page. However, a persona in the prompt reaches the simulated gaze only partly. We measure this reach as the difference in one model's gaze between two MatrAIx personas that differ in a single attribute. We introduce persona lenses, which place the persona between the model and the page: a text lens (a two-step prompt in which the model first writes what the persona would look at), a pixel lens (marks on the region matching the persona's interests) and a weight lens (a dwell reward gated to keep the scanpath natural). Using Qwen3-VL (4B and 32B) and Qwen3.5-9B on generated and live pages, we compare the lenses with one another and with scale, the 32B model with no lens. It has been confirmed that the text lens separates the personas strongly but is not robust to profile changes that should not move gaze. The pixel lens separates the personas less but is unaffected by attributes unrelated to gaze. At 4B and 9B, the weight lens separates the personas on interests held out from training, with no extra step on a new page. The 32B model separates the personas with the base prompt alone. Therefore, the choice of a lens depends on cost and model size.

AI.tldr: 提出"人格透镜"(persona lenses)：文本透镜、像素透镜、权重透镜三种在两阶段中注入用户人格以模拟网页注视点的方法，并用"单属性人格差异引起的注视差异"量化其影响力。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型可模拟用户网页浏览的注视位置，但仅在提示词中写入人格(persona)对模拟注视的影响有限，缺少对"人格→注视"映射强弱与鲁棒性的度量与可控注入手段。
AI.method: 定义度量：两个人格仅差一个属性时的模型注视差异即"影响力"。三种透镜置于模型与页面之间：文本透镜(两步提示，模型先写出该人格会看什么)、像素透镜(在符合人格兴趣的区域打标记)、权重透镜(按停留奖励加权，并以门控保持扫描路径自然)。在生成页面与真实网页上，用 Qwen3-VL 4B/32B 与 Qwen3.5-9B 横向比较各透镜及规模效应，并与无透镜的32B基线对比。
AI.result: 文本透镜对人格区分度强，但对本不应影响注视的档案改动不鲁棒；像素透镜区分度较弱，却不受无关属性干扰；4B和9B上权重透镜能在训练未见的兴趣属性上实现人格区分，且新页面无需额外步骤；32B仅用基础提示即可区分人格。
AI.conclusion: 透镜的选择取决于成本与模型规模：小模型宜用权重透镜以获得泛化与零额外推理步，大模型可依赖基础提示；鲁棒性与区分度之间存在权衡。

title: Life-IQA+: Boosting Blind Image Quality Assessment via GCN-enhanced Layer Interaction and Flexible Hierarchical Expert Specialization
summary: Blind image quality assessment (BIQA) is essential for evaluating and optimizing visual experience. Existing BIQA methods typically aggregate features from multiple backbone stages without accounting for their unequal contributions to quality prediction. Furthermore, uniformly supervising all experts may constrain their flexibility and limit the diversity of the learned quality representations. To address these issues, we present Life-IQA+, a quality representation decoding framework that combines graph convolutional network (GCN) enhanced layer interaction and flexible hierarchical expert specialization. Specifically, the layer interaction module constructs quality queries from GCN-refined deepest-stage features and uses penultimate-stage features as keys and values, thereby enabling cross-layer representation interaction via the cross-attention mechanism. Building on these representations, we further introduce a flexible hierarchical mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture comprising a densely activated shared expert layer and a sparsely activated routed expert layer. To enhance the representation diversity and ability of experts, we apply auxiliary classification supervision to a subset of shared experts using distortion-type labels for synthetic datasets and discretized quality-level labels for authentic datasets. Experiments on synthetic and authentic distortion benchmarks, together with controlled ablations of expert configurations and supervision strategies, show that Life-IQA+ achieves competitive prediction accuracy with a favorable balance between accuracy and computational cost. The code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: Life-IQA+：GCN增强的跨层交互 + 灵活分层混合专家（共享稠密专家 + 稀疏路由专家）的盲图像质量评价框架，对部分共享专家施加辅助分类监督以提升表示多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有BIQA方法简单聚合多阶段主干特征，忽视各阶段对质量预测的贡献差异；且对所有专家统一监督会限制专家灵活性与质量表示的多样性。
AI.method: 以GCN精化的最深阶段特征构造quality query，倒数第二层特征作key/value，经cross-attention实现跨层交互；构建分层MoE（稠密激活共享专家层 + 稀疏激活路由专家层）；对子集共享专家引入辅助分类监督（合成数据用失真类型标签，真实数据用离散化质量等级标签）。
AI.result: 在合成与真实失真基准上取得有竞争力的预测精度，并在专家配置与监督策略的消融中显示较好的精度-计算开销平衡。
AI.conclusion: 跨层交互与灵活分层专家特化能有效提升BIQA的特征利用效率与表示多样性，且保持计算经济性。

title: Mesh-Free Keypoint Learning for Category-Level 6D Object Pose Estimation
summary: Category-level 6D pose estimation relates partial RGB-D observations of unseen instances to a canonical frame shared across a category. Object-aware reconstruction helps adaptive keypoints retain the geometry of the visible surface. Common reconstruction targets select observed points by their distance to a registered instance surface. We present MORSEPose, which derives this support directly from standard pose and metric-size annotations. We map observed 3D points to normalized object coordinates and retain those inside a tolerancedilated pose-and-size envelope. This construction is consistent across camera frames and metric scales. When the annotated extent bounds the object surface, the envelope conservatively contains the support of a conventional surface-distance selector. We integrate this target with multi-level RGB-D features, adaptive keypoints, and learnable category context. Experiments on REAL275 and HouseCat6D show that the envelope closely matches surface-based supervision at both point and task levels, remains stable under boundary perturbations and viewpoint changes, and supports competitive category-level pose accuracy across benchmarks.

AI.tldr: MORSEPose提出用标准位姿与度量尺寸标注直接推导类别级6D位姿估计的重建监督支撑区域（容差膨胀的位姿-尺寸包络），替代传统的表面距离选点，并与多层级RGB-D特征、自适应关键点、可学习类别上下文整合。
AI.motivation: 现有类别级6D位姿方法用"到已配准实例表面的距离"来选取重建目标点，依赖实例表面配准，构造繁琐且不便于跨帧/跨尺度一致地定义。作者希望直接从标准标注（位姿+度量尺寸）得到等价且更简洁的重建支撑。
AI.method: 将观测3D点映射到归一化物体坐标（NOC），仅保留落在"容差膨胀的位姿-尺寸包络"内的点作为重建目标；该构造跨相机帧与度量尺度一致，并在标注尺寸包住物体表面时保守包含传统表面距离选择器的支撑集。随后与多层级RGB-D特征、自适应关键点及可学习类别上下文结合完成类别级位姿估计。
AI.result: 在REAL275与HouseCat6D上，该包络监督在点级与任务级均与基于表面的监督高度吻合；对边界扰动与视角变化保持稳定；在多个基准上取得有竞争力的类别级位姿精度。
AI.conclusion: 用位姿与尺寸标注构造的包络可有效替代表面距离选点，作为类别级6D位姿重建的一致、鲁棒监督，且实现更简单、标注依赖更弱。

title: Multi-View Relighting with Mergeable Radiance Fields
summary: We propose MergeableRF, a method for radiance field relighting through model parameter merging. Given multi-view images of a scene under known basis lights, our goal is to relight the scene by directly combining the parameters of radiance fields trained under these lights. This is motivated by the linearity of light transport: the image under a mixture of lights is the same weighted combination of the images under each light. However, combining the parameters of independently trained radiance fields does not produce the corresponding combination of images. To address this, we represent a scene with shared geometry and a separate appearance network for each basis light. We start these networks from the same initialization and introduce merge-aware training, which teaches their parameter combinations to reproduce the corresponding combinations of images. Given a target HDR environment map, we compute its basis-light coefficients and use them to merge the appearance networks into a single relit model. Our method supports both Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), without material estimation, additional relighting networks, or target-specific optimization. Unlike image-space blending, it requires only one rendering pass per viewpoint. Experiments on synthetic Neural Gaffer objects and real OLATverse captures demonstrate relighting quality competitive with methods trained on the same multi-light observations.

AI.tldr: MergeableRF通过"共享几何+各基光照独立外观网络+merge-aware训练"实现基光照辐射场参数的线性可合并，从而用目标环境光系数一次合并得到重光照模型，兼容NeRF与3DGS，每视角仅需一次渲染。
AI.motivation: 光传输的线性性意味着混合光照下的图像等于各基光照图像按系数加权求和，但直接线性组合独立训练的辐射场参数并不能得到对应的图像组合。作者希望绕开材质估计、额外重光照网络和目标场景逐例优化，直接以参数合并的方式实现高效重光照。
AI.method: 给定已知基光照下的多视角图像，为每个基光照训练一个外观网络，共享同一几何表示，并全部从相同初始化出发；引入merge-aware训练，约束外观网络参数的线性组合重现已观测图像对应的线性组合。推理时对目标HDR环境图求基光照系数，据此合并外观网络得到单一重光照模型。方法统一适配NeRF与3DGS。
AI.result: 在合成Neural Gaffer物体与真实OLATverse采集上与"使用同样多光照观测训练"的方法相比取得有竞争力的重光照质量；相对图像空间混合只需每视角一次渲染，且无需材质估计、附加重光照网络或目标特定优化。
AI.conclusion: 通过构造参数空间可合并的辐射场表示，可在推理阶段直接合并参数实现单次渲染重光照，为多光照分解式重光照提供轻量、可扩展方案，并适用于多种辐射场后端。

title: Contrast Where It Matters: Visual Evidence-Guided Decoding for Mitigating Hallucinations in LVLMs
summary: Despite strong multimodal capabilities, large vision-language models (LVLMs) often hallucinate when linguistic priors outweigh visual evidence or when predictions are grounded in irrelevant or misleading image regions. Training-free contrastive decoding mitigates hallucinations by contrasting the original prediction with an auxiliary one that exposes linguistic priors. Yet existing methods focus on altering the auxiliary input or computation and do not ensure that either branch uses query-relevant visual evidence during decoding. We propose Visual Evidence-Guided Decoding (VEGD), a training-free framework that identifies query-relevant visual evidence and guides its use throughout contrastive decoding. VEGD locates this evidence by aggregating localization heads with strong visual responses and coherent spatial structure, then selectively weakens it in the auxiliary image. During generation, VEGD directs visual-carrier heads in both branches toward the same evidence location, strengthening access to intact evidence in the main branch while anchoring the auxiliary branch to its weakened counterpart. An adaptive distribution fusion strategy then combines or contrasts their predictions according to distribution divergence. Experiments across diverse LVLMs and benchmarks demonstrate that VEGD consistently reduces hallucinations.

AI.tldr: VEGD：一种免训练对比解码框架，先定位与查询相关的视觉证据，再在主/辅助分支中引导视觉承载头聚焦同一证据，并用自适应分布融合降低LVLM幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练对比解码只改变辅助输入或计算方式，未保证任一分 поддерж分支在解码时使用与查询相关的视觉证据，因而在语言先验压过视觉证据或预测锚定于无关/误导区域时仍会幻觉。
AI.method: 1）通过聚合具有强视觉响应且空间结构连贯的定位头来定位查询相关视觉证据；2）在辅助图像中对该证据区域做选择性削弱；3）生成时在双分支中引导视觉承载头指向同一证据位置——主分支保留完整证据，辅助分支锚定被削弱版本；4）依据分布散度自适应选择融合或对比两支预测。
AI.result: 在多种LVLM与多个基准上实验，VEGD一致地降低幻觉。
AI.conclusion: 将"证据定位—证据引导—自适应融合"整合进对比解码，是免训练缓解LVLM幻觉的有效途径。

title: CoachSI: Self-Improvement of Robot Policies with a Language Coach
summary: Generalist robot policies execute atomic skills reliably but fail when the same skills are composed into long-horizon tasks. Self-improvement from the policy's own experience does not close this gap: experience collected by the policy alone stays within its own distribution and reproduces what it can already do. We show that what the policy lacks is not a skill but the next step. We present CoachSI, a self-improvement method in which a frozen, off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM) coaches the policy in language: it watches the robot and names the next step in the format of the policy's atomic instructions, and never outputs an action. Successful coached rollouts are relabeled in hindsight with the original task instruction and used to fine-tune the policy. The fine-tuned policy is then deployed on its own. On states where a World Action Model and a Vision-Language-Action model have stalled, naming the next step raises subgoal completion by 4.6x over the unchanged task instruction, and the frozen VLM supplies it from the same camera images the policy sees. After fine-tuning, unassisted success on long-horizon tasks in unseen scenes rises from 47.4% to 59.3%, 9.8 points above fine-tuning on human demonstrations and 7.3 points above fine-tuning on self-collected successes at an equal data budget. With a coach that sees only camera images, it reaches 56.8%, above both baselines. The gain is obtained with the action backbone frozen: language coaching teaches the policy what should happen next, and the skills it already has do the rest.

AI.tldr: CoachSI 用冻结的现成 VLM 作为"教练"，仅以语言给出策略原子指令格式的下一步子目标（不输出动作），成功的教练轨迹以原始任务指令做后见重标注用于微调，从而在动作骨干冻结的前提下提升长程任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人策略能可靠执行原子技能，但在把同样的技能组合成长程任务时失效；仅靠策略自身经验做自提升无法弥合该差距，因为自采经验仍局限于策略自身分布、只能复现已有能力。作者指出缺的不是技能，而是"下一步该做什么"。
AI.method: 冻结的 off-the-shelf VLM 观察机器人（直接从策略所用同一相机图像），按策略原子指令格式命名下一子目标，不输出动作；将教练成功的 rollout 用原任务指令做 hindsight relabeling，用于微调策略；部署时策略独立运行、不再需要教练。动作骨干保持冻结。与人类演示微调、自采集成功数据微调在等数据预算下对比，并有仅用相机图像的教练变体。
AI.result: 在 World Action Model 与 VLA 模型停滞的状态上，命名下一步使子目标完成率相比原始任务指令提升 4.6 倍；微调后未见场景长程任务无辅助成功率从 47.4% 提升至 59.3%，比人类演示微调高 9.8 点、比等预算自采集成功数据微调高 7.3 点；仅用相机图像的教练达到 56.8%，仍高于两个基线。
AI.conclusion: 语言教练教会策略"接下来该发生什么"，已有技能完成其余部分，实现无需额外动作监督、无需人类数据的自提升；冻结 VLM 即可把长程技能组合问题转化为子目标生成问题。

title: Support-Guided Triadic Decoding for Hallucination Mitigation in Multimodal Dialogue with LVLMs
summary: In multimodal multi-turn dialogue, dialogue history plays a dual role: reliable responses provide useful context for subsequent turns, whereas hallucinated responses can propagate errors across turns. Existing training-free methods globally adjust the effect of dialogue history on generation, making it difficult to suppress misleading information without weakening useful context. To address this trade-off, we introduce Support-Guided Triadic Decoding (SGTD), a training-free framework that selectively controls the influence of unreliable history and fuses complementary predictions during decoding. Specifically, Historical Answer Support Estimation measures the visual support of historical responses against type-matched alternatives and identifies low-support content that may mislead later generation. Support-Targeted Attention Intervention then weakens the influence of this content while preserving the surrounding dialogue, producing a support-refined prediction. Triadic Decoding combines this prediction with the full-history prediction and answer-free visual evidence, while the Support-Adaptive Plausibility Constraint filters implausible tokens using visual agreement and historical support. Experiments on MMHalSnowball and VisDiaHalBench across representative LVLMs show that SGTD consistently achieves the highest accuracy under hallucinated histories while preserving the benefits of factual context.

AI.tldr: SGTD：免训练三分支解码框架，通过历史答案支持度估计定位多模态对话历史中的低支撑（可疑幻觉）内容，用支持定向注意力干预削弱其影响，再融合全历史预测与无答案视觉证据进行三分支解码，并用支持自适应合理性约束过滤token，从而在保留有效上下文的同时抑制幻觉传播。
AI.motivation: 多模态多轮对话中，对话历史具有双重作用：可靠回答提供有用上下文，幻觉回答则跨轮传播错误。现有免训练方法对历史整体做全局权重调整，无法区分地抑制误导信息而不削弱有用上下文，存在难以调和的权衡。
AI.method: 免训练框架，含四个组件：(1) Historical Answer Support Estimation——用类型匹配的候选答案衡量历史回答的视觉支撑度，识别低支撑内容；(2) Support-Targeted Attention Intervention——定向削弱低支撑内容对注意力的影响，同时保留周边对话，得到支持精炼预测；(3) Triadic Decoding——将精炼预测、全历史预测和无需答案的视觉证据三者融合；(4) Support-Adaptive Plausibility Constraint——结合视觉一致性与历史支撑度过滤不合理token。
AI.result: 在 MMHalSnowball 与 VisDiaHalBench 两个基准上，跨多个代表性 LVLM 评测，SGTD 在存在幻觉历史的设置下持续取得最高准确率，同时保留事实性上下文带来的收益。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度、可定位地控制历史影响优于全局调整策略，免训练解码级干预即可有效缓解多轮多模态对话中的幻觉累积传播，且不牺牲有效上下文利用。

title: Query-Aware vs. Query-Agnostic Training-Free Video Token Pruning in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Video Large Language Models process large numbers of visual tokens, making token pruning important for efficient inference. Training-free pruning methods differ in whether and how they use the user query, and the value of query conditioning remains unclear. We present a controlled study of training-free, pre-LLM video token selection. Using a shared Qwen-3-VL backbone, token budgets, and decoding settings, we compare 21 pruning principles spanning query-agnostic, shallow query-conditioned, structured query-conditioned, and holistic strategies. To instantiate the last two categories, we introduce Structured Query Pruning, which decomposes the question into semantic anchors, and a Pareto variant, which combines anchor relevance with query-agnostic visual diversity. Across Video-MME, MVBench, and LongVideoBench, relevance computed from the raw question embedding is unreliable (8--16 points below the best methods), whereas anchors derived from query decomposition avoid this failure. However, query access is not inherently advantageous: strong query-agnostic coverage methods remain competitive or superior in the full-field comparison. Relative to a redundancy-only baseline, structured selection helps most on evidence-specific and long-context tasks at tight budgets; on broad tasks, the holistic selector improves over either relevance or redundancy alone. Further, pruning reduces cost and memory. These results support a practical design rule: preserve visual coverage by default, and add structured relevance when the task and token budget demand selective evidence retrieval.

AI.tldr: 对21种免训练视频token剪枝策略（查询无关/浅层查询条件/结构化查询条件/整体）在固定Qwen-3-VL骨干下做受控对比，提出结构化查询剪枝与Pareto变体，结论是默认保覆盖、按任务按预算加结构化相关性。
AI.motivation: 视频大语言模型需处理大量视觉token，token剪枝对高效推理至关重要；现有免训练剪枝方法在是否及如何使用用户查询上各不相同，query conditioning的实际价值不明。
AI.method: 固定骨干（Qwen-3-VL）、token预算与解码设置的受控比较研究，覆盖21种LLM前视频token选择原则；提出Structured Query Pruning（将问题分解为语义锚点）及Pareto变体（锚点相关性+查询无关视觉多样性）。
AI.result: 在Video-MME、MVBench、LongVideoBench上，原始问题嵌入的相关性不可靠（比最佳方法低8-16分），查询分解得到的语义锚点可规避该失效；强查询无关覆盖方法在全场对比中仍具竞争力甚至更优；相比纯冗余基线，结构化选择在证据特定与长上下文、紧预算任务上收益最大，宽泛任务上整体选择器优于单一相关性或冗余。
AI.conclusion: 给出实用设计准则：默认保持视觉覆盖，当任务与token预算需要选择性证据检索时再加入结构化相关性；剪枝同时降低计算与显存开销。

title: Anchored Inertial Proposals with Objective Verification for Diffusion-Prior Inverse Problems
summary: Training-free diffusion priors are powerful for inverse problems, but measurement guidance during reverse sampling is local: aggressive updates can improve immediate data fit while disrupting later denoising. We introduce an anchored inertial correction rule that separates proposal generation from acceptance. At each corrected step, the denoiser prediction anchors a frozen clean-space objective combining measurement fit with a noise-level-dependent proximal term. Heavy-ball dynamics with step size and momentum computed from the measured curvature generate a clean-state candidate; a separate verifier evaluates it with the same objective, with the denoiser prediction retained as fallback; both stages are derived from one objective for the whole trajectory, considered one step at a time. The accepted clean state is re-noised to continue sampling. The rule applies to pixel and latent diffusion with differentiable measurement operators, requires no retraining, and adds no denoiser calls inside the correction loop. We analyze how objective verification yields local nonincrease and displacement control. Across natural-image benchmarks, the method achieves competitive reconstruction quality. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出锚定惯性校正规则：将扩散逆问题中的“提议生成”与“接受判定”解耦，用同一干净空间目标（测量拟合+随噪声水平变化的近端项）驱动重球动力学提案，并用独立验证器决定接受或回退到去噪预测，接受态加噪继续采样，无需重训。
AI.motivation: 训练无关扩散先验在逆问题中很有效，但反向采样中的测量引导是局部贪心的：激进的更新能改善即时数据拟合，却会破坏后续去噪过程。需要一种在保持数据拟合的同时控制位移、避免轨迹退化的引导机制。
AI.method: 在每个校正步上，以去噪器预测为锚点定义冻结的干净空间目标（测量拟合项+噪声水平相关的近端项）；用基于测得曲率计算的步长与动量做Heavy-ball动力学生成干净态候选；再由独立验证器以同一目标评估候选（拒绝时回退到去噪预测）；接受态重新加噪继续采样。全程由单一目标逐步推导，适用于像素/潜空间扩散与可微测量算子，无需重训，校正循环内不额外调用去噪器。并给出目标验证带来局部不增性与位移控制的解析。
AI.result: 理论分析表明目标验证可保证局部目标非增并约束状态位移；在自然图像逆问题基准上取得具有竞争力的重建质量，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过将引导更新的“提案”与“接受”分离并统一在同一干净空间目标下，可在零重训、零额外去噪调用的开销下实现更稳定的扩散逆问题采样，提升重建质量并具备可分析性保证。

title: TwoPass: Draft-Guided Few-Step Video Prediction for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Action-conditioned video prediction lets robots anticipate the visual consequences of their actions for planning and policy evaluation. Existing predictors denoise each future from noise without using their own estimate of it, which limits the quality of the predicted future, in particular of the manipulated objects, and requires many network calls. We present TwoPass, a self-conditioned training-and-inference framework that keeps the standard flow-matching objective. Self-Generated Draft Training supplies a detached clean-video estimate from the shared network as conditioning at the same noisy state. A Refinement-Only Late Adapter applies a dedicated residual transformation when a draft is present. At inference, Draft-Reuse Iterative Refinement obtains both a solver update and the next draft from each velocity prediction, requiring as few as 4 function evaluations (NFE) per video chunk. Training samples discrete solver-query noise levels and updates the pretrained backbone. Extensive experiments on Bridge and Language Table show that TwoPass achieves state-of-the-art results with 4 NFE, far fewer than the 50-59 calls of existing predictors. Code: this https URL .

AI.tldr: TwoPass：自条件化动作条件视频预测框架，用自生成草稿训练+推理时草稿复用迭代精化，仅需4 NFE即达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件视频预测器对每个未来帧从纯噪声独立去噪，未利用自身对未来的估计，导致被操纵物体外观质量差且需大量网络调用（50-59 NFE）。
AI.method: 保持标准flow-matching目标：(1) Self-Generated Draft Training——用共享网络在同一噪声状态下产生detach的干净视频估计作为条件；(2) Refinement-Only Late Adapter——存在草稿时施加专用残差变换；(3) 推理端Draft-Reuse Iterative Refinement——每次速度预测同时得到求解器更新与下一次草稿；训练时采样离散求解器噪声水平并更新预训练骨干。
AI.result: 在Bridge和Language Table上取得SOTA，仅用4 NFE，远少于现有方法的50-59次调用。
AI.conclusion: 自条件化+草稿复用可在极低采样预算下显著提升动作条件视频预测质量，适合作为机器人规划与策略评估的高效世界模型。

title: UniReFP: Robust Unified Fingerprinting for Vision Models against Cross-Task Repurposing Attacks
summary: We identify, for the first time, a new model modification attack--the cross-task model repurposing attack--that can render fingerprints generated by existing model fingerprinting approaches inapplicable. To address this challenge, we propose UniReFP--a novel unified model fingerprinting framework applicable to diverse vision models across different tasks--that utilizes ownership evidence in a shared class-level semantic space rather than original task-specific output space, enabling effective ownership verification when a protected model is repurposed across tasks with heterogeneous output formats. Specifically, UniReFP constructs a surrogate classifier by repurposing the protected model, enabling fingerprints to be generated independently of the original task-dependent output space of the protected model. Moreover, it optimizes grouped fingerprints to encode ownership evidence: fingerprints within the same group are encouraged to induce consistent semantic responses and intermediate representations on the surrogate classifier, while producing dispersed responses on independently trained reference classifiers. During verification, UniReFP uses a task-aware semantic projection mechanism to map heterogeneous suspect-model outputs into unified semantic-presence vectors, and determines ownership by measuring inner-group consistency. Extensive experimental results validate the effectiveness of UniReFP, consistently showing superior performance under cross-task repurposing attacks, commonly studied model modification attacks, and even their combinations.

AI.tldr: 提出跨任务模型再用途攻击，并据此设计统一模型指纹框架 UniReFP，通过共享类别级语义空间完成跨异构输出格式的权属验证。
AI.motivation: 现有模型指纹依赖原始任务特定输出空间，当受保护模型被再用途到输出格式异构的其它任务时指纹失效；作者首次识别该"跨任务模型再用途攻击"。
AI.method: 构造替代分类器（repurpose 受保护模型）使指纹生成脱离原任务输出空间；优化分组指纹，使同组指纹在替代分类器上产生一致的语义响应与中间表示、在独立训练的参考分类器上响应分散；验证阶段用任务感知语义投影把异构可疑模型输出映射为统一"语义存在性向量"，以组内一致性判定权属。
AI.result: 实验表明 UniReFP 在跨任务再用途攻击、常见模型修改攻击及其组合下均持续优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 将指纹锚定于类级语义空间而非任务特定输出，是提升模型权属验证跨任务鲁棒性的可行路径。

title: Communication-Aware UAV Spatio-Temporal Relay Cooperation and Planning in Complex Urban Environments
summary: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are increasingly deployed in low-altitude urban airspace for delivery, emergency response, and other applications. However, UAV mobility across spatially heterogeneous urban communication environments can lead to time-varying communication outages, disrupting mission execution and compromising flight safety. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a Spatio-Temporal Relay Cooperation and Planning (ST-RCP) framework that leverages delivery UAVs as opportunistic communication relays for disconnected UAVs without requiring additional communication infrastructure. The framework predicts communication blind-spot events over a finite planning horizon, constructs a helper-event compatibility graph, and jointly optimizes relay selection, obstacle-aware trajectory replanning, and communication-aware scheduling. Multiple planners are evaluated to investigate the trade-offs among communication coverage, computational cost, and energy consumption. Experiments based on real-world traffic scenarios compare the performance of ST-RCP against baseline methods. In the peak scenario, ST-RCP improves descent-phase communication coverage by 29.93% compared with the base-station baseline and by 27.38%, 22.02%, and 15.20% compared with configurations using one, two, and three dedicated relay UAVs, respectively. Process flexibility analysis demonstrates that predictive task-aware relaying expands the pool of feasible relay resources and improves communication continuity while maintaining the feasibility of delivery missions. These findings demonstrate the potential of trajectory-enabled UAV coordination to enhance the safety and resilience of urban aerial operations.

AI.tldr: 提出ST-RCP框架，利用配送无人机作为机会式中继，通过预测通信盲区事件、构建helper-event兼容图，联合优化中继选择、障碍感知轨迹重规划与通信感知调度，提升城市低空无人机通信覆盖与任务连续性。
AI.motivation: 城市低空空间通信环境空间异质，无人机移动时会出现时变通信中断，影响任务执行与飞行安全；且不希望依赖额外通信基础设施。
AI.method: 在有限规划时域内预测通信盲区事件；构建helper-event兼容图；联合优化中继选择、障碍感知轨迹重规划与通信感知调度；对比多种规划器以分析覆盖、算力与能耗的权衡。基于真实交通场景做实验。
AI.result: 峰值场景下下降阶段通信覆盖率相比基站基线提升29.93%，相比1/2/3架专用中继无人机配置分别提升27.38%、22.02%、15.20%；流程灵活性分析表明预测式任务感知中继扩大了可行中继资源池并保持配送任务可行性。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹驱动的无人机协同可提升城市空中作业的安全性与韧性，无需额外基础设施即可缓解通信中断。

title: Online Mistake Detection in Instruction-Conditioned Procedural Video
summary: An assistant monitoring a person performing a procedure is most useful when it can detect mistakes while there is still time to recover. This requires judging actions against task instructions as the video unfolds, identifying the attempted step, locating it in time, and assessing its execution. Existing online detectors do not use the instruction text, while instruction-conditioned methods operate offline. In this paper, we study online, instruction-conditioned mistake detection in egocentric videos. Using only observed video, task instructions, and prior predictions, our model identifies and localizes completed action attempts and classifies them as correct, modified, slip, corrections, or additions; omitted steps are determined after the video ends. We compare a modular pipeline, with separate step identification, temporal localization, and execution verification, to a joint model that predicts all outputs in a single step. To support supervised learning from mistakes, we repartition EgoPER to include erroneous videos in all splits. The approaches achieve similar step-segmentation F1@0.5 (93.6% and 92.1%), while the joint model achieves higher binary mistake-detection F1@0.5 (84.1% vs. 80.7%), with its largest gain on slips (56.4% vs. 37.5%). Component-level analysis suggests that error propagation between stages contributes to the modular approach's lower detection score. On test videos containing mistakes, both designs outperform released AEM and ESTANet checkpoints under our evaluation protocol.

AI.tldr: 提出在线、指令条件化的第一人称视频错误检测：仅用已观测视频、任务指令与先验预测，识别并定位已完成动作尝试，分类为正确/修改/失误/纠正/多余，遗漏步骤待视频结束后判定；比较模块化流水线与联合模型。
AI.motivation: 助手要在操作者仍能挽回时提醒错误，需边看视频边对照指令判断；现有在线检测器不用指令文本，而指令条件化方法均为离线，二者不可兼得。
AI.method: 在线流式设定下，对比两种设计：(1) 模块化流水线，分为步骤识别、时间定位、执行核验三个阶段；(2) 联合模型，单步同时预测全部输出。为支持有监督学习，对 EgoPER 重新划分，使所有 split 均含错误视频。
AI.result: 步骤分割 F1@0.5 相近（93.6% vs 92.1%）；联合模型二值错误检测 F1@0.5 更高（84.1% vs 80.7%），slip 上提升最大（56.4% vs 37.5%）。组件分析表明模块化方案分数偏低源于阶段间误差传播。在含错误的测试视频上，两种设计均优于已发布的 AEM 与 ESTANet 权重。
AI.conclusion: 在线指令条件化错误检测可行且优于离线基线；联合建模避免了级联误差传播，对细微失误（slip）尤为有效，适合早期纠错型辅助系统的实时部署。

title: VidToC: Rethinking Video Token Compression for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Extending multimodal large language models (MLLMs) from images to videos faces substantial memory and latency challenges due to the massive number of visual tokens. These challenges have driven the development of numerous visual token compression methods and more efficient LLM architectures. However, existing compression methods are often evaluated with different training setups, tasks, and models, making fair comparison difficult. Meanwhile, the growing use of hybrid Mamba-Transformer architectures raises questions about whether compression strategies transfer across backbones. We present VidToC, a controlled evaluation framework for representative compression algorithms, LLM backbones, and time encoding strategies, covering training-free and fine-tuned settings on three complementary video understanding tasks. Our results reveal task-dependent compression behavior and characterize the effects of compression placement, time encoding, and backbone choice. These findings provide empirical guidance for designing and selecting video token compression strategies across tasks and training settings.

AI.tldr: VidToC：面向视频多模态大模型的受控评测框架，系统比较视觉token压缩算法、LLM骨干（Transformer vs Mamba-Transformer）与时间编码策略，覆盖免训练与微调设定及三类视频理解任务。
AI.motivation: 视频MLLM的视觉token数量巨大导致显存与延迟瓶颈，现有压缩方法因训练设置、任务、模型不一致而难以公平比较；同时混合Mamba-Transformer骨干兴起，压缩策略能否跨骨干迁移尚无定论。
AI.method: 构建统一受控评测框架VidToC，对代表性token压缩算法、多种LLM骨干、时间编码策略进行控制变量对比，涵盖免训练与微调两种设置，在三类互补的视频理解任务上评测，并分析压缩位置、时间编码与骨干选择的影响。
AI.result: 发现压缩效果具有任务依赖性，并刻画了压缩插入位置、时间编码方式与骨干架构选择对性能的影响规律，为跨任务与跨训练设置的压缩策略设计提供经验依据。
AI.conclusion: 视频token压缩不存在通用最优方案，需按任务与训练范式选择；该工作提供了可复用的受控评测基准与选型指南。

title: Trajectory-Calibrated Merging of Embodied Policies
summary: Robot foundation models are increasingly adapted into task specialists to expand their embodied capabilities. Yet these capabilities remain fragmented across separate policies, and existing model-merging methods do not reliably preserve them during closed-loop execution: parameter-space alignment provides only an indirect proxy for behavior, while regression may fail to preserve behavior at states not covered by its calibration inputs. We present Trajectory-Calibrated Regression (TCR), an execution-aware, gradient-free framework that consolidates robot specialists into a single policy. Across two complementary timescales, TCR collects calibration inputs from expert rollouts spanning different stages of task execution and from intermediate states within iterative action generation. To account for representation shifts introduced by merging, TCR recomputes each block's input through the already merged blocks. It then uses each expert's computation within the block to form module inputs and fits merged weights to match the experts' linear outputs. A two-pass calibration procedure further refines the merged policy using separate rollout caches while retaining the frozen specialists as teachers. The resulting model preserves the original inference graph and requires neither expert routing nor additional gradient training. On LIBERO, TCR merges four $\pi_{0.5}$ specialists and achieves 77.83% success across 1,200 evaluation episodes, outperforming FeatCal, RegMean, and direct weight averaging by 9.50, 24.17, and 33.00 percentage points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出轨迹校准回归（TCR）：无梯度、执行感知的专家合并框架，用专家 rollout 与迭代生成中间态作为校准输入，逐 block 按已合并块的表示重算输入并对齐专家线性输出，两轮校准精化，从而把多个机器人专家策略合并为单一策略，LIBERO 上四专家合并达 77.83% 成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人基础模型被微调为各类任务专家后能力碎片化，现有模型合并（权重平均、RegMean、FeatCal 等）在闭环执行中难以保持行为：参数空间对齐只是行为的间接代理，回归校准未覆盖的状态上行为易失效。
AI.method: 梯度无关、执行感知合并：①双时间尺度采集校准输入——专家 rollout 覆盖任务不同执行阶段，以及迭代动作生成过程中的中间状态；②考虑合并带来的表示漂移，逐 block 用已合并块重算输入，再以各专家在该 block 内的计算构造模块输入，拟合合并权重匹配专家线性输出；③两轮校准，用独立 rollout 缓存、冻结专家作教师精化；保持原推理图，无需专家路由或额外梯度训练。
AI.result: LIBERO 上合并四个 π0.5 专家，1200 个评测 episode 成功率 77.83%，分别超过 FeatCal、RegMean、直接权重平均 9.50、24.17、33.00 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以执行轨迹为校准依据的回归式合并在闭环成功率上显著优于参数对齐与静态回归方法，且不增加推理开销，为多专家能力整合提供了实用且轻量的方案；尚需真机与更广任务域验证。

title: QFT-Based Hybrid PointNet-Quantum Neural Networks for LiDAR Point-Cloud Classification
summary: Hybrid quantum-classical learning architectures provide a promising framework for integrating quantum feature transformations into complex data-processing tasks. Among these transformations, the Quantum Fourier Transform (QFT) offers a structured approach to feature processing, motivating an investigation of how its circuit configuration influences predictive performance, quantum resource requirements, and noise robustness. We present a hybrid PointNet-quantum neural network architecture for LiDAR point-cloud classification, combining classical feature extraction, amplitude encoding, and a variational quantum circuit. Five Fourier-processing configurations are systematically evaluated: No-QFT, Full-QFT-After, QFT-no-swap, IQFT-After, and Trainable-QFT. Experiments on KITTI, nuScenes, and PandaSet across three random seeds assess classification performance, class-level behavior, circuit complexity, and sensitivity to the IBM FakeManilaV2 noise model. Under ideal simulation, IQFT-After achieves the highest weighted F1-score on KITTI (0.857 $\pm$ 0.033), compared with 0.838 $\pm$ 0.023 for No-QFT. Removing the final SWAP gates in the QFT circuit reduces circuit complexity while preserving the Pauli-Z measurement features up to a fixed permutation that can be absorbed by the classification head. Under quantum noise, the circuit ranking changes, with IQFT-After exhibiting greater performance degradation and No-QFT and Trainable-QFT showing stronger robustness. Per-class analysis further identifies dataset-dependent differences in minority-class performance. These results demonstrate that Fourier-processing configuration influences both classification behavior and noise sensitivity, highlighting the role of circuit structure and hardware-aware evaluation in hybrid quantum learning for three-dimensional point-cloud data.

AI.tldr: 在PointNet混合量子-经典架构中系统比较五种QFT电路配置用于LiDAR点云分类，并评估理想仿真与IBM噪声下的性能与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: QFT提供结构化的特征处理方式，但其电路构型如何影响预测性能、量子资源开销与噪声鲁棒性尚缺系统研究。
AI.method: PointNet提取经典特征→振幅编码→变分量子电路；对比No-QFT、Full-QFT-After、QFT-no-swap、IQFT-After、Trainable-QFT五种配置；在KITTI、nuScenes、PandaSet上以3个随机种子实验，统计分类性能、类别行为、电路复杂度（SWAP门移除）及FakeManilaV2噪声敏感性。
AI.result: 理想仿真下IQFT-After在KITTI上加权F1最高（0.857±0.033）优于No-QFT（0.838±0.023）；去掉末尾SWAP门可降低复杂度且保留Pauli-Z测量特征（仅差一个可被分类头吸收的固定置换）；噪声下排序改变，IQFT-After退化更严重，No-QFT与Trainable-QFT更鲁棒；少数类表现呈数据集依赖性差异。
AI.conclusion: 傅里叶处理构型同时影响分类行为与噪声敏感性，凸显电路结构与硬件感知评估在三维点云混合量子学习中的作用。

title: FlashX: Scaling Robotic Experience Reuse for Embodied Agents with CBA-Based NAND Flash
summary: Embodied agents are emerging as a promising paradigm for complex robotic tasks, leveraging Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World Action Models (WAMs) to generate actions through Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based iterative denoising. However, existing models often struggle to generalize to out-of-distribution (OOD) environments. We observe that retrieving successful experiences and using them to warm-start denoising enables agents to better adapt to unfamiliar situations while reducing computational overhead. This creates a new opportunity to improve task accuracy and inference efficiency simultaneously, in contrast to conventional acceleration techniques that trade accuracy for computation. However, realizing this opportunity requires scaling experience banks, introducing substantial storage and search overhead that challenges the capacity, bandwidth, and power constraints of edge systems. We propose FlashX, a CMOS Directly Bonded to Array (CBA)-based NAND flash architecture for scalable experience reuse in embodied agents. FlashX exploits CBA's high internal bandwidth for parallel pSLC key search, employing interleaved Compute-in-Flash (CIF) engines to sustain sensing throughput while retaining dense TLC latent storage. Proprioception-aware clustering further reduces search overhead and enables incremental experience acquisition without global reclustering. Evaluations across VLA and WAM workloads demonstrate up to 12.24\%p and 7.43\%p improvements in task success under dense and compute-efficient configurations, respectively. FlashX achieves 2.57$\times$ higher search throughput than the strongest prior NAND search architecture under pSLC sensing, with a further 9.7$\times$ search reduction through clustering. This delivers 1.29--3.95$\times$ end-to-end speedup and 1.12--2.34$\times$ energy efficiency improvement over SSD-based retrieval.

AI.tldr: FlashX 提出基于 CMOS 直接键合阵列(CBA)的 NAND 闪存架构，用并行 pSLC 键搜索 + Compute-in-Flash 引擎，将成功经验检索用于 DiT 去噪热启动，从而在 VLA/WAM 具身智能体上同时提升 OOD 任务成功率与推理效率。
AI.motivation: DiT 式迭代去噪的 VLA/WAM 在分布外环境泛化差；作者观察到用成功经验热启动去噪既能提升适应性又能降低计算量，但经验库扩大后存储与检索开销超出边缘系统的容量、带宽、功耗限制。
AI.method: CBA 键合 NAND 架构，利用高内部带宽做并行 pSLC 键搜索；交错部署 Compute-in-Flash 引擎在保持感测吞吐的同时保留密集 TLC 潜变量存储；本体感知（proprioception）感知聚类降低搜索开销并支持增量式经验入库，无需全局重聚类。
AI.result: 在 VLA 与 WAM 负载上，密集/计算高效配置下任务成功率分别提升 12.24 与 7.43 个百分点；pSLC 感测下搜索吞吐为最强已有 NAND 搜索架构的 2.57×，聚类再带来 9.7× 搜索量削减；相比基于 SSD 的检索实现 1.29–3.95× 端到端加速与 1.12–2.34× 能效提升。
AI.conclusion: 将经验检索作为去噪热启动可同时改善精度与效率，硬件层面需以存储内搜索架构支撑；FlashX 为具身智能体的大规模经验复用提供了可扩展的边缘存储方案。

title: Cognitive-Horizon Action Chunking: Memory-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Embodied Navigation
summary: Multimodal foundation models are advancing embodied navigation, but frequent inference incurs substantial computational cost. We present Cognitive-Horizon Action Chunking (CHAC), a training-free framework for memory-guided adaptive reasoning with a frozen navigation policy. Retained visual context, completion cues, and controller feedback determine the cognitive horizon, or how many cached waypoints the robot executes before refreshing its prediction. At the policy's stop request, local visitation history guides a bounded correction with at most one extra movement and no additional model calls. CHAC reduces vision-language model calls by 33.4% on HM3D-OVON and 64.7% on R2R-CE, with success-rate decreases of 0.63 and 10.82 percentage points, respectively. Success rate and success weighted by path length improve per model call on both benchmarks. Across four physical navigation tasks with 40 runs per method, CHAC achieves 18 successes versus 14 for native execution, reducing model calls by 54.9% and GPU inference time by 49.7%.

AI.tldr: CHAC：面向冻结VLM导航策略的免训练自适应动作分块框架，用认知视野（执行多少缓存waypoints再刷新预测）动态调节推理频率，并以有界回溯修正处理stop请求，大幅降低模型调用次数。
AI.motivation: 多模态基础模型驱动的具身导航虽然有效，但每个决策步频繁调用VLM推理带来巨大算力开销；现有动作分块/跳帧策略多为固定长度，无法兼顾效率与成功率。
AI.method: 免训练框架，保持导航策略冻结。以保留的视觉上下文、完成度线索和控制器反馈确定"认知视野"（即一次预测后连续执行多少缓存waypoint）。当策略发出stop请求时，用局部访问历史做有界修正，至多一次额外移动且不增加模型调用。
AI.result: HM3D-OVON上VLM调用减少33.4%，成功率仅降0.63个百分点；R2R-CE上调用减少64.7%，成功率降10.82个百分点。两benchmark上每模型调用对应的成功率和SPL均提升。四个真实机器人导航任务（每方法40次）中，成功18次 vs 原生执行14次，模型调用降54.9%，GPU推理时间降49.7%。
AI.conclusion: 自适应推理频率+轻量停止修正可在不训练的情况下显著压缩具身导航的推理成本，并在真机上同时提升成功率，为VLM导航策略的部署效率提供实用方案。

title: GraF-VTA: Neuro-Symbolic Trajectory Generation from Vision and Temporal Logic via Graph-Based Fusion
summary: Robotic planning from visual observations and signal temporal logic (STL) requires grounding task requirements in scene evidence while adapting plans to execution feedback. We present GraF-VTA, a graph-based framework that extends Vision-TL-Action with structured task representations, causal observation history, and closed-loop trajectory generation. Bidirectional cross-attention fuses STL syntax tokens with visual features, while an optional frozen automaton embedding supplies complementary untimed task structure. A temporal pyramid preserves detailed current observations and compresses older frames to provide recent execution context. Conditioned on these features and robot state, a flow-matching model generates plans whose action prefixes are executed before replanning from refreshed observations. Across five simulation environments, the single-graph configuration achieves higher open-loop Success@$K$ than TeLoGraF and Vision-TL-Action on four environments at the reported budgets $K\geq16$. On Panda, matched-update ablations increase Success@256 from 53.91\% without observation history to 62.50\% with pyramid memory. In closed-loop Dubins evaluation, it reaches 64.06\% Success@1024, compared with 12.50\% for adapted S-MSP and 27.34\% for adapted Logic-VLA. These results support combining structured visual conditioning with observation history and replanning to improve coverage of STL-satisfying trajectories.

AI.tldr: GraF-VTA：图结构 + STL 语法-视觉双向交叉注意力 + 时序金字塔观测记忆 + 流匹配规划，闭环重规划生成满足信号时序逻辑的任务轨迹。
AI.motivation: 从视觉观测与 STL 规范出发的机器人规划需要将任务约束落地到场景证据，并依据执行反馈自适应更新计划；现有 Vision-TL-Action 类方法缺乏结构化任务表示、历史观测上下文与闭环轨迹生成能力。
AI.method: 提出基于图的框架 GraF-VTA：以双向交叉注意力融合 STL 语法 token 与视觉特征，可选接入冻结的自动机嵌入提供无时间属性的结构先验；时序金字塔保留当前帧细节并压缩旧帧形成近期执行上下文；以这些特征与机器人状态为条件，用 flow-matching 模型生成轨迹，执行动作前缀后基于刷新观测重规划。
AI.result: 五个仿真环境中，单图配置在四个环境下于 K≥16 预算的开环 Success@K 优于 TeLoGraF 与 Vision-TL-Action；Panda 上匹配更新次数的消融将 Success@256 从无历史观测的 53.91% 提升至含金字塔记忆的 62.50%；闭环 Dubins 评测取得 64.06% Success@1024，优于改造版 S-MSP（12.50%）与 Logic-VLA（27.34%）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化视觉条件 + 观测历史 + 闭环重规划的组合能显著提升 STL 满足轨迹的覆盖率，但证据均为仿真，缺乏真实机器人验证。

title: Characterizing Age-Conditioned Affective Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: An age prompt can change how a vision-language model (VLM) rates the emotion evoked by an image. Does the change predict how people of different ages rate that same image? We evaluate 17 VLMs on 900 OASIS images using young-, middle-, and older-adult prompts and estimate image-specific age differences from ratings by 822 participants. Without an age cue, models closely track average human valence (median Pearson $r=0.891$). Under an older-adult prompt, 16 of 17 models assign lower valence on average than under a young-adult prompt. Yet after adjusting for image pleasantness, correlations between model and human age effects range from $-0.030$ to $0.093$, against an estimated ceiling of $0.595$. The discrepancy is clearest on 54 sensitive images rated as pleasant. Across models, the older prompt reduces valence by $0.845$ points on average, while older participants rate these images $0.443$ points higher than younger participants. Providing human ratings from other images improves agreement on the direction of age differences, although image-specific fidelity remains modest on 600 held-out images ($r_{\mathrm{part}}=0.105$). These results show why evaluations of demographic personalization in foundation models need human comparisons at the level of individual stimuli. Project page available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 论文评估17个视觉语言模型在900张OASIS图像上用不同年龄提示词打分，发现年龄提示确实会降低模型给出的情绪效价，但这种改变与不同年龄真人被试的评分差异几乎不相关（r≈-0.03~0.09，远低于0.595的上限）。
AI.motivation: 基础模型（VLM）常被用于"人口学个性化"，例如通过年龄提示词模拟不同年龄用户的情绪判断，但缺乏以单张刺激为粒度的真人对照证据，无法判断提示词引起的输出变化是否真的对应人群差异。
AI.method: 以900张OASIS图像为刺激，用"青年/中年/老年"三种年龄提示词评测17个VLM的情绪效价打分；同时收集822名被试的评分，估计图像层面的年龄效应；在控制图像愉悦度后计算模型年龄效应与真人年龄效应的相关性，并给出相关性上限估计；另做"提供其他图像真人评分"的few-shot式条件实验，在600张留出图像上评估。
AI.result: 无年龄提示时模型与人类平均效价高度一致（中位r=0.891）；老年提示下17个模型中16个平均给出更低效价；但校正图像愉悦度后，模型年龄效应与真人年龄效应相关系数仅-0.030~0.093（估计上限0.595）。54张被判为愉悦的敏感图像上差异最明显：老年提示使模型平均降0.845分，而老年被试比青年被试高0.443分。提供其他图像的人类评分可改善年龄差异方向的吻合，但图像层面保真度仍有限（留出集r_part=0.105）。
AI.conclusion: 年龄提示词造成的输出偏移是系统性偏差而非人群差异的可靠代理；对基础模型的人口学个性化评估必须在单刺激层面与真人比较，仅看平均分或方向一致性会产生误导。

title: Bradley-Terry Training Can Distort Outcome Probabilities of Initially Accurate Language World Models
summary: Comparative feedback, in which a judge says which of two candidate outcomes is closer to what happened, is a practical way to train language world models that assign probabilities to an action's outcomes. We show that, fitted with a Bradley-Terry objective, it need not teach the true outcome probabilities and can distort accurate ones. On a simulated robot push with enumerated outcome distributions, this objective takes a model that is accurate on unseen layouts (hazard error 2.4 percentage points, pp) and moves 33 to 43 pp of its probability onto outcomes that none of a condition's enumerated branches produces. The cause is the objective, not the comparisons: its optimum, computed before training, predicts where the model ends up, and a likelihood that knows the judge's rule learns from the same comparisons without the shift. The shift is robust: it recurs on unseen conditions, under five candidate laws and a three-fold denser enumeration, and about 29 pp remain without the physically impossible events. Its cost is conditional: with those events it inflates hazard probabilities, and a threshold inherited from the pre-feedback model costs about 3 pp of utility per decision on trained and 1 to 2 pp on unseen conditions, through false rejects; without them the utility loss averages below 1 pp over six seeds, though a small regret in action choice remains. Audits of readout, response and decision trace the effect from probabilities to actions.

AI.tldr: 研究发现 Bradley-Terry 比较反馈目标用于训练语言世界模型时，其最优解本身会系统性地把概率质量推向任何分支都不产生的结果（模拟机器人推物中 33–43 pp），导致危险概率虚高与决策效用损失；改用已知判据的似然目标可避免该偏移。
AI.motivation: 比较式反馈（判断"哪个候选结果更接近实际发生"）是训练语言世界模型的实用手段，但作者怀疑其目标函数是否真能学到真实结果概率，甚至可能破坏原本准确的概率，因此要诊断偏差来源并给出替代方案。
AI.method: 在可枚举结果分布的模拟机器人推物任务上，用 Bradley-Terry 目标拟合比较反馈；预先计算该目标的解析最优解以预测模型收敛位置；在未见过条件、5 种候选规律、3 倍更密集枚举以及剔除物理不可能事件后做鲁棒性检验；并用"知道判据规则的似然目标"在同批比较数据上做对照训练；进一步做读出、响应与决策轨迹审计。
AI.result: 原本在未见过布局上自洽（危险误差 2.4 pp）的模型，在 BT 拟合后把 33–43 pp 概率放到任何枚举分支都不产生的结果上；偏移在未见过条件、多规律、更密集枚举下复现，去掉物理不可能事件后仍残留约 29 pp。扣除不可能事件时，继承自反馈前模型的阈值造成训练条件约 3 pp、未见过条件 1–2 pp 的每决策效用损失（假拒绝）；不含此类事件时六种子平均损失低于 1 pp，但仍存在动作选择上的小幅 regret。
AI.conclusion: 偏移源于目标函数而非比较数据本身，可由目标的最优点事先预测；以判据感知的似然替代 Bradley-Terry 即可在同样比较数据上消除该偏移。因此比较反馈用于世界模型概率校准需谨慎，并应做端到端（概率→响应→动作）审计。

title: LoopedWAM: Looped World Action Models for Elastic Inference
summary: World action models (WAMs) couple generative video modeling with robotic action prediction but typically require large video and action transformers, limiting deployment efficiency. We present LoopedWAM, a compact WAM that recurrently applies a shared six-block core in each expert, executing 30 transformer layers while storing only 12 blocks per expert. To account for their asymmetric inference costs, the video and action experts can operate at different depths: visual features are computed once per query, whereas action computation repeats at every sampling step. We further propose elastic self-distillation, which trains a single elastic checkpoint, LoopedWAM-E, across action-depth and sampling-step budgets. With only 0.58B policy parameters and no robot pretraining, LoopedWAM achieves 96.1% success on LIBERO, 91.9% on RoboTwin 2.0, and 52.2% on RoboCasaGR1, while using $7.4\times$ less peak GPU memory than Fast-WAM under matched inference measurements. On LIBERO, LoopedWAM-E achieves 96.0% success in 27.6 ms or 95.2% in 24.7 ms on an H100, providing multiple accuracy-latency operating points from a single checkpoint; with two sampling steps and four action loops, it stays within 0.5 points of LoopedWAM on all three benchmarks. Ablations demonstrate that weight-shared depth preserves competitive performance, while aggressive action-depth reduction requires explicit budget-aware training. On a real AgileX PiPER arm, LoopedWAM succeeds in 71.3% of 80 trials across four tasks.

AI.tldr: LoopedWAM 通过在每个专家内循环复用共享六层核心实现参数高效的世界动作模型，并提出弹性自蒸馏训练单一弹性检查点以适配不同动作深度与采样步数预算。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAM）通常依赖大规模视频与动作 Transformer，部署效率低；且视频专家与动作专家推理成本不对称（视觉特征每查询一次，动作预测每采样步重复）。
AI.method: 1) LoopedWAM：视频与动作专家各自用共享的六层块循环执行 30 层计算，仅存 12 层权重/专家，允许两专家采用不同深度；2) 弹性自蒸馏训练单一弹性检查点 LoopedWAM-E，覆盖不同动作深度与采样步数预算。
AI.result: 0.58B 策略参数、无机器人预训练下，LIBERO 96.1%、RoboTwin 2.0 91.9%、RoboCasaGR1 52.2%；峰值显存较 Fast-WAM 少 7.4×。LIBERO 上 LoopedWAM-E 达 96.0%/27.6ms 或 95.2%/24.7ms（H100），两采样步+四动作循环时三基准降幅≤0.5 点。真实 AgileX PiPER 四任务 80 次试验成功率 71.3%。消融显示权重共享深度保持性能，激进降低动作深度需显式预算感知训练。
AI.conclusion: 权重共享循环深度是压缩 WAM 的有效手段，配合弹性自蒸馏可在单一检查点内提供多样化精度-延迟工作点，并具备真实机器人可部署性。

title: PAD: Policy-Aware Data Valuation for Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving increasingly depends on scaling training demonstrations, yet data growth does not guarantee proportional gains. However, additional data do not guarantee better policies: a demonstration that benefits one planner may be redundant or harmful to another. Existing curation methods typically infer data value from intrinsic sample properties or training-dependent proxies that do not measure downstream policy utility. To address this, we introduce \textbf{Policy-Aware Data Valuation (PAD)}, a framework that assigns each candidate demonstration a utility specific to the target driving policy. PAD combines scene-level calibration feedback with projected policy gradients and a regularized approximation of local training geometry, producing scalable influence-based values for the policy. A controlled group-removal study establishes the directional fidelity of these values, while cross-planner analysis shows that the same candidate pool induces markedly different rankings across planner families. On DiffusionDrive, PAD improves EPDMS over real-only training by $3.5$ points on NavTest and $5.0$ points on NavHard. Policy-specific curation consistently outperforms real-only and full-pool training across diffusion-, regression-, and flow-matching-based planners while substantially reducing scene-level regressions. These results establish policy-aware data valuation as a basis for replacing indiscriminate data accumulation with targeted policy improvement, enabling more efficient and reliable scaling of autonomous-driving systems.

AI.tldr: PAD: 为端到端自动驾驶每段候选演示分配"策略相关"效用值，融合场景级校准反馈、投影策略梯度与局部训练几何的正则化近似，实现可扩展的 policy-aware 数据估值与筛选。
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶依赖扩大训练数据，但数据量增长≠性能提升：同一演示对不同 planner 可能是冗余甚至有害。现有数据筛选依赖样本内在属性或与训练相关的代理指标，无法衡量下游策略的实际效用。
AI.method: Policy-Aware Data Valuation (PAD)：针对目标驾驶策略为每条候选演示赋值效用；将场景级校准反馈、投影后的策略梯度，以及对局部训练几何的正则化近似相结合，得到可扩展的基于影响的（influence-based）数据价值；用受控的组移除实验验证价值方向保真性，并做跨 planner 排序一致性分析。
AI.result: 组移除实验验证价值的方向保真性；同一候选池在扩散/回归/flow-matching 等不同 planner 家族上产生显著不同的排序。DiffusionDrive 上较 real-only 训练 EPDMS 提升 3.5 分（NavTest）与 5.0 分（NavHard），并在三类 planner 上一致优于 real-only 与全量训练，显著减少场景级性能回退。
AI.conclusion: 策略感知的数据估值可替代"无差别数据累积"，实现有针对性的策略提升，使自动驾驶系统扩展更高效、更可靠；数据价值是策略相关的而非普适的。

title: CaT-Movie: Balancing Global Planning and Local Rendering for Long Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: Current multi-shot video generators render only limited durations per pass, requiring long movies to be stitched from local segments across which narrative progression and visual identity drift. To synthesize long-horizon movies with Coherence across Time, we present CaT-Movie, a multi-shot generation system consisting of a global story planner and a local window renderer. The planner expands user requests via a large language model to preserve, infer, and complete story details, while deterministic code maintains the resulting storyboard across shots to compile self-contained shot prompts and index reference frames from generated history. To execute this guidance, the renderer applies reference-routed sparse self-attention and shot-wise cross-attention to route identities from the indexed frames while isolating per-shot textual conditions. Given the scarcity of high-quality open-source multi-shot data, we construct a dataset of over 350K film shots annotated with semantic state transitions, entity grounding, and multi-granularity requests. We further build CaT-MBench, a benchmark on held-out films with the same annotations. It gives every baseline its native format and counts cross-shot consistency only when a cut opens a new camera setup, preventing repeated framing from passing as consistency. On CaT-MBench, CaT-Movie attains the highest average score and the most consistent characters among all methods. The project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CaT-Movie：全局故事规划器+局部窗口渲染器的多镜头长视频生成系统，通过参考路由稀疏自注意力与镜头级交叉注意力维持跨镜头的时间连贯性与角色身份一致。
AI.motivation: 现有多次采样的多镜头视频生成器单次只能渲染有限时长，拼接长片时叙事推进与视觉身份会漂移；同时开源高质量多镜头数据稀缺，缺乏能严格评价跨镜头一致性的基准。
AI.method: (1) 全局故事规划器：LLM扩写用户请求以保留/推断/补全故事细节，确定性代码维护分镜脚本、编译自包含镜头提示并从已生成历史中索引参考帧；(2) 局部窗口渲染器：参考路由稀疏自注意力+镜头级交叉注意力，从索引帧路由身份并隔离各镜头的文本条件；(3) 构建350K+带语义状态转移、实体定位、多粒度请求标注的电影镜头数据集，并提出CaT-MBench基准（仅在新机位切换时计入跨镜头一致性，防止重复构图蒙混过关）。
AI.result: 在CaT-MBench上取得最高平均分，角色一致性在所有方法中最优；同时给出各基线的原生输入格式以保证公平比较。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM驱动的全局叙事规划与注意力级身份路由相结合，可有效缓解长时序多镜头生成中的叙事与身份漂移；配套的数据集与更严格的一致性评测协议为长视频生成提供了可复用的评估基础。

title: DAWN: Robust Neural Blind Deconvolution via Alternating Wiener Guidance
summary: Blind image deconvolution (BID) is an ill-posed inverse problem that aims to jointly recover a sharp image and blur kernel from a single degraded observation. Under nontrivial and high noise, which is common in photography and scientific imaging such as microscopy, BID remains particularly challenging, as existing methods suffer from noise overfitting and inaccurate kernel estimation. Existing training-data-free learning methods for BID, such as those based on the deep image prior (DIP), often utilize external guidance by including model-based estimates as additional loss terms, which underexploits the information these estimates carry especially under nontrivial noise. To address these challenges, we propose DAWN, a training-data-free DIP framework that alternates between injecting model-based estimates directly into the model input and refining this imperfect estimate with the network's own prior. To provide more reliable kernel estimates for these injections, we apply autoencoding regularization to both the image and kernel networks. On natural and scientific images under varying levels of Gaussian and Poisson noise, DAWN outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both image and kernel quality (achieving up to +4.5 dB over the next best baseline on the Levin dataset at $\sigma = 0.1$). Without any training images, DAWN remains highly competitive with a state-of-the-art diffusion model on FFHQ, despite the latter being trained on a massive number of in-distribution images.

AI.tldr: DAWN：无需训练数据的DIP盲图像去卷积框架，交替将模型估计直接注入网络输入并用网络自身先验精化该估计，配合图像/核网络的自动编码正则，在高噪声下显著优于SOTA。
AI.motivation: 高噪声（高斯/泊松）下BID存在病态性，现有方法易噪声过拟合且核估计不准；基于深度图像先验（DIP）的无训练数据方法多以额外损失项引入模型估计作外部引导，未充分利用这些估计本身的信息。
AI.method: 提出DAWN：无训练数据的DIP框架，在“将模型估计直接注入模型输入”与“用网络自身先验精化不完美估计”之间交替；为获得更可靠的核估计，对图像网络和核网络同时施加自动编码正则（autoencoding regularization）。
AI.result: 在自然图像与科学图像、不同强度高斯与泊松噪声下，图像与核质量均优于SOTA；在Levin数据集σ=0.1时较次优基线最高+4.5 dB。零训练图像条件下在FFHQ上与经大规模同分布数据训练的SOTA扩散模型保持高度竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 将模型估计注入输入而非仅作损失约束、并辅以双分支自动编码正则，是缓解噪声过拟合、提升核估计可靠性的有效无监督去卷积策略。

title: Physical Laws without Physics Loss? Probing Learned Dynamics in Video World Models through Forced Response
summary: Do video world models learn physical laws without a physics loss, or merely imitate motion? Overall motion and appearance scores cannot settle it. We investigate this through nonlinear forced response: an excitation shakes the support of a suspended object. We introduce dual visual-numeric conditioning and adapt six image-to-video backbones to predict this motion using only the flow-matching loss. Wan predicts motion accurately and generalizes to unseen excitations, objects, poses, and scenes. Counterfactual tests suggest capabilities beyond replaying training videos. But what laws have they learned? We design three tiers of tests using Taylor expansions of the dynamics and geometry. All six reproduce the linear response, including resonance; five capture higher-order dynamics, including nonlinear softening. Remarkably, softening is barely present in training: only 0.74% of the swing's squared displacement. Extensions to a double pendulum and a rocking block show sustained dynamics are learned more faithfully than brief impacts. Yet learned dynamics may fail to appear when state estimation or propagation goes wrong. We turn these tests and findings into strategies to improve video training and generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过非线性受迫响应（激励悬挂物支撑）系统检验视频世界模型是否真正学到物理规律，而非仅模仿运动：提出双通道视觉-数值条件，微调6个图像到视频骨干（仅用flow-matching损失），并用基于动力学与几何Taylor展开的三级测试区分线性响应、高阶动力学与状态估计/传播失效。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型的整体运动/外观指标无法判断模型是"学到物理定律"还是"复现训练视频中的运动模式"，需要一个可量化、可分层的探针来检验物理知识，并据此改进视频训练与生成。
AI.method: 以受迫振动的悬挂对象为测试床，用激励作用于支撑端引发非线性响应；引入视觉+数值的双重条件输入，适配六个image-to-video骨干网络，仅使用flow-matching损失训练；设计三层测试（Taylor展开的动力学与几何近似）分别考察线性响应（含共振）、高阶动力学（如非线性软化）与状态估计/传播链路的可靠性；并扩展到双摆与摇摆块等任务。
AI.result: Wan能准确预测运动并泛化到未见激励、物体、位姿与场景；反事实测试显示其超出训练视频回放。六个模型均复现线性响应（含共振），五个捕获高阶动力学（含非线性软化）；而软化在训练数据中仅占摆动位移平方的0.74%。双摆与摇摆块实验表明持续动力学比短暂冲击学得更可靠；但当状态估计或自回归传播出错时，学到的动力学可能无法体现。
AI.conclusion: 视频世界模型可以在无物理损失下习得可迁移的物理结构（包括弱信号的高阶效应），但表现依赖状态估计与长程传播质量；作者将这些测试转化为改进视频训练与生成的策略与评测协议。

title: RelGeo: Pair-Conditioned Relational Calibration for Frozen Diffusion Correspondence
summary: Frozen diffusion descriptors retrieve strong semantic correspondence candidates, yet cosine nearest-neighbor matching can select incorrect locations despite valid high-ranking alternatives. Across DIFT-SD2.1 and DiTF-FLUX on SPair-71k, AP-10K, and SOCO (CC, SOC, Cross-SOC), 41-69% of Top-1 errors retain a PCK@0.10-valid match among the original Top-5 spatial peaks, revealing a persistent candidate-selection bottleneck. We find that descriptor rankings and current-pair relational evidence can favor different candidates: reciprocal diffusion Query/Key associations and pretrained RoMa transport exhibit distinct, partly complementary preferences. To incorporate this evidence into matching decisions, we introduce RelGeo, a Pair-Conditioned Relational Calibration framework expressing heterogeneous relations as shared source-target coordinates. Spectral Relational Coordinates (SRC) encode reciprocal diffusion affinities, while Warp Identity Coordinates (WIC) encode reliability-weighted bidirectional transport endpoints. Their inner products augment frozen descriptor similarity while preserving full-domain cosine nearest-neighbor matching without additional semantic-correspondence training. RelGeo improves all ten evaluations by an average of 5.51 PCK@0.10 points; fixed-candidate reranking and pair-misalignment controls corroborate improved selection and dependence on current-pair relational alignment.

AI.tldr: RelGeo用成对关系证据（扩散互惠亲和 + RoMa双向传输）作为旁路校正项，强化冻结扩散描述子的匹配选择，在10项评估上平均提升5.51 PCK@0.10。
AI.motivation: 冻结扩散特征在前5个空间峰值中常有PCK@0.10有效的候选，但41-69%的Top-1错误说明瓶颈在候选选择而非特征表达；且描述子排序与当前配对的关系证据偏好不同，需将二者融合。
AI.method: 提出Pair-Conditioned Relational Calibration框架RelGeo：以共享源-目标坐标表达异质关系。谱关系坐标（SRC）编码互惠扩散Query/Key亲和；形变恒等坐标（WIC）编码可靠性加权的RoMa双向传输端点；二者内积以加性方式增广冻结描述子相似度，保持全域余弦最近邻匹配，无需额外语义对应训练。
AI.result: 在DIFT-SD2.1与DiTF-FLUX两种描述子上，于SPair-71k、AP-10K、SOCO（CC、SOC、Cross-SOC）共10项评估全部提升，平均+5.51 PCK@0.10；固定候选重排与成对错配对照实验证实增益来自选择改善而非候选集变化，并依赖当前配对的关系对齐。
AI.conclusion: 语义对应存在"候选选择瓶颈"，以推理期关系校准增广冻结描述子是一种免训练、即插即用的有效方案，可作为下游3D/机器人任务的感知中间件，但尚未在具身任务闭环中验证。

title: What One Sample Cannot See: Why Fewer Denoising Steps Can Score Higher on Physics Benchmarks
summary: When a storm can head north or south, a forecast down the middle may score better under squared error than either plausible path. The same paradox appears when video generators are tested as world models: fewer denoising steps can raise physics scores even as videos blur or stop moving early. Why? Physics-IQ compares each generated video with one recording, although a scene can have multiple valid futures. An exact decomposition shows its scores can reward reduced variation among generated futures, even when their distribution becomes less accurate. We introduce Kernel Physics-IQ to remove this incentive in expectation, needing only two independent samples per condition. Two-step sampling lowers Kernel Physics-IQ in all five image-to-video models. For CogVideoX, the official score rises by 0.055 while ours falls by 0.131. Changing the sampling schedule reveals further differences official scores miss. In controlled physical systems with known outcome probabilities, our metric favors the true distribution over collapsed predictions. In short, a world model should be judged not only by how closely one video matches what happened, but by how faithfully its predictions represent what could have happened.

AI.tldr: 论文指出现有 Physics-IQ 等视频世界模型物理评测与单一真实录像比对、可用平方误差奖励"退化/坍缩"的生成分布；提出 Kernel Physics-IQ，用每条件两个独立样本的核分数在期望上消除该激励。
AI.motivation: 一个场景存在多种合理未来，而 Physics-IQ 只与单条录像比较，导致少步采样虽然视频模糊、提前静止，物理分数反而升高；指标可能奖励生成未来的方差收缩（分布塌缩），而非预测准确性。
AI.method: 对 Physics-IQ 分数做精确分解，指出其与"单目标真实点"的偏差项含方差收缩奖励；据此提出 Kernel Physics-IQ：以生成分布与真实分布间的核（MMD 类）分数替代点对点平方误差，仅需每个条件两个独立生成样本即可无偏（在期望上）估计。在五个 image-to-video 模型、两/多步采样调度上进行对照实验，并在结果概率已知的受控物理系统中验证。
AI.result: 两步采样在全部五个 I2V 模型上均降低 Kernel Physics-IQ；CogVideoX 上官方分数升高 0.055 而新指标下降 0.131；改变采样调度时官方分数遗漏的差异被新指标显现；受控物理系统中新指标偏好真实分布而非坍缩预测。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型评测不应只看单条生成视频与既定事实的贴合度，还应衡量其预测是否忠实表征"可能发生的多种未来"；Kernel Physics-IQ 提供了消除塌缩激励的低成本分布式评测方案。

title: AesDistill: Distilling Generative Aesthetics for Image Color Enhancement
summary: Image color enhancement aims to improve visual appeal, but previous methods often learn to reproduce ground-truth expert targets. These targets reflect the preferences of a few experts and cover a limited range of aesthetic choices. Matching them does not ensure stronger aesthetic quality across different tastes and scenes. By contrast, large generative models learn rich visual knowledge from large image collections and often produce vivid, appealing image edits. However, direct generation can change the source image's semantic structure along with its colors. In this paper, we introduce AesDistill, a framework for distilling generative aesthetics into image color enhancement. We use 4 leading open-source large generative models to produce 64,644 edited images as teacher targets at a cost of about 3,360 H100 GPU-hours, forming the AesDistill Dataset. AesDistill also includes AesDistill Student, a 1.13M-parameter model that learns teacher color changes through confidence-weighted supervision while preserving the source image's semantic structure. We evaluate AesDistill with 12 aesthetic and 4 image-quality assessment models. Every teacher's targets rank above the FiveK and PPR10K expert target means in the joint assessment. Across both datasets, AesDistill Student outperforms all 20 baseline methods and ranks directly behind the 4 teachers. These results demonstrate that distilling aesthetics from generative models enables a compact student to outperform methods trained on expert targets.

AI.tldr: AesDistill：用4个开源大生成模型生成64,644张编辑图作为教师目标（约3,360 H100 GPU时），蒸馏为1.13M参数的色彩增强学生模型，保结构、跨数据集超越20个基线，仅次于4位教师。
AI.motivation: 传统色彩增强以少数专家的ground-truth为目标，覆盖面窄、难泛化到多样审美与场景；大生成模型具丰富视觉先验但直接生成会破坏源图语义结构。
AI.method: 构建AesDistill Dataset：4个领先开源大生成模型产出64,644张教师编辑图；训练AesDistill Student（1.13M参数）以置信度加权监督学习教师的色彩变化，同时保持源图语义结构；用12个美学模型+4个图像质量模型评估。
AI.result: 所有教师目标的联合评估均高于FiveK与PPR10K专家目标均值；学生在两个数据集上均优于全部20个基线方法，排名紧随4位教师之后。
AI.conclusion: 将生成模型的美学蒸馏到紧凑学生网络，可在专家目标方法之外取得更优的美学质量，为色彩增强提供新的监督范式。

title: Beyond Easy Clients: Difficulty- and Improvement-Aware Aggregation for Federated Reinforcement Learning in Robot Navigation
summary: Federated reinforcement learning enables a fleet of robots to jointly learn a shared navigation policy without exchanging raw experience. In practice, however, the robots rarely operate in the same conditions: an open aisle is far easier to navigate than a cluttered room, and takes less learning to master. Standard federated aggregation rules ignore this. Uniform averaging weights every client equally, whether or not it is still learning, and weighting by episode return is worse, since easy environments permit high returns by construction. Both failures stem from what we call the \emph{plateau problem}: once a client masters its environment, its updates carry little new information even though its reported return remains high. We propose \emph{FedDIA}, which scores each client by how much its local training improves the global model it received, amplified by the difficulty of its environment. Difficulty is inferred from the model's own performance, without requiring any description of the environment. Both signals are measured against the global model, so they are comparable across clients. On a mapless navigation task with eight heterogeneous clients, FedDIA reaches a mean success rate of $75.5\%$ across training and held-out environments, against $68.7\%$ for the strongest federated baseline. Its advantage holds when the models are transferred to hand-authored warehouse and living-space layouts, or when one of the clients is defective.

AI.tldr: FedDIA通过"本地训练对全局模型的实际增益 × 环境难度"为联邦强化学习客户端加权，缓解"平台期问题"，在八客户端异构无地图导航任务上平均成功率75.5%，优于最强基线68.7%。
AI.motivation: 联邦强化学习中各机器人环境难度差异大，轻松环境回报天然高；均匀平均忽略"仍在学习"的客户端，按回合回报加权则偏向简单环境。两者共同源于"平台期问题"：客户端掌握环境后更新信息量极小但回报仍高，导致聚合权重失真。
AI.method: 提出FedDIA，以客户端本地训练对其所收到全局模型的提升量作为主信号（对齐全局模型，跨客户端可比），再乘以由模型自身表现推断的环境难度系数进行放大，无需任何环境描述信息。
AI.result: 八异构客户端无地图导航任务中，训练及留出环境平均成功率75.5%（基线68.7%）；优势在迁移至手工仓库/居住空间布局及存在缺陷客户端时仍保持。
AI.conclusion: 以"增益×难度"衡量客户端贡献可有效抑制回报偏差与平台期失效，提升异构联邦导航策略的泛化性与鲁棒性。

title: LG-FiLM: Local-Global Mixture-of-Experts Modulation for RAW-to-RGB Reconstruction
summary: An image signal processor does more than reconstruct an image.
