It also has to decide how strongly to denoise, how to balance color, and which tone curve maps the scene onto the display, and these settings depend on the scene itself, the curve that suits a backlit sky is not the one that suits an indoor portrait. Most neural ISPs learn a single fixed transformation and apply it to every scene. We instead make the adaptation an explicit part of the network. Our model, LG FiLM, keeps one shared encoder decoder and places a small mixture of affine experts at its bottleneck; the experts scales, shifts, and mixing weights are predicted from local neighborhood evidence together with a global scene descriptor. Reconstruction stays in a single shared pathway and only the processing mode is switched. We evaluate LG FiLM on three datasets, Fujifilm UltraISP, Zurich RAW to RGB, and a COCO derived benchmark built with an inverse ISP. The model reaches the best reconstruction fidelity of the compared entries on the primary benchmark and transfers to the other two.

AI.tldr: LG FiLM：在共享编解码器的瓶颈处放置小型仿射专家混合，用局部邻域证据+全局场景描述子预测缩放、偏移与混合权重，实现按场景自适应的神经ISP；在 Fujifilm UltraISP 上取得最优重建保真度并迁移到 Zurich RAW-to-RGB 与 COCO 逆ISP基准。
AI.motivation: ISP 的降噪强度、色彩平衡、色调曲线等参数应随场景变化，但多数神经ISP学习单一固定映射并应用于所有场景，缺乏显式、可控的场景自适应机制。
AI.method: 保持单一共享编码器-解码器，瓶颈处插入小型仿射专家混合（Mixture of Affine Experts，即 Feature-wise Linear Modulation 形式：scale/shift + 混合权重）；参数由局部邻域证据与全局场景描述子共同预测，重建走单一共享通路，仅切换处理模式。
AI.result: 在三个数据集（Fujifilm UltraISP、Zurich RAW-to-RGB、基于逆ISP构建的COCO衍生基准）上评估；在主基准上取得对比方法中最佳的重建保真度，并显示出向另外两个数据集的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 将场景自适应显式化为瓶颈处的仿射专家混合，是一种参数量友好且可迁移的神经ISP设计；主基准指标领先，但跨数据集支持仅以定性/迁移方式陈述，尚缺下游任务与真机成像验证。

title: Erasing the Wrong Thing: Conditional Attribute Leakage and Concept Erasure in Shared Foundation-Model Embeddings
summary: Medical-image embeddings are increasingly shared in place of raw images for authorized downstream tasks, yet they may reveal sensitive attributes. Standard concept-erasure methods target population-level guardedness. However, we prove that, when binary task and sensitive labels are associated, global and task-conditional linear guardedness cannot both hold while a nonzero linear task signal is preserved, so global erasure must either eliminate that signal or retain task-conditional linear leakage. We further show how global erasure affects linear readers' discrimination between positive and negative samples with different sensitive attributes, deriving an approximate closed-form prediction of its utility cost from pre-erasure statistics. Motivated by this conflict, we introduce Task-Conditional LEACE (TC-LEACE), a closed-form variant of LEACE that enforces linear guardedness within each task stratum of its fitting data. We evaluate four vision foundation models on 85 CelebA attribute pairs spanning a broad range of associations. After LEACE, conditional leakage persists across all four encoders, the discrepancy between marginal and conditional audits increases with association strength, and predicted utility costs track observed losses. We then examine hospital chest radiographs using three foundation models, including two biomedical models, in which chest-tube status is strongly associated with diagnosis. Although a marginal attack on LEACE-erased embeddings underperforms a diagnosis-only reference, chest-tube status remains detectable within diagnosis strata. TC-LEACE recovers most of LEACE's linear task-utility loss while keeping task-conditional leakage within a prespecified margin of LEACE's.

AI.tldr: 论文证明当二值任务标签与敏感标签相关时，全局线性擦除与任务条件线性防护（guardedness）不可兼得，据此提出 TC-LEACE，在各任务分层内强制线性防护，在 CelebA 及胸片数据集上验证条件泄漏仍存在且 TC-LEACE 可回收大部分任务效用。
AI.motivation: 医疗图像嵌入被广泛共享用于下游任务，但可能泄漏敏感属性；现有概念擦除方法（如 LEACE）只保证群体层面的线性防护，缺乏对"任务条件泄漏"的形式化分析与补救。
AI.method: 先理论证明在二值任务/敏感标签相关时，全局擦除与任务条件防护及非零任务信号三者不相容，并给出从擦除前统计量近似闭式预测任务效用代价；再提出 TC-LEACE——在拟合数据各任务分层内施加线性防护的 LEACE 闭式变体；在 4 个视觉基础模型、85 组 CelebA 属性对与 3 个胸片编码器（含 2 个生物医学模型）上做边际与条件攻击评估。
AI.result: LEACE 后四种编码器均持续存在条件泄漏；边际与条件审计差异随关联强度增大；效用代价的闭式预测与实际损失吻合。胸片场景中，边际攻击在 LEACE 嵌入上弱于仅诊断的参考基线，但胸管状态在诊断分层内仍可被检出。TC-LEACE 回收了 LEACE 大部分线性任务效用损失，同时将条件泄漏控制在预设余量内。
AI.conclusion: 概念擦除必须在任务条件下评估；全局线性擦除在标签相关场景下必然以牺牲任务信号或条件隐私为代价，TC-LEACE 提供了一种闭式、代价可控的折中方案。

title: MambaLIFT: Reference-Based Mechanism-Aware Attribution for VMamba
summary: Attributing predictions of visual state-space models remains challenging because input-dependent selective dynamics couple feature selection, recurrent state propagation, and shared computational pathways. We introduce MambaLIFT, a reference-based, multiplier-first attribution framework for VMamba that propagates contributions through its computational graph using interaction-aware rules for selective-scan injection, recurrent memory, LayerNorm, and shared pathways. MambaLIFT decomposes the reference-relative class-logit difference, \(f_c(x)-f_c(x^0)\), by spatial position, VSS block, scan direction, and computational mechanism. Experiments on ImageNet-1K evaluate VMamba-T and VMamba-B, with hyperparameters selected on a calibration set and faithfulness assessed on a disjoint held-out evaluation set. MambaLIFT achieves numerical conservation to floating-point precision across audited attribution interfaces in both configurations. Under mean-colour pixel flipping, it achieves significantly higher mean faithfulness scores than MambaLRP on both configurations and the highest scores among the evaluated methods, including Integrated Gradients with matched references. Under blurred replacement, MambaLIFT is non-inferior to MambaLRP on VMamba-T and equivalent on VMamba-B, indicating that its advantage depends on the replacement protocol. Ablations on VMamba-T show that interaction allocation, temporal propagation, and pathway composition affect attribution maps. Mechanism-level analyses further show that exact relevance conservation does not imply additive effects under finite interventions: the mechanism decomposition accounts for the reference-relative logit difference but does not estimate intervention effects or establish causal validity.

AI.tldr: MambaLIFT：面向VMamba的参考基准、以乘法路径优先的可解释归因框架，用交互感知规则沿选择性扫描注入、循环记忆、LayerNorm与共享通路传播贡献，将参考相对的类logit差分解到空间位置、VSS块、扫描方向与计算机制。
AI.motivation: 视觉状态空间模型（如VMamba）中，输入依赖的选择性动态将特征选择、循环状态传播与共享计算通路耦合，导致现有归因方法难以忠实解释其预测。
AI.method: 提出MambaLIFT，一种基于参考点的乘性优先（multiplier-first）归因框架：为选择性扫描注入、循环记忆、LayerNorm及共享通路设计交互感知的贡献分配规则，沿计算图传播参考相对贡献，实现按空间位置、VSS块、扫描方向与机制的分解；在ImageNet-1K上以校准集选超参、独立留出集评估忠实性，与MambaLRP、Integrated Gradients对比，并做消融与机制级分析。
AI.result: 在VMamba-T/B上均达到浮点精度级的数值守恒；均值色像素替换下忠实性得分显著优于MambaLRP并为对比方法中最高（含匹配参考的IG）；模糊替换下与MambaLRP持平（T上不劣、B上等价），说明优势依赖替换协议；消融显示交互分配、时序传播与通路构成均影响归因图。
AI.conclusion: 精确的相关性守恒不等于有限干预下的可加效应：机制分解能解释参考相对logit差，但不代表干预效应估计，也不构成因果有效性。

title: TRACE: Attribute Execution for Sequential Image Editing
summary: Given an image and successive user instructions, sequential image editing should return an updated image that satisfies each new request and preserves earlier requirements that remain active. This lets users develop a result without repeatedly restating or repairing their decisions. The difficulty is that a retrieved image can contain a valid color on an obsolete surface, while the current image may lack the newly requested material. Neither reference selection nor a precise object mask alone specifies how to reconcile attributes occupying the same region. We present TRACE, which separates the continuing attribute from its visual carrier and prioritizes local appearance operations under complete-request checks. Active-goal binding identifies what should persist, carrier selection supplies suitable current or newly generated pixels, and tonal calibration reduces tinting near highlights and shadows. Experiments across frozen editors, independent visual readers, new source images, and complete sequential benchmarks support joint color-material recovery and show how local execution preserves the surrounding scene.

AI.tldr: TRACE 提出顺序图像编辑框架，将"持续属性"与"视觉载体"解耦：通过 active-goal binding 确定需保留的目标，通过载体选择（来自当前或新生成像素）提供材质/颜色载体，并用 tonal calibration 抑制高光与阴影区的染色；在完整请求校验下优先执行局部外观编辑。
AI.motivation: 多轮顺序图像编辑中，用户逐条下达指令，期望新请求被满足且早期仍有效的约束被保留，避免反复重述或修补。难点在于：仅靠参考图选择无法解决"过期表面上的合法颜色"被误迁移，仅靠精确物体掩码也无法指定同一区域内属性如何调和（旧颜色 vs 新材质）。
AI.method: TRACE：① 将属性与其视觉载体分离；② active-goal binding 识别应持久保持的目标；③ carrier selection 在当前图像或新生成像素中选取合适载体；④ tonal calibration 抑制高光/阴影附近的色偏；⑤ 在 complete-request 检查下优先执行局部外观操作，从而保留周边场景。评测覆盖冻结编辑器、独立视觉读取器、新源图像与完整顺序基准。
AI.result: 实验显示可实现颜色与材质的联合恢复，且局部化执行能较好保持周围场景不被改动；在多种冻结编辑器、视觉读取器与新源图上均具一致性。
AI.conclusion: 顺序编辑的关键不在于更强的参考检索或更精细掩码，而在于属性—载体解耦加完整请求校验下的局部化编辑执行。

title: Extending Rademacher Complexity-Based Generalization Theory to Domain Generalization
summary: Domain generalization (DG) aims to train models on multiple source domains with distinct distributions to ensure robust performance on unseen target domains. In doing so, it elevates the concept of generalization from the traditional sample level to the distribution level. Existing theoretical frameworks introduce a domain space endowed with a meta-distribution to extend classical generalization analysis to this new setting. However, these approaches typically treat the domain space as devoid of geometry. In reality, the domain space is an inherently infinite-dimensional, nonlinear abstract space composed of probability distributions, and its complex geometric properties fundamentally determine generalization behavior. Consequently, existing geometry-free theories of domain generalization have a fundamental limitation. They lack a formal characterization of what distinguishes distribution-level generalization from sample-level generalization, leaving the inherent difficulty of generalizing across domains largely unexplained. To bridge this gap, we formalize the domain space as the Wasserstein space over the representation space. Building on the geometric properties of this space (specifically the $\mathrm{CD}(K,\infty)$ curvature theory) we derive a novel, geometry-dependent DG error bound. By introducing an additional curvature-dependent confidence term, this bound formally disentangles the two levels of generalization effects and reveals the essential nature that domain generalization is affected by both the invariance and the curvature of the representation space. Finally, we experimentally validate the effect of curvature on domain generalization.

AI.tldr: 将域空间形式化为表示空间上的Wasserstein空间，借助CD(K,∞)曲率理论推导出依赖几何的域泛化误差界，并用曲率相关置信项区分分布级与样本级泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有域泛化理论把域空间视为无几何结构的抽象集合，仅用元分布扩展经典泛化分析，无法刻画域空间的无限维非线性几何，因而难以解释分布级泛化相对样本级泛化的本质困难。
AI.method: 把域空间建模为表示空间上的Wasserstein空间，利用其CD(K,∞)曲率性质推导新的域泛化误差界；界中引入曲率依赖的置信项，将两级泛化效应解耦，并指出泛化受表示空间的不变性与曲率双重影响；最后设计实验验证曲率对域泛化的作用。
AI.result: 得到几何依赖的DG误差界，形式上分离分布级与样本级泛化；实验表明表示空间的曲率确实影响域泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 域空间的曲率是决定跨域泛化的关键几何因素；几何无关的DG理论存在根本缺陷。该工作为分布级泛化提供几何刻画，并给出可操作的曲率正则化启示。

title: A$^2$-VLA: Adapting Vision-Language-Action Policies to New Tools through Agentic Affordance Discovery
summary: Tools with different shapes can have similar functions, but transferring manipulation skills across tools requires understanding how tool geometry relates to the specific task and adjusting the manipulation strategy accordingly. The key challenge is to discover the common affordances that contribute to task completion across different tools and verify whether they support new tools in performing similar work. We present A$^2$-VLA, a tool-adaptation framework that combines an embodied agent with a VLA policy. It treats tool affordances as hypotheses the agent can construct, test, and revise. Given teleoperated demonstrations with a few source tools, the agent reconstructs the scenes in simulation and autonomously determines task-relevant affordance features: functional regions and their key geometric properties. It develops affordance-extraction skills and refines both the features and skills through autonomous experiments in the reconstructed scenes. Validated extraction skills accumulate in a reusable skill library for unseen tools. Finally, A$^2$-VLA uses encoded functional-region features as conditioning inputs to a $\pi_{0.5}$ backbone during training and inference. Evaluation examines affordance reliability in reconstructed scenes and real-robot task success on unseen tools. Our method achieves 86.1% success in simulated cross-tool trajectory retargeting based on affordances. On three real-robot tool-use tasks, A$^2$-VLA improves task success by 30.7 percentage points over $\pi_{0.5}$.

AI.tldr: A²-VLA combines an embodied agent with a π0.5 VLA policy to discover, verify and reuse tool affordances so manipulation skills transfer to unseen tools.
AI.motivation: Different-shaped tools can serve similar functions, but skill transfer requires relating tool geometry to task semantics and adjusting manipulation strategy; the core problem is discovering common task-relevant affordances across tools and validating them on novel tools.
AI.method: From teleoperated demos with a few source tools, the agent reconstructs scenes in simulation and autonomously infers task-relevant affordance features (functional regions + key geometric properties); it learns affordance-extraction skills and refines features/skills via autonomous experiments in the reconstructed scenes; validated extraction skills accumulate in a reusable skill library for unseen tools; encoded functional-region features condition a π0.5 backbone at training and inference.
AI.result: 86.1% success on simulated cross-tool trajectory retargeting driven by affordances; on three real-robot tool-use tasks, +30.7 percentage points task success over π0.5.
AI.conclusion: Treating affordances as agent-verifiable hypotheses and distilling them into a VLA conditioning signal yields effective real-robot cross-tool generalization, showing agent-driven affordance discovery is a viable route to tool adaptation.

title: GNetSS: Towards Learning GNSS Corrections without Ground Truth
comment: 14 pages, 7 figures, Submitted to NAVIGATION, Journal of the Institute of Navigation. See this http URL
summary: We present GNetSS, a self-supervised GNSS position correction framework that improves the robustness of single point positioning (SPP) without requiring ground-truth locations for training. GNetSS combines a transformer-based network with a deterministic differentiable positioning solver. The network predicts satellite-wise pseudorange corrections by modelling inter-satellite geometry and temporal context, while the solver converts these corrected measurements into receiver position corrections under GNSS geometry and optional motion constraints. Unlike supervised GNSS correction methods that rely on ground-truth, GNetSS derives its training signal directly from GNSS measurement consistency. Experimental results show that GNetSS improves robustness across open-sky, urban, and forested environments. The method is particularly effective at suppressing large-error outliers, reducing the maximum 3D positioning error by over 50% compared with SPP. These results demonstrate the potential of self-supervised pseudorange correction for scalable and robust GNSS positioning in real-world autonomy applications. Code and the in-house dataset will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: GNetSS：自监督GNSS伪距改正框架，Transformer网络预测星间几何与时间上下文下的伪距改正，配合确定性可微定位求解器输出位置改正；无需真值标签训练。
AI.motivation: 监督式GNSS改正依赖真值位置标签，难以规模化部署；单点定位（SPP）在城市场景、林区等复杂环境下鲁棒性差、易受大误差离群值影响。
AI.method: Transformer网络对每颗卫星预测伪距改正（建模星间几何关系与时序上下文）+ 确定性可微定位求解器，将改正后观测量映射为接收机位置改正（可加运动约束）；训练信号直接来自GNSS测量一致性，实现自监督。
AI.result: 在开阔天空、城市、林地三类环境下鲁棒性均有提升；对大幅离群误差抑制效果显著，最大3D定位误差较SPP降低50%以上。
AI.conclusion: 自监督伪距改正具备可扩展、鲁棒的实车定位潜力；代码与自采数据集将在录用后开源。

title: CauSyncVLA: Causal Latent World Modeling for Asynchronous Robot Control
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies must react while visual inference is still running. Overlapping computation and execution reduces waiting, yet leaves perceptual memory stale and successive action chunks disconnected. We present CauSyncVLA, an asynchronous dual-system controller that aligns perceptual-memory prediction and trajectory correction with actual robot execution. Rather than forecasting pixels or physical states, a Causal Latent World Model predicts current perceptual memory from delayed visual anchors and executed state-action history, supervised through action-sensitive distillation to retain the frozen expert's control response. Conditioned on this updated memory, Predictive Flow Warm-Starting (PFWS) aligns the unexecuted action horizon for single-step flow correction without extra training. On LIBERO-10, CauSyncVLA reaches 93.8% success at 5.04$\times$ inference throughput, improving closed-loop robustness and robot motion smoothness.

AI.tldr: CauSyncVLA：异步双系统VLA控制器，用因果潜世界模型从延迟视觉锚点和已执行状态-动作历史预测当前感知记忆，再用预测流热启动对未执行动作horizon做单步校正；LIBERO-10上93.8%成功率、5.04倍推理吞吐。
AI.motivation: VLA策略在视觉推理尚未完成时就需动作输出；异步流水线虽能并行计算与执行以减少等待，但会造成感知记忆陈旧、相邻动作块不连续。
AI.method: Causal Latent World Model在潜空间（不预测像素/物理状态）由延迟视觉锚点+已执行state-action历史预测当前感知记忆，并用动作敏感蒸馏对齐冻结专家控制响应；Predictive Flow Warm-Starting以更新后的记忆为条件，对未执行动作段做单步流匹配校正，无需额外训练。
AI.result: LIBERO-10达93.8%成功率，推理吞吐提升5.04倍，闭环鲁棒性与机器人运动平滑性均有改善。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间因果预测+流热启动是缓解异步VLA感知陈旧与动作块断裂的有效轻量方案，但证据限于仿真基准，缺真实机器人与开放代码验证。

title: Efficient Latent Reasoning for Vision-Language Model via Dynamics-Aware Quantization and Distillation
summary: Efficient chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning in vision-language models (VLMs) requires reducing both intermediate reasoning steps and their execution cost. Latent CoT methods compress textual rationales into continuous thoughts, yet their full-precision (FP) models retain substantial storage and computation costs. Lowering numerical precision could reduce these remaining costs, yet direct quantization severely degrades reasoning accuracy, particularly with 4-bit weights and activations. Operator and perturbation analyses reveal key sensitivity and direction-dependent predictive effects of continuous-thought errors, motivating preservation of information retrieval and subsequent reasoning beyond reconstruction accuracy. We therefore introduce QL-VLM, a dynamics-aware Quantization framework for efficient Latent reasoning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs). First, Dynamics-Guided Quantization (DGQ) uses nonuniform codebooks that preserve rotary-key structure, mitigating quantization-induced distortion in vision-language information retrieval. Second, Dynamics-Preserving Distillation (DPD) aligns continuous thoughts, latent-query readouts, and predictions with a full-precision teacher, maintaining predictive consistency through subsequent low-precision reasoning. On ScienceQA-IMG with Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct, 4-bit QL-VLM achieves 90.43% accuracy and improves baseline by 40.33%, with 16.64x fewer bit-operations and 6.40x lower measured latency than explicit CoT.

AI.tldr: QL-VLM：面向隐式CoT视觉语言模型的动力学感知量化框架，用保旋转键结构的非均匀码本量化与动力学保持蒸馏，实现4-bit权重+激活下的隐式推理，ScienceQA-IMG上达90.43%准确率，比显式CoT减少16.64倍位运算与6.40倍实测延迟。
AI.motivation: 隐式CoT（latent CoT）虽将文本推理压缩为连续思考以降低token开销，但全精度模型仍带来显著存储与算力成本；直接低比特量化（尤其4-bit权重与激活）会严重破坏推理精度。作者通过算子与扰动分析发现，连续思考误差对信息检索与后续推理存在方向依赖的预测性影响，故不应仅以重建精度为目标。
AI.method: 提出QL-VLM，包含两部分：(1) Dynamics-Guided Quantization (DGQ)：采用非均匀码本以保持rotary-key（RoPE键）结构，减轻量化对视觉-语言信息检索造成的失真；(2) Dynamics-Preserving Distillation (DPD)：以全精度教师对齐连续思考、隐式query读出与最终预测，保持低精度推理过程的预测一致性。
AI.result: 在Qwen2-VL-2B-Instruct的ScienceQA-IMG上，4-bit QL-VLM达到90.43%准确率，较基线提升40.33%；相对显式CoT位运算减少16.64倍，实测延迟降低6.40倍。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，隐式CoT的量化需以任务/动力学的保真而非单纯重建误差为准，DGQ+DPD可在4-bit下基本无损地保留推理能力，为高效多模态推理提供可行路径；但实验限于单一基准与单一模型，缺真实具身或部署验证。

title: SEAF: Selective Semantic Enrichment and Visual Evidence Fusion for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection
summary: Multimodal sarcasm detection requires textual, visual, and contextual evidence, particularly when multiple images provide complementary cues. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate auxiliary information from a post's text and images, but their outputs may mix useful background knowledge with redundant visual descriptions. We propose SEAF, a dual-branch framework for selective semantic enrichment and visual evidence fusion. SEAF assigns generated fields to distinct roles: entity background enriches semantic input, while image descriptions supply alignment statistics. The semantic branch combines the original post text, background from a frozen MLLM, and optical character recognition (OCR) text. The aligned visual branch combines global and local visual features with statistics of cross-modal and inter-image similarity. Text-Anchored Smoothed Aggregation (TASA) weights images by their similarity to the original post text while preserving contributions from images with low literal similarity. Summing the branch classification scores integrates contextual semantics with visual evidence. Experiments on the multi-image MMSD3.0 benchmark show that SEAF outperforms all compared methods.

AI.tldr: SEAF：双分支框架，将MLLM生成的实体背景用于语义分支，图像描述仅用于视觉分支的对齐统计，并以文本锚定平滑聚合(TASA)融合多图视觉证据做多模态讽刺检测。
AI.motivation: 多图场景下的多模态讽刺检测需要文本、视觉与上下文证据互补，但MLLM生成的辅助信息混杂有用背景知识与冗余视觉描述，直接拼接会引入噪声。
AI.method: 双分支框架：语义分支融合原文、冻结MLLM生成的实体背景与OCR文本；对齐视觉分支融合全局/局部视觉特征及跨模态、跨图像相似度统计。提出TASA，按图像与原文文本的相似度加权聚合，同时保留字面相似度低但可能含讽刺线索图像的贡献；两分支分类分数相加融合。
AI.result: 在多图基准MMSD3.0上优于所有对比方法（摘要未给出具体指标数值）。
AI.conclusion: 对不同来源的生成信息分配明确角色（背景语义 vs. 对齐统计）可减少冗余噪声，文本锚定平滑聚合有助于多图证据融合；但属社媒文本-图像理解任务，与Physical AI/3D重建方向关联弱。

title: Minimal Memory for Correctable Visual Continuation
summary: Given past images and known actions, visual continuation generates future frames from one evolving scene state. Keeping this state revisable matters when an object reappears or a later view changes an earlier interpretation. Once past images cannot be replayed, a summary sufficient for current rendering can lose candidates needed after correction. We establish matching sparse and dense bounds on the bits needed for later correction under stable observations and bounded disagreement. For static streams at the stated smoothness and margin scales, correction incurs at least logarithmic overhead in one dimension and polynomial overhead in higher dimensions. Coherent Archive Memory (CAM) stores geometric summaries with exact updates under clipped expansion and coordinate assignments, then uses historical existence constraints to select one state for all requested frames. Exhaustive photographic tests show strict worst-truth image-risk gains from joint witnesses, while controlled neural continuations recover positions hidden in the current view.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究“视觉延续”（根据历史图像与已知动作生成未来帧）中可修正记忆的理论与实现：在稳定观测与有界分歧假设下，给出稀疏/密贴的下界与上界，证明静态流中修正需一维对数、高维多项式级比特开销；提出相干档案记忆（CAM），用可精确更新的几何摘要与历史存在约束为所有请求帧选出单一状态。
AI.motivation: 视觉延续只需保持“足以渲染当前帧”的场景摘要，但当物体重新出现或后续视角推翻先前解释时，早期需要被丢弃的候选会产生不可恢复的错误。论文旨在刻画“可修正状态”究竟需要多少信息，并给出满足该需求的可修正记忆机制。
AI.method: 信息论分析：在平滑度与边缘尺度、稳定观测、有界分歧条件下，推导稀疏与密集两类情形下修正所需比特的下界与匹配上界。系统设计：CAM 以几何摘要形式存储状态，在裁剪式扩展与坐标分配下进行精确更新（避免重渲染累积误差）；再用历史存在约束（跨帧一致性可行域）在所有请求帧上联合选取同一场景状态，形成“联合见证”（joint witness）。
AI.result: 静态流上，修正在一维至少带来对数级开销，高维为多项式级开销，且上下界匹配。实验上：真实照片的穷举测试显示联合见证带来严格的最坏真值图像风险改进；受控神经延续实验可在当前视野中被遮挡/缺失的位置恢复物体位置。
AI.conclusion: 可修正性有明确的信息代价下限，而不能简单视为工程细节；“只够渲染的摘要”本质上不足。CAM 通过在摘要层做精确更新与跨帧存在约束的联合状态选择，在代价可控的前提下实现可修正的视觉延续记忆。

title: LeCompass: Task-Level Execution through State-Indexed Interfaces
summary: Action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) offer a foundation for predictive decision-making by modeling the consequences of actions in representation space. Yet evaluating local reachability in latent space does not by itself provide a task-level execution interface: intermediate targets must be generated, local inference has finite budgets, and execution requires spatial feedback and persistent interaction state. We introduce LeCompass, a state-indexed execution framework built around a frozen LeWorldModel (LeWM). A proposer supplies intermediate latent targets, while CompassFlow searches the source space of a learned trajectory prior to obtain effective action candidates under limited predictive-evaluation budgets. Patch-token readouts provide spatial feedback, while observation-based memory supports phase transitions and bounded recovery. State-indexed targets support cross-episode context-goal composition. On 1,000 official TEST full-episode Cube trials, the complete LeCompass execution system achieves 86.9% native 4-cm reach. Separate matched analyses show that predictive ranking raises success from 4.7% to 44.9% on TEST PushT and from 33.8% to 77.7% on TEST TwoRoom. These results demonstrate task-level execution with task-dependent roles for latent target proposal, predictive search, and observation-grounded control.

AI.tldr: LeCompass 在冻结的 LeWorldModel 之上构建"状态索引"执行框架：Proposer 生成中间潜目标，CompassFlow 在轨迹先验的源空间做受限预算的预测搜索，patch-token 读出提供空间反馈，基于观测的记忆支持相位切换与有界恢复。Cube TEST 全回合 4cm 达 86.9%。
AI.motivation: 动作条件 JEPA 只在表征空间建模动作后果，潜空间局部可达性不等于任务级执行接口：需要中间目标生成、有限推理预算、空间反馈与持续交互状态。
AI.method: 冻结 LeWorldModel；Proposer 提供中间潜目标；CompassFlow 对学到的轨迹先验的源空间搜索以在有限预测评估预算下产出有效动作候选；patch-token 读出作空间反馈；观测记忆支撑相位转换与有界恢复；状态索引目标支持跨回合上下文-目标组合。
AI.result: 1,000 次官方 TEST Cube 全回合试验达 86.9% 原生 4cm 命中；匹配分析中预测排序将 PushT 成功率从 4.7% 提至 44.9%，TwoRoom 从 33.8% 提至 77.7%。
AI.conclusion: 把 JEPA 世界模型提升为任务级执行系统，潜目标提议、预测搜索与观测接地控制的角色随任务而变。

title: Beyond Entity Recognition: Vision-Centric Knowledge Visual Question Answering
summary: We propose VC-VQA, a large-scale benchmark for vision-centric knowledge reasoning, aiming to systematically evaluate the capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in fine-grained visual knowledge acquisition and complex multi-stage reasoning. Unlike existing benchmarks that primarily treat visual information as entity recognition and rely on text-based external knowledge, VC-VQA explicitly models the role of visual information by considering both its source (internal vs. external images) and stage of involvement (pre-retrieval vs. post-retrieval). Specifically, VC-VQA requires models to retrieve external visual evidence, identify visual clues before retrieval, and localize, verify, or match retrieved knowledge against the internal image. We further construct a controlled multimodal knowledge base with traceable textual and visual evidence for each sample. We evaluate 21 representative MLLMs under four settings: no external knowledge, with provided evidence, knowledge base retrieval, and open-web search. Experimental results lead to three key findings: current models still struggle with vision-centric knowledge reasoning; fine-grained visual knowledge acquisition remains the primary bottleneck; and agentic retrieval highlights the value of multi-step planning and cross-modal knowledge integration. Overall, VC-VQA provides a more challenging benchmark for evaluating vision-centric knowledge reasoning in MLLMs. Our code and dataset are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: VC-VQA 是一个面向"视觉中心知识推理"的大规模基准，通过区分视觉证据来源（内部图像 vs 外部图像）与介入阶段（检索前 vs 检索后），系统评测 MLLM 的细粒度视觉知识获取与多阶段推理能力，并配套构建了带可追溯图文证据的受控多模态知识库。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉问答基准多把视觉仅当作实体识别入口，知识的获取依赖文本外部知识，未能显式刻画视觉信息在知识推理中的作用。作者希望显式建模视觉信息的来源与介入阶段，从而暴露 MLLM 在"以视觉为中心"的知识推理上的真实短板。
AI.method: 构建 VC-VQA 基准：要求模型检索外部视觉证据、在检索前识别视觉线索、并在检索后对证据做定位、验证或与内部图像匹配；为此构建可控多模态知识库，每个样本配有可追溯的文本与视觉证据。在四种设置下评测 21 个代表性 MLLM：无外部知识、提供证据、知识库检索、开放网络搜索。
AI.result: 实验得到三点结论：(1) 当前模型在视觉中心知识推理上仍表现不佳；(2) 细粒度视觉知识获取是主要瓶颈；(3) 智能体式检索体现出多步规划与跨模态知识整合的价值。
AI.conclusion: VC-VQA 为评测 MLLM 的视觉中心知识推理提供了一个更具挑战性的基准，并揭示了视觉证据获取与多步检索规划是其关键薄弱环节。代码与数据已开源。

title: TipDex-VTLA: Learning When to Refine Actions with Touch for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Changes in illumination can induce action drift in dexterous manipulation even when the physical state remains unchanged. Although existing vision--tactile--language--action (VTLA) policies incorporate tactile feedback, when and how touch refines actions under changing visual conditions remains challenging. We introduce \textbf{TipDex-VTLA}, a VTLA policy that combines estimated visual action reliability and tactile forecast verification to regulate execution-time refinement. Specifically, Visual Action Sensitivity Estimation (VASE) learns visual reliability from a frozen reference policy's action sensitivity to illumination perturbations. Tactile Anticipation and Correction during Execution (TACE) compares predicted and measured touch at matched times and combines the resulting discrepancy with visual reliability to gate bounded feature corrections for unexecuted actions. This effectively helps to refine actions under challenging unseen visual conditions. We evaluate TipDex-VTLA on four real-world dexterous manipulation tasks and the UniVTAC simulation benchmark. TipDex-VTLA trained on data collected under normal visual conditions, achieves average full-task success rates of 87.5% (resp. 73.8%) under normal (resp. challenging unseen) lighting in real-world tasks, significantly outperforming some state-of-the-art methods. We will release the collected data and source code.

AI.tldr: TipDex-VTLA 用"视觉动作可靠性估计(VASE)"和"触觉预测-实测校正(TACE)"联合门控执行期动作修正，使在正常光照下训练的 VTLA 策略在未见强光照变化下仍保持灵巧操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 光照变化会在物理状态不变时引起灵巧操作的动作漂移；现有视觉-触觉-语言-动作(VTLA)策略虽引入触觉，但在视觉条件变化时"何时、如何"用触觉修正动作缺乏机制。
AI.method: VASE：用冻结参考策略对光照扰动下动作的敏感度学习视觉动作可靠性。TACE：在匹配时刻比较预测触觉与实测触觉，将触觉差异与视觉可靠性结合，门控对未执行动作的有界特征修正。二者共同调节执行时修正幅度。
AI.result: 在4个真实灵巧操作任务与 UniVTAC 仿真上，仅用正常光照数据训练，真实任务全任务成功率为正常光照 87.5%、挑战性未见光照 73.8%，显著优于若干 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 以视觉可靠性+触觉验证自适应门控执行期修正，是提升触觉-视觉策略光照鲁棒性的有效路径；承诺开源数据与代码。

title: D3-Cache: Accelerating Diffusion Models with Dynamic Mode Decomposition
summary: Diffusion Transformers generate high-quality images and videos, but every sampling step requires a full network evaluation. Training-free caching reduces this cost by reusing or forecasting network outputs across steps, but common approaches use per-model calibrated skip criteria or maintain per-layer prediction histories. We present D3-Cache, which applies Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD) to Diffusion sampling: it fits DMD to a short history of exact velocities and forecasts only the velocity that the scheduler consumes. A horizon-aware gate decides when to skip: whenever the network is evaluated, its output is compared with the forecast for that step, and the larger the error, the sooner the network is evaluated again, up to a cap on consecutive skipped steps. D3-Cache requires no training or per-model offline calibration curve and adds negligible memory. It shares one history length and risk tolerance across the four evaluated models. On four state-of-the-art image and video models, D3-Cache achieves speedups of 2.6-3.8x with high fidelity to the base model output.

AI.tldr: D3-Cache：用动态模式分解（DMD）拟合精确速度历史，只预测调度器所需的 velocity，并以误差自适应门控决定何时真正评估网络，实现免训练、免校准的扩散采样加速。
AI.motivation: Diffusion Transformers 采样每步都需全网络评估，代价高；现有免训练缓存方法依赖逐模型标定的跳过准则或维护逐层预测历史，泛化性与开销不佳。
AI.method: 对短窗口的精确 velocity 序列做 DMD 线性动力学拟合，外推得到下一步 velocity 供 scheduler 使用；horizon-aware 门控在每次真实评估时将输出与预测比较，误差越大越早重新评估，并设连续跳过步数上限；跨 4 个模型共享同一历史长度与风险容忍度，无训练、无离线标定曲线，额外显存可忽略。
AI.result: 在 4 个 SOTA 图像与视频 Diffusion Transformer 上取得 2.6–3.8× 加速，且与基模型输出保持高保真度。
AI.conclusion: D3-Cache 提供了一种通用性强、零调参负担的扩散采样缓存方案，具备较好工程可迁移性，但属于采样效率优化而非具身/3D 核心方法，对物理 AI 主线为间接收益。

title: LIFT: Lifting Language-Controlled Image Fusion to Free-Viewpoint 3D Scenes
summary: Multimodal image fusion traditionally generates a single fused image from paired observations at a specific viewpoint, limiting comprehensive scene perception and adaptability to diverse perceptual objectives. To overcome these limitations, we present LIFT, a novel framework for our proposed language-controlled 3D image fusion (L3D-IF) paradigm that extends multimodal image fusion from 2D images to free-viewpoint 3D scenes, enabling language-guided fusion tailored to diverse perceptual objectives. First, LIFT formulates Semantic Modality Binding (SMB), which interprets language instructions to identify semantic targets and their associated modality preferences and grounds these targets in corresponding regions of a shared Gaussian scene, establishing persistent semantic-to-spatial correspondences for consistent fusion control across viewpoints. Second, Language-Conditioned Gaussian Appearance (LCGA) is developed to achieve scene-wide multimodal appearance modeling by combining adaptive multimodal blending with language- and viewpoint-conditioned appearance refinement, enabling spatially adaptive realization of diverse fusion appearances while preserving source fidelity at pure-modality endpoints. Finally, we construct a Multi-View Language-Supervision (MVLS) dataset that associates language instructions and calibrated viewpoints with modulated fused images, providing effective supervision for learning instruction-dependent fusion from finite multi-view observations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LIFT achieves coherent multimodal fusion across continuous viewpoints, accurate semantic target localization, and consistent regional fusion control under diverse language instructions.

AI.tldr: LIFT 提出"语言控制的3D图像融合"(L3D-IF)新范式，将多模态图像融合从固定视角2D扩展到自由视角3D高斯场景，通过语义模态绑定(SMB)与语言条件高斯外观(LCGA)实现跨视角一致的、按语言指令定制的融合。
AI.motivation: 传统多模态融合仅在单一配对视角生成一张融合图，缺乏全面场景感知与对多样感知目标的自适应能力；需要把融合提升到自由视角3D表示，并允许用自然语言指定"融合什么、用哪个模态"。
AI.method: 1) SMB：解析语言指令识别语义目标及其模态偏好，并将目标在共享高斯场景中定位，建立持久的"语义—空间"对应以支持跨视角一致的融合控制；2) LCGA：自适应多模态混合 + 语言与视角条件化的外观精修，实现场景级多模态外观建模，在纯模态端点保持源保真；3) 构建 MVLS 多视角语言监督数据集，将语言指令、标定视角与调制融合图关联，用以从有限多视角观测学习指令相关融合。
AI.result: 实验显示 LIFT 在连续视角下实现连贯的多模态融合，语义目标定位准确，并能在多样语言指令下实现一致的区域融合控制。
AI.conclusion: LIFT 把语言可控性引入3D高斯多模态融合，形成语义绑定的空间控制 + 外观条件化生成 + 多视角语言监督的三件套框架，为自由视角、目标驱动的多模态感知提供了可扩展范式。

title: Slide2PPT: Native PowerPoint Reconstruction with Localization-Guided Refinement
summary: Image-to-slide reconstruction must recover both visual appearance and native object structure for subsequent editing. Yet visually faithful charts and tables may lack editable series and cells, and direct code generation couples content prediction to rendering implementation. We present Slide2PPT, a model-agnostic, training-free framework that equips both open- and closed-source vision-language models with native PowerPoint reconstruction capabilities. Through a unified typed interface, the model predicts object records while a fixed renderer materializes their native properties, enabling integration with different backbones without task-specific training or architectural changes. Localization-guided refinement then connects visual discrepancies to object records for correction. Regional updates preserve unselected records, while whole-slide updates address cross-region relationships. Record refinement and targeted object editing support structural and attribute-level changes, with rendered feedback governing iterative acceptance. To evaluate this framework across diverse reconstruction demands, we introduce Slide2PPT-Bench, covering controlled elements, real slides, and scientific figures. Evaluation separately measures file production, rendered agreement, and native-object availability. Experiments across open- and closed-source backbones demonstrate substantially more reliable PPTX generation than direct code generation, improved layout and text recovery on scientific figures, and native chart and table interfaces beyond geometric primitives.

AI.tldr: Slide2PPT: 免训练、模型无关框架，让开源/闭源VLM通过统一类型化接口预测对象记录，由固定渲染器生成可编辑原生PPTX，并用定位引导的迭代精修纠正差异。
AI.motivation: 图像到幻灯片重建需同时恢复视觉外观与原生对象结构以供后续编辑；视觉忠实但不可编辑，直接生成代码又把内容预测与渲染实现耦合。
AI.method: 统一类型化接口解耦"对象记录预测"与"渲染实现"：模型输出对象记录（位置、属性、图表/表格数据），固定渲染器落地为原生属性；定位引导精修将视觉差异映射回对象记录，支持区域级更新（保留未选中记录）与整页级更新（处理跨区域关系），配合记录精修与定向对象编辑，以渲染反馈驱动迭代接受。另构建Slide2PPT-Bench（受控元素、真实幻灯片、科学图表），分别评测文件生成、渲染一致性与原生对象可用性。
AI.result: 开源与闭源骨干上PPTX生成可靠性显著优于直接代码生成；科学图表上的布局与文本恢复提升；原生图表/表格接口超出纯几何图元能力。
AI.conclusion: 以"接口化记录+固定渲染器+视觉反馈精修"替代代码生成，是无需训练即可获得可编辑原生文档重建的有效范式，可作为agent式迭代重建的通用模板。

title: Calibrate in Context: Efficient Data-Free Quantization from Small Synthetic Pools
comment: 21 pages, 5 main figures. Supplementary material included
summary: We enable accurate low-bit recovery from small synthetic pools by improving both image synthesis and student preparation. A grid with lower local response error can incur greater error in the student's block context. Functional Grid Calibration (FGC) selects activation scales and integer offsets against full-precision responses constructed from the student's current block input. With weights fixed during calibration, FGC evaluates candidates only at their consuming operators, bringing block context to calibration at nearly local-scoring cost. For DeiT and ViT, progressive inversion updates the same images through increasingly deep teacher prefixes. With 1,000 images, the complete pipeline exceeds MimiQ's reported accuracy in all 18 W4A4/W5A5 settings across nine backbones. With 256 images, DeiT-S and ViT-S reach 68.20% and 66.90% ImageNet top-1 accuracy at W4A4 in 26-27 minutes on one RTX 5090. The pipeline outperforms strengthened 1K-image MimiQ by 13.03 and 24.36 percentage points at lower preparation cost and the same recovery-update count. The same low-budget checkpoints retain their advantage on ImageNetV2.

AI.tldr: 提出功能网格校准（FGC）与渐进反演合成，用千级甚至256张合成图像将ViT/DeiT量化恢复到W4A4/W5A5精度接近全精度。
AI.motivation: 小规模合成数据池下低比特量化恢复精度不足：网格局部响应误差小并不代表学生网络块级上下文误差小，现有校准与图像合成流程均有失配。
AI.method: 1) FGC：以学生当前块输入构造的全精度响应为参照，联合选择激活尺度与整数偏移；权重固定，仅在消费算子处打分，从而以近局部成本引入块上下文。2) 渐进反演：同一批图像经逐步加深的教师前缀反复更新，提升合成样本质量。3) 完整流水线在9个骨干的18个W4A4/W5A5设置上验证。
AI.result: 1000张图像时全部18个设置超MimiQ报告精度；256张图像下DeiT-S/ViT-S W4A4 ImageNet top-1为68.20%/66.90%，单卡RTX 5090耗时26–27分钟；较加强版1K-image MimiQ高13.03/24.36个百分点，准备成本更低、恢复更新次数相同；低预算checkpoint在ImageNetV2上保持优势。
AI.conclusion: 在极小合成池约束下，将块级上下文纳入校准并渐进提升合成质量可显著提升低比特ViT量化的恢复效果，兼具精度与效率优势。

title: SkillLens: Action-Guided Dense Visual Dynamics for Proficiency Estimation
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables, Project page: this https URL
summary: Human proficiency estimation is challenging because skill is a high-level and often subjective property that is not captured by action identity alone. Existing approaches leverage multimodal observations such as ego-exo video, gaze, pose, and inertial signals, but the gap between sensor-level evidence and abstract proficiency labels remains difficult to bridge. We present SkillLens, a proficiency estimation framework that uses atomic action descriptions as temporal guidance, rather than direct semantic supervision, to localize proficiency-relevant windows for dense visual-dynamics extraction. Each window is summarized into an action-dynamics feature and scored by a high-low prototype margin against higher- and lower-proficiency executions from the same activity-action category. Fusing these ego/exo PDM cues with a global ego-exo-gaze baseline through CORAL ordinal calibration, our method achieves 0.542 accuracy on Ego-Exo4D. Our project page is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: SkillLens 用原子动作描述作为时序引导（而非语义监督）定位熟练度相关窗口，提取动作动力学特征，通过同类别高/低熟练度原型边际打分，并以 CORAL 序数校准融合 ego-exo-gaze 基线，在 Ego-Exo4D 达 0.542 准确率。
AI.motivation: 人类熟练度是高层、主观属性，无法由动作身份单独刻画；现有 ego-exo 视频、注视、姿态、惯性等多模态方法在传感器级证据与抽象熟练度标签之间存在巨大语义鸿沟。
AI.method: 以原子动作描述提供时序引导来定位熟练度判别窗口；对每个窗口提取稠密视觉动力学并汇总为动作动力学特征（Proficiency-Discriminative Margin, PDM）；用同活动-动作类别内更高/更低熟练度执行的高-低原型边际对其打分；再通过 CORAL 序数校准与全局 ego-exo-gaze 基线融合。
AI.result: 在 Ego-Exo4D 熟练度估计基准上取得 0.542 准确率，优于所融合的多模态基线。
AI.conclusion: 将抽象熟练度估计转化为"窗口定位+原型边际比较+序数校准"的组合问题，表明弱语义引导比直接语义监督更有效；但提升幅度有限，且未提供机器人或真实部署层面的验证。

title: Interpreting DeepStack-Style Vision-Language Models: Do Input or Deeper-Layer Visual Tokens Drive Answers?
comment: Includes the supplementary material. Code and numerical results: this https URL
summary: DeepStack-style vision-language models feed visual tokens to the language model at its input, and again at deeper layers. We call these the main entry and the later entries. What do the later entries add when the model already has the image? We give the entries versions that differ in one object's color and see which one the answer follows. On photographs, the original DeepStack follows the later entries, while Qwen3-VL-8B/32B follow the main entry. Does weakening the main entry give the later features more influence? On synthetic images, we keep this conflict and reduce color saturation at the main entry only. The unchanged later features gain a stronger effect on the relative scores of the two colors, in all four models, including Granite Vision. This holds even under mild desaturation, when accuracy without the conflict stays at 100%. To test whether later features can also correct errors, we degrade both entries and restore only the later ones. The same blur costs both Qwen models 50 percentage points of accuracy on stripe orientation. The 32B model recovers 48 points and the 8B model only 8. Accuracy with one clean entry predicted which entry each model can lose, and five of six tested predictions held on new GQA attribute questions. With the other entry zeroed, Qwen3-VL-8B loses only 0.3 points on its main entry alone, and DeepStack at most 3.45 points on either entry alone. In split inference on these questions, DeepStack can then send only its main-entry features at higher precision. This takes 49% fewer bytes than all entries at a shared precision, at similar accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文用"双入口冲突"实验量化DeepStack类VLM中后层视觉特征的作用：后层特征在图像信息已由主入口给出时仍具独立且可被放大的贡献，并可纠正主入口误差，且据此可做高效拆分推理。
AI.motivation: DeepStack式VLM在输入层与深层重复注入视觉token，但"后层入口"在模型已有图像的情况下究竟贡献什么，缺乏机制性理解与可量化证据。
AI.method: 构建两个视觉入口版本仅在单物体颜色上不同，观察答案跟随哪一入口（照片与合成图）；仅在主入口降低色彩饱和度以削弱主入口，测后层特征对两色相对分数的边际影响；同时劣化两入口、仅恢复后入口，测纠错能力（条纹朝向、GQA属性问题）；再将单一入口置零测模型对单入口的依赖，并进行拆分推理的精度/字节权衡。
AI.result: 原始DeepStack答案跟随后层入口，Qwen3-VL-8B/32B跟随主入口；主入口去饱和后，四模型（含Granite Vision）后层特征影响力均增强，轻度过饱和下亦成立（无冲突准确率仍为100%）；模糊使两Qwen各掉50点，32B恢复48点、8B仅8点；单干净入口的准确率可预测哪种入口可被移除，6条预测中5条在新GQA问题上成立；仅主入口时8B只掉0.3点，DeepStack单入口最多掉3.45点；拆分推理仅传主入口特征可省49%字节且精度相近。
AI.conclusion: 后层视觉入口并非冗余复制，而是独立且可被增益的信号通路，兼具纠错能力；模型对其依赖程度可通过"单入口精度"预测，并可用于非对称精度/带宽的拆分推理设计。

title: SteerTrace: Tracing How Target Attacks Steer World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict future videos and actions with one backbone, and their imagined future is often seen as a safety signal. We introduce SteerTrace, a targeted universal attack on WAMs that also traces its effect inside the model. One $\ell_\infty$-bounded (4/255) perturbation per model, shared across frames, tasks, and camera views, pushes the executed action toward an attacker-chosen target. On eight WAMs from four families (FastWAM, Faster-WAM, OpenWAM and LingBot-VA) on LIBERO and RoboTwin, it drives task success close to zero and moves the attacked action toward the target. Same-budget noise and BadWAM produce little action shift in the target direction. We use the signed targeted effect to measure how much of the effect each intervention removes or reproduces. Under the standard attack, restoring future tokens removes 61-94% of the targeted effect in the five models whose action experts attend to them. When the attack is constrained to keep the predicted future close to the clean prediction, the targeted effect can become more dependent on current-frame tokens. In three of these five models, restoring current-frame tokens removes 87-99% of the effect, compared with 9-15% for future tokens. In six models, restoring just 0.36% of the FFN neurons in layers 10-29 of the video expert removes 72-96% of the targeted effect. Residual directions 2-16 hold only 11-18% of the shift energy, yet removing them cancels most of the targeted effect.

AI.tldr: 提出 SteerTrace：对世界动作模型（WAM）的单次 ℓ∞(4/255) 通用定向攻击，跨帧/任务/视角共享，并在模型内部追踪该效应。
AI.motivation: WAM 同时预测未来视频与动作，且其"想象未来"常被视为安全信号；但这一信号是否可信、攻击能否定向操纵动作并定位其内部机制，尚缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 为每个模型优化一个共享的通用扰动，将执行动作推向攻击者指定目标；以符号定向效应量化干预（恢复未来 token、当前帧 token、FFN 神经元、残差方向）对效应的影响。覆盖四族八个 WAM（FastWAM、Faster-WAM、OpenWAM、LingBot-VA），LIBERO 与 RoboTwin 两个基准。
AI.result: 任务成功率接近 0，动作显著偏向目标；同等预算随机噪声与 BadWAM 定向偏移很小。五模型中恢复未来 token 消除 61–94% 效应；加入未来预测约束后，三模型恢复当前帧 token 消除 87–99%（未来 token 仅 9–15%）；六模型中仅恢复视频专家 10–29 层 0.36% 的 FFN 神经元即消除 72–96%；残差方向 2–16 仅占 11–18% 能量却消除大部分效应。
AI.conclusion: WAM 的"想象未来"并非可靠安全信号；定向效应高度集中于少量 FFN 神经元与特定残差方向，为 WAM 鲁棒性诊断与安全干预提供可定位依据。

title: DACA: Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent for Zero-Shot 3D Visual Grounding
summary: 3D visual grounding (3D-VG) is a task that bridges the natural language and 3D space, serving as a foundational capability for embodied intelligence and human-computer interaction. Although recent 3D-VG agents overcome the reliance on pre-processed 3D point clouds, they essentially employ a unidirectional, pipeline-style tool-calling architecture. This architecture separates semantic understanding from geometric reconstruction, leading to error accumulation and an inability to autonomously recover from failures. To address this flaw, this paper proposes the Dual-Anchor Collaborative Agent (DACA), which reinterprets 3D-VG as a semantic-geometric dual-anchor collaborative reasoning paradigm. DACA comprises two complementary specialized tools: the semantic anchor tool holds the visual semantic features of the target and achieves efficient target tracking via optical flow and VLM local verification; the geometric anchor tool holds the 3D spatial geometric features of the target and performs global spatial reasoning via voxelization and multi-keypoint projection. The two components exchange information bidirectionally via a standardized tool call protocol, autonomously deciding on the next perception-action step to form a closed-loop optimization. Experiments on the ScanRefer and Nr3D benchmarks demonstrate that zero-shot DACA achieves an overall Acc@0.25 of 73.6\% on ScanRefer and 70.4\% overall accuracy on Nr3D, far surpassing the latest zero-shot 3D-VG methods. The code and models are available at this https URL

AI.tldr: DACA将3D视觉定位重构为“语义锚点+几何锚点”双工具协同智能体范式，通过标准化工具调用协议实现双向信息交换与闭环优化。
AI.motivation: 现有3D-VG智能体虽摆脱了对预处理点云的依赖，但采用单向流水线式工具调用，语义理解与几何重建被割裂，导致误差累积且无法自主从失败中恢复。
AI.method: 提出双锚点协同智能体：语义锚点工具持有目标视觉语义特征，通过光流与VLM局部验证实现高效目标跟踪；几何锚点工具持有目标3D空间几何特征，通过体素化与多关键点投影进行全局空间推理；二者经标准化工具调用协议双向交互，自主决定下一步感知-动作，形成闭环优化。
AI.result: 零样本条件下ScanRefer整体Acc@0.25达73.6%，Nr3D整体准确率70.4%，显著超越最新零样本3D-VG方法。
AI.conclusion: 语义-几何双锚点协同+闭环工具调用是替代单向流水线的有效范式，可为具身智能体提供更强的3D-VG鲁棒性。

title: Verifying Before Enhancing: Target Evidence Chain Verification for Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared small target detection is essential for early warning, surveillance, remote sensing, and space-based target perception. However, infrared small targets are typically tiny, weakly textured, and boundary-blurred, making them difficult to distinguish from complex backgrounds. Moreover, target-like background structures can produce salient responses across multiple scales, making response strength alone insufficient for reliable target discrimination. To address this challenge, we propose VBE-UNet, a Target Evidence Chain Verification Network that assesses candidate reliability beyond response magnitude through complementary evidence cues. Specifically, counterfactual background explanation models local target evidence, while joint evidence verification integrates cross-scale support and perturbation-based contribution verification to guide feature recomposition. The resulting reliability estimates guide selective feature refinement, promoting target-relevant responses while reducing unsupported background activations. Extensive experiments on IRSTD-1K, NUDT-SIRST, and NUAA-SIRST demonstrate that VBE-UNet achieves superior detection accuracy and lower false-alarm rates compared with state-of-the-art methods. Ablation studies and evidence reliability analysis further validate the effectiveness of the proposed verification framework.

AI.tldr: VBE-UNet：以"目标证据链验证"思路改进红外小目标检测，用反事实背景解释建模局部目标证据，并用跨尺度支持与扰动贡献验证引导特征重组与可靠性加权精修，在IRSTD-1K/NUDT-SIRST/NUAA-SIRST上取得更高精度与更低虚警率。
AI.motivation: 红外小目标尺寸极小、纹理弱、边界模糊，且类目标的背景结构在多尺度上都会产生显著响应，仅凭响应强度无法可靠区分真目标与虚警，需要引入超越响应幅值的互补证据进行候选可靠性判别。
AI.method: 提出VBE-UNet证据链验证网络：反事实背景解释模块对局部目标证据建模；联合证据验证整合跨尺度支持与基于扰动的贡献验证，指导特征重组；所得可靠性估计用于选择性特征精修，增强目标相关响应、抑制缺乏证据支撑的背景激活。
AI.result: 在IRSTD-1K、NUDT-SIRST、NUAA-SIRST三个数据集上检测精度优于SOTA且虚警率更低；消融实验与证据可靠性分析验证了验证框架的有效性。仅报告数据集层面的指标，无真实部署或工程化验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将"可信度/证据验证"引入红外小目标分割式检测流程，提供了可解释的候选筛选机制，但属于特定遥感/预警领域CV方法，未触及物理AI、具身智能或3D重建等核心方向。

title: On the Hamel Coefficients and the Boltzmann-Hamel Equations for the Rigid Body
summary: The Boltzmann-Hamel (BH) equations are central in the dynamics and control of nonholonomic systems described in terms of quasi-velocities. The rigid body is a classical example of such systems, and it is well-known that the BH-equations are the Newton-Euler (NE) equations when described in terms of rigid body twists as quasi-velocities. It is further known that the NE-equations are the Euler-Poincare, respectively, the reduced Euler-Lagrange equations on SE(3) when using body-fixed or spatial representation of rigid body twists. The connection between these equations are the Hamel coefficients, which are immediately identified as the structure constants of SE(3). However, an explicit coordinate-free derivation has not been presented in the literature. In this paper the Hamel coefficients for the rigid body are derived in a coordinate-free way without resorting to local coordinates describing the rigid body motion. The three most relevant choices of quasi-velocities (body-fixed, spatial, and hybrid representation of rigid body twists) are considered. The corresponding BH-equations are derived explicitly for the rotating and free floating body. Further, the Hamel equations for nonholonomically constrained rigid bodies are discussed, and demonstrated for the inhomogenous ball rolling on a plane.

AI.tldr: 该文以无坐标方式推导刚体的Hamel系数（即SE(3)的结构常数），给出体固连、空间与混合三种准速度表示下的Boltzmann-Hamel方程，并讨论非完整约束刚体（如非均匀球在平面滚动）的Hamel方程。
AI.motivation: 文献中已知BH方程在刚体准速度描述下即为Newton-Euler方程，且与SE(3)上的Euler-Poincaré/约化Euler-Lagrange方程相通，其间桥梁是Hamel系数（SE(3)结构常数），但缺乏显式的无坐标推导。
AI.method: 采用几何力学（李群/SE(3)、Euler-Poincaré框架）方法，不依赖局部坐标，无坐标地导出刚体Hamel系数；对体固连、空间及混合三种准速度选择分别显式导出旋体与自由漂浮体的BH方程；并将Hamel方程推广至非完整约束刚体，以非均匀球在平面滚动为算例演示。
AI.result: 给出三种准速度表示下的显式BH方程，并表明其与NE方程的等价性可由SE(3)结构常数直接刻画；非完整约束情形下得到可计算的Hamel方程形式并给出球体滚动实例。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为刚体非完整动力学提供一个统一、坐标无关的BH表述与推导模板，便于准速度方法在刚体动力学与控制中的系统使用，属理论/形式化贡献而非面向实验验证的工程方法。

title: What's in the box? Revealing Object Layouts Inside Opaque Boxes via Contactless Vibration Excitation and Sensing
summary: Can we reveal what is inside an opaque box by observing its surface vibrations? Objects inside a box alter its mechanical response, providing cues about their hidden locations. We introduce a method that uses these cues to predict a box's 2D occupancy layout entirely remotely. A nearby speaker excites vibrations, which we measure on one visible wall using a grid of laser points and a camera measuring each point's speckle-pattern shifts. Our model, WhisperBox, learns to encode these vibrations into a latent representation and decode it into an occupancy map of the box's contents. The method requires no physical contact to excite or sense vibrations. We demonstrate layout recovery across various boxes and single- and multiple-object scenes, with generalization to unseen object instances, positions, orientations, and weights, as well as changes in laser placement and excitation source. Our analysis reveals that informative frequency bands need not coincide with the box's resonances and that the learned latent space captures object placement and supports arithmetic operations. These results demonstrate the potential of remote vibration sensing to infer spatial layouts hidden from view.

AI.tldr: WhisperBox：用扬声器激励箱体振动，以激光散斑阵列+相机非接触测量一面可见箱壁的振动，学习隐表示并解码为箱内物体的2D占据布局图。
AI.motivation: 箱内物体改变箱体的机械响应，这些振动线索隐含物体位置信息。作者希望完全远程、无接触地推断不透明容器内部的空间布局，用于不可见区域的感知。
AI.method: 近场扬声器作为非接触激励源，可见箱壁网格化激光点，相机逐点测量散斑图案位移以获取振动响应；WhisperBox模型将振动信号编码为隐表示，再解码为箱内2D占据图，端到端训练，无需接触式激振或传感。
AI.result: 在多种箱体、单/多物体场景中恢复布局，可泛化到未见过的物体实例、位置、朝向与重量，并对激光布点与激励源变化保持鲁棒；分析发现有效频带不一定对应箱体共振峰，且隐空间编码物体位置并支持算术运算。
AI.conclusion: 远程振动传感可用于推断视线之外的内部空间布局，为非接触式内部感知与机械响应建模提供了可行路径。

title: CGM: Chaos-Guided Graph Attention and Expert Routing for Autism Stereotypy Detection
summary: Skeleton graph attention for autism video analysis weights joints by content alone, giving an erratic wrist the same standing as a still one. Stereotypy, however, is defined by how unpredictably movement unfolds rather than how much of it occurs: in our cohort, every amplitude-based kinematic descriptor falls in stereotyped clips, while windowed Sample Entropy of angular velocity alone rises (Hedges' g = +1.05). We compute this irregularity as a per-joint, per-frame tensor that structurally drives computation. The proposed chaos-guided graph attention and mixture-of-experts model (CGM) couples two mechanisms. First, a learned pairwise term added to the graph-attention logit concentrates attention on irregular joints and re-ranks the remaining edge weight toward jointly irregular pairs; its unconstrained coefficient neither vanishes nor inverts, and zeroing the tensor realigns attention in 94% of clips. Second, a gate conditioned on the same signal routes each frame to two of four experts, whose weights track frame-level irregularity. Under subject-grouped five-fold cross-validation on 116 clips, CGM reaches 0.930 balanced accuracy, exceeding the graph-attention baseline by +0.187; the component ordering replicates on the public MMASD dataset, and on held-out Panoptic Studio sessions, CGM keeps 0.86 specificity without retraining, against at most 0.35 for chaos-free baselines. In ablation, routing without irregularity yields no reliable gain, whereas chaos modulation alone contributes +0.132. A severity index from the same tensor reaches 0.87 split-half reliability, separates the cohorts with Hedges' g = +1.08, and stays consistent within children across therapy recordings, supporting video-only monitoring of stereotypy during intervention.

AI.tldr: 提出混沌引导图注意力与混合专家模型(CGM),用逐关节逐帧的角速度样本熵张量驱动注意力重加权与专家路由,在自闭症刻板行为视频上达0.930平衡准确率,优于图注意力基线+0.187。
AI.motivation: 现有骨架图注意力仅按幅度/内容为关节加权,无法区分"幅度小但节律异常"的刻板动作;而刻板行为的定义在于运动展开的不可预测性(不规则度)而非运动幅度。作者观察到幅度类运动学指标在刻板片段中全部失效,唯有角速度的窗口化样本熵显著上升。
AI.method: 将逐关节、逐帧的样本熵组成的不规则度张量作为结构性计算输入:①在图注意力logit上加入学习到的成对项,把注意力集中到不规则关节并将边权重向"共同不规则"关节对重排序;②以同一信号为条件的门控把每帧路由到4个专家中的2个(MoE)。采用受试者分组的五折交叉验证。
AI.result: 116个片段上平衡准确率0.930(+0.187 vs 图注意力基线);成对项系数不消失也不反转,置零张量后94%片段注意力重新对齐;组件排序在公开MMASD上复现;在未再训练的Panoptic Studio留存会话上特异度保持0.86(无混沌基线≤0.35);消融中无混沌的路由无稳定增益,仅混沌调制贡献+0.132;由同一张量得到的严重度指数分半信度0.87、组间Hedges' g=+1.08,且在儿童跨治疗录像内保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 以运动不规则度为结构先验可显著提升骨架动作识别,并支持干预期间仅用视频的刻板行为监测与严重度评估。

title: Towards High-Fidelity Learned Video Compression
summary: Professional video workflows operate at qualities that learned video codecs do not reach. We measure how much of a professional quality range a codec covers, from the lowest quality of the standard test conditions, VVC at QP 37, to the highest 4:2:2 grade of the production codec ProRes. To compare inter-frame coding alone, every codec receives original frames as references at the intra positions. On 10-bit YCbCr 4:2:2 test sequences, four recent learned codecs cover 24 to 38% of this range. Their encoders are feed-forward networks with a fixed latent capacity, the number of latent values per sample, of at most 0.25, and removing their quantization raises the quality by at most 1 dB. We propose a learned inter-frame codec whose encoder searches, as the encoders of conventional codecs do. It searches block motion, which a learned network refines, and it searches among learned block transforms whose latent capacity ranges up to 1, selecting the partition, the skip decisions, and the quantized coefficients by a rate-distortion cost. Our codec reaches the upper end of the range on all six sequences. With all residual blocks fixed to 16x16, whose latent capacity is 0.25, the same codec covers 55% of the range, with or without quantization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种支持编码端搜索的帧间学习视频编码器，通过搜索块运动、块变换划分与量化决策，在10-bit 4:2:2专业质量区间内大幅超越现有学习型编解码器。
AI.motivation: 专业视频工作流的质量（如ProRes 4:2:2高档）远超现有学习型视频编解码器所能达到的范围。作者量化现有学习编解码器在“VVC QP37最低档到ProRes最高档”这一专业质量区间中的覆盖比例（仅24–38%），并指出根源在于其编码器为固定隐容量（≤0.25 latent/sample）的前馈网络，缺乏传统编码器那样的搜索机制。
AI.method: 在帧间位置统一使用原始帧作为参考以隔离帧间编码能力的比较；在10-bit YCbCr 4:2:2测试序列上评测。提出的学习型帧间编解码器在编码端引入搜索：搜索块运动并由学习网络细化，同时在隐容量最高为1的学习块变换集合中搜索，依据率失真代价选择划分、skip决策与量化系数。
AI.result: 在六条序列上均达到专业质量区间的上端；当所有残差块固定为16x16（隐容量0.25）时，同一编解码器覆盖区间的55%，且无论是否使用量化均如此。相比之下，四种近期学习型编解码器仅覆盖24–38%，且去除量化最多提升1 dB。
AI.conclusion: 编码端搜索（运动搜索+变换/划分/量化决策的率失真优化）与可变隐容量是让学习型视频编码器进入专业质量区间的关键，固定容量前馈编码器难以胜任。

title: SAM 3 Sees More Than It Detects: Promptable Concept Maps Beyond Categories
summary: Promptable segmenters answer what a thing is. Dense prediction tasks also ask class-agnostic questions, such as what stands out or hides, how light is blocked, transmitted or reflected, and where structure lies. Robots, surveillance systems and image editors build on their answers. We study promptable concept maps (PCM), which extend SAM 3's promptable concept segmentation from noun instances to maps of concepts named by short noun phrases such as `"transparent object", with "none" as an answer. PCM-Bench groups the standard test sets of seven such tasks by the question they ask. On it, we find that SAM 3 sees more than it detects. Its semantic path responds to many of these concepts, yet a low image-level presence score can block every detection of its instance path. We present UNVEIL, which trains a copy of SAM 3's semantic path for these maps, with LoRA on copies of its last blocks. A separate presence decoder learns from verified negatives whether a concept occurs. With one text phrase per query, UNVEIL maps region concepts such as salient and camouflaged objects, shadows, transparent objects and mirrors. The same weights map thin structures such as edges and skeletons as well as object categories. Run next to SAM 3, it leaves SAM 3's own outputs unchanged. On each of the seven tasks, UNVEIL reaches the highest score among the compared promptable models, including SAM 3's official fine-tuning and pipelines built on multimodal LLMs. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出PCM-Bench与UNVEIL，将SAM 3的"可提示概念分割"从名词实例扩展到短名词短语指定的概念图（如透明物体、阴影、边缘、骨架），并解决SAM 3语义路径"看得见却检测不出"的问题。
AI.motivation: Dense prediction任务需要回答"什么突出/什么被遮挡/光如何传播/结构在哪"等类别无关问题，机器人、监控与图像编辑均依赖此类答案；而SAM 3等可提示分割器仅回答"这是什么物体实例"。作者观察到SAM 3语义路径对许多此类概念已有响应，但其低图像级存在性分数(presence score)会阻断实例路径的全部检测。
AI.method: 构建PCM-Bench，将七个密集预测任务的标准测试集按"所问问题"归类整合；提出UNVEIL：复制SAM 3语义路径并用LoRA微调其最后若干块以输出概念图；另设独立presence decoder，利用经核验的负样本学习概念是否出现；每查询仅需一个文本短语；与SAM 3并行运行、不改变SAM 3原始输出。
AI.result: 同一套权重可同时映射显著/伪装物体、阴影、透明物体、镜面等区域概念，以及边缘、骨架等细结构与物体类别；在七项任务上均取得对比可提示模型的最高分，优于SAM 3官方微调方案及基于多模态LLM的pipeline。
AI.conclusion: 概念图是对可提示分割的自然扩展；解耦"语义响应"与"图像级存在性判定"是关键。UNVEIL以插件式方式提升密集预测能力而不损害SAM 3原有功能，代码已开源。

title: AdaptReg: Skip-level FiLM Adapter for Task-Specific Adaptation of a Frozen Registration Foundation Model
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Paper for the Learn2Reg 2026 PSMAReg challenge (PSMA-PET/CT longitudinal registration), 4th place among 16 teams on the hidden test set
summary: Longitudinal PSMA-PET/CT registration is a key step in assessing treatment response in prostate cancer, and it requires more than generic alignment accuracy: the deformation must preserve lesion volume, so that measured changes in metabolic tumor volume (MTV) and total lesion glycolysis (TLG) reflect treatment response rather than registration artifacts. We propose AdaptReg, which adapts a frozen registration foundation model to such task-specific requirements through a lightweight trainable adapter branch with identity-preserving initialization. Keeping uniGradICON fully frozen, we apply FiLM-style per-voxel affine modulation ($\gamma$, $\beta$) to its decoder skip connections; the modulation is generated from anatomical semantic features of a frozen TotalSegmentator encoder and supervised by a lesion volume-preservation loss. On the official Codabench validation set (20 pairs), AdaptReg achieves DSC 0.7585, HD95 6.33 mm, MTV/TLG errors of 1.68%/2.11%, and 0.0022% non-diffeomorphic voxels, improving on the uniGradICON + instance optimization baseline by $+0.05$ DSC and reducing the MTV/TLG errors by 70.9%/67.7%. On the hidden official test set (160 pairs), AdaptReg achieves CT DSC 0.816, PET DSC 0.598, and MTV/TLG errors of 4.02%/3.46%, ranking fourth among 16 teams in the final PSMAReg evaluation. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: AdaptReg 在冻结的 uniGradICON 配准基础模型上加轻量 FiLM 适配分支（由冻结 TotalSegmentator 语义特征生成逐体素仿射调制），并用病灶体积保持损失监督，实现保体积的前列腺癌纵向 PSMA-PET/CT 配准。
AI.motivation: 前列腺癌疗效评估需要纵向 PSMA-PET/CT 配准，但不仅是通用对齐精度：形变必须保持病灶体积，使 MTV/TLG 变化反映真实疗效而非配准伪影。
AI.method: 保持 uniGradICON 完全冻结，仅训练带恒等初始化（identity-preserving）的适配器分支：对解码器跳跃连接施加 FiLM 风格的逐体素仿射调制 (γ, β)，调制参数由冻结 TotalSegmentator 编码器的解剖语义特征生成，并由病灶体积保持损失监督。
AI.result: Codabench 验证集（20 对）：DSC 0.7585、HD95 6.33 mm、MTV/TLG 误差 1.68%/2.11%、非微分同胚体素 0.0022%，较 uniGradICON+实例优化基线 DSC +0.05、MTV/TLG 误差降 70.9%/67.7%。隐藏测试集（160 对）：CT DSC 0.816、PET DSC 0.598、MTV/TLG 误差 4.02%/3.46%，16 队中排名第 4。
AI.conclusion: 任务特定的轻量适配（语义引导调制+物理意义损失）可在不微调基础模型的前提下将通用配准基础模型定制为保体积临床配准器，但属医学影像领域应用，未提供跨域通用方法洞察。

title: Driver Gaze Target Identification via Gaze Estimation and Structured Driving Scene Understanding
summary: Identifying a driver's gaze target provides object-level information for visual attention monitoring in intelligent vehicles. Gaze-zone classification and continuous attention localization provide limited information about the identity of the attended scene target. This paper proposes a modular framework that identifies object- or region-level gaze targets from synchronized in-cabin driver images and forward-view road images. The framework comprises four components: MFGaze, which combines a Vision Transformer pretrained with a masked autoencoder (MAE) and head-pose conditioning through feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM); panoptic scene understanding, which constructs a structured candidate set; polynomial ridge regression, which maps gaze features to 2D scene-image coordinates through individualized calibration; and entropy-driven target inference, which adaptively fuses boundary-distance geometry with class-level semantic priors. Experiments evaluate the framework using three public gaze datasets, a laboratory test using Cityscapes road scenes and self-collected gaze data, and the Look Both Ways (LBW) dataset. The complete framework achieves an overall Top-1 gaze target identification accuracy of 96.27% in the laboratory experiment. After sequence-specific calibration, it achieves Top-1 accuracies of 79.92% for task-relevant objects and 85.58% for the road class on LBW. MFGaze achieves the lowest mean angular errors among the compared methods, with 4.06$^\circ$, 4.23$^\circ$, and 10.52$^\circ$ on MPIIFaceGaze, ETH-XGaze, and Gaze360, respectively, and demonstrates strong cross-dataset generalization. Sensitivity analyses show stable performance under hyperparameter perturbations. These results support the framework as a source of object-level gaze information for driver monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出模块化框架，从座舱驾驶员图像与前方道路图像同步输入中识别物体/区域级注视目标，含MFGaze视线估计、全景场景理解候选集、多项式岭回归个体校准与熵驱动目标推断。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶员注意力监测多为注视区域分类或连续坐标定位，无法给出被注视场景目标的身份信息，缺少物体级语义。
AI.method: 四模块：MAE预训练ViT＋FiLM头部姿态条件化的MFGaze；全景分割构建结构化候选集；多项式岭回归将视线特征映射到2D场景坐标并做个体化校准；熵驱动推断自适应融合边界距离几何与类别语义先验。
AI.result: 实验室实验总体Top-1注视目标识别96.27%；LBW上序列校准后任务相关物体79.92%、道路类85.58%；MFGaze平均角误差MPIIFaceGaze 4.06°、ETH-XGaze 4.23°、Gaze360 10.52°，跨数据集泛化良好，超参数灵敏度稳定。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可作为驾驶员监测中物体级视线信息的可靠来源，适合智能座舱注意力监测与安全辅助场景。

title: Suppressing the Shortcut Hidden Behind the Gains of VideoLLM Fine-Tuning
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is the stage in which Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) advance their capability to reason over video. However, the VideoLLM also learns to answer from textual regularities of its training data, a shortcut that bypasses the video. The regularities behind the shortcut are hard to define at the data level, and the shortcut forms regardless of training epoch, data size, or backbone. The shortcut is hidden behind a rise in accuracy within the training distribution, yet it is not required for the rise and even costs SFT the gain the video offers under distribution shift. We therefore propose Video-Evidence Training via Orthogonal projection (VETO), which intervenes on the fine-tuning update where the shortcut is written rather than on the data. VETO calibrates the subspace that the text alone occupies in the activations of the base model and projects the update onto its orthogonal complement. The VideoLLM is thus left to ground its answer in the full input, with the shortcut suppressed as it forms and never defined. Across seven VideoLLMs, VETO preserves the gain of SFT on the training distribution and suppresses the shortcut. On six benchmarks under shift it gains more than SFT and answers from the full input rather than the shortcut. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出VETO：在SFT更新层面用正交投影抑制VideoLLM的文本捷径，保留SFT增益并提升分布偏移下的视频grounding能力。
AI.motivation: VideoLLM在SFT中会学到依赖训练数据的文本规律（文本捷径）而非真正看视频，该捷径难以在数据层面定义，且与训练轮数、数据规模、backbone无关，藏在训练分布内准确率上升的背后，代价是分布偏移下视频信息带来的收益。
AI.method: VETO（Video-Evidence Training via Orthogonal projection）不干预数据，而是干预微调更新：在基座模型激活中校准"仅文本"所占的子空间，并将SFT更新投影到其正交补上，使捷径在形成过程中即被抑制且无需显式定义。
AI.result: 在7个VideoLLM上，VETO保持SFT在训练分布上的增益并抑制捷径；在分布偏移下的6个基准上优于SFT，并更多基于完整输入（视频）作答。
AI.conclusion: 通过更新空间投影而非数据工程可有效消除多模态SFT中的模态捷径，为VideoLLM训练提供了一种通用、模型无关的干预手段。

title: Hindsight Self-Distillation: Teaching Robots to Act from the Present
summary: A robot must choose an action before it can see the outcome. In a recorded demonstration, later camera frames show what happened after the robot moved. Hindsight Self-Distillation (HSD) uses these later frames to teach a policy what to extract from current images. During training, a teacher sees both the current and later frames, while a student sees the current frames. They share a visual encoder and an action predictor. Each branch summarizes its images with a small set of feature vectors. These visual summaries supply all visual input to the action predictor. The teacher learns from demonstrated actions. For each noisy action sequence, the student learns from either the demonstration or the teacher's denoising prediction. It also learns to match the teacher's visual summaries. We analyze which aspects of the teacher's predictions the student can recover from its inputs. At deployment, the student encodes the current images once and reuses its summaries at every denoising step. HSD achieves average success rates of 98.50\% on LIBERO and 92.31\% on RoboTwin 2.0.

AI.tldr: HSD（Hindsight Self-Distillation）用演示中"事后"帧作为教师监督，通过共享视觉编码器+动作预测器的双分支自蒸馏，让学生仅凭当前帧就学到应提取的视觉表示；特征汇总（summary tokens）为动作预测器唯一视觉输入，部署时只需编码一次并复用。
AI.motivation: 机器人必须在看到结果之前选动作，当前帧观测往往不足以判断该抓取/提取什么信息；而录制的演示中后续帧已隐含"发生什么"的因果线索。作者希望把这种事后信息（hindsight）在线蒸馏到仅用当前帧的学生策略中，消除训练-部署的信息不对称。
AI.method: 教师分支输入当前帧+后续帧，学生分支仅输入当前帧，二者共享视觉编码器与动作预测器。每分支将图像聚合为少量特征向量（visual summary），所有视觉输入均经该汇总进入动作预测器。教师用演示动作监督；学生对每步噪声动作序列，既可学习演示动作，也可学习教师的去噪预测，并额外对齐教师的视觉汇总。文中分析了学生能从自身输入中恢复教师预测的哪些方面。推理时学生只编码当前帧一次，各去噪步复用汇总特征。
AI.result: LIBERO 平均成功率 98.50%，RoboTwin 2.0 平均成功率 92.31%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在训练期引入事后帧教师并对视觉汇总做自蒸馏，可将"看未来"的优势压缩进只看当前帧的学生策略，且推理开销低（单次编码+复用），在两大操作基准上取得高成功率；是一种轻量、可插拔的 VLA/扩散策略训练增强。

title: ECHO: In-Context Behavior foundation model for Humanoid Whole-Body Control
summary: Humanoid behavior foundation models (BFMs) acquire diverse skills through large-scale motion imitation and massively parallel reinforcement learning, yet broad behavioral capability does not ensure precise execution across physical conditions. Without distinguishing the underlying dynamics, policies may favor conservative compromises over environment-specific precision. We introduce ECHO, an in-context BFM that turns interaction experience into environment-specific control, separating general behavioral capability from dynamics-specific execution. Mixed and Annealed Sampling first establishes a behavior prior in a single pretraining stage by balancing targeted practice with broad motion coverage. Building on this prior, Context Representation and Residual Adaptation learns structured dynamics representations from interaction histories to guide residual corrections to the frozen prior, enabling adaptation without test-time parameter updates. Extensive experiments show that ECHO outperforms all baseline methods across diverse motions and physical conditions. Moreover, deployment on the Unitree G1 demonstrates whole-body teleoperation spanning extreme acrobatics and terrain interaction, alongside payload adaptation in manipulation and whole-body control. Page is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: ECHO：一种in-context人形行为基础模型，通过混合退火采样预训练建立行为先验，再用上下文动力学表示+残差适配冻结先验，实现无需测试时参数更新的环境特异精确控制。
AI.motivation: 大规模运动模仿与并行RL训练出的人形行为基础模型（BFM）虽具备广泛技能，但无法区分底层动力学，策略倾向保守折中，难以在特定物理条件下精确执行。
AI.method: (1) Mixed and Annealed Sampling：单阶段预训练中平衡定向练习与广泛动作覆盖，形成行为先验；(2) Context Representation and Residual Adaptation：从交互历史学习结构化动力学表示，据此对冻结先验生成残差修正，实现in-context自适应。
AI.result: 在多样动作与物理条件下超越所有基线；在Unitree G1上实现涵盖极限杂技与地形交互的全身遥操作，以及操作与全身控制中的负载自适应。
AI.conclusion: 将通用行为先验与动力学特异执行解耦，可在不更新参数的前提下以交互历史驱动精确适配，验证了in-context BFM在人形全身控制上的可行性。

title: GeoPillars: A Large-Kernel Pillar Detector for Single-Sweep LiDAR Under Point Sparsity, and a Decomposition of Its Gain
summary: GeoPillars is a pillar-based 3D detector for single-sweep LiDAR under a hard budget of eight points per 0.4 m pillar, a budget that discards 46.6% of in-range points. It adds geometric pillar features, grouped vector attention within each pillar, a learned absolute positional prior on the bird's-eye-view (BEV) grid, a large-kernel backbone, auxiliary surface-normal supervision and a full-resolution detection head. Trained on 123k synthetic CARLA scans and evaluated on cars, it reaches 81.33 BEV AP@0.7, 13.76 points above CenterPoint at the same input budget and 1.91 points above CenterPoint at its native, denser budget. These are in-distribution figures, because the validation split is per-frame rather than scene-disjoint. A rung-by-rung decomposition shows that the new components explain little of the gain. Raising the detection-head resolution alone recovers 10.19 of the 13.76 points, the joint change of encoder, backbone, neck and positional prior adds 3.37, and the normal-supervision branch adds 0.20, which is within run-to-run variation. With heading reversals folded out, orientation error is similar for all seven models, although GeoPillars reverses headings about half as often as a resolution-matched baseline. It is also the slowest of the seven models. Evaluated zero-shot on 6,743 real nuScenes keyframes, no model transfers, and each retains 3.7% to 12.2% of its CARLA accuracy. A collection defect left LiDAR intensity constant, so every model learned from geometry alone. Code and checkpoints are publicly available.

AI.tldr: GeoPillars 在每 0.4 m 柱仅 8 点的极端 LiDAR 预算下提出多组件 3D 检测器，虽在 CARLA 上比 CenterPoint 高 13.76 BEV AP，但消融显示增益几乎全部来自检测头分辨率提升，且零样本迁移到真实 nuScenes 失败。
AI.motivation: 针对单帧、极稀疏点云的柱式 3D 检测，在固定点预算（每柱 8 点、丢弃 46.6% 有效点）下尽量保留几何信息并提升检测精度。
AI.method: 柱内几何特征、柱内分组向量注意力、BEV 网格上的可学习绝对位置先验、大核骨干、表面法向辅助监督、全分辨率检测头；在 123k 合成 CARLA 扫描上训练，仅评估 car 类。
AI.result: 81.33 BEV AP@0.7（同预算比 CenterPoint +13.76，比其原生稠密预算 +1.91）；逐级消融显示仅提升检测头分辨率即贡献 10.19/13.76，编码器+骨干+颈部+位置先验联合仅 +3.37，法向分支 +0.20 属噪声；7 个模型中速度最慢；零样本在 6,743 帧真实 nuScenes 上全部失效，仅保留 3.7%–12.2% 精度。
AI.conclusion: 在固定点预算下，扩大检测头分辨率这一“朴素”改动几乎解释全部增益，其余新组件贡献有限；结论基于非 scene-disjoint 的分布内验证，且无真实域迁移能力，方法价值主要在诊断性消融而非新架构。

title: Collision-Free Is Not Enough: Passage-Conditioned Navigation for Wheeled-Legged Robots
summary: A collision-free detour can still bring a legged robot to the next stair or ledge a few centimetres or degrees off, and a fixed locomotion skill, factory or learned, can stall or fall. Existing methods prevent this with a robot model or extensive trial and error, but on a new site with unknown skills neither is available, so they cannot be used. We find that a single 27-minute teaching session already supplies what these methods have to derive or learn: for every stair and ledge, one crossing the skill has completed. Our method, passage-conditioned navigation, makes the route remember how each transition was entered, not only where the path went. It stores each taught crossing as an event and, without training or a robot model, enforces it after every local replan: before each ledge, an entry gate makes the robot turn or back up and retry if it is more than 10 cm or 10° off the taught crossing. Under localization noise, with path, gait schedule, and sensing unchanged, this raises the share of disturbed ledge crossings that stay within these limits from 24.1% to 88.6%. In contact simulation with our learned policies, a robot pushed off course before stairs never falls in 180 climbs, against 9 falls when the stored direction is ignored; pushed 1.2 m away, it rejoins the route, ending on average 0.14 m from it (1.10 m without rejoining), and finishes as often as an undisturbed robot. This suits any robot with fixed skills that repeats a route over terrain transitions, as in inspection and patrol, where one wrong entry can end the task. We deployed it in competition on a real wheeled-legged robot: over 271 m of multi-obstacle terrain spanning 7.0 m of elevation, it completed all six runs, won third place at the 2026 Global Open-source AI Challenge, which drew 2,999 submissions, and was the only finalist in its task to finish fully autonomously.

AI.tldr: 提出"通行条件化导航"(passage-conditioned navigation)：将单次27分钟示教中每次跨越台阶/边缘的进入姿态存为事件，在局部重规划后以"入口门"约束（>10cm或>10°偏差则回转/后退重试），无需机器人模型或额外训练。
AI.motivation: 无碰撞的绕行路线仍可能让腿足机器人以几厘米/几度的偏差抵达下一级台阶或边缘，导致固定运动技能（学习得到的或出厂固化的）卡死或摔倒。已有方法依赖精确机器人模型或大量试错，在未知场地、技能未知时均不可用。作者观察到：一次示教已为每个跨越点提供了"成功进入姿态"这一先验。
AI.method: 核心是将路径的记忆从"轨迹位置"扩展为"进入方式"：(1) 把每次示教跨越记录为事件（位置+进入位姿）；(2) 不做训练、不建机器人模型，在每个局部重规划之后强制施加事件约束；(3) "入口门"机制——若当前位姿偏离示教进入姿态超过 10 cm 或 10°，则触发转向或后退重试，使技能在其"工作域"内被复用；(4) 离线重定位偏差下的鲁棒性评估 + 接触仿真的策略推挤实验 + 真实轮腿机器人竞赛部署。
AI.result: 定位噪声下、路径/步态调度/感知不变，受扰动跨越中满足限位的比例由 24.1% 提升至 88.6%；接触仿真中楼梯前被推离路线，180 次爬升零摔倒（忽略存储方向时为 9 次）；被推离 1.2 m 后可重新并线，终点平均距路线 0.14 m（不并线 1.10 m），完成率与无扰动相当；真机竞赛：271 m 多障碍地形、7.0 m 高差，6 次全部完成，获 2026 全球开源AI挑战赛第三名（2999 份提交），为其任务中唯一完全自主完赛的决赛队伍。
AI.conclusion: 把"如何进入地形转换"作为路径的一部分来记忆和强制执行，是一种免模型、免训练、仅需一次示教即可部署的导航范式，适用于巡检、巡逻等需重复通过地形转换的固定技能机器人；应用场景中一次错误进入即可能终止任务。

title: Design and Validation of a Telescopic Chassis-Assisted Stair-Climbing Mechanism for Powered Wheelchairs
summary: We propose a simple stair traversal mechanism that augments a four-wheel wheelchair with an auxiliary telescopic chassis actuator. The proposed mechanism provides the following key contributions during stair ascent: (A) enhanced safety by ensuring that either the front or rear wheels remain stationary at all times; (B) primary reliance of the required force and mechanical work on the telescopic chassis rather than the wheels; (C) insensitivity of the required force and mechanical work to stair inclination; and (D) reduced risk of wheel slip on steeper stairs. In addition, the telescopic chassis is expected to improve level-ground mobility by enabling tight turning with the shortest wheelbase and enhancing stability with the longest wheelbase.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"辅助伸缩底盘执行器"的爬楼梯机构，为四轮轮椅增加伸缩底盘，使爬楼时前后轮总有一组保持静止，并由底盘而非车轮承担主要驱动力与机械功，且对楼梯倾角不敏感、降低打滑风险；同一伸缩底盘还能调节轴距以兼顾小半径转向与行驶稳定性。
AI.motivation: 四轮轮椅爬楼梯时依赖车轮发力，存在安全性差、所需力矩大、对楼梯坡度敏感、陡坡易打滑等问题；同时固定轴距难以兼顾转向灵活性与地面行驶稳定性。
AI.method: 在四轮轮椅上增设一个被动/辅助式伸缩底盘执行器，构成阶梯式爬升机构：爬楼过程中通过前后轮交替静止、伸缩底盘相对轮组伸缩来完成台阶跨越，使驱动力与功主要由底盘承担。
AI.result: 摘要给出的定性结论为：爬升安全性提高（前后轮始终至少一组静止）、所需力与机械功主要由伸缩底盘提供且对楼梯倾角不敏感、陡坡打滑风险降低；变轴距可分别实现最短轴距紧凑转向与最长轴距的稳定性提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为移动辅助机器人的越障机构提供了一种简洁的机械设计思路，但摘要未给出原型实验、定量指标或与基线机构的对比，说服力有限，具体性能需查阅正文验证。

title: Fast and Accurate Body Estimation in Pixels, World Space and Scenes
comment: 28 pages, 9 pages of main text. 16 figures
summary: We present FAB (Fast and Accurate Body estimation), a human body estimator that jointly improves inference efficiency and body-recovery fidelity. Rather than predicting only parametric mesh-model parameters, FAB directly predicts human skeleton joints and dense surface points. In images, it predicts dense 2D and 3D body points alongside a parametric Momentum Human Rig (MHR) head, then fits SMPL in one learned pass followed by two Gauss-Newton steps. Its ViT-L student, FAB-L, distilled from a fine-tuned SAM 3D Body, runs in real time for one person on an RTX 4070 Ti SUPER, from detection to a fitted body, at 4.6x the speed of SAM 3D Body's eager-PyTorch body-only path, while improving accuracy on most camera-space benchmarks. The same network predicts heel, toe, hand, and knee contacts, which connect the body to the scene. FAB also estimates world-space motion, fuses static-scene depth around the visible person, and aligns body and scene using predicted contacts. For human-to-humanoid real-to-sim transfer, an in-model G1 head and FAB-Retarget, a motion-level retargeter that reads dense points or the fitted mesh, map motion to a Unitree G1. FAB-Retarget produces references that follow the person more closely than specialized retargeters including SOMA, GMR, UMR, and OmniRetarget, and substantially more closely than Fast SAM 3D Body retargeted with our sequence IK. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: FAB 直接预测人体骨架关节与稠密表面点，经单次学习式拟合和两步 Gauss-Newton 得到 SMPL 参数，配合蒸馏自 SAM 3D Body 的 ViT-L 学生网络实现实时人体重建，并扩展至接触预测、世界坐标运动估计、场景融合与人形机器人重定向。
AI.motivation: 现有单目人体估计方法要么只回归参数化网格模型参数导致保真度受限，要么推理效率不足，难以满足实时下游需求（如场景交互、real-to-sim 人形机器人重定向）。作者希望同时提升推理效率与人体恢复保真度。
AI.method: 1) 不直接回归参数化网格参数，而是预测稠密 2D/3D 人体表面点与关节，并结合 MHR 头；2) 用一次学习式拟合加两步 Gauss-Newton 完成 SMPL 拟合；3) FAB-L 为 ViT-L 学生模型，从微调后的 SAM 3D Body 蒸馏；4) 同一网络预测脚跟、脚趾、手、膝接触点；5) 估计世界坐标系运动，融合可见人体周围静态场景深度，用预测接触对齐人体与场景；6) 内置 G1 头与 FAB-Retarget 运动级重定向器（可读取稠密点或拟合网格），将动作映射到 Unitree G1。
AI.result: 在 RTX 4070 Ti SUPER 上单人实时运行（含检测到拟合全过程），速度是 SAM 3D Body eager-PyTorch 纯人体路径的 4.6 倍，并在多数相机坐标系基准上精度更优；FAB-Retarget 生成的参考动作比 SOMA、GMR、UMR、OmniRetarget 等专用重定向器更贴近原人体动作，且显著优于用序列 IK 重定向的 Fast SAM 3D Body。
AI.conclusion: 以稠密点预测替代纯参数回归，可在保持实时性的同时提升保真度，并提供接触、场景对齐与重定向等下游能力，构成从单目人体估计到人形机器人 real-to-sim 的完整流水线；未来可关注接触精度与实时性与场景泛化的进一步平衡。

title: World-delta: Continually Integrating Observations for Incremental 3D Scene Generation
summary: Existing 3D generation methods synthesize visually compelling scenes from fixed inputs, yet struggle to continually expand and revise a 3D world as new observations arrive. Iterative approaches often fuse real observations and generated content into a single representation, treating generated content as established structure rather than revisable predictions. Consequently, early generation errors can persist and accumulate despite new evidence. We propose World-delta, an incremental 3D scene generation framework combining uncertainty-aware persistent world modeling with delta-guided diffusion for continual scene expansion and correction. Our framework comprises three components: 1) Visual Evidence Encoding integrates geometric and semantic cues from incoming images into unified world tokens. 2) Observation-Calibrated World Modeling maintains a persistent latent world state that distinguishes observation-supported content from provisional completion hypotheses. New evidence drives selective world deltas to revise conflicting hypotheses while preserving well-supported content. 3) Incremental World Diffusion Generation uses delta-derived masks to restrict diffusion to regions requiring updates, freezing unchanged regions. Only affected 3D chunks are decoded and integrated into the existing scene. Together, these components enable continual world expansion and revision while reducing redundant generation and preserving scene consistency. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of World-delta in incremental 3D scene generation, observation-driven correction, scene consistency, and update efficiency over successive scene updates.

AI.tldr: World-delta：用不确定性感知的持久世界状态+delta引导扩散实现增量式3D场景扩展与纠错，仅重生成需更新的区域。
AI.motivation: 现有3D生成方法难以随新观测持续扩展和修订场景；迭代式方法把生成内容当作既定结构融入统一表示，导致早期误差随新证据不断累积。
AI.method: 三模块框架：(1)视觉证据编码，将输入图像的几何与语义线索编码为统一world tokens；(2)观测校准世界建模，维护区分"观测支持"与"临时补全假设"的持久隐世界状态，新证据产生选择性world delta修订冲突假设并保留可靠内容；(3)增量世界扩散生成，用delta导出的掩码限制扩散仅作用于需更新区域，冻结未变化区域，仅解码受影响3D chunk并入场景。
AI.result: 实验表明在增量3D场景生成、观测驱动纠错、场景一致性及多次更新下的更新效率方面均有效。
