AI.conclusion: 将生成内容显式建模为可修订假设而非既定结构，配合局部化扩散更新，是缓解3D世界模型误差累积、实现持续场景扩展的可行路线。

title: What Does Anti-Hallucination Training Buy? Saying Less, Cheap Pruning, and the Rest
summary: Preference training is the standard recipe for reducing object hallucination in vision-language models, and each new method reports a lower CHAIR score. We ask what that reduction consists of. Every trained system is compared with its base model's caption truncated to the same object recall, which removes the part of the gain that comes from saying less; the remainder is compared with what a deliberately weak, frozen, eleven-feature post-hoc probe fitted on 500 annotated images can reproduce. All criteria were specified in the analysis code and frozen before the outputs they judge existed. For eight public methods on LLaVA-1.5-7B, the probe reproduces at least two thirds of what training removes beyond saying less for 7 of 8 methods on COCO, 8 of 8 on AMBER and 6 of 8 on Object HalBench, with RLAIF-V the consistent exception; a later public method released for both LLaVA-1.5 and Qwen2.5-VL (SENTINEL) meets the same bar on both. On our own DPO checkpoints the accounting holds on Qwen2.5-VL but fails on InternVL2.5 on COCO (2 of 4 training designs). At matched recall, the base model plus the probe beats truncation for 8 of 9 LLaVA-1.5 systems on COCO and 9 of 9 on AMBER, on the two newer backbones, and when realized as actual sentence deletion. The same measure prices training signals: DPO on the model's own samples labelled by the probe or by an object-level CLIP score recovers 0.70 and 0.87 of the beyond-brevity gain of ground-truth-labelled DPO on Qwen2.5-VL (the probe 0.73 on InternVL2.5), both beat length-matched random labels, and CLIP labels buy more than probe labels on COCO. Human judgements show that the sentences the probe deletes are wrong more often than those truncation would delete; a human check of the CHAIR evaluator's precision falls below our pre-set bar, which we report as a limitation.

AI.tldr: 该文质疑偏好训练降低物体幻觉(CHAIR分数)的实际构成：严格预注册分析显示，去除"少说话"带来的增益后，剩余增益的大部分可被一个在500张标注图上拟合的、冻结的11特征事后探针复现（8个公开方法中7/8在COCO、8/8在AMBER、6/8在Object HalBench达标，RLAIF-V例外）。
AI.motivation: 偏好训练（如DPO）被广泛用于降低VLM物体幻觉，且每个新方法都报告更低的CHAIR分数，但CHAIR下降究竟是"真正减少了错误描述"还是"说得更少/更短"或可被简单事后修正解释的部分，此前缺乏预注册的归因分析。
AI.method: 预注册分析流程（判据在输出产生前冻结）：1）将每个训练系统与"基座模型caption截断至同物体召回率"对照，剥离"说得少"带来的增益；2）剩余增益再与一个刻意设计的弱探针（冻结、11个特征、仅500张标注图拟合的事后探针）能复现的部分比较；覆盖LLaVA-1.5-7B上8个公开方法、SENTINEL（LLaVA-1.5与Qwen2.5-VL）、自训DPO检查点（Qwen2.5-VL、InternVL2.5，4种训练设计）；并在COCO/AMBER/Object HalBench上做等召回对比、实际句子删除实验、训练信号定价（探针标签、对象级CLIP标签、真值标签、长度匹配随机标签）及人评检查CHAIR评估器精度。
AI.result: 去除"少说话"部分后，探针可复现至少2/3的剩余训练增益：COCO 7/8、AMBER 8/8、Object HalBench 6/8，RLAIF-V为一致例外；SENTINEL在两个骨干上均达标。自训DPO在Qwen2.5-VL成立，但在InternVL2.5的COCO上4种设计中仅2种成立。等召回下，基座+探针优于截断：COCO 8/9、AMBER 9/9的LLaVA-1.5系统，且在两个新骨干与真实句子删除实现下均成立。训练信号定价：探针/CLIP标签的DPO可恢复真值标签DPO超简增益的0.70/0.87（Qwen2.5-VL；InternVL2.5探针0.73），均优于长度匹配随机标签，COCO上CLIP标签优于探针标签。人评显示探针删除的句子错误率高于截断删除；但CHAIR评估器精确率低于预设门槛，作为局限性报告。
AI.conclusion: 大量报告的幻觉抑制增益可归因于简短性与一个简单事后探针即可捕获的特征，提示现有基准对方法新颖性区分度不足。探针还可作为廉价标注/奖励信号替代昂贵人工或强模型标注。同时承认CHAIR评估器精度缺陷限制结论稳健性，呼吁更严格的幻觉评测协议。该工作属VLM评测方法论，与具身/3D核心方向不直接相关。

title: What Places an Action Boundary? Structure-Aware Attribution for Temporal Action Localization
summary: Temporal action localization (TAL) detectors must identify actions and estimate their temporal boundaries, but localization remains a major source of detection errors. While understanding what determines boundary placement requires faithful attribution of temporal evidence, existing attribution methods have not sufficiently addressed the temporal structure of TAL or the need to tailor attribution to boundary localization. We introduce a structure-aware attribution framework that averages contributions across random evidence-restoration orders following the Shapley-Shubik principle. We make it tractable by using the detector's receptive field to limit which time steps are ordered individually, and by approximating each order with a soft gradient path. For boundary predictions, we further introduce cell-structured restoration orders and boundary-anchored references that selectively remove adjacent evidence. We also adapt faithfulness evaluation to assess the joint effects of contiguous temporal evidence and the direction of boundary displacement. Experiments on THUMOS14 and EPIC-KITCHENS-100 with TriDet and ActionFormer demonstrate improved attribution faithfulness over existing methods. Attribution analysis and controlled interventions further reveal that class-score changes do not reliably track boundary displacement, providing input-level evidence that classification relies on content less informative about boundary placement. Code and evaluation artifacts will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出结构感知的时序证据归因框架，用于时序动作定位（TAL）边界定位的可解释性分析，在THUMOS14/EPIC-KITCHENS-100上提升归因忠实度，并揭示类别分数变化并不反映边界位移。
AI.motivation: TAL检测器需同时识别动作与估计时序边界，而定位是主要误差来源；理解"边界位置由何决定"需要对时序证据做忠实归因，但现有归因方法未考虑TAL的时序结构，也未针对边界定位需求进行定制。
AI.method: 基于Shapley-Shubik原理，在随机证据恢复顺序上平均贡献以获得结构感知归因；利用检测器感受野限制可单独排序的时间步以降低计算复杂度，并用软梯度路径近似每个顺序；针对边界预测引入单元化（cell-structured）恢复顺序与边界锚定的参照基线，选择性移除相邻证据；同时改造忠实度评估以衡量连续时序证据的联合效应与边界位移方向。
AI.result: 在THUMOS14与EPIC-KITCHENS-100上、使用TriDet与ActionFormer的实验中，归因忠实度优于现有方法；归因分析与受控干预显示类别分数变化与边界位移并不同步，说明分类依赖的信息对边界定位提示性较弱。
AI.conclusion: 为TAL提供了可行的结构感知归因方案，暴露了分类头与定位头证据基础不一致的问题，为后续边界感知设计提供输入层证据；代码与评估工件将公开。

title: SCCV-6D: Sparse Canonical Coordinate Voting for Holistic Multi-View RGB-D 6D Pose Estimation in Robotic Bin Picking
comment: to appear in Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV), 2027
summary: Industrial bin picking requires pose estimates that are accurate under clutter, partial occlusion, and the reflective, texture-less nature of manufactured parts. Most recent approaches to 6D pose estimation follow multi-stage pipelines. These achieve high accuracy, but incur memory and runtime footprints that do not cope with the operational constraints of many real-world industrial deployments. Holistic pipelines estimate poses in a single pass, with cost controlled through indiscriminate subsampling or lowered resolution. Continuing this line, we present SCCV-6D, a fully sparse multi-view RGB-D estimator. We reconstruct the 3D space at millimeter precision, prune background via a staged heatmap mechanism, and predict class, translation offset and rotation at highest resolution for an arbitrary number of objects simultaneously. Rotation is formulated as canonical coordinate voting. Points vote for their canonical object coordinates with an associated confidence, enabling closed-form pose recovery with a symmetry-aware weighted Procrustes solve. Along an in-cluster point recovery induced by offset votes, this removes time-consuming post-processing stages. We reuse the task-supervised attention priors from the heatmap formulation for a novel attention-gated distillation objective that reweights teacher-student feature alignment. On the IPD test split we report competitive 0.826 AP at 1.13 s per scene, significantly faster than the leading entries. On MV-YCB our approach reaches 96.1 ADD-S, and remains competitive even on the densely packed bins of ROBI.

AI.tldr: SCCV-6D：全稀疏多视角RGB-D单阶段6D位姿估计器，通过毫米级稀疏体素重建、分层热力图背景剪枝、canonical coordinate voting + 对称感知加权Procrustes闭式求解位姿，并用热力图注意力先验做注意力门控蒸馏。IPD 0.826 AP / 1.13 s每场景，MV-YCB 96.1 ADD-S。
AI.motivation: 工业料箱抓取需要在高杂乱、部分遮挡、反光且无纹理的零件上获得精确位姿；多阶段管线精度高但内存与时延开销大，难以满足工业部署约束；单阶段整体式方法虽省时，却靠 indiscriminate 下采样或降分辨率控制成本，牺牲精度。
AI.method: 全稀疏多视角RGB-D端到端估计：毫米级精度重建3D空间；用分层热力图机制剪除背景；在最高分辨率下同时预测类别、平移偏移与旋转（支持任意数量物体）。旋转表述为canonical coordinate voting：点以置信度投票到其规范化物体坐标，配合对称感知加权Procrustes求解实现闭式位姿恢复；结合偏移投票引导的簇内点恢复，避免耗时后处理。另将热力图的任务监督注意力先验复用为注意力门控蒸馏目标，对师生特征对齐重新加权。
AI.result: IPD测试集0.826 AP，每场景1.13 s，显著快于领先方法；MV-YCB达96.1 ADD-S；在ROBI密集堆叠料箱场景仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 将稀疏体素重建、热力图剪枝、坐标投票闭式求解与注意力门控蒸馏统一为单阶段管线，可在工业级时延约束下达到有竞争力的6D位姿精度，验证了"无后处理+全稀疏"路线的可行性。

title: Limits of local curvature for constructing search subspaces in segmentation models
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Includes an appendix
summary: We examine how well subspaces constructed from local curvature represent the change in the gradient update field after a finite step in semantic segmentation models. The local response is the action of the curvature operator on the actual input displacement. In a study of 50 images and two models, we measure the ratio of the loss increase attained in a fixed subspace to that attained in the full space. This ratio decreases as the search radius increases. On ten images from the same sample, we compare the one-dimensional subspace spanned by the initial gradient with two rank-16 subspaces for both models. The two equal-rank subspaces are assessed at the same initial states, using the same actual steps and measured vectors. Adding generalised Gauss-Newton directions to the initial gradient reduces the mean relative error in representing the field change from 0.922 to 0.874 for the first model and from 0.819 to 0.763 for the second. At the same rank, including the response direction for the initial gradient nearly eliminates the error in representing the local response. The mean error in representing the field change does not decrease. A decomposition with fixed pixel weights shows that the finite-step remainder is comparable in norm to the field change and makes the largest diagonal contribution to the squared projection error of the field after the step. Evaluation of a search subspace should measure how accurately it represents the field change and the local response.

AI.tldr: 该文研究语义分割模型中，由局部曲率构成的子空间对有限步后梯度更新场变化的表征能力，并提出应以"场变化表征精度"与"局部响应表征精度"双重指标评估搜索子空间。
AI.motivation: 现有对曲率子空间（如广义Gauss-Newton方向、K-FAC类低秩子空间）的评估多依赖损失下降比例等间接指标，缺乏对"子空间是否真实刻画有限步更新场变化"的直接度量，且易混淆"局部响应"与"场变化"两类不同目标。
AI.method: 在50张图像、两个语义分割模型上，测量固定子空间内损失增量与全空间损失增量之比随搜索半径的变化；在10张图像上，以相同初始状态、实际步长和测量向量，对比初始梯度的一维子空间与两个秩16子空间（加入广义Gauss-Newton方向），并用固定像素权重分解分析有限步余项。
AI.result: 损失增量比随搜索半径增大而下降。加入广义Gauss-Newton方向后，场变化平均相对误差模型一由0.922降至0.874，模型二由0.819降至0.763；而同秩下纳入初始梯度响应方向可将局部响应误差几乎消除，但场变化平均误差未下降。分解显示有限步余项范数与场变化同量级，且对步后场的平方投影误差贡献最大对角项。
AI.conclusion: 局部曲率子空间对"局部响应"的表征与对"有限步场变化"的表征是两类不同性质的问题，前者可近乎精确、后者存在不可约误差；评估优化搜索子空间应同时报告场变化表征精度与局部响应表征精度，而非仅依赖损失下降比。

title: Fusing Multimodal CNN Features with Structurally-Masked Transformers for Hierarchical Sub-Pixel Tree Species Mapping
summary: Precise forest species mapping using spaceborne hyperspectral data is challenging due to high spectral similarity and the inherent sub-pixel heterogeneity of natural forest stands. While traditional deep learning models exploit spatial context through convolutional architectures, these approaches can introduce noise in fragmented or mixed-species forests. In this paper, we propose a hierarchy-aware, multimodal deep learning framework to resolve sub-pixel forest composition by integrating PRISMA (PRecursore IperSpettrale della Missione Applicativa) hyperspectral imagery, high-resolution panchromatic data, and digital elevation models. The architecture features a multi-branch encoder combining an EfficientNetV2-based one-dimensional convolutional neural network (CNN) for spectral signatures and twin two-dimensional CNNs for spatial and topographic features, coupled with a novel structurally-masked Transformer. By using a binary transition tensor to condition the Transformer slot embeddings and constrain inference, the model enforces taxonomic consistency between broad forest categories and fine-grained species distributions. The framework is validated across three diverse Italian biogeographical regions (the Alps and the Central and Southern Apennines) using field-surveyed plots. The proposed method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multi-label and ranking-based paradigms, particularly in identifying subordinate species and their relative dominance. The bidirectional learning mechanism allows sub-pixel compositional features to refine macroscopic forest type predictions, while the integration of topographic priors effectively resolves spectral ambiguities in complex terrains. This knowledge-driven method supports regional-scale biodiversity monitoring and forest characterization within the evaluated PRISMA scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种层级感知的多模态深度学习框架，融合PRISMA高光谱影像、高分辨率全色数据与DEM，通过多分支编码器（EfficientNetV2 1D-CNN + 双2D-CNN + 结构掩码Transformer）实现亚像元森林树种组成制图。
AI.motivation: 星载高光谱森林树种精细制图受限于光谱高度相似与天然林分的亚像元异质性；传统CNN依赖空间上下文，在破碎或混交林区易引入噪声，需在"宏观森林类型"与"细粒度树种分布"之间建立分类学一致性约束。
AI.method: 多分支编码器：EfficientNetV2骨干的1D-CNN提取光谱特征，孪生2D-CNN分别处理空间与地形特征；引入结构掩码Transformer，用二值转移张量对Transformer槽位嵌入进行条件化并约束推理，从而强制宽泛森林类别与细粒度树种分布间的层级一致性；结合PRISMA高光谱、全色影像与DEM多模态输入，做多标签亚像元组成预测。在意大利三个生物地理区（阿尔卑斯、中部与南部亚平宁）的实测样地上验证。
AI.result: 在三个意大利生物地理区的地面实测样地上，方法稳定优于现有多标签与排序类先进模型，尤其在识别从属树种及其相对优势度上表现突出；双向学习机制使亚像元组成特征反哺宏观森林类型预测，地形先验有效缓解复杂地形下的光谱歧义。
AI.conclusion: 该知识驱动框架在评估的PRISMA场景下可用于区域尺度生物多样性监测与森林表征，说明层级约束+多模态先验是缓解高光谱亚像元混分问题的有效途径。

title: Rank2Replace: VLM-Ranked Slot Replacement for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
summary: Spurious correlations can give image predictors high in-distribution accuracy but poor generalization under distribution shift. We introduce $\textbf{Rank2Replace}$, which transfers knowledge of task-relevant evidence from pretrained vision--language models (VLMs) to small predictors through training-time augmentation for out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. The VLM ranks object-centric slots by task relevance and guides rank-dependent replacement with same-rank slot embeddings from another image. This augmentation retains the original image's label, encouraging reliance on preserved task evidence as incidental cues change, and supports combination with existing OOD methods. Across four datasets and six splits under shared frozen slot embeddings, the default cross-entropy configuration reaches macro-averaged average-group and worst-group accuracies of $80.43\%$ and $65.28\%$ without environment labels or dataset-specific replacement tuning. Slot corruption improves both macro-averaged metrics for all fourteen OOD training methods. Combining it with slot ranking and IRM reaches $81.96\%$ and $72.68\%$. Controlled ablations support the ranking and replacement design, with gains across five ranking VLMs and six extractor--predictor combinations. Permutation-invariant predictors further improve both macro-averaged metrics over their unaugmented counterparts while using VLM guidance only during training for efficient inference.

AI.tldr: 提出Rank2Replace：用预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）按任务相关性对图像中的object-centric slots排序，并在训练时用另一张图中同秩slot嵌入替换低相关slot，实现OOD泛化知识迁移。
AI.motivation: 图像预测器易学得虚假相关（spurious correlation），在分布偏移下泛化差；目标是借助VLM的"任务相关证据"知识，通过数据增强让小模型学到更鲁棒的特征。
AI.method: 冻结slot提取器与统一slot嵌入空间；VLM对slots按任务相关性排序，按秩进行跨图替换（保留原标签），使非本质线索变化而保留任务证据；可与IRM等现有OOD方法组合，且VLM指导仅在训练期使用，推理高效，并支持置换不变预测器。无环境标签、无需按数据集调替换超参。
AI.result: 四个数据集六个划分上，默认交叉熵配置达macro平均组准确率80.43%、最差组65.28%；slot corruption使14种OOD训练方法的两项指标全部提升；slot排序+IRM达81.96%/72.68%；消融验证排序与替换设计有效，在5个排序VLM、6种extractor–predictor组合上均有增益。
AI.conclusion: VLM引导的秩相关slot替换是一种通用、轻量、可直接插入现有OOD流程的训练期增强，显著提升最差组鲁棒性；但属一般图像分类OOD鲁棒性方法，未涉及机器人/具身或3D/生成任务验证。

title: ContextRenderer: Dynamic-Context Video Generation for Interactive Game Worlds
summary: Interactive game world models separate executable world evolution from visual generation, using video models to render engine-provided scene representations into detailed observations. During sustained gameplay, however, existing generative renderers struggle to follow changing conditions while preserving visual continuity across diverse proxies and target styles. We therefore introduce ContextRenderer, an autoregressive video diffusion framework designed for both dynamic conditioning and cross-proxy generalization. It couples Dynamic-Context Learning (DCL) for chunk-level interaction supervision with Recurrent History Compression (RHC) to follow condition updates while preserving visual continuity within a bounded token budget. Across proxy representations, Cross-Representation Flow Alignment (CRFA) connects proxy reconstruction with appearance and interaction variation through a shared high-fidelity reconstruction. WorldPrism, our interaction-centric dataset constructed from agent-built worlds, AAA gameplay, and open-source videos, supplies the corresponding renderings and chunk-level annotations for these learning tasks. Experiments on GWM-Bench and Solar-Bench show improved reconstruction and visual quality, while qualitative results demonstrate minute-long interactive rendering under changing prompts and subject references. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: ContextRenderer：面向交互式游戏世界模型的自回归视频扩散渲染器，通过动态上下文学习(DCL)、循环历史压缩(RHC)与跨表征流对齐(CRFA)实现多代理表征、变化条件下的长时视觉连续渲染，并构建WorldPrism数据集。
AI.motivation: 交互式游戏世界模型将"可执行世界演化"与"视觉生成"解耦：引擎输出场景代理(proxy)表征，视频模型负责渲染成观测。但现有生成式渲染器在持续游戏过程中难以同时满足两点——跟随不断变化的交互条件，以及在多样代理表征与目标风格间保持视觉连续性。
AI.method: 提出ContextRenderer自回归视频扩散框架：1) 动态上下文学习(DCL)，以chunk级交互监督对齐条件更新；2) 循环历史压缩(RHC)，在受限token预算内压缩历史以兼顾条件跟随与视觉连续性；3) 跨表征流对齐(CRFA)，借助共享高保真重建将代理重建与外观、交互变化关联；4) 构建WorldPrism数据集，来自智能体搭建世界、3A游戏与开源视频，提供渲染结果及chunk级标注。
AI.result: 在GWM-Bench与Solar-Bench上重建质量与视觉质量均有提升；定性结果显示在提示词与主体参考持续变化下可实现分钟级交互渲染。
AI.conclusion: 将引擎世界演化与视觉渲染解耦、并以动态条件+历史压缩+跨表征对齐的扩散渲染方案，可支撑长时间交互式游戏渲染；配套数据集为该任务提供训练与评测基础。

title: Harnessing Medical Visual-Language Models with Agentic Evidence Management
comment: 22 pages, 3 figures. Qiming Huang, Hanze Dong, and Jipeng Zhang contributed equally
summary: Medical vision-language agents increasingly rely on segmentation tools, and recent work has focused on acquiring the right mask, often treating a good mask as the end point of tool use. But do these agents use the resulting evidence effectively? To answer this question, we need a benchmark that separates evidence use from segmentation quality, spans multiple medical image types, and allows the same mask to be presented in different ways. Existing medical VQA datasets do not jointly provide these properties. We therefore construct Mask-Evidence MedVQA, a 2.5K-example benchmark spanning four image types, where each question is paired with an answer-relevant ground-truth mask and multiple possible renderings. Our study reveals two limitations of direct tool use. First, evidence presentation matters. Different renderings of the same fixed mask can substantially change model behavior. Second, masks introduce an evidence trade-off. Highlighting a relevant region can expose diagnostic evidence the model previously missed, but the added visual cue can also induce incorrect associations. As a result, even a ground-truth mask can correct some answers while turning initially correct ones into incorrect ones. Together, these findings show that acquiring the right mask is not enough. An agent must also decide how to present the evidence and whether it should change the answer. We therefore introduce TUNE (Tool Use is Not Enough), an evidence-management harness that explicitly manages what evidence to acquire, how to present it, and whether to accept the resulting answer update. Across three public medical VQA benchmarks, evidence management improves the fine-tuned Qwen3.5-9B backbone's mean accuracy by 4.0 percentage points. Full TUNE improves over direct tool use by 9.1 points on average across seven benchmarks and achieves competitive results against existing medical VLMs and agents.

AI.tldr: 该文指出医学视觉语言智能体“拿到正确掩码”并非终点，构建了包含2.5K样本、四种影像类型、同一真值掩码多种渲染方式的 Mask-Evidence MedVQA 基准，并揭示证据呈现方式与证据权衡两大问题，进而提出 TUNE 证据管理框架。
AI.motivation: 现有医学VQA数据集无法同时满足三点：将“证据使用能力”与“分割质量”解耦、覆盖多种医学影像类型、支持同一掩码的多种呈现形式。因此无法回答“智能体是否有效利用了工具产出的掩码证据”这一问题。
AI.method: 构建 Mask-Evidence MedVQA 基准（2.5K 例、四类影像、每题配对答案相关的真值掩码及多种渲染）；在受控条件下分析直接使用工具的表现；提出 TUNE（Tool Use is Not Enough）证据管理框架，显式决定获取何种证据、如何呈现证据、以及是否接受由此产生的答案更新。
AI.result: 同一固定掩码的不同渲染会显著改变模型行为；真值掩码既能纠正本已错误的回答，也会把原本正确的回答变为错误，呈现“证据权衡”。在三个公开医学VQA基准上，证据管理使微调的 Qwen3.5-9B 平均准确率提升4.0个百分点；完整 TUNE 在七个基准上平均优于直接工具使用9.1个百分点，并与现有医学VLM和智能体结果相当。
AI.conclusion: 获取正确的掩码只是必要非充分条件；智能体还须决定证据呈现方式以及是否据此修改答案。证据管理是提升医学多模态智能体工具使用效能的关键环节。

title: TrajCal: Trajectory-Calibrated Time Schedules for Few-Step Flow Sampling
summary: Flow matching enables high-quality image and video generation, but its iterative sampling process requires repeated evaluations of large neural networks. Existing few-step methods can distort the output and reduce its agreement with a many-step reference. We propose TrajCal, a training-free calibration framework for few-step sampling. Based on scatter search, a well-established metaheuristic for difficult optimization problems, TrajCal starts with diverse seed schedules, deforms and combines these candidates, and selects one fixed schedule by final output fidelity for reuse on new inputs. For both image and video generation, TrajCal achieves higher reference fidelity than all compared baselines at low evaluation budgets while maintaining competitive visual quality. The search is effective even with randomly generated seeds, while trajectory-based seeds further improve fidelity. For cross-style generalization, photography-calibrated schedules also improve fidelity on unseen image styles.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练轨迹校准框架TrajCal，用散点搜索在少步采样轨迹空间中搜索固定调度，提升图像/视频生成对多步参考的保真度。
AI.motivation: Flow matching生成质量高但迭代采样需反复调用大网络；现有多步蒸馏/少步方法易导致输出失真、与多步参考一致性下降。
AI.method: 训练无关的少步采样校准框架：以散点搜索（scatter search）元启发式为优化器，从多样化种子调度出发，对候选做变形与组合（交叉/路径重连），按最终输出的参考保真度选出一个固定调度并复用于新输入；支持基于随机种子与基于已有轨迹的种子。
AI.result: 在图像与视频生成任务上，低评估预算下参考保真度优于所有对比基线，视觉质量具竞争力；随机种子即可奏效，轨迹种子进一步提升；摄影域校准的调度可跨风格泛化到未见图像风格。
AI.conclusion: 将少步采样调度设计视为可搜索的离散优化问题，可训练无关地缩小与多步参考的差距，并具备一定跨域迁移性。

title: Interpretable Prototype-Conditioned Adaptation for Weather Forecasting
comment: 38 pages, including supplementary material. Project page: this https URL
summary: Data-driven weather forecasting requires distinguishing local states and their temporal evolution. However, learned patterns remain implicit in neural forecasters, making their influence difficult to interpret. Failing to distinguish local evolution can lead to similar forecasts for locations that develop differently, increasing prediction error. This motivates explicit references for distinguishing and interpreting local patterns. Prototypes provide explicit pattern references, but sample- or task-level conditioning leaves open how to adapt to distinct locations and variable groups. To deal with this problem, we design ProtoCast, which uses group-specific prototype banks to adapt local features while accounting for cross-variable dependencies. Specifically, (1) we combine each group's historical features and temporal change with forecast context from cross-variable attention for evolution-aware prototype matching. (2) Sparse mixtures of prototype-specific low-rank operators tailor corrections to each group and location. A gated attention block then exchanges the corrected features across groups before prediction. Each group's correction decomposes into explicit prototype contributions before this fusion. (3) We jointly train the forecasting network and operators from scratch and refit each group's prototypes before every training epoch. Slot tracking preserves prototype-operator associations, making each prototype's contribution to local corrections more interpretable. Experiments on GlobalForecast and TyphoonTracking show improved forecasting accuracy, while prototype deletion links local feature contributions to changes in prediction error. This work advances the development of more accurate and interpretable data-driven weather forecasting models. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: ProtoCast 用分组原型库为神经天气预报器提供显式的局部模式参照，结合跨变量注意力与稀疏低秩算子实现可解释的局部修正。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动天气预报中，神经网络的局部演变模式是隐含的，同类预报难以区分随时间演化差异明显的地点，导致误差上升；现有原型方法多为样本级或任务级条件化，无法适配具体位置与变量组。
AI.method: 设计分组专属原型库：将各组历史特征、时间变化与跨变量注意力得到的预报上下文结合，做演变感知的原型匹配；用稀疏混合的原型专属低秩算子对各组/各位置做定制修正，门控注意力块在预测前跨组交换特征；每个训练 epoch 前重拟合各组原型，联合从头训练预报网络与算子，并用槽位追踪维持原型—算子关联。
AI.result: 在 GlobalForecast 与 TyphoonTracking 上预报精度提升；原型删除实验将局部特征贡献与预测误差变化建立联系，验证可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 原型条件化的显式局部参照可在提升精度的同时提供可追溯的特征归因，为可解释的数据驱动天气预报提供可行路径。

title: EgoWitness: Benchmarking Instance-Level Spatial Memory and Reasoning in Egocentric Video Streams
comment: 43 pages, including supplementary material. Zhengru Fang and Zehao Liu contributed equally. Project page: this https URL ; Code: this https URL
summary: Recalling where and when an object was last seen and who saw it requires recognizing it across days and people. Existing long-video benchmarks focus on events, object categories, or relative locations, leaving instance-level spatial memory largely untested in multimodal models. To address this gap, we present EgoWitness, a benchmark for instance-level spatial memory and reasoning in egocentric video. Its 8,453 human-verified questions span approximately 324 hours of week-long and short-horizon recordings and test seven abilities, from recognizing an object or room to recalling who saw it and reasoning about room visits. Over one million reviewed masks of 34 registered landmarks and 21 movable-object labels are linked through room timelines. Among twelve direct vision-language models (VLMs), open-weight models reach at most 46.97% accuracy, and none exceeds 35% on identifying who saw an object last. We therefore propose EgoClue, a spatial-memory agent that retrieves candidate intervals, verifies instance identity, and computes spatial and temporal relations with five tools. Two-stage training with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) raises its 4B controller from 23.64% to 72.65% accuracy on 1,320 held-out questions. Evidence-trace synthesis matches the best direct VLM at 74.85% on week-long questions and achieves 80.56% in environments excluded from training.

AI.tldr: EgoWitness：面向第一人称长视频的实例级空间记忆基准（324小时、8453个人工核验问题、7项能力、百万级掩码与房间时间线）；十二个直读VLM最高仅46.97%，并据此提出EgoClue空间记忆智能体（五工具检索-校验-关系计算，SFT+GRPO两阶段训练），4B控制器从23.64%升至72.65%，证据链合成在周级问题上达74.85%。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频基准只考察事件、物体类别或相对位置，缺少对"对象上次出现在何时何地、谁看到"这类实例级空间记忆的评测；多模态模型在该能力上基本未被测量。
AI.method: 构建EgoWitness基准：34个注册地标与21类可移动物体的逾百万条审校掩码，经房间时间线关联；8453问覆盖约324小时周级与短时程录制，测7类能力。方法侧提出EgoClue智能体：先检索候选时间区间，再校验实例身份，最后用五个工具计算时空关系；训练为SFT+GRPO两阶段。
AI.result: 十二个直读VLM中开源权重模型最高46.97%，"谁最后看到该物体"子任务无人超过35%；EgoClue的4B控制器由23.64%提升至72.65%（1320道留出题），证据链合成在周级问题上74.85%、训练环境外达80.56%。
AI.conclusion: 实例级空间记忆是当前VLM的显著短板，而"检索候选—实例校验—工具化时空推理"的智能体流程配合强化学习可大幅弥补；基准与证据链机制为长时程具身记忆研究提供可复用范式。

title: Learning-Based System Identification for DVL-Constrained AUV Localization
summary: Nowadays, most AUVs utilize Doppler velocity logs (DVLs) and inertial measurement units (IMUs) to achieve satisfactory dead-reckoning results. However, the DVL bottom lock may not be available in some scenarios, such as moving over a soft bottom or traveling further away from the seafloor beyond the DVL's range. As a result, the localization system solely reliant on the IMU data will experience significant drift. The relatively high cost of DVLs also inhibits multirobot or swarm operations. In this article, we present the results of using fully connected feedforward neural networks to predict vehicle velocity (surge, sway, and heave) for AUV localization. Approximation functions for the vehicle velocities are derived based on the generalized six degree-of-freedom dynamic equation and kinematics, proving that they are suitable for feedforward neural networks with measurable inputs. The neural networks are trained using field data collected using an AUV. An ablation study was conducted to investigate the impacts of hyperparameters, and the most effective models were selected using the Akaike information criterion. The selected neural network models are tested on three new sets of mission data collected on two different days. The quantitative results show that localization using vehicle velocities predicted by neural networks yields lower averaged root-mean-square distance errors and standard deviation compared to the DVL-aided dead-reckoning method. However, the extent of this improvement was found to depend on ocean current conditions. The promising results show that lightweight fully connected feedforward neural networks offer an attractive approach for inertial-based underwater localization when DVLs or their measurements are not available.

AI.tldr: 用全连接前馈神经网络从IMU等可测输入预测AUV三轴速度（surge/sway/heave），替代DVL辅助航位推算，实现惯导水下定位。
AI.motivation: DVL底锁在软底质或超出量程场景失效，纯IMU定位漂移严重；且DVL成本高，限制多机器人/集群应用。
AI.method: 基于六自由度动力学方程与运动学推导速度近似函数，论证其适于以可测量为输入的前馈网络；用实测AUV数据训练FC网络；做超参数消融并以AIC选模；在两天三组新任务数据上验证。
AI.result: 神经网络预测速度的定位平均RMSE与标准差均低于DVL辅助航位推算；提升幅度依赖海流条件。
AI.conclusion: 轻量全连接前馈网络可作为无DVL时惯性水下定位的可行方案。

title: Thinking in Streams: Proactive Spatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models
summary: Recognizing when a requested spatial condition holds in streaming video can require maintaining and updating spatial knowledge across changing viewpoints. We study this capability through proactive spatial reasoning, where a model receives a query in advance and determines whether and when to respond as the stream unfolds. We introduce ProSpace-Bench, comprising nine tasks across object, camera, and scene reasoning, and ProSpace-Train for supervised training. To support spatial decisions, we propose ProSpace-VLM, which injects explicit geometric encodings estimated causally from incoming frames into intermediate VLM layers, using the existing KV cache as spatial memory and spatial token selection for efficient streaming. Experiments reveal a substantial gap between VLMs and humans, while ProSpace-VLM improves timely responses and correct abstention over fine-tuned baselines. Analyses examine how ProSpace-VLM represents previously observed spatial information across changing viewpoints.

AI.tldr: 提出ProSpace-Bench（9个任务，覆盖物体/相机/场景推理）与ProSpace-Train，并设计ProSpace-VLM：将因果估计的显式几何编码注入VLM中间层，以KV cache作为空间记忆、用空间token选择实现高效流式推理，做主动式空间判断（是否/何时响应）。
AI.motivation: 流式视频中判断空间条件是否成立，需要跨视角变化维护和更新空间知识；现有VLM缺乏这种随流演化的主动空间推理能力。
AI.method: 构建ProSpace-Bench（9任务：物体、相机、场景三类）与ProSpace-Train监督数据；ProSpace-VLM从实时帧因果估计几何编码并注入VLM中间层，复用KV cache作空间记忆，采用空间token选择降低流式开销实现主动响应/弃答。
AI.result: VLM与人类存在显著差距；ProSpace-VLM在及时响应与正确弃答上优于微调基线，并分析其跨视角表征历史空间信息的方式。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何注入+KV cache空间记忆是提升流式视频主动空间推理的可行路径，但整体能力仍远低于人类。

title: From Sequence to Space: Explicit Spatial Belief with Vision-Language Distillation for Active Geo-Localization
summary: Active geo-localization (AGL) asks an agent to navigate a small aerial search grid and reach a target specified by an aerial image, a ground-level photograph, or text. Existing methods align the goal modalities well, but they keep the navigation state inside a large sequential Transformer and train with a dense distance reward that uses the hidden goal location. This paper proposes EAGLE, an Explicit spatial-belief Agent for Geo-Localization and Exploration. Offline training jointly optimizes a teacher-conditioned Swin branch and a context-free Swin student from the same randomly masked partial mosaics. The teacher branch attends to frozen full-scene context extracted by Qwen2.5-VL-7B, both branches receive masked-cell aerial-feature reconstruction and uncertainty supervision, while the student additionally distills stop-gradient feature predictions from the teacher. After distillation, Qwen, its cached context, and the teacher-attention branch are discarded. The retained student predicts cell-level aerial-feature embeddings and predictive uncertainty from partial observations alone. These predictions are combined with the modality-aligned goal embedding and a trajectory-derived visitation mask to construct the spatial belief tensor. The student is then frozen while a compact CNN actor-critic is optimized with PPO. EAGLE achieves state-of-the-art average success rates of 78.1%, 76.4%, and 76.8% on MASA, xBD zero-shot transfer, and the MM-GAG zero-shot aerial-goal split, respectively, without using a VLM or cached visual tokens at inference. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: EAGLE：用显式空间信念张量替代大型序列Transformer做主动地理定位，离线蒸馏后仅保留学生分支，推理时无VLM。
AI.motivation: 现有主动地理定位(AGL)方法把导航状态塞进大型序列Transformer，并用含隐藏目标位置的稠密距离奖励训练，效率低且依赖特权信息。
AI.method: 离线训练中，从同一随机掩码的部分马赛克图同时优化教师条件Swin分支与无上下文Swin学生；教师分支关注Qwen2.5-VL-7B提取的冻结全场景上下文；两分支做掩码格点航拍特征重建与不确定性监督，学生额外蒸馏教师的stop-gradient特征预测。蒸馏后丢弃Qwen、缓存上下文与教师分支。学生从部分观测预测格点级航拍特征嵌入与预测不确定性，与模态对齐目标嵌入、轨迹导出的访问掩码组合成空间信念张量；冻结学生后用PPO训练紧凑CNN actor-critic。
AI.result: 在MASA、xBD零样本迁移、MM-GAG零样本航拍目标划分上平均成功率分别达78.1%、76.4%、76.8%，均为主流最优，且推理时不用VLM或缓存视觉token。
AI.conclusion: 将特权VLM上下文离线蒸馏为轻量显式空间信念表征，可实现高效、可泛化的主动地理定位，代码将开源。

title: WHU-Road3D: A dataset and benchmark towards fine-grained road surface mapping
summary: Accurately extracting and mapping road surface elements is crucial for applications such as high-definition maps, road asset management, and intelligent transportation systems. This study first provides a comprehensive review of the benchmark datasets for extracting and mapping road elements, encompassing overhead-to-perspective data, large-to-local scales, and coarse-to-fine details. Subsequently, we thoroughly review the relevant approaches for extracting road surface elements. However, we argue that existing datasets still require enhancements in semantic richness, data modality diversity, and scenario complexity. To bridge these gaps, this paper presents WHU-Road3D, a large-scale multimodal dataset for fine-grained road surface mapping to address these shortcomings. WHU-Road3D provides approximately 100 km of diverse Chinese highways and urban streets. It features a rich combination of MLS point clouds, associated panoramic images, vehicle trajectories, detailed vectorized annotations, and pointwise instance annotations for road surface elements. The dataset carefully annotates 15 distinct categories of road elements, including common markings like road boundaries, zebra crossings, lane dividers, stop lines, as well as 10 types of direction symbols. To our knowledge, WHU-Road3D stands as the first multimodal dataset for mapping such a comprehensive range of road surface elements, designed to facilitate cutting-edge research in instance segmentation, full-element extraction and mapping on road surfaces. Beyond these immediate applications, WHU-Road3D also provides a valuable source for hierarchical road topology reasoning, map updating, and street scene generation. The dataset, along with the code for our benchmark methods, will be made publicly available at \href{ this https URL }{ this https URL }.

AI.tldr: 提出WHU-Road3D大规模多模态路面要素建图数据集，含约100km中国公路与城市道路的MLS点云、全景影像、轨迹、矢量化与逐点实例标注，覆盖15类路面要素，并综述现有数据集与方法。
AI.motivation: 现有路面要素提取与建图数据集在语义丰富度、数据模态多样性和场景复杂度上不足，制约高清地图、道路资产管理与智能交通等应用研究。
AI.method: 先系统综述从俯视到透视、从大范围到局部、从粗到细的路面要素数据集与提取方法；再构建WHU-Road3D：多模态（MLS点云+全景图像+车辆轨迹）、多层次标注（矢量化标注+逐点实例标注），并把10类方向符号与其他常见标线要素统一纳入15类体系。
AI.result: 数据集覆盖约100 km真实道路，含15类路面要素（道路边界、斑马线、车道分隔线、停止线及10类方向符号），为首个面向如此全面路面要素建图的多模态数据集，并提供基准方法代码。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集服务于路面实例分割、全要素提取与建图，并可支撑分层道路拓扑推理、地图更新与街景生成等下游任务；数据与代码将公开。

title: EvoMem: Self-Evolving Skills for Time-Aware Long Video Memory Agents
summary: Although memory-augmented architectures have expanded the ability of large vision-language models (LVLMs) to process long videos, existing retrieval processes still largely rely on global semantic matching and lack state-driven temporal control, often returning fragmented or redundant evidence and failing to maintain a coherent evidence chain. To address this challenge, we propose EvoMem, a time-aware long-video memory agent guided by self-evolving retrieval skills. EvoMem constructs a hierarchical time-indexed memory, where different types of evidence are aligned onto a unified video timeline; during retrieval, temporal cues from acquired evidence are further converted into explicit signals that constrain subsequent memory access. To address recurring procedural errors in long-video question answering, such as unclear retrieval targets, improper memory access paths, or premature stopping, EvoMem introduces retrieval skills to provide process-level guidance, enabling the agent to dynamically adjust retrieval content, memory operations, and target temporal ranges according to the current evidence state, while deciding when to stop. Furthermore, inspired by reinforcement learning, we formulate skill evolution as a reward-guided policy improvement process. Each candidate skill is treated as an external policy patch, and rewards are assigned according to answer-correctness state transitions on the validation set. In this way, effective skills are accepted and low-quality skills are rejected without updating model parameters. Experiments on four long-video question answering benchmarks show that EvoMem significantly outperforms existing baselines, achieving an average accuracy of 60.1% and an average improvement of 8.6 percentage points over the previous best methods, demonstrating its effectiveness for long-video reasoning.

AI.tldr: EvoMem：以自演化检索技能引导的时间感知长视频记忆智能体，构建层级时间索引记忆并将时间线索转化为约束后续访问的显式信号，通过奖励引导的技能演化（外部策略补丁，不更新模型参数）提升长视频问答准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM长视频记忆增强架构的检索仍依赖全局语义匹配，缺乏状态驱动的时间控制，容易返回碎片化或冗余证据，难以维持连贯的证据链；长视频问答中还存在检索目标不清、记忆访问路径不当、过早停止等过程性错误。
AI.method: 1) 层级时间索引记忆：将不同类型证据对齐到统一视频时间线；2) 检索时把已获证据的时间线索转为显式信号，约束后续记忆访问；3) 引入检索技能提供过程级指导，使智能体按当前证据状态动态调整检索内容、记忆操作与目标时间范围，并决定停止时机；4) 将技能演化形式化为奖励引导的策略改进：候选技能作为外部策略补丁，依据验证集上答案正确性的状态转移分配奖励，接受优质技能、拒绝低质技能，全程不更新模型参数。
AI.result: 在四个长视频问答基准上显著优于现有基线，平均准确率60.1%，较此前最佳方法平均提升8.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 时间感知记忆结构结合自演化检索技能，可有效缓解长视频检索碎片化与过程性错误，在不训练模型参数的前提下提升长视频推理表现；但方法属视频QA智能体范畴，与具身/3D重建主线关联有限。

title: Does It Depend on the Split? Frozen Satellite Features vs. Fine-Tuned CNNs for Tree Species Mapping
summary: Self-supervised foundation models are often said to need fewer labels than supervised training. We test this on a forestry task: classifying 20 tree species classes in 0.2 m aerial images from the TreeSatAI dataset. We compare a frozen DINOv3 model pretrained on 493 million satellite images, with only a linear classifier trained on top, against an ImageNet ResNet-50 that is fine-tuned end to end. On the official split, fine-tuning wins clearly (macro F1 0.764 vs. 0.685). However, 28.8% of the official test patches overlap a training or validation patch, and copying the label of the nearest such patch is correct for 83.6% of them. We therefore build a spatial split that holds out whole 2 km squares with a 200 m buffer. On this split the comparison becomes inconclusive (0.648 vs. 0.640, paired 95% CI of the difference [-0.054, 0.016]), and the learning curves of the two models overlap at every label budget from 343 to 33,126 training patches. On the five rarest classes, the frozen model achieves a higher mean F1 (0.566 vs. 0.445), although the confidence interval for this difference includes zero ([-0.05, 0.23]). Diagnostics show that the frozen features mainly miss differences between closely related species, such as the two native oaks. Choosing the input size and layer on validation data (224 px, block 16) raises the frozen model to 0.662 on the spatial split. A comparison that looks decisive on the official split is thus inconclusive under geographically separated evaluation. We release the spatial split and our code.

AI.tldr: 在TreeSatAI 20类树种分类任务上，作者发现官方数据划分存在严重的空间泄漏（28.8%测试块与训练/验证块重叠，最近邻复制标签准确率83.6%），改用2 km网格留出+200 m缓冲的空间划分后，冻结DINOv3线性探测与端到端微调ResNet-50的差异不再显著（0.648 vs 0.640，CI含0），学习曲线全程重叠。
AI.motivation: 自监督基础模型"比监督训练需要更少标签"是广泛引用的论断，但该结论常在存在空间泄漏的遥感划分上被验证，缺乏地理分离条件下的可靠证据；作者要检验这一论断在细粒度树种分类任务上是否成立。
AI.method: 0.2 m航拍影像、TreeSatAI 20类树种；对比冻结DINOv3（4.93亿卫星影像预训练）+线性分类器与ImageNet ResNet-50端到端微调。先复现官方split，再做空间泄漏诊断（最近邻patch标签复制准确率）；构造留出整块2 km方格加200 m缓冲的空间split；在343至33,126个训练patch的多个标签预算下比较学习曲线，配对bootstrap 95% CI；对5个最稀有类单独统计；在验证集上选择输入尺寸与ViT层（224 px、block 16）。
AI.result: 官方split上微调明显领先（macro F1 0.764 vs 0.685）；空间split上差异不显著（0.648 vs 0.640，差值95% CI [-0.054, 0.016]），各标签预算下学习曲线重叠；5个稀有类冻结模型均值更高（0.566 vs 0.445）但CI含0（[-0.05, 0.23]）；诊断显示冻结特征主要缺失近缘种区分能力（如两种本土栎）；调优输入尺寸/层后冻结模型升至0.662。
AI.conclusion: 在地理分离的评估下，官方split上看似决定性的结论变为不确定；遥感基础模型的标签效率优势需要排除空间泄漏后才能确认。作者开源空间split与代码。该工作为领域CV的评测方法论贡献，对具身/3D核心方向无直接方法洞察。

title: Multiple-Camera Tracking of Rigid Objects
summary: In this paper we describe a method for tracking rigid objects using one or several cameras. The tracking process consists of aligning a 3-D model representation of an object with image contours by measuring and minimizing the image error between predicted model points and image contours. The tracker behaves like a visual servo loop where the internal and external camera parameters are updated at each new image acquisition. We study in detail the Jacobian matrix associated with this minimization process in the presence of both point-to-point and point-to-contour matches. We establish the minimal number of matches that are needed as well as the singular configurations leading to a rank-defficient Jacobian matrix. We find a mathematical link between the point-to-point and point-to-contour cases. Based on this link we show that the latter has the same kind of singularities than the former. Moreover, we study multiple camera configurations which optimize the robustness of the method in the presence of single-camera singularities, bad, noisy, or missing data. Extensive experiments done with a complex ship part and with up to three cameras validate the method. In particular we show that the tracker may well be used as a camera calibration procedure.

AI.tldr: 提出基于3D模型与图像轮廓配准的单/多相机刚体跟踪方法，通过最小化预测模型点与图像轮廓的误差实现视觉伺服式跟踪，并系统分析雅可比矩阵的最小匹配数与奇异构型，给出点到点与点到轮廓两种情形的数学联系，进而用多相机布局提升鲁棒性，实验验证其可兼作相机标定。
AI.motivation: 单相机下基于轮廓的模型跟踪在少数匹配或退化几何下会出现雅可比秩亏，导致跟踪失效；作者希望从理论上刻画所需最少匹配数与奇异构型，并找出点到点与点到轮廓两类匹配的内在联系，从而为多相机配置设计提供依据，提升对噪声、缺失数据和单相机奇异的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 以3D刚体模型在图像上的投影点为预测，与检测到的图像轮廓进行匹配；构造并最小化预测模型点与图像轮廓之间的图像误差，将跟踪形式化为视觉伺服闭环，在每帧更新相机内参与外参。对最小化过程的雅可比矩阵进行解析研究，分别针对点到点匹配和点到轮廓（点到切线/法向距离）匹配推导最小匹配数条件并识别导致秩亏的奇异位形；通过数学推导建立两类匹配之间的等价/映射关系，并据此设计优化鲁棒性的多相机配置以规避单相机奇异、噪声与缺失数据。使用复杂船体零件与最多三台相机进行实验验证。
AI.result: 理论方面给出所需最少匹配数量与秩亏奇异构型的刻画，并证明点到轮廓情形与点到点情形具有同类型奇异；多相机配置在单相机奇异、含噪或数据缺失时显著提升鲁棒性。实验在复杂船体零件上以最多三台相机验证方法有效性，并表明该跟踪器可作为相机标定流程使用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将基于轮廓的模型跟踪置于严谨的雅可比秩分析框架下，阐明点到点与点到轮廓匹配的奇异结构一致性，并提供多相机配置设计原则；方法兼具鲁棒跟踪与相机标定能力，但属于经典模型基几何跟踪范式，面向动态/接触场景与数据驱动泛化能力有限。

title: SpatialMem: Building Quantitative Spatial Reasoning Agents with Hierarchical Memory
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities in qualitative spatial reasoning, but remain limited in quantitative spatial reasoning. Current work leverages the VLM agent to invoke external vision tools to perform computation. However, these methods usually bind each functional requirement to a single predefined vision specialist, implicitly resulting in fixed and rigid tool pipelines. In practice, addressing diverse spatial scenarios and tasks demands a broader diversity in pipeline orchestration and vision specialist selection to achieve robust spatial reasoning. However, such diversity leads to a combinatorial execution space, making it challenging for the agent to orchestrate the optimal pipelines and specialists for different scenarios. In this work, we propose SpatialMem, a memory framework that enables a VLM agent to accumulate tool-use experience and leverage that memory to orchestrate vision specialists to solve the spatial reasoning problem. SpatialMem builds a two-level memory structure, with task memory capturing tool orchestration and scene memory capturing tool selection. It further introduces a dual-state trajectory optimization process to preserve successful tool experiences and refine suboptimal ones. Moreover, existing spatial reasoning benchmarks suffer from quality issues and limited coverage of scene types and tasks. To address these gap, we propose MetricBench, a benchmark covering both indoor and outdoor scenes and three quantitative spatial reasoning tasks. Our method achieves state-of-the-art results on MetricBench, Q-Spatial, and SpatilRGPT-Bench, outperforming best VLM baselines by 32% on MetricBench. Additionally, the memory design yields a 9.1% absolute gain over a memory-free agent on MetricBench.

AI.tldr: SpatialMem：用双层记忆（任务记忆=工具编排，场景记忆=专家选择）+ 双状态轨迹优化，让VLM智能体积累工具使用经验以完成定量空间推理；并提出MetricBench基准。
AI.motivation: VLM在定量空间推理上较弱，现有做法将每项功能需求绑定到单一预定义视觉专家，导致工具流水线僵化；而扩大流水线与专家选择的多样性又会带来组合爆炸，智能体难以针对不同场景选出最优方案。此外现有空间推理基准存在质量与覆盖不足。
AI.method: 构建双层记忆结构：任务记忆记录工具编排（pipeline），场景记忆记录工具/专家选择；引入双状态轨迹优化过程，保留成功的工具经验并修正次优轨迹；另提出MetricBench，涵盖室内外场景与三类定量空间推理任务。
AI.result: 在MetricBench、Q-Spatial、SpatialRGPT-Bench上取得SOTA，MetricBench上较最佳VLM基线提升32%；记忆设计相对无记忆智能体带来9.1%绝对提升。
AI.conclusion: 以记忆驱动的智能体工具编排是提升VLM定量空间推理的有效路径，且记忆带来的经验复用显著优于无记忆流水线；配套基准填补了场景覆盖与质量的空白。

title: Fast-JEPA: Advancing the Success-Latency Frontier for Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models predict the outcomes of action sequences, but comparing candidate plans through recursive rollout remains expensive at test time. We introduce Fast-JEPA, a latent world model planning framework that advances the success-latency Pareto frontier of predictive search. Fast-JEPA reorganizes predictive computation to support effective action-sequence search at low planning cost. It constructs a goal-directed plan to guide search and directly predicts the outcomes of complete candidates for efficient comparison, avoiding recursive state rollout during refinement. Across PushT, Reacher, Cube, and TwoRoom, Fast-JEPA achieves 96.50% average success rate with 2.41x faster planning than INTACT. Search-budget sweeps show that its competitive success and low latency extend across candidate counts and refinement depths. We further introduce DynaGoal, a benchmark for evaluating world-model planning under dynamic out-of-distribution conditions, execution deadlines, and controlled response delays. Fast-JEPA achieves average success rates of 73.83% on DynaGoal-Shift and 87.67% on DynaGoal-Deadline, demonstrating the practical value of low-latency predictive planning under changing control conditions and execution-time constraints. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: Fast-JEPA：面向低延迟规划的高效JEPA潜空间世界模型规划框架，直接预测候选动作序列结果以替代递归rollout
AI.motivation: 潜空间世界模型虽能预测动作序列后果，但通过递归rollout比较候选方案在测试时成本高昂，限制了预测式搜索在实时控制中的应用。
AI.method: 重构预测计算流程：先构造目标导向计划引导搜索，再直接预测完整候选动作序列的结果以高效比较，避免精化阶段的递归状态rollout；同时提出DynaGoal基准（含DynaGoal-Shift与DynaGoal-Deadline），评估动态分布外条件、执行截止时间与可控响应延迟下的规划性能。
AI.result: 在PushT、Reacher、Cube、TwoRoom上平均成功率96.50%，规划速度较INTACT快2.41倍；搜索预算扫描显示优势在候选数与精化深度上稳健；DynaGoal-Shift成功率73.83%、DynaGoal-Deadline成功率87.67%。
AI.conclusion: 直接预测完整候选序列结果可显著提升预测式搜索的成功率-延迟帕累托前沿，低延迟潜空间规划在动态控制条件与时间约束下具备实用价值；代码已开源。

title: Why Flat Drafts Stay Flat: Region-Mean Latents Govern Texture in Flow-Based Image Generation
summary: Flat color-block drafts specify layout and regional color while leaving interior detail unspecified, yet pretrained flow-based generators can preserve their flat appearance even under photorealistic prompts. We trace this behavior to a cross-scale mechanism linking fine pixel variation to regional means in variational autoencoder (VAE) latent space. Flattening photo regions systematically shifts their latent means, with offsets concentrated along a shared channel direction within each backbone. Controlled field exchanges in FLUX.1-dev and Qwen-Image establish the effect of this displacement on texture generation: adding the photo-derived regional mean field to a flat latent restores texture, whereas adding its complementary field alone largely preserves flatness. A second-order encoding expansion explains how encoder curvature can convert zero-mean perturbations into mean shifts. An analytically solvable conditional Gaussian flow shows how regional noise averaging enables near-unit endpoint sensitivity at high signal-to-noise ratios. This mechanism motivates training-free rendering through pixel dither before encoding, mean-field scaling, and early boundary holding. Paired low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with draft conditioning improves content recovery and produces photo-like regional means under the standard velocity objective. Explicit regional mean guidance remains effective after adaptation, continuously controlling texture and improving color fidelity. These findings connect encoding shifts to persistent generation behavior and support interventions evaluated for texture, spatial fidelity, and semantic recovery.

AI.tldr: 该文揭示预训练流式生成器即使输入平坦色块草图也保持扁平外观的跨尺度机制：VAE潜空间中区域均值沿共享通道方向平移，进而通过平均场交换实验验证其控制纹理生成；据此提出免训练渲染（像素抖动+均值场缩放+早期边界保持）与配对LoRA改进。
AI.motivation: 现象：平坦色块草图只规定布局与区域颜色，内部细节缺失，但预训练流模型在写实提示词下仍输出扁平化结果，缺乏对这一"顽固扁平性"机理的系统解释，也缺乏可控干预手段。
AI.method: 1) 在VAE潜空间做跨尺度分析，发现区域平整化系统性改变潜均值，偏移集中于骨干网络内共享通道方向；2) 在FLUX.1-dev与Qwen-Image上做受控"场交换"：向平坦潜变量加入照片派生的区域均值场可恢复纹理，仅加其补场则保持平坦；3) 二阶编码展开解释编码器曲率如何把零均值扰动转为均值漂移；4) 可解析求解的条件高斯流说明高信噪比下区域噪声平均导致近单位端点敏感度；5) 基于机制提出免训练渲染流程：编码前像素抖动、均值场缩放、早期边界保持；6) 配对LoRA+草图条件在标准速度目标下提升内容恢复并生成类照片区域均值，配合显式区域均值引导持续控纹理、改善色彩保真。
AI.result: 场交换实验定量确认区域均值位移是纹理生成的因果驱动；理论分析给出编码曲率与噪声平均两条机理解释；免训练与LoRA两条路径在纹理、空间保真与语义恢复三项指标上均得到评估改进，且适应后区域均值引导依然有效。
AI.conclusion: 将VAE编码偏移与生成器的持续性行为联系起来，把平坦渲染问题转化为可干预的区域均值场控制问题，为草图到写实渲染提供有理论依据的推理时与微调两类方案。

title: AGSR: Aperture-Guided Super-Resolution for Gaussian Splatting
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Multimedia Signal Processing (MMSP 2026). Recipient of the Best Paper Award
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables real-time novel view synthesis, but Gaussian rasterization attenuates fine-scale scene structure through the projected covariance of each primitive. We show that contracting these projected covariances at inference time can mitigate the effective bandwidth limitation induced by finite Gaussian footprints, motivating a multi-aperture rendering framework for super-resolution. Based on this insight, we propose AGSR (Aperture-Guided Super-Resolution), a lightweight inference-time framework that progressively fuses multi-aperture renderings using uncertainty-guided feature aggregation and geometric conditioning from transmittance and depth cues. AGSR operates as a plug-in enhancement for pre-trained 3DGS models. Experiments on the Mip-NeRF 360 benchmark show that AGSR outperforms lightweight image-space super-resolution baselines, with gains increasing as the underlying Gaussian representation deteriorates. The results provide evidence that covariance contraction exposes bandwidth-sensitive structural cues attenuated by native Gaussian rasterization. AGSR achieves these improvements while maintaining real-time performance with up to 139k parameters.

AI.tldr: AGSR：推理时收缩3DGS投影协方差，多孔径渲染+不确定性引导特征聚合实现轻量超分插件的框架。
AI.motivation: 3DGS虽支持实时新视角合成，但每个高斯基元的投影协方差导致细尺度结构被衰减，形成等效带宽瓶颈，原生高斯光栅化会丢失高频细节。
AI.method: 先分析指出收缩投影协方差可在推理时缓解有限高斯足迹带来的带宽限制；据此提出Aperture-Guided Super-Resolution（AGSR）：对预训练3DGS模型做多次不同孔径（协方差收缩）渲染，获得多孔径图像，再利用透射率与深度作为几何条件，以不确定性引导的特征聚合逐步融合多孔径结果。作为即插即用模块，仅约139k参数，无需重训练。
AI.result: 在Mip-NeRF 360基准上优于轻量级图像空间超分基线；当底层高斯表示质量越差时增益越大，且保持实时性能（≤139k参数），验证了协方差收缩能暴露被原生光栅化衰减的带宽敏感结构线索。
AI.conclusion: AGSR以协方差收缩为物理动机，为预训练3DGS提供低成本、即插即用的超分增强，说明带宽受限于高斯足迹而非仅图像分辨率；后续可推广至更多表示与场景。

title: TwinD: Generalizing Deepfake Detection from Blending to Entire Face Synthesis
summary: Facial deepfake detectors are usually trained on blending fakes, where a generated face is pasted back into a real frame. Recent generators synthesize the entire face and leave no traces of blending. On a benchmark of 19 datasets released from 2019 to 2026, the best prior facial deepfake detector reaches a mean AUROC of 96.2% on ten blending datasets, but none exceeds 78.1% on five datasets of entire face synthesis (EFS). AI-generated content (AIGC) detectors do not close this gap. We propose TwinD, a detector trained on FaceForensics++ fakes and two kinds of twins: fakes made from a real frame. A reconstruction twin is a real frame reconstructed by an autoencoder, with the real pixels put back in a random region. It targets the neural traces of a decoder. A blob twin blends an altered copy of a real frame with the frame itself, targeting blending artifacts. It needs no generator and no face-shaped mask. Together, these twins provide two complementary forensic cues that generalize to unseen manipulations. TwinDreaches a mean AUROC of 96.3%, 8.9 points above the prior state-of-the-art, with 98.1% on the blending datasets and 95.6% on the EFS datasets. Trained on twins alone, without a deepfake dataset, single models still reach 94.3% on average over three seeds. For reproducibility, the code, trained model, and training data are at: this https URL

AI.tldr: TwinD用一个自编码器重建帧回填、一个不需生成器的blob混合两种"孪生"伪造样本训练检测器，泛化到整脸合成伪造。
AI.motivation: 现有脸部深伪检测器依赖混合伪影，而新一代生成器直接合成整张脸、无混合痕迹，导致跨数据集泛化崩溃（EFS数据集AUROC≤78.1%）；AIGC检测器也未能填补该空白。
AI.method: 在FaceForensics++基础上构造两类"孪生"假样本：(1) Reconstructor twin——真实帧经自编码器重建，并将真实像素随机区域回填，暴露解码器神经指纹；(2) Blob twin——真实帧的改动副本与原帧自体混合，暴露混合伪影，无需生成器和人脸形mask。两者提供互补取证线索。
AI.result: 19个数据集（2019–2026）基准上平均AUROC 96.3%，较前SOTA提升8.9点；混合类98.1%、EFS类95.6%。仅用孪生数据、不含深伪数据集训练，三seed平均仍达94.3%。
AI.conclusion: 以无生成器、无face-mask的合成孪生数据即可构造可泛化的取证线索，显著弥合混合型与整脸合成型深伪检测的差距；代码、模型、数据开源。

title: Point Dynamics as Proxy for Robotic World Models
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures, 11 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Robotic world models predict future video frames from the current observation and a sequence of robot actions. While recent models follow the given actions closely, manipulated objects often collapse or move inconsistently with the action. We attribute this to the conditioning: an action, or a rendering of the robot, specifies where the robot goes but not how the scene responds, leaving a single video model to infer the interaction dynamics implicitly while also rendering appearance. We therefore separate dynamics prediction from visual rendering, with 3D point dynamics as the proxy between them. Specifically, we lift the first frame into 3D points, simulate how they respond to the robot's motion with a learned point dynamics model, and render the simulated points back into pixel-aligned videos that any video model can read. In controlled experiments on the DROID dataset with two video renderers of different architectures, this point dynamics proxy reduces object motion error by 8.6% and 6.2% without degrading image quality, and by 8.1% on a real bimanual robot. Moreover, the video follows the simulation: more accurate dynamics yield more accurate object motion, and editing the points steers the video. This suggests that advances in dynamics modeling can translate into more faithful robotic world models.

AI.tldr: 将机器人世界模型拆分为“点动力学预测”与“视频渲染”两阶段，用3D点动力学作为中间代理，提升操作物体运动一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型虽能紧密跟随动作，但被操作物体常出现塌陷或与动作不一致的运动。作者认为根因在于条件信号（动作或机器人渲染）只指明机器人去哪，未指明场景如何响应，迫使单一视频模型隐式推断交互动力学并同时负责外观渲染。
AI.method: 首帧提升为3D点云，用学习到的点动力学模型模拟点在机器人运动下的响应，再将模拟点渲染回像素对齐的视频帧供任意视频模型读取，从而实现动力学预测与视觉渲染的解耦。
AI.result: 在DROID数据集上以两种不同架构视频渲染器控制实验，物体运动误差分别降低8.6%和6.2%且不损失图像质量；在真实双臂机器人上降低8.1%。动力学越准确物体运动越准确，编辑点可引导视频变化。
AI.conclusion: 以3D点动力学为中间表示解耦动力学与渲染，可显著提升机器人世界模型的物理一致性，说明动力学建模的进展能直接转化为更忠实的机器人世界模型。

title: Learning optimal gaits and styles for terrain-adaptive quadruped locomotion
summary: Animals use many different gaits to locomote at different speeds across varying terrains. A longstanding question in biology and robotics is: which gait is best? This question is most often addressed from an energy-efficiency perspective on flat terrain, leaving open how the answer depends on terrain and on the criterion optimized. Here we show that gait optimality is determined jointly by terrain, performance metric, and velocity. We use deep reinforcement learning and networks of abstract oscillators, modeling spinal central pattern generators, to learn 11 quadrupedal gaits across diverse challenging terrains, together with the locomotion style (base height, foot ground clearance, foot offsets) that each requires. A second policy then selects among them to optimize a user-specified criterion such as cost of transport, base stability, or joint smoothness. Across these performance metrics and within this repertoire, every gait is optimal under at least one terrain-metric-velocity combination. The framework adapts zero-shot to gait couplings and styles never seen during training, to terrains far beyond the training distribution, and to larger quadrupeds five times the training mass. With a single additional pitch-tracking reward term, the same gait couplings also support bipedal-mode locomotion. Our method provides a general and systematic way to produce expressive locomotion and to select the gait best suited to a given terrain and criterion. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 利用深度强化学习与抽象振子网络(模拟脊髓CPG)学习11种四足步态及其运动风格,再由上层策略据用户指定指标(cost of transport、基座稳定性、关节平滑度)与地形/速度选取最优步态。
AI.motivation: "哪种步态最优"长期只从平地能效角度回答,忽略了地形与优化准则的依赖;作者主张步态最优性由地形、性能指标、速度三者共同决定。
AI.method: 深度RL + 抽象振子网络(CPG建模),在多样复杂地形上学习11种步态及其所需风格(基座高度、抬脚离地间隙、足端偏移);第二个策略层做步态选择,以用户指定指标为优化目标。
AI.result: 在该步态库内,每种步态至少在一种"地形-指标-速度"组合下最优;框架零样本泛化到训练未见的步态耦合与风格、远超训练分布的地形,以及5倍质量的更大四足体;额外加一个俯仰跟踪奖励项即可让同一组步态耦合支持双足模式运动。
AI.conclusion: 提出通用且系统的方法生成富表达性运动,并针对给定地形与准则选择最适步态,为生物力学与机器人步态选择提供统一框架。

title: MorphTwin: Enriching Deformable Material Responses from Videos for Morphable and Interactive Physical Twins
summary: Reconstructing interactive physical twins from video requires accurately capturing how objects deform while maintaining efficient simulation. We observe that reproducing motion in a video does not guarantee correct responses to new forces when the physical representation restricts how an object can deform. In spring-based twins, coupling between volume and shape responses creates such a limitation. We present MorphTwin, which enriches local deformation modes to capture and independently control these responses while retaining standard spring forces and explicit simulation. To support interpretable material editing and transfer, we use offline calibration to map shared relative response changes to stiffness updates on each reconstructed graph. Under identical inverse settings on synthetic scenes, MorphTwin reduces the mean absolute error of Poisson's ratio by 75.8% and the mean relative error of Young's modulus by 22.1% compared to PhysTwin. We introduce an egocentric stereo and RGB-D benchmark covering interactions with objects of varying stiffness. Real-world experiments demonstrate improved reconstruction accuracy and up to 14.4% lower future tracking error than PhysTwin at interactive speeds.

AI.tldr: MorphTwin：从视频重建"物理孪生"的弹簧模型改进方法，通过丰富局部变形模式解耦体积与形状响应，并用离线标定把相对响应变化映射到刚度更新，实现可解释的材质编辑与迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有视频物理孪生（如PhysTwin）能复现视频中的运动，但由于弹簧网络的体积响应与形状响应相耦合，其物理表示对形变空间的限制导致模型无法正确响应新施加的力；同时缺乏可解释的材质编辑与跨场景迁移能力。
AI.method: 在保留标准弹簧力与显式仿真的前提下，为每个节点/边引入额外的局部变形模式，使体积响应与形状响应可独立控制；采用离线标定，将共享的相对响应变化映射为各重建图上的刚度更新，从而支持材质参数的可解释编辑与迁移。
AI.result: 合成场景相同逆问题设置下，泊松比平均绝对误差降低75.8%，杨氏模量平均相对误差降低22.1%（相对PhysTwin）；提出自视角立体+RGB-D基准，覆盖不同刚度物体的交互；真实实验重建精度提升，未来跟踪误差最多降低14.4%，且保持交互级实时速度。
AI.conclusion: 解耦体积/形状响应的弹簧表示能显著提升视频重建物理孪生的材料参数辨识精度与新外力响应正确性，并具备可解释的材质编辑与迁移能力，为可交互的实时物理孪生提供了实用方案。

title: Sample-efficient end-to-end Optical Music Recognition through Active Learning
summary: End-to-end approaches to Optical Music Recognition (OMR) have recently shown promising results, but their performance often degrades on unseen data. A common solution is to pretrain and fine-tune models with annotated samples from the target domain, improving adaptation to new distributions. However, this process typically requires extensive manual annotation to yield competitive models, making it costly and time-consuming. In this work, we explore Active Learning to reduce this burden by selecting informative samples for labeling in low-resource scenarios, where the amount of manual annotation that can be performed is limited. We evaluate both uncertainty- and diversity-based sampling strategies on staff-level and full-page corpora. Results show that confidence-based sampling performs comparably to oracle selection (based on true error), and that each scenario benefits from a tailored strategy.

AI.tldr: 探索用主动学习（Active Learning）减少端到端光学乐谱识别（OMR）在低资源目标域微调时的人工标注成本，对比不确定性与多样性采样策略在谱表级与整页语料上的表现。
AI.motivation: 端到端OMR模型在未见数据上性能下降，常规缓解手段是在目标域做预训练+微调，但需大量人工标注，成本高、耗时长；希望在标注预算极低的场景下用主动学习替代。
AI.method: 在有限标注预算下迭代式主动学习采样：分别采用基于不确定性（置信度）与基于多样性的采样策略，在staff-level和full-page两种语料粒度上进行实验对比，并以基于真实错误的oracle选择作为上界参照。
AI.result: 置信度采样与oracle选择（基于真实误差）性能接近；不同场景（谱表级 vs 整页级）各自受益于不同的定制化采样策略。
AI.conclusion: 主动学习可在低资源下显著降低OMR域适应所需标注量，且需按场景特点定制采样策略；该结论主要面向音乐符号文档识别，与物流/机器人相关核心方向无直接关系。

title: Multi-View Transformer with Geometry-Guided Multi-Modal ControlNet for 3D Virtual Try-On
summary: Editing a 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) capture of a person so that they wear a new garment requires every rendered view to agree on the same garment details. Existing 3D virtual try-on (VTON) pipelines, however, edit training views largely independently and fuse them with hand-designed heuristics such as manually chosen reference views and fixed attention-blending weights. The resulting inconsistencies are baked into the 3D representation and surface as texture drift, blurred prints, and implausible geometry in novel views. We present GS-VTON-MVT, a three-stage framework that combines implicit and explicit 3D reasoning for consistent 3DGS try-on. (i) A multi-view inpainting transformer jointly edits a set of training views with full cross-view self-attention, so that cross-view correspondence is learned rather than imposed. (ii) A geometry-guided multi-modal ControlNet conditions the diffusion editor on the garment image together with depth and surface normals rendered from the current 3DGS state, supplying explicit structure where visual evidence is weakest. (iii) A pose-adaptive persona-aware attention replaces the fixed blending weight between current-view and reference-view features with weights derived from camera-pose proximity. On the 3D-VTONBench benchmark, GS-VTON-MVT improves FID, KID, LPIPS-based cross-view consistency, and user preference over general-purpose 3D editors and prior 3D try-on methods.

AI.tldr: GS-VTON-MVT提出三阶段框架实现3DGS人体虚拟试穿：多视角修复Transformer做全跨视角自注意力联合编辑，几何引导多模态ControlNet引入深度与法线，姿态自适应注意力以相机位姿邻近度替代固定融合权重。
AI.motivation: 现有3D虚拟试穿流水线逐视角独立编辑训练视图，再用人工参考视角与固定注意力混合权重等启发式融合，跨视角不一致被烘焙进3D表示，导致新视角出现纹理漂移、印花模糊和几何不合理。
AI.method: (1) 多视角修复Transformer，对一组训练视图做全跨视角自注意力联合编辑，显式学习跨视角对应关系；(2) 几何引导多模态ControlNet，以服装图像及当前3DGS渲染的深度、表面法线作为条件，在视觉证据薄弱处提供结构约束；(3) 姿态自适应人物感知注意力，用相机位姿邻近度生成当前视角与参考视角特征的融合权重。
AI.result: 在3D-VTONBench上，FID、KID、基于LPIPS的跨视角一致性及用户偏好均优于通用3D编辑器与已有3D试穿方法。
AI.conclusion: 将隐式多视角联合推理与显式几何条件结合，可有效缓解3DGS试穿中的跨视角不一致；但验证限于自建基准与人像场景，未涉及真实机器人或开放场景泛化。

title: Learning What Actions Change: Action Effect Matching for Dynamics-Faithful World Models
summary: World models aim to predict environment dynamics under actions, enabling the prediction of action consequences without executing them in the real world. Yet despite producing increasingly realistic videos, current world models often fail to capture how small action changes affect future observations. This limits their use in tasks such as robotic policy evaluation and model-based planning, where nearly identical actions can lead to qualitatively different outcomes. To address this, we propose AFFECT, an auxiliary training objective for learning the distribution of visual changes induced by action perturbations. Specifically, we inject temporally correlated noise into the actions of a policy trained on task-agnostic human teleoperation. We then train the world model so that its generated videos respond to this noise as the recorded videos do, without requiring repeated executions from the same initial state. Across OGBench simulation and real-world DROID and ALOHA-2 setups, AFFECT makes world-model rollouts more faithful to real outcomes. On DROID, the Pearson correlation between policy success rates in the world model and on the real robot rises from 0.47 to 0.79, alongside up to 23% lower FVD. These gains carry over to planning, where selecting actions with AFFECT-trained world models improves task success by up to 8.3%.

AI.tldr: AFFECT：通过向动作注入时间相关噪声，训练世界模型匹配动作扰动下的视觉变化分布，提升世界模型对动作敏感性的保真度，用于策略评估与基于模型的规划。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型虽能生成逼真视频，但难以捕捉微小的动作差异如何影响未来观测；在机器人策略评估与基于模型的规划中，近乎相同的动作可能导致定性不同的结果，因此需要提升世界模型对动作扰动的响应保真度。
AI.method: 提出AFFECT辅助训练目标：在任务无关的人类遥操作数据训练的策略上，向动作注入时间相关噪声；要求世界模型生成的视频对这些噪声的响应与真实录制视频一致，从而学习动作扰动引起的视觉变化分布，且无需在同一初始状态下重复执行。
AI.result: 在OGBench仿真及真实DROID、ALOHA-2平台上，rollout更贴近真实结果；DROID上世界模型与真机策略成功率Pearson相关由0.47提升至0.79，FVD最多降低23%；在规划中任务成功率最高提升8.3%。
AI.conclusion: AFFECT以简易辅助目标显著提升世界模型的动作敏感性保真度，改善策略评估与规划效果，具备真实机器人验证，可作为世界模型训练的通用增强组件。

title: Close&Safe: Maximal Task Preservation for Redundant Manipulators via C-Space Boundary Detour
summary: Contact-rich manipulation such as wiping, polishing and surface inspection specifies the task as a continuous end-effector trajectory rather than a goal pose. When an obstacle absent from the planning model intersects it, conventional planners return a collision-free path that may differ from the nominal throughout, discarding trajectory that was never obstructed. We present Close&Safe (Close to the intended task, Safe from obstacles), which decouples tracking from avoidance: the nominal is followed exactly wherever it remains feasible, and avoidance acts only on the interval where it is not, so tracking is hindered as little as the obstacle allows. On that interval we sample the configuration-space obstacle boundary within a corridor around the nominal, connect the samples into a roadmap, and search it for the detour that deviates least before rejoining the nominal at the earliest feasible configuration. We evaluate across diverse simulated obstacle configurations, physical Franka experiments, and ablations of key algorithmic components. The results demonstrate collision-free trajectory repair with localized task modification, while recovering 52.4-78% in simulation and on hardware.

AI.tldr: 提出Close&Safe方法：将接触丰富任务的标称轨迹跟踪与避障解耦，仅在标称不可行的区间内沿构型空间障碍边界采样建图并搜索最小偏离绕行，再尽早回归标称路径。
AI.motivation: 擦洗、抛光、表面检测等接触丰富任务要求连续末端轨迹而非目标位姿；当规划模型外的障碍物与轨迹相交时，传统规划器全局重规划，丢弃了本未被阻挡的轨迹部分，导致任务偏移过大。
AI.method: 解耦跟踪与避障：标称轨迹在可行区间精确跟踪，仅在不可行区间激活避障。在该区间内于标称走廊附近的构型空间障碍边界采样，构建roadmap，搜索偏离最小、并能在最早可行构型处回归标称的绕行路径。在多种仿真障碍配置、Franka真机和消融实验中评估。
AI.result: 实现无碰撞轨迹修复，任务修改局部化；在仿真与硬件上恢复标称轨迹52.4%–78%。
AI.conclusion: 局部化轨迹修复优于全局重规划，在保持任务执行保真度方面有效；但基线对比范围与更多样真实任务上的表现仍待拓展。

title: Fixing the Twin, Not the Detector: Sim-to-Real Roadside LiDAR Detection from Digital-Twin Data
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Accepted to the IEEE BigData 2026 Cup (UCF UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge); first place, LUMPI track. Code: this https URL
summary: Roadside LiDAR detectors are expensive to train on real labels, and digital twins promise to replace these labels, but a detector trained on a twin meets a different sensor, different objects and different annotation conventions on the real site. We describe the pipeline that placed first in the LUMPI track of the UrbanTwin Sim2Real LiDAR Challenge (IEEE BigData 2026 Cup, 0.5541 combined score) and fifth on its V2X-Real track (0.8102). Every detector is a CenterPoint model trained only on synthetic data, on a single 8 GB laptop GPU. Most of the gain came from correcting differences between the twin and the real site rather than from the detector. We align the twin's coordinates, point density and box convention with the test sensor, generate the pedestrians and riders that the twins lack, plus street clutter as unlabeled negatives, and rebuild twin objects at real size and real point density. A non-learned resampling to the per-cell point density of unlabeled real frames lifts LUMPI realism from 0.589 to 0.947, against 0.949 between real frames. Label-free post-processing then exploits what a fixed roadside sensor guarantees: static structures recur in every frame, and real objects have characteristic point statistics. Reporting the validation and test gain of each component side by side, we find that corrections of systematic sim-to-real differences transfer to the test set, typically keeping a quarter to three quarters of their validation gain, while choices that fit the few objects of a validation set do not.

AI.tldr: 在仅用合成数据、单张8GB笔记本GPU的条件下，通过系统性修正孪生域与真实路侧LiDAR之间的分布差异（坐标/点密度/框约定对齐、补全行人骑行者、真实尺度重建、无标签点密度重采样、无标签后处理），获得UrbanTwin Sim2Real挑战赛LUMPI赛道第一（0.5541）、V2X-Real第五（0.8102），并量化了各类修正的验证-测试迁移性。
AI.motivation: 路侧LiDAR检测器依赖昂贵的真实标注，数字孪生可提供免费标签，但孪生与真实站点在传感器、目标类别与标注约定上存在系统性差异，直接迁移性能严重下降。作者希望验证：Sim2Real的增益主要来自"消除孪生与现场的系统性差异"而非更强的检测器。
AI.method: 所有检测器均为CenterPoint，仅用合成数据训练。主要手段：(1) 将孪生坐标、点密度、3D框约定对齐测试传感器；(2) 生成孪生缺失的行人与骑行者，并加入街道杂物作为未标注负样本；(3) 按真实尺寸与真实点密度重建孪生目标；(4) 非学习的点密度重采样，将合成帧每格点密度匹配未标注真实帧（LUMPI真实度0.589→0.947）；(5) 无标签后处理，利用固定路侧传感器的静态结构逐帧复现性与真实目标的点统计特性。逐组件并列报告验证集与测试集增益。
AI.result: 点密度重采样使LUMPI真实度达0.947（真实帧间为0.949）；LUMPI赛道综合分0.5541（第一），V2X-Real 0.8102（第五），全部在8GB笔记本GPU上完成训练。消融显示：针对系统性Sim2Real差异的修正通常可保留验证增益的1/4至3/4并迁移到测试集，而针对验证集中少量目标的过拟合式选择不能迁移。
AI.conclusion: Sim2Real路侧感知的关键瓶颈在于孪生-现场系统性偏差的显式建模与校正，而非模型容量；无标签的真实帧统计量（点密度分布、静态背景复现性）是可迁移的有效监督信号，可作为检测器设计与调参的稳健性判据。

title: Streaming-AAA: Streaming AAA Game Video Generation at High Resolution, High Frame Rate, and Low Latency
summary: Controllable streaming video generation offers a promising route toward interactive game simulation, yet existing methods remain far from practical gameplay. They often fail to jointly achieve high visual fidelity, high frame rates, and low interaction latency, resulting in poor responsiveness and degraded user experience. We present Streaming-AAA, a new paradigm for controllable infinite generation of AAA-quality game videos. Our system generates 1080p gameplay videos at 43 FPS with 198 ms end-to-end latency interaction on merely NVIDIA A800 GPUs, while supporting long-horizon play without severe temporal degradation or collapse. Streaming-AAA is built upon three key designs. First, we redesign the VAE architecture for efficient high-resolution decoding, enabling real-time synthesis at 1080p. Second, we pretrain the diffusion model using diffusion forcing and significantly extend the temporal training horizon, allowing the model to capture long-term dependencies and maintain persistent memory. Third, we perform post-training distillation and memory compression to improve inference efficiency while retaining visual quality and temporal consistency. Experiments show that Streaming-AAA substantially improves visual fidelity, frame rate, latency, and long-term stability over prior controllable video generation approaches, enabling a significantly more playable experience for interactive AAA game video generation.

AI.tldr: Streaming-AAA 提出可控无限游戏视频生成范式：在 8×A800 上生成 1080p、43 FPS、端到端延迟 198ms 的 AAA 级交互式游戏视频，并保持长时程不退化。
AI.motivation: 现有流式可控视频生成无法同时兼顾高保真、高帧率与低交互延迟，响应性差、体验不佳，难以支撑真实可玩的交互式游戏仿真。
AI.method: 三项设计：1）重设计 VAE 架构实现高效高分辨率解码，支撑 1080p 实时合成；2）用 diffusion forcing 预训练并显著延长时序训练视界，捕获长程依赖与持久记忆；3）后训练蒸馏 + 记忆压缩，在保持视觉质量与时序一致性的同时提升推理效率。
AI.result: 1080p 游戏视频 43 FPS、端到端交互延迟 198ms（NVIDIA A800），长时程生成无明显时序退化或崩溃；相比既有可控视频生成方法在保真度、帧率、延迟与长期稳定性上均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过 VAE 改造、长视界 diffusion forcing 预训练与蒸馏/记忆压缩的组合，流式可控视频生成可达到接近实用的游戏级可玩性，为交互式世界模型与游戏仿真提供可行路径。

title: PaveSplat: Resolution-Robust Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting with Residually Corrected Surface-Aligned Covariances
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. 16 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Project page: this https URL ; code: this https URL
summary: We present PaveSplat, a feed-forward Gaussian splatting method that adds a learned residual to the analytic surface-aligned covariance, keeping surfels paving the visible surface across rendering resolutions. Pixel-aligned feed-forward Gaussian splatting predicts one primitive per pixel from a few images in a single pass, and its rendering quality depends on how well these primitives cover the surface. Recent surfel-based methods compute the surface-aligned covariance analytically from predicted depth. However, this covariance has no way to correct the surfel orientation where the depth-derived frame is ill-posed. The surfels then cover the surface loosely; at the training resolution each surfel's one-pixel minimum footprint covers the gaps, but they show up as holes when the same prediction is re-rendered at a higher resolution. To address this, we keep the analytic covariance as an initialization, with its axes aligned to the surface tangents, and add an identity-initialized unit-quaternion residual that reorients a surfel only where this improves rendering, turning surfels that the analytic frame mis-aims back onto the surface. On RealEstate10K, PaveSplat achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS among single-Gaussian-per-pixel methods at every scale (1x-8x). The native-resolution gain is small; the benefit appears when the same prediction is rendered at higher display resolutions without re-running the network. On zero-shot DL3DV, it leads PSNR within this group at every scale and ranks first or second on SSIM/LPIPS. A coverage-hole analysis shows fewer uncovered pixels than both baselines under high-resolution re-rendering.

AI.tldr: PaveSplat：前馈高斯泼溅中在解析面片协方差上加入单位四元数残差以校正surfel朝向，使单像素单高斯的预测在更高分辨率重渲染时不出现空洞。
AI.motivation: 像素对齐前馈GS每像素预测一个高斯基元，其覆盖质量依赖协方差是否贴合表面。现有方法由预测深度解析推导表面切向对齐协方差，但在深度导出坐标系病态处无法修正surfel朝向，导致面片松散覆盖；训练分辨率下每像素最小足迹掩盖了间隙，高分辨率重渲染时暴露为孔洞。
AI.method: 保留解析协方差（轴对齐表面切向）作为初始化，附加恒等初始化的单位四元数残差，仅在能改善渲染时重新定向surfel；端到端前馈，单次前向从少量图像预测每像素一个高斯。
AI.result: RealEstate10K上1x–8x各尺度在单高斯每像素方法中PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS最优；原生分辨率增益有限，优势主要体现在不重跑网络的高分辨率重渲染。零样本DL3DV各尺度PSNR领先，SSIM/LPIPS第一或第二；覆盖率空洞分析显示高分辨率重渲染下未覆盖像素少于两个基线。
AI.conclusion: 解析先验+可学习轻量残差是稳健的surfel朝向校正范式，显著提升前馈单高斯泼溅的分辨率可迁移性（无空洞上采样渲染）。改进幅度属渐进式且限于受约束的稀疏视角前馈设定，缺乏下游机器人/交互应用验证。

title: Agentic Scaling of Embodied Tasks in Simulation for Synthetic Data Collection and Policy Evaluation
comment: 12 pages. Dataset: this https URL Project website: this https URL
summary: Scaling embodied interaction data requires a broad collection of usable tasks, yet specifying and validating each task instance remains costly. We present AgenticTask, an agent-based framework that expands existing task collections under human intent. Its central representation links interaction requirements to object and part bindings, scene and robot configurations, initial conditions, and completion criteria. A task-generation agent reuses interaction structure to construct supported variations and revises incompatible configurations using validation feedback. A task-execution agent uses the same bindings and geometric records to select robot-supported skills and check completion against the original task criteria. On RoboCasa, the framework builds the AgenticTask collection, saving 16,450 task instances from 20,323 construction attempts at a throughput of 166.97 saved instances per elapsed hour, with 62.26% of construction attempts passing the configured physical checks. The execution agent completes approximately 38% of evaluated tasks, with successful cases spanning object placement, articulated manipulation, and sequential arrangement. Diagnostic analysis identifies improvement priorities in construction reliability, action selection, task-robot compatibility, and runtime integration. Together, these results demonstrate task-collection expansion with measured construction productivity and concrete execution evidence, providing a foundation for subsequent interaction-data collection for embodied AI.

AI.tldr: AgenticTask：基于智能体框架，以"交互需求—物体/部件绑定—场景与机器人配置—初始条件—完成判据"为核心表示，自动扩展现有具身交互任务集合；生成智能体复用交互结构并依据验证反馈修订配置，执行智能体用同一绑定与几何记录选择机器人可支持技能并核验完成度。
AI.motivation: 扩展具身交互数据需要大量可用任务，但逐个任务实例的指定与验证成本高昂，需自动化手段在人类意图约束下扩充任务集合。
AI.method: 提出 AgenticTask 框架，核心为统一任务表示（交互需求、物体与部件绑定、场景与机器人配置、初始条件、完成判据）；任务生成智能体基于结构复用构造受支持的变体，并用验证反馈修正不兼容配置；任务执行智能体复用绑定与几何记录选择机器人可支持技能，并按原始判据检验完成状态。
AI.result: 在 RoboCasa 上，从 20,323 次构造尝试中保存 16,450 个任务实例，吞吐 166.97 实例/小时，62.26% 的尝试通过物理检查；执行智能体约 38% 任务成功，覆盖物体放置、关节操作与顺序排布；诊断分析指出构造可靠性、动作选择、任务—机器人兼容性与运行时集成等改进方向。
AI.conclusion: 框架展示了可度量的任务集合扩展生产力与具体执行证据，为后续具身交互数据采集奠定基础，但在成功率与构造可靠性上仍有较大提升空间。

title: AGE-Capture: Autonomous, General, and Efficient UAV Capture for High-Fidelity Scene Reconstruction
summary: High-fidelity scene reconstruction with an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) requires more than identifying valuable viewpoints: the system must autonomously acquire informative observations and determine task completion under different sensing configurations and limited flight resources. We present AGE-Capture, an autonomous, sensor-adaptive, and efficient active-capture framework for real UAVs. Building on renderability, the framework uses a lightweight online state to evaluate the utility of candidate views, assess task progress, and guide flight execution. By decoupling geometric exploration from reconstruction observations and establishing a unified camera-ray interface, the framework allows different range sensors and RGB camera models to share a reconstruction-driven acquisition pipeline. Reconstruction-frontier viewpoints characterize residual acquisition value for region screening and autonomous termination; dynamics-aware hierarchical planning combined with asynchronous event-driven capture reduces unnecessary inter-region motion, time spent waiting for plans, and repeated observations. Across ten indoor and outdoor simulation scenes, AGE-Capture achieves a mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) $3.30$--$3.53\,\mathrm{dB}$ higher than that of the online baselines while using $58.2\%$ of the common mission-time budget on average. Its mean peak GPU memory usage is $91.0\%$--$93.3\%$ lower than that of the same baselines. Experiments with different sensor configurations validate the adaptability of the shared acquisition pipeline, while flights in nine real-world scenes further demonstrate onboard closed-loop operation under practical computational and motion constraints.

AI.tldr: AGE-Capture 是一个面向真实无人机的自主、传感器自适应、高效的主动场景捕捉框架，通过可渲染在线状态评估候选视角、判定任务完成，并在十个仿真场景与九个真实场景中验证。
AI.motivation: 高保真 UAV 场景重建不仅需要挑选有价值视角，还需系统自主获取信息、在不同传感器配置与有限飞行资源下判断任务何时完成；现有在线基线任务时间长、重复观测多、显存开销大。
AI.method: 基于可渲染性的轻量在线状态评估候选视角效用与任务进度；解耦几何探索与重建观测，统一相机射线接口使不同测距传感器与 RGB 相机模型共享重建驱动采集管线；用"重建前沿"视角刻画残余采集价值以做区域筛选与自主终止；采用动力学感知的分层规划与异步事件驱动捕捉减少区间移动、等待规划时间与重复观测。
AI.result: 在十个室内外仿真场景中，平均 PSNR 比在线基线高 3.30–3.53 dB，仅用约 58.2% 的常规任务时间预算；峰值 GPU 显存比基线低 91.0%–93.3%；不同传感器配置验证了共享管线的适应性，九个真实场景飞行验证了机载闭环在算力与运动约束下的运行。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将主动感知、传感器自适应与资源高效规划统一到一个可机载闭环运行的框架中，为真实无人机上的重建驱动式主动采集提供了可行方案。

title: Reference-Free Humanoid Skateboarding via Termination-Shaped Reinforcement Learning
comment: 8 pages, 15 figures, Accepted at the 2026 IEEE-RAS 25th International Conference on Humanoid Robots (Humanoids 2026)
summary: Humanoid locomotion research has advanced rapidly on walking and running, but \emph {object-mediated} locomotion, in which a robot must coordinate its body with a passive external object, remains difficult. One challenging task is skateboarding, which requires simultaneous interaction with the ground and a passive but movable platform to achieve forward motion. Current methods for tackling skateboarding with humanoid robots either require human demonstrations or utilise analytic steering models that require system identification. In this paper, we introduce a deep reinforcement learning framework that does not rely on prior data such as demonstrations and enables robots such as the K1 humanoid to learn to skateboard using model-free learning. The method combines task rewards with exploit-blocking terminations. We introduce a number of constraints restricting behaviours such as losing the planted board foot, standing with both feet on the board, excessive twisting, separation from the board, and unstable board motion. Their changing prevalence during training produces an implicit progression from stance control towards sustained robot--board locomotion.

AI.tldr: 提出无示教数据的深度强化学习框架，使K1人形机器人通过无模型学习完成滑板运动，利用任务奖励与"利用阻断"终止约束实现从站立控制到持续人-板协同运动的隐式课程递进。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人行走/奔跑进展很快，但"物体介导"运动（机器人需与被动可动外物协同）仍困难。滑板需同时与地面和被动可动平台交互；现有方法要么依赖人类示范，要么使用需系统辨识的解析转向模型。
AI.method: 深度强化学习框架：无模型学习、无需示范数据。将任务奖励与阻断利用行为的终止条件结合，引入五类约束（失去踩板脚的接触、双脚同时上板、过度扭转、与板分离、板体运动不稳定），训练中这些约束触发率的动态变化形成从姿态控制到持续滑板运动的隐式课程。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量结果；声称在K1人形机器人上无需先验数据即学会滑板技能（具体成功率、仿真/实机细节未提供）。
AI.conclusion: 约束驱动的终止条件可作为隐式课程，替代示范数据与解析模型，为人形机器人学习接触丰富、物体介导的运动提供可行路径；证据强度依赖后续实机与定量评估。

title: Less Than Meets the Eye: Action-Set Identifiability and Principled Abstention for 3D Physical Geometry
