summary: A corridor, its mirror reflection, and its image on a display can look identical, yet their physical surfaces lie at different depths. We test whether bounded camera motions distinguish these explanations. Intervene3D takes an image and an initial geometry estimate, predicts the view under each hypothesis and candidate motion, and selects a motion by maximin separability. It reports the mechanism and first physical surface only if the available motions separate the hypotheses still in contention. Otherwise it abstains. An adequacy test also rejects observations that no hypothesis explains. On a matched synthetic benchmark with exact landmarks, disabling abstention gives confident answers on 76.4% of unresolvable scenes. With abstention, none receives a confident answer under exact or noisy landmarks. At 100% accuracy on answered scenes, maximin selection answers 61.0% of scenes and summed selection 43.1%. The adequacy test lowers wrong answers on strongly curved mirror scenes from 56.8% to 12.4%. Real display experiments compare two hypotheses using one frozen depth-network estimate. The second image supplies photometric evidence and is never passed through the depth network. One executed motion reduces the pooled median surface error of twelve networks by 31.5%. These networks have larger error inside the annotated panel than outside on 33.4% of illusion-benchmark images. They place the first physical surface behind the glass on 36.9% of Mirror3D frames.

AI.tldr: 提出 Intervene3D 框架：给定单张图像与初始几何估计，针对"真实走廊/镜面反射/显示屏图像"等深度歧义假设，预测各假设与候选相机运动下的视角，以最大最小可分性选择运动，并在运动不足区分假设时弃答，另设充分性检验拒斥无假设可解释的观测。
AI.motivation: 走廊、其镜像、及其在显示屏上的成像在视觉上可能完全一致，但物理表面深度不同。现有深度网络/单视图重建会给出自信却错误的答案（如把镜中第一物理表面判在玻璃之后）。作者希望用有界的相机运动这一主动干预手段来判别这些歧义的物理假设，并保证在不具备可分性时明确弃答而非瞎猜。
AI.method: 1) 输入单图+初始几何估计，构造多个候选假设（真实表面、镜面反射、显示屏）；2) 对每个假设×候选相机运动预测视角图像；3) 以 maximin 可分性准则选择运动，仅在可用运动能区分剩余竞争假设时报告机制与第一物理表面，否则弃答；4) 引入 adequacy test 拒斥任何假设都无法解释的观测；5) 合成基准（精确地标）与真实显示屏实验；真实实验中第二张图像仅提供光度证据，不经过深度网络，比较两个假设时使用一个冻结的深度网络估计。
AI.result: 合成基准上：关闭弃答时对76.4%的不可解场景给出自信答案；启用弃答后确切地标与含噪地标下均无误答。在作答场景100%准确前提下，maximin选择覆盖61.0%场景，summed选择43.1%。adequacy test 将强曲率镜面场景的错误答案从56.8%降至12.4%。真实显示屏实验中，一次执行运动使12个网络的中位表面误差合并降低31.5%；这些网络在33.4%的错觉基准图像上标注面板内误差大于面板外，并在36.9%的 Mirror3D 帧上把第一物理表面置于玻璃之后。
AI.conclusion: 基于有界相机运动的主动假设检验配合弃答机制，可可靠区分视觉歧义的表面深度解释；无充分可分性时弃答是保证精度的关键，为深度/几何感知在镜面与显示类歧义下提供了可验证的主动感知范式。

title: One-to-Many: Diverse and Bidirectional Image-to-Image Translation via Rectified Flow
comment: 12 pages, 13 figures, 4 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: Many paired image-to-image translation tasks admit multiple valid target appearances, while training provides only one target per source. We propose One-to-Many Flow (O2MFlow), a latent-conditioned Rectified Flow (RF) model for one-to-many generation and backward translation (target$\rightarrow$source) within a single transport framework. Conditioning the RF dynamics on an appearance latent turns transport into a family of latent-indexed bijections: a fixed latent gives a mapping that is inverted by time-reversed integration, and sampled latents produce diverse outputs for the same input. We formalize reusable appearance variations as Shared Latent Transport and show that Kullback--Leibler (KL) regularization directly controls the source--latent distribution gap between training and generation. Across three benchmarks, O2MFlow offers dataset-dependent forward diversity--fidelity trade-offs and the lowest backward LPIPS-Dist among evaluated methods, with the lowest backward FID on two benchmarks.

AI.tldr: O2MFlow：以潜在外观变量条件化的Rectified Flow模型，在同一传输框架内实现一对多I2I生成与反向翻译，并提出Shared Latent Transport及KL正则控制源-潜分布差距。
AI.motivation: 成对图像翻译中每个源图像仅有一个目标，但真实任务往往存在多种合法外观；现有确定性映射无法表达多样输出，也难以在同一框架内获得可逆的反向翻译。
AI.method: 将RF动力学生成条件于外观潜变量，使传输成为一族“潜变量索引的双射”：固定潜变量对应可被时间反演积分求逆的映射，采样潜变量则产生同一输入的多样输出；形式化Shared Latent Transport，并用KL正则约束训练与生成阶段源-潜分布差异。
AI.result: 在三个基准上取得随数据集而异的前向多样性-保真度权衡；反向LPIPS-Dist为所比较方法中最低，其中两个基准上反向FID也最低。
AI.conclusion: 通过潜条件化流动实现统一的双向一对多翻译，是通用I2I方法而非具身/3D方向的贡献，作为邻域背景参考。

title: Domain-Aware Conformal Prediction for Trustworthy Spacecraft Pose Estimation under Sim-to-Real Shift
summary: Autonomous rendezvous and proximity operations require not only an accurate estimate of the pose of the target spacecraft, but also a reliable indication of when this estimate can be trusted. Conformal prediction provides such an indication with a formal guarantee, by producing pose uncertainty sets that contain the true pose with a specified probability. Such a guarantee, however, assumes that calibration and test data follow the same distribution, an assumption that is violated in orbital perception, where labelled calibration images are available only from synthetic renderings while operational images are real. In this work, we show on the SPEED+ dataset that conformal pose estimation calibrated on synthetic images loses its coverage guarantee on real images, and that many of the resulting failures are silent: the predicted pose set appears valid but excludes the true pose. To address this, we calibrate on synthetic images translated to the appearance of real images. Since translation alters appearance while preserving geometry, the synthetic pose labels remain valid and no labelled real images are required. Experiments with two translation models show that this calibration restores coverage above the specified level for miscoverage levels of 0.1 and above, and reduces silent failures from up to 43.5% to at most 3.3% of the test images, bringing conformal pose estimation a step closer to trustworthy deployment in space.

AI.tldr: 针对合成图像标定的共形位姿估计在真实图像上失效（且出现“静默失效”）的问题，利用“翻译改变外观但保留几何”的性质，在图像翻译到真实域外观后的合成图上重新标定，从而在无需真实标注的情况下恢复覆盖保证。
AI.motivation: 自主交会与近距离操作需要目标航天器位姿估计以及“该估计何时可信”的可靠性指示。共形预测能给出形式化覆盖保证，但其前提是标定与测试同分布；而在轨感知中仅有合成渲染的标注图像、实际图像为真实图像，分布偏移导致保证失效，且大量失败是静默的（预测集合看似有效却排除真值）。
AI.method: 在SPEED+数据集上先验证合成标定的共形位姿估计在真实图像上的覆盖失效情况；随后将合成图像通过图像翻译模型迁移到真实外观后再做共形标定——由于翻译仅改变外观、保持几何，合成位姿标签依然有效，因此无需任何带标注的真实图像。实验采用两种翻译模型进行对比。
AI.result: 合成域直接标定时覆盖保证在真实图像上失效，静默失效比例最高达43.5%；采用翻译后合成图像标定，在miscoverage水平0.1及以上可恢复覆盖率至指定水平以上，静默失效比例降至测试图像的至多3.3%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉域翻译可为共形位姿估计提供几何一致、无需真实标注的标定源，显著缓解静默失效，推动共形位姿估计在航天在轨任务中的可信部署。

title: DfD-GS: Defocus Image Prior for Metric-Scale Single-View Depth Estimation and View Synthesis
summary: Recovering metric-scale geometry from observations at a single viewpoint remains fundamentally ill-posed, limiting the reliability of novel view synthesis. Recent methods rely on learned monocular depth priors, which provide strong structural estimates but can suffer from scale ambiguity and dataset-dependent biases. We propose DfD-GS, a feed-forward framework that predicts a metric-scale 3D Gaussian scene representation from a single-view all-in-focus--defocused image pair. The key idea is to exploit defocus blur as a physical metric depth cue. DfD-GS first estimates a defocus-based metric disparity map from the all-in-focus--defocused image pair and the corresponding defocus strength. This estimate is used to align and refine a monocular depth prior to metric scale. Visible and hidden 3D Gaussians are then predicted for occlusion-aware novel view synthesis. Experiments on synthetic-defocus datasets constructed from Booster and Middlebury show that DfD-GS outperforms single-image baselines in metric depth estimation and novel view synthesis. On WildRGB-D, DfD-GS achieves lower AbsRel and LPIPS but higher depth RMSE than the single-image baselines. Additional analyses show that DfD-GS maintains a more stable metric scale under field-of-view changes. Qualitative results on a real dataset show recovery of the main scene structure under optical defocus.

AI.tldr: DfD-GS 用单视角"全聚焦—散焦"图像对中的散焦模糊作为物理度量线索，先估计基于散焦的度量视差图与散焦强度，再据此把单目深度先验对齐并细化到度量尺度，最后预测可见与隐藏 3D 高斯实现遮挡感知的新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 单视角恢复度量尺度几何本质上是病态问题；现有方法依赖学习式单目深度先验，存在尺度歧义和数据集偏置，导致新视角合成可靠性不足。
AI.method: 前馈框架 DfD-GS：输入单视角全聚焦—散焦图像对，估计散焦驱动（depth-from-defocus）的度量视差图及散焦强度；用该估计对单目深度先验做度量尺度对齐与细化；随后联合预测可见与隐藏 3D 高斯，用于遮挡感知的新视角合成。
AI.result: 在由 Booster 与 Middlebury 构造的合成散焦数据集上，度量深度估计与新视角合成均优于单图基线；在 WildRGB-D 上 AbsRel 与 LPIPS 更低但深度 RMSE 高于基线；分析显示视场变化下度量尺度更稳定；真实数据定性结果可在光学散焦下恢复主要场景结构。
AI.conclusion: 散焦模糊是有效的物理度量深度线索，可替代/校正单目深度先验的尺度歧义，实现单图度量尺度前馈 3D 高斯重建，但跨域深度精度（RMSE）仍有限。

title: Controlling the Humanoid Robot H1-2 With a Simulated Biologically Plausible Network
summary: Artificial Spiking Neural Networks have gained remarkable attention in the last few years due to their proven ability in simulating biological neural cultures and producing similar activity and trends. Nevertheless, whether they can be trained for humanoid locomotion while retaining biological plausibility and robust performance at once remains an open question. We study this problem by proposing a biologically inspired spiking network, trained by different learning schemes and tested on the H1-2 Unitree Humanoid. These schemes differ in how recurrent weights are trained. Ordered from most to least biologically faithful, they are: a fixed reservoir mimicking an in-vitro neural culture, where recurrent weights are kept frozen and only a linear readout is trained, the same network but with its synapses trained by reward-modulated spike timing dependent plasticity and eligibility propagation, and finally backpropagation through time as a non biological baseline for comparison. All schemes relied on distillation of a reinforcement learning expert policy with dataset aggregation. We show that e-prop reached 100% survival rate matching backpropagation through time, whereas both the fixed reservoir and the reward-modulated STDP, though the closest to biological cultures, plateaued at a much lower performance (~43.7% and ~11% survival). We explore in further detail which trends a real culture could and could not produce until now. Finally we demonstrate brief bipedal stepping on a full size humanoid H1-2.

AI.tldr: 该文在Unitree H1-2全尺寸人形机器人上比较三类脉冲网络训练方案（冻结储层+线性读出、e-prop/奖励调制STDP、BPTT），用RL专家策略蒸馏+数据集聚合训练，e-prop达到100%存活率与BPTT持平，而更生物合理的方案性能显著更低，并实现短暂双足行走。
AI.motivation: 脉冲神经网络能复现生物神经培养物的活动特征，但其能否在保持生物合理性的同时被训练完成人形机器人运动控制尚不清楚；作者希望量化"生物忠实度"与"控制性能"之间的权衡。
AI.method: 提出生物启发脉冲网络，仅在循环权重训练方式上做变量控制：①固定储层（循环权重冻结，仅训练线性读出，模拟体外神经培养物）；②奖励调制STDP + eligibility propagation (e-prop) 训练突触；③BPTT作为非生物基线。三者均通过数据集聚合（DAgger式）蒸馏强化学习专家策略，在Unitree H1-2仿真环境评测。
AI.result: e-prop存活率100%，与BPTT持平；固定储层约43.7%，奖励调制STDP约11%。进一步分析了真实神经培养物目前能/不能产生的活动趋势，并演示了全尺寸H1-2上的短时双足迈步。
AI.conclusion: e-prop这类局部、生物学上更可实现的在线学习规则足以匹配BPTT的控制性能，而更严格的生物约束（冻结储层、纯R-STDP）会成为性能瓶颈；提示生物合理性与高性能并非不可兼得，但取决于学习规则的选择。

title: Reference-Twist-Based Velocity-Domain Spatiotemporal Calibration for mmWave Radar, Event Camera, and IMU
comment: 17 pages, 12 figures. Code: this https URL
summary: Multi-sensor navigation requires a common spatial and temporal basis, but geometric calibration relies on targets, features, point clouds, or pose associations that are difficult to establish across mmWave radars, event cameras, and inertial measurement units (IMUs). These sensors nevertheless share rigid-body motion. This paper formulates reference-conditioned velocity-domain spatiotemporal calibration for a rigid suite of two mmWave radars, one event camera, and two IMUs. Given a trusted reference body twist, radar Doppler, event normal flow, and inertial measurements are regressed against the same motion to estimate relative rotations, lever arms, time offsets, and sensor-specific bias and scale without artificial targets, structure from motion, or cross-modal point-cloud registration. The reference is treated as a conditioning input rather than a sensor to be calibrated. We compare joint and reference- conditioned estimation, derive conditional identifiability and CRLB-level covariance and bias bounds, and state the operating conditions under which conditioning is informative. Indoor and forest recordings with axis-separated motion evaluate initial- ization, temporal alignment, motion degeneracy, reference-input sensitivity, and residual consistency. Because the reference does not add physical observability, the estimates remain conditional on reference accuracy, synchronization, motion excitation, and projection diversity.

AI.tldr: 针对两枚毫米波雷达、一个事件相机与两个IMU组成的刚性传感器组，提出"参考条件化"的速度域时空标定：以可信的参考体旋量为条件输入，将雷达多普勒、事件法向流与惯性量回归到同一运动上，联合估计相对旋转、杆臂、时间偏移及各传感器偏置与尺度。
AI.motivation: 异构传感器（毫米波雷达、事件相机、IMU）间缺乏可共享的几何标定基元：靶标、特征、点云与位姿关联均难以跨模态建立；但它们在刚体运动上是耦合的。因此希望绕开人工靶标、SfM与跨模态点云配准，仅在速度域利用共同运动完成标定，并厘清"参考输入"在何种条件下才带来信息增益。
AI.method: 将参考体旋量作为条件变量（而非待标定传感器），把雷达多普勒速度、事件相机法向流与IMU测量统一回归到同一运动模型，求解相对旋转、杆臂、时间偏移及传感器特定偏置/尺度；对比联合估计与参考条件化估计两种方案，推导条件可辨识性、CRLB级协方差与偏置界，给出条件化具有信息量的工作条件；在室内与林区场景采集轴分离激励运动，评估初始化、时间对齐、运动退化、参考输入敏感性与残差一致性。
AI.result: 给出条件可辨识性分析与CRLB级协方差/偏置下界，明确条件化标定有效的工作区间；室内与林区轴分离运动实验验证了初始化、时间对齐、运动退化与残差一致性，并量化了估计对参考精度与时间同步的敏感性。结论是参考并不增加物理可观测性，估计仍以参考精度、同步性、运动激励充分性与投影多样性为前提。
AI.conclusion: 该文建立了速度域参考条件化多模态时空标定的形式化框架与误差界，说明在无靶标、无跨模态配准条件下可实现异构传感器组标定，但精度上界受参考信号质量制约，属条件性标定而非绝对可观测标定。

title: Dynamic Human-Robot Role Allocation through Entropy-Based Monitoring and LLM Reasoning
summary: Role allocation strategies in human-robot collaboration typically assign tasks to both the human and the robot, limiting the user's ability to take initiative. Furthermore, allocation decisions may conflict with the user's intentions, and the rationale behind such allocations may remain unclear, potentially reducing both acceptance and collaboration fluency. The novelty of the proposed framework is that the human is left free to contribute to the task, while the robot is dynamically allocated activities through a cost-driven Behavior Tree architecture according to user-expressed preferences and behavior. Explicit preferences are extracted from natural language instructions using a large language model, whereas human activity is monitored online through a Shannon entropy-based analysis of hand-object interactions. Furthermore, the framework can recognize anomalies in human execution and autonomously trigger corrective robot actions. The approach was validated through a pilot study and a multi-subject experiment involving 14 participants. Results demonstrate the potential of such an allocation strategy for enabling intuitive and engaging collaboration without increasing the perceived workload.

AI.tldr: 提出一种成本驱动的行为树人机协作任务分配框架：人类可自由参与任务，机器人依据自然语言表达偏好（LLM解析）与基于Shannon熵的手-物交互在线活动监测动态分配自身行动，并能识别人类执行异常并自主触发纠错动作；14人实验显示协作更直观流畅且不增加主观工作负荷。
AI.motivation: 传统角色分配同时给人机指派任务，限制用户主动性；分配决策可能与用户意图冲突且缺乏可解释依据，降低接受度与协作流畅性。
AI.method: 成本驱动的Behavior Tree架构做动态活动分配；用大语言模型从自然语言指令中提取显式偏好；用基于Shannon熵的手-物交互分析在线监测人类活动；支持人类执行异常识别并自主触发机器人纠正动作。通过试点研究与14人多被试实验验证。
AI.result: 14名被试的多被试实验（含试点）表明该分配策略可实现直观、投入的协作，且未增加感知工作负荷。
AI.conclusion: 保留人类自由度的成本驱动行为树分配结合LLM偏好理解与熵驱动活动监测，是一种可行的人机协作角色分配方案；但缺乏定量任务绩效指标与真实复杂场景验证。

title: Frequency-Synchronized Boundary Coupling for Training-Free Multi-Prompt Long Video Generation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: Text-to-video generation has made remarkable progress with diffusion models and transformer-based video architectures, yet generating coherent long videos from evolving textual descriptions remains challenging. Training long-video models from scratch requires substantial computation and large-scale multi-event data, while training-free multi-prompt generation must activate new prompt semantics without breaking temporal continuity. We identify a frequency-agnostic boundary coupling problem in existing transition strategies: weak coupling causes abrupt changes, flicker, and background jumps, whereas overly strong or coarse coupling may over-preserve source semantics and produce ghosting or duplicated subjects around prompt boundaries. To address this problem, we propose FreqSync, a training-free framework that formulates prompt transitions as frequency-selective boundary coupling. FreqSync combines Frequency-Synchronized Source-Conditioned Attention (FS-SCA) with Residual-Clipped Spectral Stitching (RCSS), enabling adjacent segments to share stable low- and mid-frequency structure and motion cues while keeping high-frequency prompt-specific details target-dominant under explicit residual constraints. Extensive experiments show that FreqSync achieves state-of-the-art transition smoothness and prompt alignment while maintaining strong perceptual video quality, demonstrating its effectiveness for coherent multi-prompt long video generation.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练框架 FreqSync，将多提示词长视频生成的提示切换建模为频域选择性边界耦合，用 FS-SCA 与 RCSS 让相邻片段共享低/中频结构与运动、高频细节由目标提示主导，实现平滑过渡与高提示对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频生成需从零训练大模型（算力与多事件数据成本高）；免训练多提示词拼接则面临"频率无关的边界耦合"问题：耦合过弱导致突变、闪烁、背景跳变，耦合过强/过粗则过度保留源语义，在边界处产生鬼影或重复主体。
AI.method: 免训练框架，将提示过渡形式化为频率选择性边界耦合：Frequency-Synchronized Source-Conditioned Attention (FS-SCA) 在注意力层面对源片段条件进行频率同步；Residual-Clipped Spectral Stitching (RCSS) 在频谱域做残差裁剪拼接，低/中频共享结构运动线索，高频残差显式受限以保持目标提示主导。
AI.result: 大量实验表明在过渡平滑性和提示对齐上达到 SOTA，同时保持较强感知视频质量，验证其在连贯多提示长视频生成上的有效性（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。
AI.conclusion: 频域选择性耦合是缓解多提示长视频边界失真的有效免训练思路，可作为长视频生成后处理/拼接的通用过渡策略，但证据集中于生成质量指标，与物理 AI/机器人/3D 重建无直接关联。

title: UniVEP: Unifying Velocity and Endpoint Prediction for Robot Manipulation
summary: Flow-matching robot policies usually use one prediction target throughout action generation, even though recovering actions from noise and polishing nearly clean actions bring different challenges. We systematically compare velocity prediction (V), endpoint prediction (X), and velocity-weighted endpoint prediction (X--V) across multiple robot policies, benchmarks, and inference budgets. On StarVLA and LiLa-WAM, X--V works best for few-step generation, while V gains more from iterative refinement. We further uncover their complementary strengths across noise levels: clean actions have concentrated covariance spectra, endpoint predictions stay more stable under high noise, and velocity predictions offer more accurate corrections near clean actions. Inspired by these findings, we introduce UniVEP, which learns both prediction targets together with consistency supervision and switches from endpoint recovery to velocity refinement as noise drops. Each step only needs one network run, and joint training also boosts single-step endpoint generation. Tests on simulated and real-world manipulation show better success rates and efficiency. On RoboTwin, UniVEP hits 61.36% success with one StarVLA run, beating the best single-target baseline at sixteen runs (59.96%). With LiLa-WAM, two runs outperform the best sixteen-step single-target baseline and cut inference latency by 77.1%.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了机器人流匹配策略中的速度预测(V)、端点预测(X)与速度加权端点预测(X−V)三种目标，发现不同噪声水平下二者互补，据此提出联合训练并随噪声降低从端点恢复切换到速度精修的统一框架UniVEP，每步仅需一次网络前向。
AI.motivation: 现有flow-matching机器人策略在整个动作生成过程中只使用单一预测目标，但从噪声中恢复动作与打磨接近干净的动作所面临的挑战本质不同，缺少对预测目标的系统分析和自适应方案。
AI.method: 在StarVLA与LiLa-WAM等多个策略、基准和推理预算下系统对比V、X、X−V三种预测目标；观察到干净动作协方差谱集中、高噪声下端点预测更稳定、近干净动作处速度预测修正更准；据此提出UniVEP，联合学习两种目标并加入一致性监督，随噪声下降从端点恢复切换到速度精修，单步仅一次网络运行。
AI.result: RoboTwin上UniVEP以一次StarVLA推理达61.36%成功率，超过最佳单目标基线十六步的59.96%；与LiLa-WAM结合时两次运行即超越最佳十六步单目标基线，推理延迟降低77.1%；仿真与真实世界操作任务均显示成功率与效率提升。
AI.conclusion: 预测目标的互补性可被显式利用：端点与速度预测在不同噪声区间的优势可统一到单一策略中，从而在极少步数下同时获得高成功率与低延迟，且联合训练还能提升单步端点生成能力。

title: PhysVAM: Physics-oriented Future Value Action Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation
comment: 23 pages, 10 figures. Project page: this https URL
summary: Predicting future scene or object states does not necessarily reveal how robot-object interactions will advance or hinder a task. This challenge is particularly pronounced in dynamic robotic manipulation, where objects continue moving during perception and execution. Effective action generation therefore requires not only modeling object dynamics but also anticipating how future interactions will shape task progress. To this end, we propose \textbf{PhysVAM}, a Physics-oriented Future Value Action Model that represents anticipated interactions through their effects on future task progress. This value-based formulation provides task-directed foresight without reconstructing future visual states. Conditioned on current observations and historical object and robot motion, PhysVAM jointly learns action generation and multi-horizon future-value prediction. The value branch learns horizon-specific latent representations through future task-value prediction from successful and failed trajectories. These future-value representations are integrated into the action policy through gated cross-attention, guiding action generation toward interactions that facilitate task success. Extensive simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate superior task success, with absolute success-rate improvements of 27.0 and 27.5 percentage points over the strongest baselines in simulation and real-world tasks, respectively. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: PhysVAM 提出面向物理的未来价值动作模型：不重建未来视觉状态，而以"未来任务价值"作为预测表征，联合学习动作生成与多时间尺度未来价值预测，并通过门控交叉注意力把价值表征注入动作策略。
AI.motivation: 动态机器人操作中，物体在感知与执行期间持续运动；单纯预测未来场景/物体状态并不能说明交互将如何推进或阻碍任务。因此需要一种任务导向的"预见性"，而非昂贵的未来视觉重建。
AI.method: 以当前观测与历史物体/机器人运动为条件，单一模型联合学习：(1) 动作生成策略；(2) 多 horizon 未来任务价值预测分支，价值分支从成功/失败轨迹中学习各 horizon 特有的隐表征；(3) 通过门控交叉注意力将未来价值表征融合进动作策略，引导生成有利于任务成功的交互动作。属于 value-based world-action model 范式。
AI.result: 仿真与真实机器人实验中任务成功率均优于最强基线，绝对提升分别为 27.0 与 27.5 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 以价值预测替代视觉未来重建是一种高效的任务导向预训练/表征方式，可直接提升动态操作策略的成功率；但摘要未披露价值分支训练细节、horizon 设计与消融规模。

title: HiUni: Harmonizing Understanding and Generation in Shared Visual Space
summary: Unified multimodal models aim to support visual understanding and generation within a single framework. However, prevailing approaches often separate their visual representations or backbone computation to accommodate the different requirements of these two tasks, which limits the degree of unification. In this paper, we present HiUni, which revisits this design choice and explores whether a pretrained vision language model can be directly extended into a unified model with extensive parameter sharing. Specifically, HiUni reuses the same language-aligned ViT and dense Transformer backbone for both capabilities, while confining task-specific computation to the output side. Yet such a design introduces two key challenges. Generation in pixel space is difficult to optimize, and semantic abstraction in pretrained ViT discards fine spatial details required for synthesis. To address these challenges, HiUni introduces a \emph{Pixel Diffusion Head} tailored to direct pixel-space optimization and a lightweight \emph{HiGate} pathway that provides fine-grained spatial details near the output stage. Extensive experiments show that HiUni achieves a similar average understanding score to the pretrained VLM while attaining competitive performance on image generation and editing. Controlled comparisons and analyses further demonstrate that a single dense backbone can effectively support both capabilities without task-specific backbone computation, highlighting a simpler path toward unified multimodal modeling.

AI.tldr: HiUni 探索用单一预训练 VLM（共享 ViT 与密集 Transformer 主干）同时做视觉理解与像素级生成，仅在输出端加任务专用头：Pixel Diffusion Head 与轻量 HiGate。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态统一模型通常为理解与生成分离视觉表征或主干计算，统一程度受限；作者希望验证预训练 VLM 能否在大量参数共享下直接扩展为统一模型。
AI.method: 理解与生成共享同一 language-aligned ViT 和稠密 Transformer 主干，把任务特化计算限制在输出侧：引入面向像素空间直接优化的 Pixel Diffusion Head 缓解像素空间生成难优化的问题；引入轻量 HiGate 支路在输出阶段补回 ViT 语义抽象所丢失的细粒度空间细节。
AI.result: 平均理解得分接近原始预训练 VLM，同时在图像生成与编辑上取得有竞争力的表现；对照实验与分析显示单一稠密主干无需任务特化主干计算即可支撑两种能力。
AI.conclusion: 统一的密集主干足以同时支持视觉理解与生成，为更简洁的统一多模态建模提供了可行路径。

title: Learning Reconstruction Errors as Spatiotemporal Evidence for AI-Generated Video Detection
summary: The proliferation of AI-generated videos has raised growing concerns about misinformation, fraud, and potential societal risks, creating an urgent need for detection. Reconstruction-error-based methods have shown strong empirical performance for AI-generated image detection by exploiting discrepancies between an input and its reconstructed version. Their extension to video detection, however, faces two challenges: (i) a fixed reconstructor is not optimized for the detection objective and may yield weak discriminative signals; and (ii) an additional raw-video feature stream is often introduced to model temporal dependencies, increasing architectural overhead. To address these challenges, we develop a detector that learns and exploits reconstruction errors as a unified source of spatiotemporal evidence. First, we jointly optimize a reconstructor and the downstream classifier to produce reconstruction errors that are more informative for detecting AI-generated videos. Second, we show that consecutive reconstruction errors alone carry temporal evidence, and thus a 3D convolution over them captures spatiotemporal evidence without a raw-video stream. Extensive experiments on over 30 existing AI-video generators demonstrate competitive performance against baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出联合优化重建器与分类器的AI生成视频检测器，仅用连续重建误差经3D卷积获取时空证据，无需原始视频特征流，在30余种生成器上competitive。
AI.motivation: AI生成视频带来的虚假信息与欺诈风险亟需检测手段。基于重建误差的方法在图像检测上有效，但迁移到视频面临两个问题：固定重建器非面向检测目标、判别信号弱；引入原始视频特征流建模时序带来额外架构开销。
AI.method: 联合优化重建器与下游分类器，使重建误差对检测更具判别性；论证连续帧重建误差本身蕴含时序信息，对其施加3D卷积即可捕获时空证据，从而省去原始视频流分支。
AI.result: 在30多个现有AI视频生成器上进行大量实验，性能与基线相比具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 重建误差可作为统一的时空证据来源，端到端优化重建器与分类器可在不增加架构开销的情况下实现有效的AI生成视频检测。

title: Better Retrieval, Not Better Binding: Pretraining Exposure in Egocentric Video Retrieval
summary: Video-language models (VLMs) achieve strong performance on video-text retrieval and are increasingly used for egocentric video understanding. Yet, despite gains in zero-shot retrieval, they have shown limitations in compositional understanding, and it remains unclear whether they understand compositional relationships between verbs and nouns. In this work, we introduce Ego-ExBind, a compositional diagnostic protocol for analyzing pretraining exposure and verb-noun binding in egocentric video-text retrieval. Ego-ExBind consists of an Exposure Ledger built from the EgoClip pretraining corpus used by EgoVLPv2, which defines Seen Composition, Unseen Composition, and Unseen Atom splits for EPIC-KITCHENS-100 multi-instance retrieval (MIR). We further probe noun and verb binding channels through controlled noun-swap and verb-swap negatives. We find that zero-shot retrieval is positively associated with pair exposure within seen compositions, even after controlling for the marginal frequencies of verbs and nouns. However, higher pair exposure is associated with larger noun-swap margins and slightly smaller verb-swap margins. This asymmetry motivates us to test whether exposure reweighting can improve retrieval with little change in the measured swap margins. To isolate the effect of exposure input, we keep the trained checkpoint fixed and replace only the exposure input at inference. We demonstrate that this exposure reweighting can improve video-text retrieval without stronger verb-noun compositional understanding, and that the gain depends on the correct sample-level exposure correspondence. By separating exposure-driven retrieval gains from verb-noun binding, Ego-ExBind provides a diagnostic framework for evaluating whether future improvements in egocentric MIR reflect compositional understanding rather than pretraining familiarity.

AI.tldr: Ego-ExBind：面向自我中心视频-文本检索的组合性诊断协议，用 Exposure Ledger 划分 Seen/Unseen 组合与原子，并通过名词/动词替换负样本与推理期曝光重加权，区分"预训练熟悉度"与"动名绑定理解"。
AI.motivation: EgoVLPv2 等 VLM 在零样本 MIR 上进步明显，但组合性理解（动词-名词绑定）是否真正提升并不清楚；既有增益可能来自预训练语料中样本对级别的曝光记忆，需将二者解耦诊断。
AI.method: ①构建 Ego-ExBind 协议：基于 EgoClip 预训练语料构建 Exposure Ledger，定义 Seen Composition / Unseen Composition / Unseen Atom 三种划分，用于 EPIC-KITCHENS-100 多实例检索；②设计名词替换与动词替换的受控负样本，分别探测两路绑定通道；③在控制动词、名词边际频率后做偏相关分析；④受限检查点固定，仅在推理期替换曝光输入做重加权消融。
AI.result: 零样本检索与 seen 组合内的样本对曝光正相关（控制边际频率后仍成立）；曝光越高，名词替换 margin 越大，而动词替换 margin 略小，呈现不对称；仅重加权曝光输入可提升检索，但并未增强动名组合理解，且收益依赖正确的样本级曝光对应关系。
AI.conclusion: 检索增益与组合理解可被分离；Ego-ExBind 提供了判断未来自我中心 MIR 提升究竟来自组合性理解还是预训练熟悉度的诊断框架，对 VLM 评测方法论有参考价值，但不提供模型或训练层面的新方法。

title: Spatially Conditioned Trajectory Diffusion
summary: Multi-Robot Motion Planning (MRMP) requires trajectories that avoid environmental obstacles and collisions between robots in a shared workspace. Diffusion-based planners often address obstacle avoidance through sampling-time guidance, while some conditioned approaches aggregate map geometry into a global representation. We present Spatially Conditioned Trajectory Diffusion (SCTD), a map-conditioned trajectory generator for multi-robot planning. SCTD retains multiple position-aware occupancy tokens accessed through cross-attention throughout a temporal U-Net, with hard endpoint inpainting enforcing start and goal states. One model trained on single-robot demonstrations across procedural environments generates obstacle-aware trajectories without sampling-time obstacle-cost guidance. High-level Conflict-Based Search (CBS) coordinates these trajectories through constrained replanning, retaining inter-agent guidance during sampling and reusing the model across workspace layouts and team sizes. Experiments assess single-robot success and trajectory quality, generalization to unfamiliar layouts with added obstacles, and coordinated multi-robot planning. On 15,000 held-out tasks, SCTD achieves higher success than the evaluated guided diffusion baseline, with the largest gains on hard-detour tasks, while trajectory-quality comparisons show smoother trajectories. Conditioning ablations show higher success with spatial tokens than with a global map embedding, and map-replacement tests demonstrate dependence on the supplied geometry. The resulting multi-robot system achieves higher team success than the compared diffusion baselines, with experiments covering teams of up to 15 robots.

AI.tldr: 提出空间条件轨迹扩散（SCTD）：以多位置感知占用token经cross-attention注入时间U-Net，配合端点硬性inpainting约束起终点，单机器人数据训练的单一模型即可生成避障轨迹，再由CBS做高层协调实现多机器人规划。
AI.motivation: 扩散规划器多依赖采样期引导处理避障，或把地图压成单一全局表示，损失空间细节且需推理时额外引导成本；同时需在多变布局与团队规模下复用同一模型。
AI.method: 保留多个位置感知occupancy token，在整个时间维U-Net中通过cross-attention访问地图；硬性endpoint inpainting强制起终点；仅用程序化环境中的单机器人示范训练一个模型，无需采样期避障代价引导；上层用Conflict-Based Search以约束重规划协调各机器人，采样期保留智能体间引导。
AI.result: 15,000个留出任务上成功率高于所评估的引导式扩散基线，hard-detour任务增益最大，轨迹更平滑；消融显示空间token优于全局地图嵌入，地图替换测试证明对给定几何的依赖性；多机器人系统团队成功率高于对比扩散基线，团队规模扩展至15台机器人。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度空间条件化可替代采样期引导，兼具避障能力与平滑性，并与经典CBS组合为可扩展、可跨布局与团队规模复用的多机器人规划框架。

title: CryoGaussian: Heterogeneous Cryo-EM Reconstruction Made Explicit with Gaussian Splatting
summary: Single-particle cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) determines macromolecular structures from noisy particle images. However, rare, transient compositional states and subtle, continuous conformational variation are difficult to resolve. We present CryoGaussian, a Gaussian splatting method for heterogeneous cryo-EM reconstruction that fits an explicit Gaussian density representation directly to the particle images through a differentiable rasterizer rendering orthographic line integrals modulated by the contrast transfer function. The Gaussians are initialized randomly, with their number derived from the estimated spatial support of the molecular density and their minimum size bounded by the Nyquist frequency of the particle images. To capture the compositional and conformational variation across particle images, we learn particle-image and per-Gaussian latents that jointly modulate the base position, amplitude, and scale of each Gaussian. Each structural state is then reconstructed by fitting the Gaussians conditioned on its inferred latent. On CryoBench, CryoGaussian achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction accuracy for both compositional and conformational heterogeneity. On experimental data, it resolves a rare compositional state of the 50S ribosomal subunit (class C4, 1.3% of particles) with rRNA helix 68 docked in the absence of the central protuberance, and continuous conformational motion of the SF3b and helicase subcomplexes of the pre-catalytic spliceosome. We further optimize the rasterizer for additive cryo-EM projection, reducing training time by 12.8-28.0$\times$.

AI.tldr: CryoGaussian 用可微分高斯泼溅显式表示直接拟合冷冻电镜粒子图像，学习粒子级与高斯级潜变量以刻画组成与构象异质性，并优化光栅化器提速 12.8–28 倍。
AI.motivation: 冷冻电镜单颗粒重建中，稀有瞬态组成状态与细微连续构象变化难以解析，需要能同时刻画离散组成异质性与连续构象异质性的重建方法。
AI.method: 以随机初始化的一组显式高斯密度作为表示，数量由分子密度空间支撑估计决定、最小尺度由 Nyquist 频率约束；通过可微分光栅化器渲染受 CTF 调制的正交线积分并与粒子图像直接比对。学习粒子图像潜变量与每高斯潜变量，共同调制各高斯的基础位置、幅值与尺度；对给定推断潜变量条件下拟合高斯即得该结构状态。
AI.result: 在 CryoBench 上于组成与构象异质性两类任务均取得 SOTA 重建精度；在实验数据上解析出 50S 核糖体亚基稀有组成状态（class C4，占粒子 1.3%，rRNA helix 68 对接且中心突起缺失），并捕捉 pre-catalytic spliceosome 中 SF3b 与解旋酶亚复合体的连续构象运动；针对加性投影优化光栅化器，训练时间缩短 12.8–28.0 倍。
AI.conclusion: 高斯泼溅式显式表示配合潜变量调制可有效处理冷冻电镜异质重建，兼具稀有状态解析能力与显著计算效率提升，为连续构象动力学分析提供新范式。

title: Can World Models Predict Rice Growth? Toward Agricultural World Models
summary: World models can imagine how a physical scene evolves over the next few seconds, but growers need to know how a crop will develop over weeks to months: will this rice plant have headed a month from now, and how will it look at harvest? We introduce agricultural world modeling, the task of predicting how the same plant will look at a requested horizon of days to months, from one photo of it, its cultivar, and its camera view. In preliminary analysis, even state-of-the-art image generators get this wrong: they often grow the plant too little or give it the color and form of the wrong growth stage. We argue that they do not work out the plant's developmental state, which the photo reveals only indirectly. We therefore propose AgroWM, which reasons about development before it draws growth. Its reasoning module, PhenoClock, works out the current growth stage, predicts the future one, and writes a Growth Script with numeric targets for height, plant area, and color; its generation module, the Rooted Renderer, then edits the photo to follow this script, adding new organs and colors to the photographed plant. Because pixel scores can prefer an unchanged copy of the photo, we instead check each forecast's traits and developmental timing against the plant's own later photos. On rice, 54.6% of the forecasts of AgroWM are matched to the target stage (Stage R@1), against 34.8% for GPT Image 2.5, 24.0% for Qwen Image 2.1, and 47.4% for the strongest domain-specific baseline, the same backbone fine-tuned without Growth Scripts; 9 to 20 weeks ahead, it still reaches 46.4%, against 35.7% for that baseline. On maize, a crop with a different body plan and stage scale, the same design again scores best on all four measures.

AI.tldr: AgroWM: agricultural world modeling——给定单张照片、品种与相机视角，预测同一植株在数天至数月后目标时刻的样子；用PhenoClock推理发育阶段并生成带数值目标的Growth Script，再由Rooted Renderer按脚本编辑图像；在按阶段匹配的Stage R@1上显著优于GPT Image 2.5、Qwen Image 2.1及去掉脚本的强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型只能想象数秒尺度场景演化，而农业需要周-月尺度的作物发育预测；SOTA图像生成器直接"画生长"会生长不足或给出错误生育期的形态与颜色，原因是未显式推断照片中仅间接可见的发育状态。
AI.method: 提出"先推理发育、再生成形态"的两段式框架。推理模块PhenoClock推断当前生育期、预测未来生育期并写出Growth Script（株高、植株面积、颜色的数值目标）；生成模块Rooted Renderer以该脚本为条件对原照片做编辑式生成，在拍摄植株上添加新器官与颜色。评估上弃用像素指标（易偏好不变副本），改用植株后续真实照片校验性状与发育时序。
AI.result: 水稻上Stage R@1达54.6%，对比GPT Image 2.5的34.8%、Qwen Image 2.1的24.0%、去掉Growth Scripts的强域内基线47.4%；9–20周长程预测仍为46.4% vs 基线35.7%。玉米（不同株型与期尺度）上同一设计在四项指标上均最佳。
AI.conclusion: 显式发育状态推理（阶段时钟+数值生长脚本）是长时程植物生长预测的关键，可零改动迁移到不同作物；同时指出像素级指标不适合该任务，应使用性状与发育时序的一致性评价。

title: A Practical Proprioceptive Data Collection Utility for the Unitree GO1
summary: The Unitree Go1 is a widely used platform for legged robotics research, yet collecting proprioceptive data from it is unnecessarily difficult: the Unitree SDK is sparsely documented, and ROS1 (Robot Operating System), the Go1's native middleware, is fully deprecated. We present an open-source graphical utility that enables researchers to reliably record proprioceptive data from the Go1, including joint states, IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit) readings, foot force sensor data, and gyroscope measurements, without requiring ROS expertise. The tool provides a simple GUI (Graphical User Interface) for starting, stopping, and labeling recordings in real time. The contribution of this paper is the collection utility. We characterize the acquisition quality of 51 recordings collected with it, including the achieved sampling rate and repeated samples. As a secondary, deliberately modest check that the data is useful, we train a terrain classifier on it. The results are weak: a Temporal Convolutional Network reaches about 38% accuracy on held-out recordings across ten terrain classes (10% would be chance), and a window-level split that ignores recording boundaries inflates the same measurement to about 99%. We report this as a demonstration that the logged signals carry terrain information, not as a competitive classifier. The utility is designed to lower the barrier to collecting Go1 proprioceptive data without ROS.

AI.tldr: 开源GUI工具，无需ROS即可从Unitree Go1采集本体感知数据（关节状态、IMU、足端力、陀螺仪），并评估51段录制的采样质量，附带领地形分类弱基线。
AI.motivation: Go1是四足研究常用平台，但Unitree SDK文档稀疏、原生ROS1已完全弃用，导致本体感知数据采集困难。
AI.method: 开发开源图形化采集工具，提供实时启停与打标签功能；统计分析51段录制的实际采样率与重复样本；用TCN做地形分类作为数据可用性的次要验证，并对比窗口级切分与按录制切分两种评估协议。
AI.result: TCN在10类地形、按录制留出的协议下仅约38%准确率（随机10%），而忽略录制边界的窗口级切分将同一指标虚高至约99%，显示数据泄漏导致的评估膨胀。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献为采集工具本身，旨在降低无ROS环境下Go1数据采集的门槛；分类实验仅证明信号含地形信息，并非有竞争力的方法，且暴露了常见评估泄漏问题。

title: When Foundation Models Disagree: Representational Heterogeneity for Calibrated Uncertainty in Whole-Slide Image Classification
summary: Pathology foundation models supply strong representations for whole-slide image classification, yet the confidence attached to their predictions remains hard to trust. Prevailing uncertainty estimators act within a single feature space and thereby overlook the uncertainty that the choice of foundation-model representation itself induces. This work introduces CALIFUSE, a calibration-oriented framework that fuses several pathology foundation models for the specific purpose of uncertainty estimation. Departing from accuracy-driven fusion, CALIFUSE reads representational heterogeneity across encoders as an explicit confidence cue. Slide-level decision consensus is coupled with chunk-level evidence agreement quantified through Jensen-Shannon divergence, so that both prediction stability and fine-grained evidence consistency inform the estimate. Foundation-model encoders stay frozen. A task-specific nnMIL classifier is still trained for each FM; CALIFUSE then estimates confidence at inference without training an extra fusion module. Evaluated on seven WSI classification tasks under several foundation-model combinations, the framework sharpens calibration, misclassification detection, and selective prediction relative to both the strongest single-encoder baseline and naive ensemble averaging, all while preserving competitive balanced accuracy.

AI.tldr: CALIFUSE 融合多个病理基础模型的表征，把编码器间的表征异质性当作显式不确定性线索，结合切片级决策共识与 chunk 级 Jensen-Shannon 散度证据一致性做置信度校准。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型虽提供强表征，但其预测置信度不可靠；现有不确定性估计器只在单一特征空间内工作，忽略了"选择哪个基础模型表征"本身带来的不确定性。
AI.method: 冻结各病理 FM 编码器，为每个 FM 训练任务特定的 nnMIL 分类器；推理时通过切片级决策共识 + chunk 级证据一致性（JSD 度量）融合异构表征，无需额外训练融合模块，面向校准而非精度。
AI.result: 在 7 个 WSI 分类任务、多种 FM 组合下，校准质量、误分类检测与选择性预测均优于最强单编码器基线和朴素集成平均，同时保持有竞争力的平衡准确率。
AI.conclusion: 跨表征空间的不确定性可作为有效置信度信号，无训练成本的推理期融合方案在医学影像分类中提升可靠性。

title: One View, One Action: Spatially Generalizable VLAs through Observation-Aligned Experts and Cross Graph Consistency
summary: Multi-view vision-language-action (VLA) models still face challenges in spatial generalization, particularly under changes in camera viewpoints and robot initial states. These models typically receive action supervision only in the robot base frame, requiring them to implicitly learn the spatial correspondence between observations from each view and base-frame actions. We propose One View, One Action (OVOA-VLA), which learns to predict actions in each view's camera frame, allowing the same physical motion to provide diverse, observation-aligned supervision across views. OVOA-VLA jointly trains a base-frame expert and view-specific action experts, whose robot-state inputs and action targets are expressed in their respective camera frames. Two complementary directed attention graphs model both directions of interaction between the base and view-specific experts, jointly leveraging view-specific action supervision to improve base-frame prediction. Cross Graph Consistency further encourages agreement between the two graphs' base-frame predictions for the same sample. With the same multi-view inputs, the model supports both full and base-only inference. Experiments across multiple simulation benchmarks demonstrate improved manipulation performance and robustness to camera-viewpoint and robot-initialization perturbations. Full and base-only inference achieve average success rates of 88.1% and 85.7% on LIBERO-Plus, respectively. In real-world evaluations, base-only inference raises the average success rates from $\pi_{0.5}$'s 28.3% to 58.3% across three tasks under spatial distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: OVOA-VLA让每个相机视角各自预测本视角坐标系下的动作，并联合训练基座帧专家与视角专家，通过双向有向注意力图与跨图一致性提升空间泛化。
AI.motivation: 多视角VLA模型仅在机器人基座坐标系下受动作监督，需隐式学习各视角观测与基座帧动作间的空间对应，导致相机视角与初始位姿变化下的空间泛化不足。
AI.method: 提出OVOA-VLA：在每个视角相机帧内预测动作，使同一物理运动为不同视角提供观测对齐的多样化监督；联合训练基座帧专家与各视角动作专家（机器人状态输入与动作目标均在各自相机帧表达）；用两个互补的有向注意力图建模基座与视角专家间的双向交互；引入Cross Graph Consistency促使两图在同一基座帧预测上一致；共享多视角输入，支持full与base-only两种推理。
AI.result: 多仿真benchmark上操作性能提升，对相机视角与机器人初始位姿扰动更鲁棒；LIBERO-Plus上full与base-only平均成功率88.1%/85.7%；真实世界三任务在空间分布偏移下，base-only推理将平均成功率从π0.5的28.3%提升至58.3%。
AI.conclusion: 以视角帧动作监督替代单一基座帧监督，可在不改变推理输入的条件下显著增强VLA的空间泛化能力，仿真与真机均验证有效。

title: MultiBinder: Preventing Multi-Subject Identity Leakage in Personalized Video Generation
summary: Personalized video generation faces a significant scalability challenge: as the number of custom subjects increases, existing methods suffer from severe identity leakage and semantic entanglement, resulting in videos with blended attributes and incoherent narratives. We identify that this stems from a lack of explicit binding between textual entity phrases and their corresponding visual patterns prior to fusion in diffusion models. To address this, we propose MultiBinder, a novel framework built on a ``bind-then-narrate'' paradigm. Our approach introduces a two-stage conditioning process before video diffusion. First, Cross-modal Entity Binding devises an entity-aware Q-Former to extract identity-centric features from each subject's reference image and tightly align them with its unique entity phrase, yielding disentangled ``identity tokens.'' Second, a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) acts as a ``narrative director'' in the Narrative-Aware Subject Arrangement stage, capturing the action of each subject from the text prompt and synthesizes contextualized subject features that encapsulate ``who is doing what'' and preserve role-specific distinctions. These features are then injected into a video diffusion model via dedicated conditioning pathways, ensuring precise attribute allocation. Extensive experiments on both general and newly curated multi-subject benchmarks show that MultiBinder significantly outperforms existing methods in multi-subject identity fidelity.

AI.tldr: MultiBinder提出"先绑定后叙事"范式：先用实体感知Q-Former将每个主体的参考图像特征与其唯一实体短语对齐，生成解耦的身份token；再用MLLM作为"叙事导演"将动作与主体绑定，最后通过专用条件通路注入视频扩散模型。
AI.motivation: 个性化视频生成在多主体数量增加时出现严重的身份泄漏与语义纠缠（属性混合、叙事不连贯）。作者将成因归结为扩散模型融合之前，文本实体短语与对应视觉模式之间缺乏显式绑定。
AI.method: 两阶段条件化：(1) Cross-modal Entity Binding——实体感知Q-Former从每个主体参考图提取身份中心特征，并与独特实体短语紧密对齐，得到解耦的identity tokens；(2) Narrative-Aware Subject Arrangement——MLLM作为叙事导演，从文本提示解析各主体动作，合成编码"谁在做什么"的上下文化主体特征。这些特征通过专用条件通路注入视频扩散模型实现精确属性分配。构建了新的多主体基准。
AI.result: 在通用基准与新建多主体基准上，MultiBinder在多主体身份保真度上显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式短语-视觉绑定是解决多主体个性化视频生成中身份泄漏与语义纠缠的关键机制；分发式条件注入可提升可扩展性。

title: StreamEgo: Streaming Exocentric-to-Egocentric Video Generation
summary: Exocentric-to-egocentric (Exo2Ego) video generation transforms third-person recordings into first-person viewpoints, unlocking immersive AR/VR experiences and scalable demonstration synthesis for embodied robotics. Extending it to a streaming setting is expected to further enable live applications. However, existing methods suffer from degraded manipulation regions, overfitting and confinement to fixed-length clips with prohibitive latency. To address these limitations, we present StreamEgo, a real-time framework for unbounded, generalizable Exo2Ego video generation. To resolve intricate manipulation dynamics while supporting the streaming pipeline, a streaming dual-branch prior provides pixel-aligned guidance for translating appearance and skeletal kinematics. We also introduce a region-aware loss curriculum to improve generalization and stabilize multi-objective diffusion training. Furthermore, we distill the model into a chunk-wise autoregressive model, augmented with a region-aware corruption mechanism and a first-chunk curriculum, enabling high-quality, generalizable real-time streaming Exo2Ego generation at 24.3 FPS on a single H100 GPU.

AI.tldr: StreamEgo 提出实时、无长度限制且可泛化的外中心到自中心（Exo2Ego）视频生成框架：用流式双分支先验（外观+骨架运动学）提供像素对齐引导，配合区域感知损失课程，并蒸馏为 chunk-wise 自回归模型，单张 H100 达 24.3 FPS。
AI.motivation: Exo2Ego 转换可利用第三人称视频生成第一人称视角，服务 AR/VR 与具身机器人示教数据合成；但现有方法在操作区域质量退化、过拟合、仅支持定长片段且延迟过高，无法支撑在线/实时应用。
AI.method: 1) 流式双分支先验：分别建模外观与骨架运动学，为转换提供像素对齐引导，以还原复杂操作动态；2) 区域感知损失课程（region-aware loss curriculum）：提升泛化性并稳定多目标扩散训练；3) 将模型蒸馏为 chunk-wise 自回归模型，辅以区域感知扰动机制与首 chunk 课程，实现流式实时推理。
AI.result: 在单张 H100 GPU 上以 24.3 FPS 实现高质量、可泛化、实时的流式 Exo2Ego 生成；缓解操作区域退化、过拟合与固定长度片段限制，支持无界长视频生成。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以流式双分支先验+区域感知训练+自回归蒸馏的组合，将 Exo2Ego 从离线定长生成推进到实时流式、无长度约束且可泛化的设定，为具身机器人示教数据合成与沉浸式交互提供可行路径。

title: Planning to Stop: Factored Certification and Terminal Repair for Noncircular Robots
summary: Tight-space navigation requires a robot to clear obstacles and stop inside its goal despite uncertainty. We present GeoDiff, a motion-program planner coupling original-goal stopped-set inclusion, witness-guided terminal repair, and factored proof compilation. An exact feasible-translation characterization guides repair; request-local reuse reduces repeated geometric work. We establish conditions for compiler equivalence and reach-and-stop soundness. Across 11,440 floorplan-derived jobs, GeoDiff certifies 61/139 tasks at 5-cm tolerance within 15 s, versus 44/139 for the stop-set baseline. The strongest observed external certificate adapter certifies 13/139 tasks from 119/139 native routes, separating route availability from certification. On tasks derived from public BARN maps, GeoDiff certifies 202/270 at 5-cm tolerance for a Jackal-shaped body, versus 3/270 for the portal baseline. Development analyses distinguish emitter savings from solver coverage, and 1,420 route-tracking episodes characterize the execution interface. These results show how terminal reasoning and proof reuse increase finite-budget certification coverage while preserving the original physical task and goal.

AI.tldr: GeoDiff 是一个紧空间导航的运动程序规划器，耦合"原始目标停驻集包含"（original-goal stopped-set inclusion）、witness 引导的终端修复与因子化证明编译，用于在有限预算内完成"到达并停住"的形式化认证。
AI.motivation: 紧空间导航要求机器人在存在不确定性时既能避障、又能停在目标内部，而仅凭路由（route）存在并不等于可认证的"到达并停止"。作者希望把终端停驻推理与几何证明复用结合起来，在有限算力/时间内提升认证覆盖率，同时不改变原始物理任务与目标（不做目标松弛）。
AI.method: 1) 精确的可行平移（feasible-translation）刻画用于引导终端修复；2) witness 引导的 terminal repair，与"原目标停驻集包含"约束耦合，保证修复后仍是原始物理目标；3) 因子化证明编译（factored proof compilation）配合 request-local 复用，减少重复几何计算；4) 理论上给出编译器等价性与 reach-and-stop 可靠性的成立条件；5) 与停驻集（stop-set）基线、portal 基线及外部证书适配器对比，并做 emitter 节省与 solver 覆盖的消融分析，外加 1,420 次路线跟踪实验刻画执行接口。
AI.result: 在 11,440 个由平面图派生的任务中，GeoDiff 在 15 s 内以 5 cm 容差认证 61/139 任务，停驻集基线为 44/139；最强外部证书适配器可从 119/139 条原生路由中认证 13/139，说明"路由可用性"与"认证能力"是可分离的。在公共 BARN 地图、Jackal 形体的 270 个任务上认证 202/270（5 cm 容差），portal 基线仅 3/270。
AI.conclusion: 终端停驻推理与证明复用能显著提升有限预算下的认证覆盖率，且保持原始物理任务和目标不被改写；路由存在不等于可认证，证明编译与停驻集包含是紧空间导航认证的关键环节。工作偏形式化运动规划与验证，缺乏真实机器人部署证据。

title: SpatialScout-V2: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore Real-World 3D Scenes and Localize Objects?
summary: Spatial intelligence requires agents to acquire visual evidence and integrate partial observations into coherent three-dimensional representations. We introduce SpatialScout-V2, which extends SpatialScout's active mapping task from simulation to real residential scenes through three advances: real visual observations, preservation of original scene content, and interactive exploration of recorded views. Built from 100 homes in Realsee3D, the benchmark covers 3,171 target objects across 29 categories. Given a fixed target inventory, agents autonomously select recorded viewpoints and viewing directions, integrate calibrated RGB observations, and iteratively estimate and revise object centers within a fixed interaction budget. We evaluate the localization accuracy and completeness of object-center maps using mean IoU, IoU-threshold hit rates, and target coverage. Evaluating seven frontier vision-language models (VLMs), we find that six achieve an all-target mean IoU below 20\%. Even the best-performing model, Claude Opus 5.5, reaches only 22.52\%, with just 18.36\% of targets exceeding an IoU of 0.5. Further analysis shows that broad submission coverage can coexist with limited localization accuracy, while target omissions further reduce overall scores. These results highlight substantial challenges in constructing accurate and complete object-center maps through active exploration of real scenes.

AI.tldr: SpatialScout-V2 将主动建图基准从仿真扩展到 100 个真实住宅场景（Realsee3D），要求智能体在固定交互预算内主动选择已录视角与朝向，融合 RGB 观测并迭代估计/修正 29 类共 3171 个目标物体的中心点图；七个前沿 VLM 中六个全目标平均 IoU 低于 20%，最佳模型仅 22.52%。
AI.motivation: 空间智能需要智能体主动获取视觉证据并将部分观测整合为一致的三维表征，但现有主动建图评测多停留在仿真、合成或篡改场景内容，缺乏对真实住宅中"主动探索—目标定位完整性"能力的可信度量。
AI.method: 构建基于 Realsee3D 的 100 个真实住宅数据集，保留原始场景内容，并提供可交互查阅的已录视角；任务设定为给定固定目标清单与固定交互预算，智能体自主选择视点与视角、融合标定 RGB 观测，迭代估计并修正物体中心；采用 mean IoU、IoU 阈值命中率与目标覆盖率三项指标评测七个前沿 VLM。
AI.result: 六个模型的全目标 mean IoU 低于 20%，最优 Claude Opus 5.5 仅 22.52%，IoU>0.5 的目标占比 18.36%；分析显示"提交覆盖广"与"定位精度低"可并存，目标遗漏进一步拉低总分，即精度与完整性双重不足。
AI.conclusion: 在真实场景的主动探索中构建准确且完整的物体中心图仍是重大挑战，现有 VLM 尚不具备可靠的空间主动感知能力；该基准为后续方法（如探索策略、证据融合与显式三维记忆）提供评测基础。

title: FlexVSR: Continuous-Scale Super-Resolution for Streaming Video Generation
summary: Real-time streaming video generation has gained rapid momentum in live content creation and interactive media. Deploying such systems in practice requires flexible scaling factors to accommodate diverse source resolutions, target displays, and computational budgets. However, extending fixed-scale generative video super-resolution (VSR) to varying target scales poses two challenges: downsampling from a larger fixed scale incurs redundant cost, while re-optimizing the diffusion transformer (DiT) is costly and alters the shared generative prior. To address both, we propose FlexVSR, a decoupled framework for continuous-scale streaming generative VSR with supervision at only a few scales. Our key insight is that naively resampling fixed-scale latents onto a new target grid induces scale-dependent input mismatch, which can be effectively addressed through parameter-efficient, scale-aware adaptation of the latent interface without updating the DiT. To this end, FlexVSR introduces ReLSA (Refined Latent Scale Adaptation), a lightweight latent adapter that constructs and refines target-grid latents before they enter the DiT, enabling a shared frozen VSR prior to generalize across continuous scales with only 0.274M trainable parameters and an adaptation cost of 7.3 H100 GPU-hours, while introducing no additional temporal dependencies and preserving the native causal streaming protocol. Extensive experiments demonstrate competitive or superior reconstruction and temporal quality, lower latency than most native-scale streaming baselines and offline methods, and effective generalization to unseen continuous scales, filling the continuous-scale gap in real-time streaming generative VSR.

AI.tldr: FlexVSR：冻结 DiT，用 0.274M 参数的轻量潜空间适配器 ReLSA 在目标网格上重建/细化 latent，实现仅需少数尺度监督下的连续尺度实时流式生成式视频超分。
AI.motivation: 实际部署流式生成式 VSR 需要可变的缩放因子以适配不同源分辨率、显示端与算力预算；但固定尺度模型向下采样存在冗余计算，重新训练 DiT 代价高且破坏共享生成先验。
AI.method: 解耦框架：不更新 DiT，而是把固定尺度的 latent 重采样到新目标网格，并识别由此产生的"尺度相关的输入失配"；提出 ReLSA（Refined Latent Scale Adaptation）轻量 latent 适配器，在 latent 进入 DiT 之前构建并细化目标网格 latent，实现参数高效、尺度感知的接口适配；不引入额外时序依赖，保留原生因果流式协议。
AI.result: 仅 0.274M 可训练参数、7.3 H100 GPU-小时适配成本；在重建与时间一致性质量上具有竞争力或更优，延迟低于多数原生尺度流式基线与离线方法，并能泛化到未见过的连续尺度。
AI.conclusion: 以极低代价将固定尺度流式生成式 VSR 扩展为连续尺度，填补了实时流式生成式 VSR 的连续尺度空白，为部署提供了实用的尺度可扩展方案。

title: RegionAgent: Two-Stage Preference Optimization for Regional Image Restoration
summary: Images under non-uniform coupled degradations require diverse restoration capabilities for different degraded regions. Existing methods employ globally uniform operations, potentially overlooking regional differences and causing incomplete restoration or even damage to image content. Moreover, a degraded region may require successive restoration actions, and earlier actions may alter residual degradation characteristics or introduce artifacts, potentially hindering subsequent restoration. To address these challenges, we propose RegionAgent, an adaptive restoration framework that trains a Vision-Language Model (VLM) through two-stage preference learning to generate a region-specific restoration action at each iteration. Specifically, we first train the VLM to select an action suited to the current region through step-level Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), using preferences derived from immediate restoration feedback to supervise only the differing component in each action pair. To account for the effects of current actions on subsequent restoration, we then apply trajectory-level DPO, using preferences derived from complete trajectory scores to supervise the sole differing action in each trajectory pair. Furthermore, as conventional image-pair datasets do not directly provide preferences over regional restoration decisions, we construct a regional restoration preference dataset comprising 10K action pairs and 20K trajectory pairs for two-stage VLM training. Experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate strong restoration performance under both mixed and single degradations. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of two-stage preference learning in improving restoration quality.

AI.tldr: RegionAgent 提出用 VLM 通过两阶段偏好学习（step-level DPO + trajectory-level DPO）在每次迭代生成区域自适应的图像修复动作，并构建了 10K 动作对与 20K 轨迹对的区域修复偏好数据集。
AI.motivation: 非均匀耦合退化图像的不同区域需要差异化修复，而现有方法采用全局统一操作，忽略区域差异，易造成局部修复不彻底甚至破坏内容；同时同一区域需连续多次修复，先前动作会改变残余退化特性或引入伪影，阻碍后续修复。
AI.method: 训练 VLM 作为区域级决策器：先用来自即时修复反馈的偏好做 step-level DPO，仅监督动作对中不同部分，选出适配当前区域的动作；再用完整轨迹评分导出的偏好做 trajectory-level DPO，仅监督轨迹对中唯一不同的动作，以建模动作对后续修复的影响；并构建 10K 动作对 + 20K 轨迹对的区域修复偏好数据集。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，混合退化与单一退化场景均取得较强修复性能；消融实验验证两阶段偏好学习对修复质量提升的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以 VLM 驱动的区域级、多步迭代修复策略优于全局统一操作，分层偏好学习可有效利用局部反馈与长程轨迹信号。

title: Invertible Transport Between Sample-Only Distributions via Projected Characteristic Functions
summary: Many useful latent distributions can be sampled but do not have a tractable density. Such distributions may be represented by empirical collections of real-world observations or generated by scientific simulators and black-box generative models. These sample-only priors cannot be used directly in likelihood-based normalizing flows, which require evaluating the prior density. We propose Projected Characteristic-Function matching (PCF), a density-free framework for learning an invertible map between a data distribution and a prior specified only through samples. Our method aligns distributions using projected empirical characteristic functions, eliminating the need for density estimation, adversarial training, or paired observations. To address the non-uniqueness of the transport map, we introduce an optional transport regularizer that selects lower-displacement transformations while preserving endpoint alignment. We benchmark PCF on controlled transports, sample-efficiency studies, and high-dimensional alignment tasks. PCF matches the accuracy of kernel MMD on the controlled benchmark and on raw-pixel MNIST--USPS at a cost linear in the batch size, and it is more sample-efficient, achieving lower endpoint error than MMD in 13 of 15 paired runs across library sizes. By avoiding pairwise kernel evaluation, it reduces discrepancy memory by 29.8% and trains at batch sizes where kernel MMD exceeds GPU memory. These results show that PCF provides accurate and efficient invertible transport, particularly in sample- and memory-limited settings.

AI.tldr: PCF：用投影经验特征函数对齐分布，实现"仅样本先验"下的可逆（normalizing flow）传输学习，无需密度估计、对抗训练或配对数据。
AI.motivation: 许多有用的潜分布只能采样、无法写出可积密度（经验样本集、科学仿真器、黑箱生成模型），而基于似然的 normalizing flow 需要可评估的先验密度，因此这类"仅样本先验"无法直接使用。目标是构建一个无密度（density-free）可逆映射框架。
AI.method: 以投影经验特征函数（projected empirical characteristic function）作为分布差异度量，对齐数据分布与样本先验；完全绕开密度估计、对抗判别器与配对观测；针对传输映射的非唯一性，引入可选的传输正则项，在保持端点对齐的前提下偏好低位移变换。批内计算成本随 batch 线性增长，无需成对核评估。
AI.result: 在受控传输基准上与 kernel MMD 精度相当；在原始像素 MNIST–USPS 上持平且成本线性；15 组跨库规模配对实验中 13 组端点误差低于 MMD（样本效率更高）；内存占用降低 29.8%，并可在 kernel MMD 已超 GPU 显存的 batch 规模下训练。
AI.conclusion: PCF 给出一种准确、高效、可逆的"样本先验→数据"传输方案，尤其适用于样本受限与内存受限场景，可作为 flow 类模型中密度无关先验对齐的通用替换模块。

title: Backbone Matters: Benchmarking Encoder-Decoder Networks for Semantic Segmentation of Driving Scenes on BDD100K
summary: Semantic segmentation gives an autonomous vehicle a dense, pixel-level description of its surroundings and is a core part of scene understanding. Most segmentation networks consist of an encoder (the backbone) and a decoder, yet the backbone is often chosen without a systematic comparison. This work studies this choice on the BDD100K driving dataset. Four widely used decoders (U-Net, FPN, LinkNet and PSPNet) are combined with 13 backbones from six families (ResNet, VGG, DenseNet, Inception, MobileNet and EfficientNet), and all 52 models are trained with one common protocol. The best model, an FPN decoder with an EfficientNet-B4 backbone, reaches 62.6% mean intersection over union (mIoU), 89.8% accuracy and a loss of 0.092. Only two of the 52 models, both FPN with EfficientNet, exceed the 56.9% mIoU reported with the BDD100K benchmark. The effect of the backbone depends strongly on the decoder: the same EfficientNet-B4 gives 42.6% mIoU with PSPNet but 62.6% with FPN, and the gap between the best and the worst backbone ranges from 12.0 points (U-Net) to 42.5 points (FPN). The results and the scope of this study are discussed.

AI.tldr: 在BDD100K驾驶数据集上系统比较4种解码器(U-Net/FPN/LinkNet/PSPNet)与6个家族13种骨干,共52个模型统一训练;最佳为FPN+EfficientNet-B4,62.6% mIoU。
AI.motivation: 分割网络多为"骨干+解码器"结构,但骨干选择常缺乏系统性对比;作者在自动驾驶语义分割场景下对此做受控实验。
AI.method: 固定训练协议,将4种解码器与13种骨干(ResNet、VGG、DenseNet、Inception、MobileNet、EfficientNet)两两组合成52个模型,在BDD100K上训练并评测mIoU、精度与损失。
AI.result: 最优为FPN+EfficientNet-B4:62.6% mIoU、89.8% 准确率、loss 0.092;仅2个模型超过基准56.9% mIoU。骨干效应强烈依赖解码器:同一EfficientNet-B4在PSPNet下仅42.6%,在FPN下62.6%;最佳与最差骨干差距从12.0点(U-Net)到42.5点(FPN)。
AI.conclusion: 骨干与解码器存在显著交互,不能孤立选择骨干;需按解码器联合选型,并讨论研究范围与局限。

title: A version of the Cloude/van Zyl decomposition for full/quad pol synthetic aperture radar data
summary: Based on the Cloude/van Zyl decomposition of reflection symmetric polarimetric SAR data we present a version for full/quad polarisation data. We demonstrate both versions on X-band F-SAR data over Vejers, Denmark. Differences between the original and our version of the decomposition occur especially for very bright man-made targets. These differences come with lower entropy for our version giving an improved focus on a more pronounced dominant scattering mechanism for these objects. Interpretation of the scattering mechanism related to the full/quad pol version of the decomposition is facilitated by means of the Cloude/Pottier $\bar{\alpha}$ angle.

AI.tldr: 提出适用于全极化/四极化数据的 Cloude/van Zyl 极化分解扩展版本，并在丹麦 Vejers 的 X 波段 F-SAR 数据上与原版对比验证。
AI.motivation: 原始 Cloude/van Zyl 分解仅针对反射对称极化 SAR 数据，无法直接用于全极化/四极化数据，因此需要给出适用于全极化数据的分解版本。
AI.method: 基于 Cloude/van Zyl 分解框架构建全极化/四极化版本，并用 X 波段 F-SAR 实测数据对两个版本进行对照实验；借助 Cloude/Pottier 平均 α 角辅助解释全极化版本所对应的散射机制。
AI.result: 两版本在高亮度人造目标处差异显著；新版本给出更低的熵，使这些目标的主导散射机制更突出、聚焦更好。
AI.conclusion: 全极化版本可作为反射对称版本的推广，在强散射人造目标上表现出更明确的散射机制区分，α 角可为其散射机理解释提供便利。

title: EmbodyAgent: Post-Training Embodied VLM Agents via Distillation, SFT, and RL
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures. Code-as-policy robot-use agent post-training
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can act as closed-loop robot-use agents (RUAs) by writing and executing control code through tool interfaces. However, turning an open-weight VLM into a high-performing embodied agent requires a complete post-training stack: out-of-the-box open VLMs fail completely at interactive tool contracts, strong frontier teachers are accessible only as black-box endpoints without exposed weights or token probabilities, and supervised imitation alone plateaus under rollout distribution shift. We present EmbodyAgent, an end-to-end post-training framework with three tightly coupled pipelines: (1) a black-box data synthesis pipeline that queries a strong teacher under a forced think-then-code contract and filters trajectories by task success; (2) an SFT pipeline that distills the explanation-and-program targets into an open-weight 9B VLM with both vision and language encoders trainable; and (3) an online RL pipeline that optimizes student-generated episodes via group-relative advantage with a runtime-error-penalized outcome reward. All three pipelines share one primitive-free Python execution tool exposing only raw visual observation and seven-dimensional end-effector control, with no action decoder and no interface shift across stages. Under a strictly separated evaluation protocol on ten LIBERO Spatial tasks (disjoint state splits, greedy test-time decoding, training-only safeguards), held-out success on 100 test states rises from 0/100 (base 9B VLM) to 14/100 (after SFT) and 84/100 (after RL), while training rollout success climbs from 8.4% to 87.7% and median model calls per episode drop from 36 to 11. We further identify a self-reinforcing runtime-error mode induced by outcome-based RL on executable code, and establish a failure-category monitoring and sampling-side curation protocol that stabilizes training.

AI.tldr: EmbodyAgent 提出端到端后训练框架：黑盒教师数据合成（强制 think-then-code + 成功率过滤）→ SFT 蒸馏到 9B 开源 VLM（视觉/语言编码器全可训）→ 在线 RL（组相对优势 + 运行时错误惩罚的结果奖励）；三阶段共用同一"原语无关"Python 执行工具（仅原始视觉观测 + 7 维末端控制）。
AI.motivation: 开源权重 VLM 直接作为机器人智能体在交互式工具契约上完全失败；强前沿教师仅以黑盒端点形式可用（无权重、无 token 概率），无法直接蒸馏 logits；纯监督模仿在 rollout 分布漂移下性能饱和。需要一个统一工具接口下的完整后训练栈。
AI.method: 三管线紧耦合：(1) 黑盒合成——在强制"先思考后写码"契约下查询教师，按任务成功过滤轨迹；(2) SFT——将解释+程序目标蒸馏进 9B 开源 VLM，视觉与语言编码器均训练；(3) 在线 RL——对学员自生成 episode 用 group-relative advantage 优化，结果奖励中惩罚运行时错误。全流程共享一个无原语的 Python 执行工具，只暴露原始视觉观测与 7 维末端执行器控制，无动作解码器、无接口切换。评估协议严格分离（不相交状态划分、贪心解码、仅训练期保护措施）。
AI.result: LIBERO Spatial 十任务、100 个留出测试状态成功率：基线 9B VLM 0/100 → SFT 14/100 → RL 84/100；训练 rollout 成功率 8.4% → 87.7%；每 episode 中位模型调用从 36 降至 11。另识别出结果型 RL 作用于可执行代码所诱发的自强化运行时错误模式，并给出失败类别监控 + 采样侧筛选协议以稳定训练。
AI.conclusion: 黑盒教师数据 + SFT 蒸馏 + 在线 RL 的统一后训练栈可在单一工具接口下大幅提升开源 VLM 的闭环机器人代码智能体能力；但结果奖励 RL 在可执行代码上会产生错误模式自强化，需配套监控与采样策展；工作仍限于 LIBERO 仿真基准（10 任务/100 状态），缺少真机与跨任务泛化证据。

title: Learning to Think with Images Faithfully via Adaptive Data Selection
summary: Thinking with images (TwI) empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to overcome perceptual bottlenecks by actively cropping and zooming into fine-grained visual details, promising both higher accuracy and interpretable, region-grounded reasoning. However, our analysis shows that the improved accuracy of TwI models does not guarantee faithful tool use; they frequently invoke tools without actually relying on the zoomed region, undermining the reliability of tool-assisted reasoning. We trace this unfaithful behaviour to the training data: when questions are answerable without zooming, the model can answer correctly while ignoring the returned evidence, and this problem is exacerbated during training as the model becomes better at answering without tools. To keep zooming useful throughout training, we adapt the training data to the model's evolving capability and train on questions where correct zoomed evidence can still help the model answer correctly. This selection is supported by a data synthesis pipeline that localises small objects and constructs verifiable questions about their fine details, and complemented by an adaptiveness reward that favours tool-free answers when zooming is unnecessary. The experimental results show that our method substantially improves reasoning faithfulness and achieves state-of-the-art performance on visual search benchmarks (+11.6% on V*, +7.9% on HR-Bench 4K, and +9.4% on HR-Bench 8K). On multimodal hallucination benchmarks, our model also outperforms the compared TwI baselines. These results suggest that improving TwI faithfulness does not sacrifice accuracy and that both can be learnt from the right training data without directly supervising the reasoning process.

AI.tldr: 针对"Thinking with images"类VLM中工具调用不忠实(调用裁剪回放但不依赖其证据)的问题，提出按模型能力动态筛选训练数据+数据合成管线+自适应性奖励，提升推理忠实度并在高分辨率视觉搜索基准上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: TwI模型虽通过主动裁剪/放大提升精度，但常出现"调用工具却不依赖缩放区域"的不忠实行为，削弱工具辅助推理的可信性；作者将其归因于训练数据中"无需缩放即可答对"的样本，且训练中模型无工具能力变强会加剧该问题。
AI.method: 1) 随训练进程与模型能力演化自适应地筛选训练问题，保留"正确缩放证据仍能带来增益"的样本；2) 数据合成管线：定位小目标并围绕其细粒度细节构造可验证问题；3) 引入自适应性奖励，在无需缩放时偏好无工具作答。
AI.result: 视觉搜索基准显著提升：V* +11.6%，HR-Bench 4K +7.9%，HR-Bench 8K +9.4%；在多模态幻觉基准上亦优于对比的TwI基线；未出现精度—忠实度权衡。
AI.conclusion: TwI忠实性可与精度同时从合适的数据中学得，无需对推理过程直接监督；关键在于让缩放证据在整个训练过程中保持"有用"。

title: Learn, Freeze, and Transfer an Activation Function Across Architectures
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables. Code: this https URL , Interactive figures: this https URL
summary: Transfer learning typically reuses knowledge acquired by a source network through its learned weights. We investigate whether a learned activation function can also be transferred and remain useful in networks trained from scratch. We study this complementary form of transfer through a learn-freeze-transfer protocol, in which the activation is optimized jointly with a source network in a single training run, and is then frozen and reused in target networks trained from scratch. A pointwise activation with globally shared parameters is independent of layer dimensions and can therefore be incorporated into networks of different architectures trained from scratch. We instantiate this protocol with FAct, a five-parameter activation represented by a two-harmonic truncated Fourier series, initialized from a Fourier approximation of GELU and learned in a Vision Transformer (ViT) on ImageNet-1K. When reused in a ViT of the same architecture trained from scratch on ImageNet-1K, the frozen activation (Frozen FAct) improves top-1 accuracy by 1.46 percentage points over GELU. Across four smaller target architectures (standard ViT, Swin Transformer, linear-attention ViT, and MLP-Mixer) and four image-classification datasets, it achieves the highest mean accuracy among eleven activation functions in 15 of 16 settings under a common training configuration, with improvements of up to 1.71 percentage points over the best conventional activation. When the learning rate and weight decay are tuned separately for each activation under the same search budget, Frozen FAct still ranks first in 11 of the 16 settings, second in four, and fourth in one. These results provide empirical evidence that a learned activation function can retain its usefulness when transferred across vision architectures, independently of the weights with which it was learned.

AI.tldr: 提出"学习-冻结-迁移"协议，验证在ViT上学习到的全局共享五参数激活函数FAct（两谐波截断傅里叶级数）冻结后可迁移到不同视觉架构并稳定超过GELU等11种激活函数。
AI.motivation: 迁移学习通常只复用源网络权重，作者想探究"激活函数"这一与层维度无关的知识是否也能被学习并冻结迁移，形成一种互补的迁移形式。
AI.method: 在单次训练中把点式、全局共享参数的激活与源网络联合优化（源为ImageNet-1K上的ViT，FAct由GELU的傅里叶近似初始化），随后冻结该激活，插入到从零训练的四个较小目标架构（标准ViT、Swin、线性注意力ViT、MLP-Mixer）与四个分类数据集上，与11种激活函数在统一训练配置下比较，并做了等预算逐激活超参搜索的对照实验。
AI.result: 同架构ViT迁移提升top-1 1.46个百分点；16个设置中15个平均精度最高，最高超最佳常规激活1.71个百分点；在等预算分别调学习率与权重衰减后仍11次第一、4次第二、1次第四。
AI.conclusion: 学习到的激活函数可脱离其学习时的权重，跨视觉架构保持有效性，为"激活级迁移"提供了实证支持。

title: SpecWM: Turning Verification into Refinement for Streaming World Models
summary: Recently, video world models have advanced interactive generation, with large models offering higher quality and smaller models enabling faster inference. Existing speculative methods combine their strengths through fast draft generation and selective target regeneration guided by rewards on decoded frames. However, verification covers only the external scorer's evaluation dimensions and adds decoding and scoring costs. Moreover, these scores provide no correction, requiring costly target regeneration for rejected drafts. To address these limitations, we propose Speculative World Model (SpecWM), a unified, training-free inference framework for streaming world models. It verifies draft chunks using the target's latent velocity field. Verification also yields a reusable correction; two thresholds select Accept, Refine, or Reject. Specifically, one-step refinement reuses it to improve perceptual quality, while three-step refinement strengthens camera following and trajectory consistency. These findings motivate transition-aware refinement. On WBench Navigation, SpecWM improves visual quality at 1.63$\times$ speedup over the target and raises NavScore from the draft's 75.99 to 85.63, achieving the best quality-speed-control trade-off. Additionally, our LongSpecBench shows sustained quality and control over long, multi-turn rollouts, while experiments on Hy-Nomas validate SpecWM across backbones and denoising budgets.

AI.tldr: SpecWM：无需训练的流式世界模型投机推理框架，用目标模型的潜空间速度场验证草稿块并复用其作为修正信号，双阈值路由至Accept/Refine/Reject，实现1.63×加速且提升导航控制质量。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型的投机采样依赖解码帧上的外部奖励打分，验证仅覆盖评分器维度且引入解码与打分开销；更重要的是分数不提供修正信息，被拒草稿只能触发昂贵的目标模型重生成。
AI.method: 在潜空间而非解码帧上验证：利用目标模型的速度场对草稿块进行一致性检验，验证残差直接作为可复用的修正量；设置两个阈值实现三路路由（接受/精化/拒绝），其中一步精化提升感知质量，三步精化增强相机跟随与轨迹一致性，并据此引入过渡感知的精化策略；全程无需训练。
AI.result: WBench Navigation上视觉质量提升、达1.63×加速，NavScore由草稿的75.99升至85.63；LongSpecBench显示长时多轮 rollout 下质量与控制可持续；Hy-Nomas实验验证跨骨干与不同去噪预算的通用性。
AI.conclusion: 将验证从解码后外部评分转至潜空间速度场并复用验证残差作为修正，可同时降低开销、避免完整重生成，在质量—速度—可控性三角上取得更优折中，属于通用、即插即用的推理时加速范式。

title: MixReact: Physics-Based Reactive Humanoid Control from Multimodal Cues via a Discrete-Continuous Mixture of Transformers
summary: Humanoid agents in everyday environments are expected to react to diverse cues as humans do, with semantically appropriate and physically executable behaviors. Existing cue-driven reaction generation methods support only a narrow range of cue modalities and are limited to purely kinematic generation, leaving the resulting reactions susceptible to physical artifacts. To this end, we present MixReact, the first unified framework for physics-based reactive humanoid control from text, audio, and video cues, integrating a Discrete--Continuous Mixture of Transformers (DisCo-MoT) for state prediction with a History-aware Action Transformer (HAT) for physical execution. DisCo-MoT couples a discrete masked-modeling branch with a continuous autoregressive diffusion branch via one-way mixture attention within a MoT architecture. Guidance from discrete context mitigates collapse into averaged behaviors in one-to-many reaction generation, while direct prediction in continuous state space bypasses the decoding bottleneck of discrete representations. HAT then maps the predicted next state and observed execution history to executable actions, enabling robust closed-loop control in physics-based simulation. Experiments across all three modalities demonstrate consistent improvements over the baselines in fidelity, diversity, and physical consistency, while ablations validate the complementary contributions of the components. Our code will be released to facilitate future research. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: MixReact：首个统一的多模态线索（文本/音频/视频）驱动的物理仿真人形反应生成框架，用 DisCo-MoT 做状态预测、HAT 做历史感知动作执行。
AI.motivation: 现有线索驱动反应生成仅支持单一模态且为纯运动学生成，结果易出现物理伪影（穿模、漂浮、非物理接触），缺乏可物理执行、语义合适的反应。
AI.method: DisCo-MoT：在 Mixture-of-Transformers 中耦合离散掩码建模分支与连续自回归扩散分支，以单向混合注意力让离散上下文引导连续状态预测，兼顾多样性与避免均值坍缩；HAT（History-aware Action Transformer）将预测的下一状态与执行历史映射为可执行动作，实现物理仿真中的闭环控制。
AI.result: 在三种模态上较基线在保真度、多样性与物理一致性上均有稳定提升；消融实验验证各组件互补贡献。摘要未给出定量指标或真实机器人验证。
AI.conclusion: 统一的多模态线索到物理可执行人形反应的框架，为感知驱动的角色/人形运动生成与物理仿真结合提供了可行范式，但证据限于仿真与量化指标，缺少实机部署。

title: Attention Drift Regularization with Adaptive Initialization for Domain-Robust Visual Recognition
summary: Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) adapts a pretrained source model to unlabeled target domains without source data access, yet two critical failure modes remain unaddressed. First, attention drift: source-learned attention maps shift toward spurious or background features under distribution shift, destabilizing feature representations. Second, domain-gap-agnostic initialization: applying a single fixed source model uniformly across all target domains ignores domain gap severity, causing premature overfitting to noisy pseudo-labels under large shifts. We propose DGA-CAFC to address both failures. The Counterfactual Attention-based Feature Consistency (CAFC) module enforces feature stability by minimizing the discrepancy between representations computed under learned attention and those under counterfactual-inspired normalized perturbations, thereby promoting domain-robust features independent of spurious attention shifts. The Domain-Gap Aware Source Model Selection (DGASS) module estimates domain gap severity via target prediction entropy and selects the source model variant whose confidence level best matches the estimated gap, reducing negative transfer and stabilizing pseudo-label quality. Crucially, CAFC transfers beyond SFDA: applied as a lightweight regularizer to standard domain generalization objectives without target data. Extensive experiments across SFDA and DG benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently improves over recent baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness and generality of the proposed framework. Project page is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: DGA-CAFC：用反事实注意力特征一致性（CAFC）缓解源域注意力漂移，并用基于目标预测熵的域差距感知源模型选择（DGASS）初始化，提升无源域自适应（SFDA）与域泛化的稳定性。
AI.motivation: SFDA在无源数据条件下存在两类关键失效：(1) 注意力漂移——源域学到的注意力图在分布偏移下转向虚假/背景特征，破坏特征表征稳定性；(2) 域差距不可知初始化——对所有目标域统一使用同一固定源模型，忽视域差距严重程度，在大偏移下过早过拟合噪声伪标签。现有方法未同时处理上述问题。
AI.method: 提出DGA-CAFC框架，含两个模块。CAFC（反事实注意力特征一致性）：最小化"学习注意力下的特征表示"与"反事实启发的归一化扰动下特征表示"之间的差异，以强制特征稳定性，获得不依赖虚假注意力偏移的域鲁棒特征。DGASS（域差距感知源模型选择）：以目标域预测熵估计域差距严重程度，并从多个源模型变体中选择置信度水平与该差距最匹配者，以降低负迁移、稳定伪标签质量。CAFC还可作为轻量正则项，在无目标数据情况下嵌入标准域泛化目标。
AI.result: 在SFDA与DG多类基准上，方法相对近期基线取得一致提升；CAFC作为独立正则项在DG设置下同样有效，验证了框架的有效性与通用性（摘要未给出具体数值与消融量级）。
AI.conclusion: 注意力层面的反事实一致性正则与按域差距自适应的源模型选择，是缓解SFDA中注意力漂移与负迁移的可行组合；该正则具有跨任务可迁移性，可无目标数据地用于域泛化。局限在于仅为二维视觉基准验证，缺乏机器人/具身场景与实机证据。

title: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models to Stop Safely
comment: A two-stage pipeline that teaches VLAs to stop prohibited tasks safely while preserving permitted skills
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform diverse tasks from visual observations and language instructions. While prior work has explored task suppression and refusal, stopping prohibited behavior once execution is underway and controlling the resulting physical response remain challenging. Our evaluation reveals that policies which suppress a task from its initial state can still complete it when taking over partway through execution. Even when the task remains unfinished, the robot may drop a held object, making non-completion an incomplete measure of safety. To address these challenges, we introduce State-Aware Fallback Imitation (SAFI) for tasks where holding provides an appropriate alternative response. SAFI comprises two stages, (1) fallback target construction, which assigns stationary arm commands and consistent gripper targets throughout prohibited-task demonstrations, and (2) joint policy adaptation, which learns these targets alongside the original actions of retained tasks. This supervision teaches an explicit alternative response at intermediate execution states while maintaining the robot's other skills. Extensive experiments with OpenVLA-OFT across LIBERO and BadLIBERO tasks evaluate prohibited completion, physical incidents, and retained-task performance. On the evaluated LIBERO tasks, SAFI reduces aggregate target success after takeover to 1.3\%, with no recorded physical incidents or action saturation, while preserving high retained-task success.

AI.tldr: SAFI通过两阶段方法（回退目标构建+联合策略适配）为VLA策略提供执行中途被接管时的显式替代响应，使机器人保持在原地持物而非完成任务或失手掉落。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA安全研究多关注"任务抑制/拒答"，但评测发现：从初始状态抑制成功的策略，在执行中途被接管时仍可能完成任务；即便未完成也可能掉落物体，因此"未完成"并非可靠的安全度量。需要一种在执行中间状态仍能触发安全物理响应的机制。
AI.method: 提出State-Aware Fallback Imitation（SAFI），适用于"保持持物"为合理替代响应的任务。阶段一：回退目标构建，在禁止任务演示中为所有中间状态分配固定的静止臂指令与一致的夹爪目标；阶段二：联合策略适配，与保留任务的原始动作联合训练，学习这些目标。以此在中间执行状态提供显式替代响应的监督信号，同时保留其他技能。基于OpenVLA-OFT在LIBERO与BadLIBERO上评测。
AI.result: 在被接管的LIBERO任务上，聚合目标成功率降至1.3%，无记录到的物理事故与动作饱和，且保留任务成功率保持较高水平。
AI.conclusion: 通过在执行中间状态引入可学习的"安全回退"监督，SAFI比仅初始状态抑制更有效地阻止违规行为并避免掉落等物理事故，同时不牺牲原有技能，为VLA执行期安全控制提供了可验证的方案。

title: FastRoverVLA: Fast Vision-Language-Action Execution for Off-Road Autonomous Driving
summary: Off-road vision-language-action (VLA) models generate scene-conditioned plans, but frequent trajectory updates can repeatedly invoke expensive multimodal inference. Reusing a prediction reduces this demand while leaving its commands exposed to changes in vehicle motion. FastRoverVLA addresses this mismatch by decoupling visual plan generation from motion-conditioned execution. Its training-free interface maintains decoded plans between visual predictions. A speed-curvature action buffer is aligned with measured motion at each update, integrated into a local trajectory, and advanced by consuming the current action. The corrected remainder is written back to the buffer, preserving motion corrections across successive updates. A bounded refresh rule normalizes speed and curvature variations within a newly decoded plan and assigns a short or long reuse budget according to the resulting plan-roughness score. The interface requires neither backbone features nor an additional learned driving policy. Over a 3 s horizon, independent real-request evaluation achieves average displacement error (ADE) and final displacement error (FDE) of 0.328/0.596 m on ORAD-3D and 0.266/0.526 m on RELLIS-3D, reducing FDE by 18.0% and 36.7% at request rates of 6.0% and 4.8%, respectively. These runs retain lower errors across four backbones and both datasets and reduce Qwen3-VL request-processing cost by factors of 16.6 and 20.8 under serial replay, while mechanism and motion-only controls identify persistent state correction as the main source of the observed accuracy benefit. The source code and evaluation materials are publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: FastRoverVLA 提出免训练的“视觉规划—运动条件执行”解耦接口：在两次视觉预测之间复用已解码轨迹，用速度-曲率动作缓冲随实测运动对齐、局部积分、扣减已执行动作并回写剩余量，配合基于计划粗糙度的有界刷新规则，显著降低 VLA 多模态推理调用频率与误差。
AI.motivation: 越野 VLA 需要频繁更新轨迹，反复调用昂贵的多模态推理；直接复用预测虽可省算力，但命令会随车辆运动变化而失配。目标是解耦视觉规划与运动条件执行，在不改主干、不额外训练策略的前提下兼顾低成本与精度。
AI.method: 免训练接口层：维护解码计划并在视觉预测间复用；将速度-曲率动作缓冲与每次更新时的实测运动对齐，积分成局部轨迹并随当前动作推进消耗，剩余修正量回写缓冲以跨更新保持状态修正；刷新规则按新解码计划的计划粗糙度分数归一化速度/曲率变化，并分配短或长复用预算；不需要主干特征或额外学习驾驶策略。
AI.result: 3 s 视界、独立真实请求评测：ORAD-3D 上 ADE/FDE = 0.328/0.596 m，RELLIS-3D 上 0.266/0.526 m；请求率 6.0% 与 4.8% 时 FDE 分别下降 18.0% 与 36.7%。四个主干与两个数据集均保持更低误差；串行重放下 Qwen3-VL 请求处理成本降低 16.6 倍与 20.8 倍；机制与纯运动控制实验表明持续状态修正是精度收益的主要来源。
AI.conclusion: 以极低请求率实现更准确的越野轨迹复用，证明“有界刷新 + 状态修正回写”的缓冲接口可作为即插即用加速层；代码与评测材料已公开。

title: Beyond Covers and Titles: Evidence-First Ranking for Robust Cold-Start Recommendation
summary: Short-video platforms rank new uploads before anyone has watched them, using content towers that read a video's cover, title and frames. Existing attacks on content-aware recommenders perturb pixels or features and ignore platform re-encoding, and existing defenses train against norm-bounded perturbations that neither match real edits nor preserve recommendation quality. We show with REAP, a realizable attack through {a simulated platform channel (H.264 transcoding, rescaling, cropping and JPEG)}, that packaging edits raise a cold video by 32.0 rank-percentile points in unrelated audiences.
