We then observe that cold-start ranking does not need the packaging at all: a tower that sees only the video body ranks cold items best. Building on this, we propose Evidence-First Ranking (EFR), which scores cold videos from their body, admits packaging only through a support-gated residual bounded by $\gamma$, and merges cold and warm rankings by rank percentile, yielding an exact certificate against any packaging edit. On MicroLens-100K, EFR cuts the attack gain by 81% and raises cold-start Recall@100 from 0.1133 to 0.170, while keeping the merged NDCG@10 within 4% of the undefended system.

AI.tldr: 提出冷启动推荐的真实可实施攻击REAP（经H.264转码、缩放、裁剪、JPEG信道），并用仅看视频主体的Evidence-First Ranking（EFR）防御，附精确认证保证。
AI.motivation: 现有内容感知推荐系统攻击只扰动像素/特征，忽略平台重编码；防御则针对范数有界扰动训练，既不匹配真实编辑也不保推荐质量。
AI.method: REAP：在模拟平台信道下对封面/标题/帧做包装编辑。EFR：冷视频仅由视频主体打分，包装信息只通过受support门控、以γ为界的残差引入，并以排序百分位合并冷/热排序，给出对任意包装编辑的精确认证。
AI.result: 在无关受众中冷视频提升32.0排名百分位点；MicroLens-100K上EFR将攻击收益降低81%，冷启动Recall@100由0.1133升至0.170，合并NDCG@10与无防御系统相差4%以内。
AI.conclusion: 冷启动排序本质上不需要包装信息；以视频主体为主、包装为受限残差的设计可同时获得鲁棒性与推荐质量的可证明折中。

title: Prism: Hierarchical Text Detection with Minimalist Design
summary: Hierarchical text detection aims to localize words, text lines, and paragraphs while parsing their structural relationships. It provides essential structural cues for visual text understanding. To maximize accuracy, existing methods typically rely on complex multi-scale feature fusion necks and heavy-weight heads, resulting in bloated architectures and low inference efficiency. In this paper, we argue that a sufficiently pre-trained backbone can effectively replace these sophisticated external modules, while simple geometric inclusion suffices for hierarchical text structural parsing. Thus, we propose Prism, a minimalist framework for hierarchical text detection. Prism performs multi-granularity detection by attaching parallel lightweight heads to a single-scale backbone feature map, covering words, text lines, and paragraphs, and reconstructs the structural hierarchy via an efficient geometric inclusion algorithm. In addition, we systematically compare representative lightweight head archetypes and show that pixel-level regression offers the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off in this setting. Experiments on multiple public benchmarks show that our significantly simplified architecture achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance with remarkable efficiency. Specifically, it runs $1.7\times$ faster than LRANet on CTW1500 while achieving higher accuracy, and surpasses the current SOTA method, OmniParser V2, by over 6 PQ points on the hierarchical HierText dataset. Code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: Prism：极简层级文本检测框架，单尺度骨干特征上挂并行轻量头分别检测词/行/段落，用几何包含算法重建结构层级。
AI.motivation: 现有多层级文本检测方法依赖复杂多尺度融合颈与重型头部，架构臃肿、推理效率低；作者主张充分预训练的骨干可替代这些外部模块，且简单几何包含即可完成层级结构解析。
AI.method: 在单尺度骨干特征图上附加并行轻量检测头，覆盖词、文本行、段落三个粒度；通过高效几何包含算法重建层级结构；系统对比轻量头原型，发现像素级回归在精度-效率权衡上最优。
AI.result: 在CTW1500上比LRANet快1.7倍且精度更高；在HierText层级数据集上PQ超过当前SOTA（OmniParser V2）6个点以上；简化架构下仍达SOTA并保持显著效率优势。
AI.conclusion: 充分预训练骨干+轻量并行头+几何包含解析是层级文本检测的有效极简范式，兼顾精度与效率，为视觉文本理解提供结构线索。

title: Digitization of Analogue Gauges using Computer Vision
summary: Analogue gauges remain prevalent in manufacturing industries for measuring physical quantities, yet manual monitoring by operators introduces human error and operational inefficiency. This research developed and evaluated an automated gauge reading system using computer vision and deep learning techniques. Three hybrid approaches were implemented and compared: OpenCV with Scikit-Image (traditional computer vision), OpenCV with ResNet18, and OpenCV with VGG19 (deep learning approaches). A comprehensive dataset of 1,848 pressure gauge images (0-10 BAR range) was curated through web scraping, synthetic generation, and augmentation techniques. The experimental results demonstrate that ResNet18 significantly outperforms the alternatives, achieving an accuracy of 97.3%, compared to VGG19's 64.4% and Scikit-Image's 63.8%. The study validates the effectiveness of residual learning architectures for industrial gauge digitization, providing a robust foundation for Industry 5.0 automation applications.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建并比较了三种仪表读数自动化方案（OpenCV+Scikit-Image、OpenCV+ResNet18、OpenCV+VGG19），在1848张压力表图像数据集上，ResNet18混合方案以97.3%准确率显著优于VGG19（64.4%）和传统CV（63.8%）。
AI.motivation: 制造业中模拟仪表仍广泛使用，人工读表存在人为误差与低效问题，需要自动化读数方案以支撑Industry 5.0的数字化升级。
AI.method: 构建1848张0–10 BAR压力表图像数据集（网络抓取+合成生成+数据增强），实现并对比三种混合管线：OpenCV+Scikit-Image（传统CV指针/刻度检测）、OpenCV+ResNet18、OpenCV+VGG19，通过分类/读数精度指标评估。
AI.result: ResNet18混合方案准确率97.3%，VGG19为64.4%，Scikit-Image为63.8%；残差学习架构在该域显著优于传统CV与较深VGG网络。
AI.conclusion: 残差学习适合工业仪表数字化读数任务，可作为Industry 5.0自动化的基础组件；但数据集主要为抓取与合成图像，缺少真实产线部署证据。

title: Tracking Objects Through Assembly and Decomposition
summary: Tracking objects through transformations is essential for understanding real-world dynamics. Recent work has extended traditional object tracking to detect state changes. However, existing methods require an initial object prompt and detect only its decompositions, missing assembly events, which begin with multiple objects rather than one. We therefore introduce a prompt-free formulation of this task, where the goal is to recover all object tracks and detect both decomposition and assembly events given only a video. Our key insight is that assembly is decomposition in reverse. Building on this insight, we present Atlas, a zero-shot system that constructs and jointly reasons over forward and reverse spatiotemporal partitions to recover object tracks and their transformations. We further introduce OmniST, a benchmark with dense annotations of objects and both transformation types. On OmniST, Atlas recovers more than twice as many state changes as prior methods while remaining competitive on existing benchmarks that only evaluate decomposition.

AI.tldr: Atlas：无提示（prompt-free）的视频目标跟踪与状态变化检测系统，通过构建并联合推理前向与反向时空分割（利用"组装是分解的逆过程"），同时恢复目标轨迹并检测分解/组装事件；另提出含密集标注的 OmniST 基准。
AI.motivation: 现有状态变化检测方法依赖初始目标提示，且只能检测其分解（decomposition）事件，无法处理以多物体为起点、进而发生装配（assembly）的事件。
AI.method: 提出无提示任务形式：仅给定视频，需恢复全部物体轨迹并检测分解与装配事件。核心洞察为装配是分解的逆向过程，据此构建 zero-shot 系统 Atlas，对前向与反向时空分割（spatiotemporal partitions）进行构造与联合推理；同时构建 OmniST 基准，提供物体及两类变换的密集标注。
AI.result: 在 OmniST 上恢复的状态变化数量超过此前方法两倍以上，同时在仅评测分解的现有基准上仍具备竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 逆向时空推理可有效统一分解与装配检测，实现无需初始提示的零样本物体轨迹与变换恢复，为跟踪与状态变化感知提供新范式。

title: I See You: Initial Multi-Robot LiDAR Registration with Mutual-Observation Checks
comment: Accepted final version. IEEE International Symposium on Safety, Security, and Rescue Robotics (SSRR), Incheon, South Korea, November 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: Compared to single-robot deployments, multi-robot teams can significantly improve search-and-rescue (SAR) mission success by covering large areas in parallel. To collaborate effectively, these robots must be registered in a common reference frame. Standard registration methods typically rely on external infrastructure or significant map overlap, but real deployments require infrastructure-free, stationary initial alignment for immediate operation. While global LiDAR point cloud registration addresses this, existing single-scan methods often fail silently in aliased or degenerate environments. Approaches scaling beyond two agents also remain rarely evaluated in real-world scenarios. We propose a centralized, deployment-ready framework for pre-mission multi-robot registration. Our system performs pairwise coarse-to-fine alignment and actively rejects impossible pose hypotheses via deterministic plausibility checks. We validate the framework on a real-world custom dataset of four synchronized robots in various environments with ground truth. The checks reject more than a third of the incorrect pairwise registrations while falsely rejecting less than 1% of the correct ones, and reduce the number of team registrations with a wrong robot pose by 38%. Dataset and code are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出集中式多机器人任务前配准框架：两两由粗到细对齐，并用确定性合理性检查主动剔除不可能位姿假设；在4机器人同步真实数据集上验证，剔除超1/3错误配准、误拒<1%，团队错误位姿配准数下降38%。
AI.motivation: 多机器人搜救需在统一参考系中协同，但实际部署要求无基础设施、静止状态下的即时初始对齐；单次扫描LiDAR全局配准在混叠/退化环境中常静默失效，且超过两个智能体的规模化方法缺乏真实场景评估。
AI.method: 集中式、可直接部署的预任务配准框架：成对粗到细配准（coarse-to-fine alignment），并引入确定性合理性检查（deterministic plausibility checks）主动拒绝不可能的位姿假设；在自建四机器人同步、带真值的多环境真实数据集上评估，统计拒绝率与团队级错误位姿比例。公开数据集与代码。
AI.result: 检查模块拒绝超过1/3的错误成对配准，同时误拒正确配准低于1%；团队级含错误机器人位姿的配准数量减少38%。
AI.conclusion: 表明无基础设施的多机器人初始配准可通过显式假设检验获得实用可靠性，为多机器人SAR部署提供可复现基准与开源数据。

title: LocoMuJoCo: A Comprehensive Imitation Learning Benchmark for Whole-Body Control
comment: 26 pages, 11 figures, 4 tables. Code: this https URL
summary: LocoMuJoCo is an open-source benchmark for imitation learning (IL) and reinforcement learning (RL) on whole-body control. The library couples MuJoCo (CPU) with MJX and the MjWarp backend (GPU) under a single API, exposes 9 humanoid, 3 (musculo-)skeletal, and 4 quadruped embodiments, and ships a curated native motion-capture dataset for every humanoid, to which it can also retarget AMASS and LAFAN1. A modular plug-in architecture makes observations, rewards, control modes, terrains, and domain randomization fully interchangeable, while compact JAX implementations of many RL and IL algorithms provide JIT-compiled end-to-end training, and the companion loco-mujoco-real repository provides sim-to-real deployment. We describe the design, the SMPL-to-robot and robot-to-robot retargeting pipeline, and a usage example. LocoMuJoCo is released under MIT at this https URL .

AI.tldr: LocoMuJoCo：统一 CPU(MuJoCo) 与 GPU(MJX/MjWarp) 后端的全身控制模仿学习/强化学习开源基准，含 16 种具身、配套动捕数据与 AMASS/LAFAN1 重定向，并提供 JAX 算法与 sim-to-real 部署仓库。
AI.motivation: 全身控制（人形/四足/骨骼肌）的 IL 与 RL 研究缺乏统一、可复现的基准：后端（CPU/GPU）割裂、具身与数据格式各异、重定向与域随机化等组件难以复用，导致算法比较与复现成本高。
AI.method: 1) 单一 API 耦合 MuJoCo(CPU) 与 MJX/MjWarp(GPU) 后端；2) 提供 9 个人形、3 个（肌）骨骼、4 个四足共 16 个具身；3) 每个人形配备原生动捕数据集，并支持 AMASS 与 LAFAN1 重定向（SMPL-to-robot、robot-to-robot 流水线）；4) 模块化插件架构，使观测、奖励、控制模式、地形与域随机化可互换；5) 紧凑 JAX 实现多种 RL/IL 算法，JIT 编译端到端训练；6) 配套 loco-mujoco-real 支持 sim-to-real 部署。
AI.result: 论文为系统/工具类工作，主要给出设计说明、两阶段重定向流水线与使用示例，未报告算法性能对比类的量化结果；以 MIT 许可开源发布，具备端到端 JIT 训练与实机部署路径。
AI.conclusion: LocoMuJoCo 提供了可复用、可扩展的全身控制 IL/RL 基准与工具链，降低跨具身算法比较与 sim-to-real 的门槛；但其价值主要在于基础设施与数据管线，缺乏方法层面的新洞见，适合作为人形/移动操作的实验平台参考。

title: BADAS-3.0: Real-Time Driving Perception and Planning from One Camera
summary: We ask how far a driving model can get with one camera and real-time latency. BADAS-3.0 is a 1B-parameter video encoder with four small heads. From two seconds of one forward camera, it predicts the current speed, the metric path just driven, a collision-risk score and six candidate futures over 6.4 seconds, in under 50 ms. Given the car's current speed, BADAS-3.0 has 44% lower minADE$_6$ over five trajectory benchmarks than the 34B Alpamayo 2 Super, which reads six cameras and runs over 100x slower. The gain comes from camera rigs that neither model was trained on. On the rig they share, the two are on par. Existing benchmarks are mostly nominal driving, so we add two open-loop safety benchmarks, one of real dashcam collisions and near-misses and one of Euro NCAP scenarios. On both, BADAS-3.0 has a higher pass rate than every published planner we tested.

AI.tldr: BADAS-3.0：1B 参数视频编码器 + 4 个轻量头，用单目前视相机 2 秒输入、<50ms 延迟预测车速、已行驶米制轨迹、碰撞风险分与 6 条 6.4s 候选未来，并在新增的两个开放环安全基准上超越所有已发表规划器。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶模型依赖多相机与大模型、推理慢，且基准多为理想化常规驾驶，缺乏对安全关键场景（真实碰撞/近失、法规测试场景）的评测，作者希望探究"单相机 + 实时延迟"条件下驾驶模型性能的上限。
AI.method: 1B 参数视频编码器提取 2 秒单目前视视频特征，后接四个小型预测头：当前速度回归、米制历史轨迹、碰撞风险打分、6 路多模态未来轨迹（6.4s）；强调实时（<50ms）；并构建两个开放环安全基准（真实行车记录仪碰撞/近失事件；Euro NCAP 场景）。
AI.result: 在车辆当前速度已知条件下，跨五个轨迹基准 minADE₆ 比 34B、六相机、慢 100× 以上的 Alpamayo 2 Super 低 44%；提升主要来自两者均未训练过的相机配置（跨 rig 泛化），在共享 rig 上二者持平；在两个安全基准上通过率高于所测全部已发表规划器。
AI.conclusion: 单目 + 实时的小模型可在外推相机配置与安全关键场景上胜过大规模多相机模型，说明跨 rig 鲁棒性与安全指标应成为驾驶世界模型评测重点；但对比存在相机配置与速度先验条件差异，需谨慎解读绝对优势。

title: SKILL.PNG: Learning Agent Skills in Pixel Space
summary: AI agents are commonly specialized for new tasks and domains using skills, i.e. natural language instructions placed in their context. However, the discrete nature of textual skills prevents continuous optimization. Gradient-based approaches such as finetuning, on the other hand, are typically model-specific, preventing skill transfer across different agents. Since many agents today are built on vision-language models (VLMs), we can address these limitations by introducing this http URL : a method for obtaining skill-like image inputs whose pixels are optimized with gradient descent through the vision encoder of a frozen VLM. Image skills are compatible with any VLM, and a single image can be optimized jointly for an ensemble of models. We show that this http URL significantly outperforms state-of-the-art textual skills optimized using frontier LLMs in 9 of 16 settings (across 4 VLMs and 4 benchmarks) while requiring only 64 to 256 image tokens instead of roughly 900 to 2000 text tokens at inference time. Hybrid skills, i.e. text and image skills jointly optimized, further improve agent performance. Moreover, an image optimized with an ensemble of VLMs can successfully transfer across the models in the ensemble. this http URL thus presents the first agent skill that can be optimized with gradient descent while retaining transfer benefits of text skills. Our code is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: 提出"图像技能"(image skills)：通过冻结VLM的视觉编码器反传梯度，优化出可注入上下文的图像输入作为技能表示，可与文本技能混合，并支持跨模型集成优化与迁移。
AI.motivation: 文本技能是离散的、无法连续优化；微调等梯度方法又与具体模型绑定、无法跨智能体迁移。希望在保留文本技能可迁移性的同时获得梯度优化能力。
AI.method: 以自然语言技能为初始化，构建与技能等价的图像输入，其像素通过冻结VLM视觉编码器梯度下降优化；可对多个VLM组成集成联合优化单张图像；也可与文本技能联合优化构成混合技能（hybrid skills）。
AI.result: 在4个VLM、4个基准共16个设置中，有9个设置显著优于前沿LLM优化的SOTA文本技能；推理时仅需64–256个图像token，而文本技能约需900–2000 token；混合技能进一步提升性能；集成优化得到的图像技能可在集成内各模型间成功迁移。
AI.conclusion: 图像技能是首个既可梯度优化、又保留文本技能迁移优势的智能体技能形式，为通用视觉-语言智能体提供轻量、可跨模型复用的技能适配方式。

title: Exposure-Aware Informative Path Planning Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper addresses the finite-budget exposure-aware informative path planning (IPP) problem for a fleet of mobile sensing agents. The agents map an unknown scalar field while limiting exposure to high field intensity. Existing IPP methods optimize informativeness under motion or resource constraints, but do not address field exposure constraints. We formulate exposure-aware IPP (EA-IPP) as a scalarized bi-objective belief-state Markov decision process that trades the normalized Gaussian-process (GP) information gain against a normalized measurement-derived fleet exposure index. A parameter-shared proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework with decentralized actors and a centralized fleet critic is trained offline and evaluated on unseen fields. Across the radar, plume, and wildfire field families, the EA-IPP agent achieves the lowest GP reconstruction RMSE among the evaluated baselines while retaining D-optimal information within $10\%$ of the non-learning information baseline. The minimum field exposure is approximately $34.6\%$, $20.1\%$, and $27\%$ below the non-exposure-aware baseline for radar, plume, and wildfire, respectively.

AI.tldr: 将有限预算下的"暴露感知"信息路径规划(EA-IPP)建模为标量化双目标信念MDP，用共享参数PPO(去中心actor+集中式车队critic)在GP信息增益与测量导出的车队暴露指数间权衡，离线训练后泛化到未见标量场。
AI.motivation: 现有IPP方法只优化运动/资源约束下的信息量，忽略了对高场强区域的暴露约束；而实际传感agent（如雷达、羽流、野火）需要兼顾建图精度与安全性。
AI.method: 构建belief-state MDP，以归一化GP信息增益与归一化测量派生暴露指数构成标量化双目标奖励；采用参数共享PPO，去中心化actor、集中式fleet critic，离线训练，在radar/plume/wildfire三类未见场上评估，与信息基线和非暴露感知基线对比。
AI.result: 在三类场上EA-IPP取得最低GP重建RMSE，同时D-最优信息量保持在不学习的非学习信息基线10%以内；最低场暴露分别比非暴露感知基线低约34.6%(radar)、20.1%(plume)、27%(wildfire)。
AI.conclusion: 说明多智能体RL可在信息-暴露权衡中同时提升重建精度与安全性，但仅在仿真标量场上验证，缺乏真机/部署证据。

title: C-LiTE: A Lightweight Foundation Model for Cellular feature learning in Histopathology
summary: Characterising individual cells is fundamental to computational pathology, as cellular morphology informs tasks such as tumour grading, mitotic assessment and immune profiling. However, most pathology foundation models are trained on tissue patches and capture cellular features only implicitly, while existing cell-level models are either restricted to specific cell populations or rely on computationally expensive architectures with hundreds of millions of parameters. Applying ViTs directly to small cellular crops also presents an architectural challenge: upsampling increases computational cost without adding morphological information and may introduce interpolation artefacts. To address these limitations, we introduce C-LiTE, a lightweight foundation model for cellular representation learning in H&E-stained histopathology, with only 22 million parameters. C-LiTE employs a native-resolution tokenisation strategy tailored to cellular inputs, processing 64 x 64 px cell-centred crops using a 4 x 4 patch embedding to produce a 16 x 16 token grid without image upsampling. To transfer visual knowledge from large-scale pre-training, we adapt the patch embedding weights of a pre-trained ViT-5-S using a pseudoinverse-based transformation, enabling weight initialisation at the finer patch resolution. We further assemble a pre-training dataset of 60 million cell-centred crops from TCGA, balanced across 19 cancer types and 16 tissue types. To our knowledge, this represents the largest public dataset for self-supervised pre-training on H&E images at the cellular level. We evaluate C-LiTE on seven public datasets spanning mitotic figure recognition, nucleus and cell-type classification, and immune cell phenotyping. Under frozen-feature evaluation, C-LiTE achieves a mean macro-F1 of 0.670, approaching CytoFormer (0.682) with approximately 30x fewer parameters.

AI.tldr: C-LiTE：22M 参数的轻量级细胞级病理基础模型，用原生分辨率 4×4 patch 嵌入 + 伪逆权重迁移，在 6000 万细胞级 H&E 裁剪块上自监督预训练，冻结特征下 macro-F1=0.670，接近 CytoFormer（0.682）且参数少约 30 倍。
AI.motivation: 病理基础模型多基于组织 patch 训练，细胞特征仅为隐式习得；现有细胞级模型或局限于特定细胞群，或依赖上亿参数的重型架构；直接对微小细胞裁剪块用 ViT 需上采样，增加算力却不增信息且引入插值伪影。
AI.method: 引入 C-LiTE（约 22M 参数）：(1) 原生分辨率 token 化，对 64×64 px 细胞中心裁剪用 4×4 patch embedding 得到 16×16 token 网格，无上采样；(2) 用基于伪逆的变换将预训练 ViT-5-S 的 patch embedding 权重适配到更细粒度分辨率以初始化；(3) 构建 TCGA 来源、覆盖 19 种癌型与 16 种组织类型均衡的 6000 万细胞中心裁剪预训练集（称目前最大公开细胞级 H&E 自监督数据集）。
AI.result: 在 7 个公开数据集上评测，覆盖核分裂象识别、细胞核与细胞类型分类、免疫细胞表型分析；冻结特征评估下平均 macro-F1 达 0.670，CytoFormer 为 0.682，参数约少 30 倍。
AI.conclusion: 原生分辨率 token 化可有效替代上采样以适配细胞尺度输入，配合伪逆权重迁移实现轻量高效迁移；轻量模型在细胞级病理任务上可逼近重型模型性能，为计算病理细胞表征学习提供可扩展方案。

title: ResVision: Spectrum-Matched Resizing and Context-Preserving Inspection for Visual Reasoning
summary: Agentic visual reasoning improves vision-language models by selectively enlarging evidence without adding new scene content, but the benefit depends on whether fine structure remains accessible and whether local observations stay grounded in the full scene. We identify three recurring bottlenecks: high-frequency detail can be attenuated during visual-token formation; spatially distributed evidence can remain encoded yet difficult for the language model to retrieve; and isolated crops can weaken whole-detail correspondence through scale and positional mismatch. ResVision addresses these limitations with two complementary components. Spectrum-Matched Resizing (SMR) estimates image complexity and selects an adaptive global sampling scale, avoiding unnecessary enlargement on simple inputs while allocating more visual tokens to detail-rich images. Context-Preserving Inspection (CPI) returns each inspected crop together with the complete working view, preserving local detail and global context across tool turns. We evaluate Direct and Agentic variants on four frontier VLMs and 29 benchmarks spanning six visual-reasoning families. Complete ResVision (Agentic Base plus SMR plus CPI) is best for every model, improving by 3.36 to 4.94 points over Direct Base and 1.87 to 2.94 points over Agentic Base. These results show that adaptive visual sampling and context-preserving inspection address distinct, complementary constraints in multimodal reasoning.

AI.tldr: ResVision通过谱匹配缩放（SMR）自适应选择全局采样尺度，并用上下文保持检查（CPI）在返回局部裁剪时附带完整工作视图，缓解视觉token高频细节衰减、分布式证据检索困难与局部裁剪失配三大瓶颈。
AI.motivation: Agentic视觉推理通过放大证据区域提升VLM，但效果依赖细结构可访问性与局部观测的全景接地；作者指出现有方法存在三个反复出现的瓶颈：视觉token形成阶段高频细节被削弱、空间分散证据难以被语言模型检索、孤立裁剪因尺度与位置不匹配削弱全局-局部对应。
AI.method: 两组件：1) Spectrum-Matched Resizing，估计图像复杂度并选取自适应全局采样尺度，简单图像不做无谓放大，细节丰富图像分配更多视觉token；2) Context-Preserving Inspection，每次检查裁剪均连同完整工作视图一并返回，跨工具轮次同时保留局部细节与全局上下文。在4个前沿VLM、29个基准、6类视觉推理任务上评测Direct与Agentic变体。
AI.result: 完整ResVision（Agentic Base+SMR+CPI）对每个模型均为最优，较Direct Base提升3.36–4.94点，较Agentic Base提升1.87–2.94点，说明自适应视觉采样与上下文保持检查分别解决互补的约束。
AI.conclusion: 自适应采样与上下文保持检查针对多模态推理中不同且互补的瓶颈，可稳定叠加增益；但工作属基准驱动的方法改进，缺乏机器人/具身部署证据。

title: FirstCross: Convex Single-Photon 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Views
summary: Single-photon lidar records the arrival time of each returning photon, enabling 3D reconstruction from few views and scarce photons. However, leading neural methods such as Transientangelo require over an hour of non-convex per-scene optimization, and their accuracy degrades as photon flux decreases. We propose FirstCross, a network-free approach that instead solves a short sequence of convex problems on a voxel grid. For a solid object, the Poisson likelihood of a ray with given signal and background rates depends on the scene solely through its first crossing, the point where the ray first enters the object. Decomposing this likelihood yields two tractable terms. The first penalizes surfaces in front of detected photons and admits a tight convex closure, namely volume rendering with a running-maximum transmittance in place of NeRF's product transmittance. The second accounts for photons that no surface explains and admits a convex upper bound once the object is assumed to be thick behind each detected surface point. Compared with Transientangelo under its own real-data protocol, FirstCross achieves lower depth error across every test scene, view count, and flux level. With three views and 100 times fewer photons than at the protocol's lowest flux, our mean object depth error stays under half of Transientangelo's with all photons. Given our detected surface points, the best classical fusion has 1.3 to 1.8 times our three-view error across flux levels. On real room-scale captures with 1% of their photons, TransientNeRF has 2.8 to 7.7 times our error. FirstCross lets few-view single-photon scanners cut exposure to 1% and reconstruct an object in about a minute on one GPU.

AI.tldr: FirstCross: a network-free single-photon lidar 3D reconstruction method that solves a short sequence of convex problems on a voxel grid using a first-crossing likelihood decomposition, achieving far lower depth error than Transientangelo at 100x fewer photons and ~1 min runtime.
AI.motivation: Neural methods like Transientangelo need >1 hour of non-convex per-scene optimization and degrade under low photon flux, limiting few-view single-photon lidar reconstruction.
AI.method: Key insight: for solid objects, the Poisson likelihood of a ray depends only on its first crossing (first entry into the object). Decompose the likelihood into two tractable terms: (1) a term penalizing surfaces in front of detected photons, admitting a tight convex closure equivalent to volume rendering with running-maximum transmittance (replacing NeRF's product transmittance); (2) a term for photons unexplained by any surface, which admits a convex upper bound under a thick-behind assumption. Solve the resulting sequence of convex problems on a voxel grid — no neural network, no non-convex optimization.
AI.result: Under Transientangelo's own real-data protocol, lower depth error across every test scene, view count, and flux level. With 3 views and 100x fewer photons than the protocol's lowest flux, mean object depth error is under half of Transientangelo's with all photons. Best classical fusion from detected surface points has 1.3–1.8x the three-view error. On real room-scale captures with 1% photons, TransientNeRF has 2.8–7.7x the error. Total runtime ~1 minute on a single GPU.
AI.conclusion: FirstCross enables few-view single-photon scanners to cut exposure to 1% and reconstruct objects in about a minute on one GPU, offering a convex, network-free, and substantially more photon-efficient alternative to transient neural rendering.

title: Online Temporal Rotations for 2 Bit KV-Cache Quantization in Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Video diffusion transformers reuse key--value (KV) caches across denoising steps, which quickly becomes a bottleneck for long video generation. We find that quantizing temporally distant cache vectors leads to a large range and high quantization error, but that nearby video tokens in the KV-cache share a persistent pattern per channel. These patterns also vary across videos, motivating rotations that are adapted to each video's unique cache. We propose Temporal Rotation Quantization (TRQ), a method that rotates frames in the cache that are adjacent in time before quantization. For each block of temporally adjacent cache vectors, TRQ fits an orthogonal transform that maps the block's per-channel means to a vector that is close to a constant across channels. To keep the quantization format lightweight, we parameterize this rotation as a tree of $2 \times 2$ planar rotations, each stored with only two bits, followed by a fixed Hadamard transform shared across all blocks. The rotations are fit without gradients or changes to model weights, and we prove that a simple greedy fit is globally optimal for our 'mean-flattening' objective. The transforms are fit online for each new video, and we release fused Triton kernels to make this process efficient at inference. At 2-bit precision and matched compression, TRQ improves VBench subject consistency over the state-of-the-art method QVG from 90.38 to 92.02 on LongCat-Video-13B and from 86.33 to 87.61 on HY-WorldPlay-8B, as well as improving other metrics.

AI.tldr: TRQ: 面向视频扩散Transformer KV-cache 的按视频自适应正交旋转量化方法。对时间相邻的cache向量拟合共享正交变换（可证贪心最优），把逐通道均值压平，配合压缩到2bit的树状2x2平面旋转+固定Hadamard，实现2-bit KV量化。
AI.motivation: 长视频生成时，扩散Transformer跨去噪步复用KV cache，显存成为瓶颈。直接量化时间上相距较远的cache向量时，数值范围大、量化误差高；但作者观察到同一通道内时间相近的token具有持久的模式，且该模式随视频而异，因此需要按视频在线适配的旋转。
AI.method: 对时间相邻的cache向量分块，拟合正交变换使块内逐通道均值映射到近常数向量（均值压平目标）；旋转参数化为2x2平面旋转树（每个仅存2 bit）+ 全块共享的固定Hadamard变换，保持量化格式轻量；无梯度、不改模型权重，证明简单贪心拟合在該目标下全局最优；每个新视频在线拟合，并提供融合Triton kernel 加速推理。
AI.result: 2-bit精度、同等压缩率下，LongCat-Video-13B 的 VBench 主体一致性由 QVG 的 90.38 提升至 92.02，HY-WorldPlay-8B 由 86.33 提升至 87.61，其他指标亦有改善。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明KV cache量化的误差主要来自跨时间尺度的通道分布漂移，按视频在线拟合的低比特正交旋转可有效缓解，并以可证明最优的贪心拟合和高效kernel实现，为长视频扩散生成提供实用显存优化方案。

title: Reasoning on Call: Efficient Agentic Robot Control for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
summary: Large multimodal models can support long-horizon robot manipulation, but frequent model calls incur substantial latency and token costs. The central challenge is determining when agent assistance or intervention is needed and whether errors require correcting robot execution, subtask planning, or both. To address this problem, we propose RoC (Reasoning on Call), an efficient framework that coordinates a low-level policy and a high-level reasoning agent through an online task-state monitor. The monitor combines temporal visual observations with ordered interaction memory to jointly estimate progress within the active subtask and predict its successor. These predictions guide event-triggered agent review for coordinated execution repair and plan revision. Verified outcomes govern memory updates and subtask transitions, allowing routine execution to remain with the policy while reasoning focuses on decisions requiring additional assessment. On RMBench, RoC improves task success rate by 24.0 percentage points and reduces token consumption by 65.3% compared with the strongest agent-based baseline. It also outperforms the strongest policy-based baseline by 15.1 percentage points in task success rate. Real-world experiments further validate its effectiveness across three long-horizon manipulation tasks. Overall, RoC supports efficient agent intervention and coordinated recovery across execution and planning for long-horizon robot manipulation.

AI.tldr: RoC 框架通过在线任务状态监控器协调低层策略与高层推理智能体，仅在事件触发时调用大模型推理，实现长程机器人操作的高效纠错与规划修订。
AI.motivation: 长程机器人操作中大模型频繁调用带来高延迟与高 token 成本；核心难点在于判断何时需要智能体介入，以及错误究竟应归因于执行层还是规划层。
AI.method: 提出 Reasoning on Call（RoC）：低层策略负责常规执行，高层推理智能体按需介入。在线状态监控器结合时序视觉观测与有序交互记忆，联合估计当前子任务进度并预测后继子任务；预测结果以事件触发方式引导智能体复核，从而协调执行修复与计划修订；经核验的结果用于更新记忆并控制子任务切换。
AI.result: 在 RMBench 上，相较最强智能体基线任务成功率提升 24.0 个百分点，token 消耗降低 65.3%；相较最强策略基线成功率提升 15.1 个百分点。真机三类长程操作任务验证有效。
AI.conclusion: RoC 以监控器驱动的按需推理实现了执行与规划层面的协同恢复，在保持效率的同时提升了长程操作成功率，具备真机可迁移性。

title: OffBeat: Multicoset Sampling for 4D Capture Beyond the Camera Frame Rate
summary: For 4D reconstruction, a synchronized multi-camera rig records all views at the same timestamps and misses the motion between them. Staggered triggers spread the same frames over more timestamps. However, when the cameras along each row fire one after another, as in 4DSloMo's schedule on the N3DV rig, the row acts as one moving camera that confounds depth with motion. We introduce OffBeat, which models a staggered rig as a spatially distributed multicoset sampler: shifted copies of one sampling grid. From the calibration alone, OffBeat derives camera groups that fire together and their firing order. Since one group records each timestamp, a short-lived primitive can fit an error its cameras share, such as a color offset, and flicker in novel views. We show that a primitive's opacity over time weights all groups equally, for every number of groups, only if it lasts at least one camera frame interval. On Spacetime Gaussians, a minimum lifetime approximates this bound, and a closed-form smoothed box of that length satisfies it exactly, with less flicker than a Gaussian in its place at nearly equal PSNR. In simulated staggered capture on N3DV, OffBeat outperforms the full 4DSloMo pipeline with video diffusion on every test frame, by 3.04 dB in mean dynamic-region PSNR. Between the first and last synchronized frame, it outperforms the best synchronized method of each scene, with or without frame interpolation, by 1.98 dB in mean dynamic-region PSNR, while synchronized capture is better at its own frames. On PanopticSports, in this frame range, OffBeat is comparable in PSNR to synchronized capture with interpolation. On every N3DV scene, replacing 4DSloMo's schedule with ours raises the dynamic-region PSNR of Spacetime Gaussians, 4DSloMo without diffusion, and our reconstruction. Multi-camera rigs could follow faster motion at the same frame count by changing only when each camera fires.

AI.tldr: OffBeat将交错触发（staggered）多相机阵列建模为空间分布的多陪集采样器（multicoset sampler），从标定即可推导同发相机组与触发顺序，并给出"短寿命高斯基元在时域均匀加权所有组"的最小寿命下界，用平滑盒核替代高斯核降低闪烁；在N3DV模拟交错采集下动态区域PSNR较完整4DSloMo流水线提升3.04 dB。
AI.motivation: 同步多相机阵列在相同时间戳记录所有视角，丢失帧间运动；4DSloMo等交错触发方案把同样帧数铺到更多时间戳，但N3DV机架按行依次触发时，一行相机等效于单一运动相机，导致深度与运动相互混淆，且单时间戳仅由一个相机组观测，短寿命基元易拟合组间共享误差（如颜色偏移）而在新视角产生闪烁。
AI.method: 将交错机架形式化为移位采样网格的多陪集采样模型，仅凭标定推导相机分组与触发次序；分析基元不透明度时域加权，证明只有当基元持续至少一个相机帧间隔时各相机组才被等权（与组数无关）；在Spacetime Gaussians上用最小寿命近似该界，并用等长闭式平滑盒核（优于同位置高斯核、PSNR近似持平）替代；提出新触发调度。
AI.result: N3DV模拟交错采集：较含视频扩散的完整4DSloMo流水线在全部测试帧上动态区域PSNR高3.04 dB；在首末同步帧之间较各场景最佳同步方法（含/不含帧插值）高1.98 dB（同步采集在其自身帧上仍更优）；PanopticSports该帧区间内与带插值的同步采集PSNR相当；每个N3DV场景上替换调度均提升4DSloMo原始、无扩散版及本文重建的动态区域PSNR。
AI.conclusion: 交错触发机架可仅通过改变各相机触发时刻，在相同帧数下捕捉更快运动；采样理论的等权条件为时域基元设计提供明确准则，平滑盒核是满足该界的实用且低闪烁选择。

title: PUPPET: Physical-Unified Platform for Presence, Embodiment, and Teleoperation
summary: Remote access to robotics hardware does not by itself guarantee usable experimental data. A teleoperated trial can complete the task and still produce an incomplete or inconsistent record. PUPPET aims to solve this problem by presenting a cyber-physical framework that opens a physical robotics laboratory through a continuously synchronized VR replica of the robot, stranding environment, and task objects. In addition, PUPPET integrates a trial validation pipeline built into the experimental workflow. We evaluated PUPPET in a within-subject study with 30 participants, who performed the same table-to-shelf object-transfer task in person, through 2D teleoperation, and through PUPPET. VR reduced post-learning completion time by 27.7% over 2D (68.7,s vs. 95.0,s), statistically indistinguishable from in-person execution (72.1,s). It also produced more validation-ready (85.6% vs. 66.0%) and intervention-free (89.7% vs. 67.2%) trials. With PUPPET we show that modality shapes the remote task performance and the reusability of the resulting experimental record.

AI.tldr: PUPPET：用持续同步的VR数字孪生遥控物理机器人实验室，并在实验流程中内嵌试次校验流水线，使远程实验数据可复用。
AI.motivation: 远程访问机器人硬件并不保证产出可用的实验数据：遥操作试次可能完成任务却留下不完整/不一致的记录，因此需要让远程操作模态本身能保障实验记录质量。
AI.method: 提出赛博-物理框架：将机器人、搁架环境与任务物体构建为持续同步的VR副本，供用户远程遥操作；同时把试次校验流水线（trial validation pipeline）集成进实验工作流。30人被试内设计，对比亲自操作、2D遥操作与PUPPET完成同一桌面到搁架物体搬运任务。
AI.result: VR较2D降低学习后完成时间27.7%（68.7 s vs 95.0 s），与亲自执行（72.1 s）统计上无差异；验证就绪试次比例85.6% vs 66.0%，无干预试次89.7% vs 67.2%。
AI.conclusion: 遥操作模态既影响远程任务表现，也影响所得实验记录的可复用性；同步数字孪生+在线校验是提升远程机器人数据质量的有效手段。

title: Contactless Estimation of Respiratory Frequency Using 3D-CNN on Thermal Images
summary: Monitoring physiological parameters such as respiratory rate ($f_R$) is essential for diagnosing and managing various pathological conditions. Thermal imaging offers a promising contactless alternative to traditional methods, which often rely on partially invasive sensors or obtrusive wearable systems. However, existing approaches for $f_R$ estimation from thermal signals typically require extensive pre-processing and manual or semi-automatic region-of-interest (ROI) tracking, limiting their practical applicability. This study proposes a deep learning-based method for estimating $f_R$ directly from thermal videos, eliminating the need for complex pre-processing and ROI tracking. A 3D Convolutional Neural Network (3D-CNN) is developed to operate on raw thermal video data. To address challenges related to small datasets, the model is trained using data augmentation and transfer learning from synthetic datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves a validation $R^2$ score of approximately 0.61 on both pre-processed and raw thermal videos. By simplifying the workflow, this method holds promise for enhancing the feasibility of thermal imaging in real-world applications, such as remote healthcare and driver monitoring in automotive applications.

AI.tldr: 提出基于3D-CNN直接从原始热成像视频估计呼吸率的方法，无需复杂预处理与ROI跟踪，通过数据增强和合成数据迁移学习解决小样本问题，验证集R²约0.61。
AI.motivation: 传统呼吸率监测依赖有创传感器或可穿戴设备；现有热成像方法需大量预处理与手工/半自动ROI跟踪，限制实际部署。
AI.method: 端到端3D卷积神经网络直接处理原始热视频；采用数据增强与合成数据集迁移学习缓解小样本问题。
AI.result: 在预处理与原始热视频上验证R²均约0.61，验证了免ROI流程的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 简化工作流提升了热成像在远程健康监测与驾驶员监测等场景的可用性，但精度仍有限。

title: Fast Self-Supervised Generative CT Denoising via Few-Step Sampling
comment: 30 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Xingyi Yao and Zhengtao Ma contributed equally to this work. Zhennong Chen is the corresponding author
summary: Low-dose and thin-slice computed tomography (CT) images suffer from elevated noise that obscures anatomical detail, while clean references for supervised denoising are often unavailable. Although Noise2Noise permits self-supervised training from noisy pairs, direct regression tends to oversmooth fine structure. Averaging multiple independently generated samples mitigates this blur, though repeating multi-step diffusion sampling is costly. We introduce Noise2Noise with Improved Mean Flow (N2N-iMF) to accelerate this process via few-step sampling. N2N-iMF learns to generate one noisy image conditioned on its paired counterpart; at inference, independent outputs are sampled and averaged to suppress noise. We evaluated image quality and sampling efficiency on simulated thin-slice brain and low-dose abdominal CT across four sampling methods and averaging counts from 1 to 20, and validated the approach on real-world photon-counting CT (PCCT) brain scans. With ten samples per conditioning input and three network evaluations per sample, N2N-iMF achieved a mean absolute error of 2.60 HU on brain CT and 14.02 HU on abdominal CT, outperforming 50-evaluation denoising diffusion implicit model (DDIM) sampling (2.91 and 14.53 HU). On the same GPU, per-output generation time dropped from 7.29 to 0.43 s. Across eight PCCT cases, N2N-iMF reached a mean gray-white matter contrast-to-noise ratio of 1.341, versus 0.916 for Noise2Noise and 1.176 for DDIM. N2N-iMF accelerates self-supervised generative CT denoising without distillation while keeping the number of averaged outputs adjustable at inference.

AI.tldr: N2N-iMF 用改进 Mean Flow 的少步采样替代多步扩散采样，实现免蒸馏的自监督生成式 CT 去噪，大幅降低采样成本。
AI.motivation: 低剂量/薄层 CT 噪声大，干净参考不可得；Noise2Noise 直接回归易过度平滑，而"多独立样本平均"路线依赖多步扩散采样，推理代价高。
AI.method: N2N-iMF 学习在给定配对噪声图像条件下生成另一张噪声图像（自监督），推理时多次独立采样并平均；用 Improved Mean Flow 做少步采样（每样本 3 次网络评估），避免蒸馏。在模拟薄层脑 CT、低剂量腹部 CT 上与 4 种采样方法和 1–20 个平均样本数做对比，并在真实光子计数 CT（PCCT）脑扫描上验证。
AI.result: 10 样本/输入、每样本 3 次评估下，脑 CT MAE 2.60 HU、腹部 CT 14.02 HU，优于 50 次评估的 DDIM（2.91 / 14.53 HU）；单输出耗时从 7.29 s 降至 0.43 s。8 例 PCCT 上灰白质 CNR 1.341，对比 Noise2Noise 0.916、DDIM 1.176。
AI.conclusion: 少步生成式平均去噪在质量与效率上同时优于多步扩散基线，且平均样本数可在推理时灵活调节，无需蒸馏。

title: Alignment Drives Reuse: Learning Generalizable Robot-Use Agents from Heterogeneous Experience
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) demonstrate broad generalization across tasks and domains. However, comparable generalization in robot manipulation remains challenging. Heterogeneity in robot embodiments, task formulations, geometric conventions, and action interfaces fragments interaction experience across benchmarks and hardware. We rethink robot skill learning through alignment: Can heterogeneous interactions across benchmarks and embodiments jointly improve one shared skillset for robot manipulation? We propose UniCraft, a framework for learning robot manipulation skills by aligning heterogeneous settings. Specifically, UniCraft represents observed scene geometry using consistent coordinate conventions and aligns sensing and control interfaces across robots. It organizes tasks from different benchmarks in a canonical format, allowing interaction feedback to jointly refine shared skills and the orchestration policy that guides their selection and composition, without any demonstrations or model weight updates. We interleave tasks from 3 benchmarks and 6 embodiments, collecting 2,700 learning rollouts per agent model. During training, UniCraft improves pooled task success on unseen scenarios and tasks by 9-28 percentage points on LIBERO-PRO, 10.8-13.3 on RoboTwin 2.0, and 3.1-14.4 on RoboCasa365 (Epochs 1-3). After training, with the learned skills frozen, UniCraft demonstrates zero-shot transfer across 4 new robot embodiments and 5 additional agent models on robosuite and RoboDojo.

AI.tldr: UniCraft proposes aligning heterogeneous robot manipulation benchmarks and embodiments via consistent coordinate conventions, unified sensing/control interfaces, and a canonical task format, enabling interaction feedback to jointly improve a shared skill library and an orchestration policy without demonstrations or weight updates.
AI.motivation: VLM-level generalization does not transfer to robot manipulation because heterogeneity in embodiments, task formulations, geometric conventions, and action interfaces fragments interaction experience across benchmarks and hardware. The paper asks whether interactions from many heterogeneous benchmarks/embodiments can jointly train one shared manipulation skillset.
AI.method: UniCraft represents scene geometry in consistent coordinate conventions, aligns sensing and control interfaces across robots, and canonicalizes tasks from different benchmarks. Interleaved training over tasks from 3 benchmarks and 6 embodiments (2,700 rollouts per agent model) refines shared skills plus an orchestration policy that selects/composes them, using no demonstrations and no model weight updates.
AI.result: During training, pooled success on unseen scenarios/tasks improves by 9–28 pp on LIBERO-PRO, 10.8–13.3 pp on RoboTwin 2.0, and 3.1–14.4 pp on RoboCasa365 (epochs 1–3). With frozen learned skills, zero-shot transfer holds across 4 new embodiments and 5 additional agent models on robosuite and RoboDojo.
AI.conclusion: Cross-benchmark, cross-embodiment alignment is an effective substitute for in-domain demonstrations: canonicalizing geometry/interfaces and sharing interaction feedback yields a transferable, frozen manipulation skill library with orchestration, generalizing zero-shot to new robots and agent backbones.

title: EgoCaptioner: Towards Comprehensive and Fine-Grained Egocentric Video Captioning
summary: Egocentric video captioning requires fine-grained detail and accurate timing, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often miss brief actions, confuse their order, or misinterpret the wearer's motion. Existing caption formats also offer limited support for combining detailed narration with precise timing. We present EgoCaptioner, which pairs a video-level overview of the setting, participants, and the wearer's overall activity with timed steps whose narration adapts to varying perceptual demands and marks key moments at specific timestamps. We develop a coarse-to-fine annotation pipeline that establishes event structure before expanding step descriptions, yielding 50,000 training examples from eight egocentric video sources. Complementary rewards assess factual accuracy and coverage, measure step-level temporal alignment, and penalize fragmented or redundant narration, guiding caption refinement through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). To improve the reliability of factual supervision, we supplement caption references with pose-derived motion facts when sensor data are available. Across five egocentric benchmarks, EgoCaptioner achieves leading performance among evaluated open-source models in caption quality, caption-conditioned question answering, and temporal alignment. It also surpasses Gemini 3.1 Pro on PhysCapBench and all evaluated proprietary baselines on Minerva-Ego under the caption-to-QA protocol. Ablations support the complementary roles of factual and temporal rewards and show that coarse-to-fine annotation provides more effective supervision than single-pass annotation.

AI.tldr: EgoCaptioner 提出视频级概览+时间戳步级描述的第一人称视频字幕生成框架，用粗到细标注流水线构建5万训练样本，并以GRPO结合事实/覆盖/时序对齐/冗余惩罚多维奖励优化MLLM。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在第一人称视频字幕中易漏掉短时动作、混淆动作顺序、误解佩戴者自身运动；且现有字幕格式难以兼顾细节叙述与精确时间定位。
AI.method: (1) 两级字幕格式：视频级概览（场景、参与者、佩戴者整体活动）+ 带时间戳的步骤；步骤叙述按感知需求自适应。(2) 粗到细标注流水线：先建立事件结构再扩展步骤描述，从8个第一人称视频源生成50k训练样本。(3) GRPO训练，奖励包括事实准确性、覆盖度、步骤级时序对齐、碎片化/冗余惩罚。(4) 在可用传感器数据时，用姿态估计导出的运动事实补充字幕参考以增强事实监督可靠性。
AI.result: 在5个第一人称基准上，字幕质量、字幕条件QA、时序对齐均领先所评估的开源模型；在PhysCapBench上超过Gemini 3.1 Pro，在Minerva-Ego的字幕-to-QA协议下超过所有评估的闭源基线。消融显示事实奖励与时序奖励互补，粗到细标注优于单遍标注。
AI.conclusion: 可通过结构化字幕格式+粗到细标注+多维奖励的策略微调，显著提升第一人称视频字幕的细节保真度与时间精度；该范式可推广到具身感知与动作理解的数据构造。

title: Beyond the Sink Interpretation: Radial Attention in Flow-Based VLA Policies
summary: Prior work calls the high attention on the first and last action tokens of a flow-based VLA policy a radial action sink, and uses these tokens to set the execution horizon. In language models, a sink is a token with high incoming attention, a small value, and little effect on the output. We test whether that profile holds, not the horizon rule, in one $\pi_{0.5}$ checkpoint on five RoboCasa tasks. The two endpoints receive 5.4% of action-key mass, 1.4 percentage points above their uniform share, and rotary positional encoding produces this excess: directly in shallow layers and through upstream action-token RoPE deeper in the network. The endpoints do not fit the sink profile. Their value norms stay near the action-token mean in all 18 layers. On 250 paired episodes, masking them or zeroing their values changes success by less than 4 points, and replacing their value directions with those of another observation lowers it by 3.2 to 7.2 points across three donors, whereas the same replacement on two non-endpoint tokens in the executed prefix lowers it by 28.4 points. The token that does fit the sink profile on mass and value norm is the prefix BOS; on this checkpoint, zeroing its value raises success in two paired runs, by +13.2 points (95% CI [+7.0, +19.4]) and +6.0 points ([+0.2, +11.8]). Inside the action chunk, a relative-offset routing profile estimated on other tasks keeps 75% of action-token spread and keeps closed-loop success on three held-out tasks (42.7% against a 38.7% baseline), while uniform or shuffled routing drops success to 3-4%. High attention mass alone does not tell what a token does.

AI.tldr: 在单个 π0.5 检查点上用 RoboCasa 五任务检验 flow-based VLA 首末动作 token 的"attention sink"假说：该处注意力盈余由 RoPE 造成，但端点并不符合 sink 画像（值范数接近均值、掩码/置零影响<4点、替换方向仅降3.2–7.2点），真正符合 sink 画像的是 prefix BOS；基于相对偏移的 routing profile 可保留 75% 动作 token 分散度并在三个留出任务上达 42.7% vs 38.7% 基线。
AI.motivation: 先前工作把 flow-based VLA 策略对首末动作 token 的高注意力称为"radial action sink"，并据此设置执行时域。本文质疑该解释：若这些 token 真为 sink，则应具备高入注意力、小 value、对输出影响微弱三项特征。作者希望厘清注意力质量与 token 功能之间的因果关系，并为动作 chunk 内的路由提供更可靠的依据。
AI.method: 对 π0.5 单个 checkpoint 在 RoboCasa 5 个任务上做机制分析：(1) 统计首末端点在 action-key 上的注意力占比；(2) 通过浅层直接 RoPE 与深层经上游 action-token RoPE 两条路径做归因；(3) 逐层比较端点 value 范数与动作 token 均值；(4) 250 对配对 episode 上做掩码、value 置零、以及跨观测 donor 的 value 方向替换（并对比执行前缀内两个非端点 token）；(5) 检验 prefix BOS 是否符合 sink 画像，并做 value 置零干预；(6) 在其它任务上估计相对偏移 routing profile，迁移到 3 个留出任务做闭环评测，与 uniform/shuffled routing 对照。
AI.result: 首末两端点占 action-key 质量的 5.4%，比均匀份额高 1.4 个百分点，该超额由 RoPE 产生（浅层直接、深层经上游 RoPE）。端点不符合 sink 画像：18 层中 value 范数均接近动作 token 均值；掩码或置零 value 使成功率变化<4 点；用其他观测的 value 方向替换仅降 3.2–7.2 点（三个 donor），而前缀内两个非端点 token 做同样替换降 28.4 点。真正符合 sink 画像的是 prefix BOS，置零其 value 在两个配对实验中分别提升成功率 +13.2 点（95% CI [+7.0, +19.4]）与 +6.0 点（[+0.2, +11.8]）。动作 chunk 内，其它任务估计的相对偏移 routing profile 保留 75% 动作 token 分散度，并在三个留出任务上保持闭环成功率 42.7%（基线 38.7%），而 uniform 或 shuffled routing 使成功率跌至 3–4%。
AI.conclusion: 高注意力质量本身不能说明 token 的功能。首末动作 token 的高注意力是 RoPE 结构性的副产品，而非可利用的"汇点"；将其用于设定执行时域缺乏机制依据。相对偏移的路由结构才是承载动作信息的关键，并具备跨任务迁移性。对 VLA 内部表征的干预式分析（value 替换、配对实验）比单一注意力统计更能揭示因果作用。

title: SEEC: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Self-Supervised External-Eye Representation Learning
summary: External-eye photography captures clinically relevant periocular anatomy at low acquisition cost, yet no large-scale standardized resource exists for evaluating self-supervised external-eye representations. We introduce a 4.35-million-image Standardized External-Eye Corpus (SEEC) derived from fourteen heterogeneous public face datasets, together with a benchmark for external-eye representation learning. For evaluation, we provide held-out evaluation distributions, landmark-annotated anatomical probe sets, and clinical disease-classification experiments spanning ptosis, thyroid eye disease, and craniofacial syndromes. We evaluate representations at two complementary levels: (a) the representation level, by assessing embedding geometry across multiple data distributions, and (b) the functional level, by assessing anatomical recovery, out-of-distribution anatomical transfer, and disease classification. Our models include ResNet-101 and ViT-B encoders pretrained using InfoNCE, VICReg, and LeJEPA objectives and compared with DINOv2 and MAE. Our results indicate that representation-level and functional-level evaluations are dissociable: broader embedding-space utilization does not consistently correspond to anatomical transfer or disease-classification performance, and no single encoder is universally optimal. Domain-specific external-eye encoders outperform DINOv2 and MAE on cross-dataset anatomical transfer despite being pretrained at substantially smaller scale, while external-eye-pretrained ViT models match or outperform these general-purpose baselines on frozen disease-classification probes. We release benchmark code, evaluation scripts, and preprocessing pipelines to reproduce SEEC at this https URL

AI.tldr: 构建435万张外部眼部图像标准化语料SEEC，提出自监督外部眼表征学习基准，在表征层（嵌入几何）与功能层（解剖标志恢复、跨域解剖迁移、眼睑下垂/甲状腺眼病/颅面综合征分类）两级评估多种编码器。
AI.motivation: 外部眼部摄影获取成本低且含临床相关解剖信息，但缺乏大规模标准化资源用于评估自监督外部眼表征，现有通用视觉模型在该细粒度解剖域上的适用性未被系统衡量。
AI.method: 从14个异构公开人脸数据集汇聚4.35M图像构成SEEC，提供留出评估分布、带关键点标注的解剖探针集与疾病分类实验；训练ResNet-101与ViT-B编码器，采用InfoNCE、VICReg、LeJEPA三种自监督目标，并与DINOv2、MAE对比；评估分表征层（多分布嵌入几何）与功能层（解剖恢复、OOD解剖迁移、冻结分类探针）。
AI.result: 表征层与功能层评估可分离：嵌入空间利用更充分并不稳定对应解剖迁移或疾病分类提升，无单一最优编码器；域内预训练外部眼编码器在跨数据集解剖迁移上优于DINOv2与MAE（尽管预训练规模小得多），外部眼预训练ViT在冻结疾病分类探针上持平或超越通用基线。
AI.conclusion: 域内数据与预训练目标的选择显著影响下游功能表现，通用表征质量指标不足以替代功能级评测；作者开源基准代码、评测脚本与预处理流程以支持复现。

title: GateTrace: Where Do Crowd Crossings Go Missing Under Occlusion?
summary: At large events, pedestrian tracking supports entrance and passageway counts, but totals hide which crossings were missed. In a stadium study, the system recorded about four in five clearly visible crossings but fewer than one in three mostly obscured crossings. The videos lacked trajectories annotated across frames, so we turned to MOT20, which provides pedestrian trajectories and visibility. We introduce GateTrace to locate missed crossings and assess changes to counting rules. It derives reference crossings from annotations under fixed rules, matches reports by person, direction, time and position, and traces misses through saved boxes and counting decisions. With a shared detector, ByteTrack, OC-SORT and BoT-SORT recover 38.9-46.7% of low-visibility reference crossings on development sequences, versus 98.1-99.0% at high visibility. The gap recurs on two further sequences under a protocol fixed in advance. Published outputs of MOT20-tuned BASE recover 63-78% at low visibility across both sequence groups. Losses stop at different stages across systems. Across four systems and both groups, 47-79% of low-visibility misses have no nearby output linked to the person or no possible crossing in the saved tracks. Removing later checks from BASE on development sequences leaves most misses unresolved and lowers precision against the fixed reference list from about 96% to 77%. Misses also remain among sampled reference crossings that two human annotators supported after checking the videos. GateTrace shows where crossings are lost and measures the recovery and precision costs of changing later checks. We will release the code and per-crossing records.

AI.tldr: GateTrace 基于 MOT20 追踪被遮挡行人跨越计数遗漏位置并提供逐帧与计数决策级溯源分析，量化低可见度下的召回与规则改动代价。
AI.motivation: 体育场等大型活动中行人追踪用于出入口计数，但总数掩盖了哪些跨越被漏检；现场视频缺少跨帧标注轨迹，因此需借助带可见度标注的 MOT20 建立可诊断的基准与工具。
AI.method: 以固定规则从标注生成参考跨越事件，按人、方向、时间、位置将系统报告与参考事件匹配；利用保存的检测框与计数决策逐步追溯遗漏发生阶段。在共享检测器上对比 ByteTrack、OC-SORT、BoT-SORT，并对比 MOT20 调优的 BASE 已发布输出；消融 BASE 的后处理校验环节。
AI.result: 低可见度参考跨越召回率 38.9–46.7%，高可见度 98.1–99.0%，差异在另两组序列上按预设协议复现；BASE 在低可见度下 63–78%；四系统两序列组中 47–79% 的低可见度遗漏缺乏可关联输出或轨迹中不存在可能跨越；去除 BASE 后校验使精度由约 96% 降至 77%，且双人标注确认的参考跨越中仍存在遗漏。
AI.conclusion: 遮挡是行人跨越计数的主要失效来源，且各系统丢失阶段不同；后校验环节兼顾召回与精度，改动需权衡。GateTrace 提供定位遗漏与评估计数规则变更成本的诊断工具，将开源代码及逐事件记录。

title: ViDecide: Teaching Video Diffusion Models to Reason and Plan Step by Step
summary: Current leading video generation models can synthesize highly realistic videos, while still frequently violating physical and logical constraints in multi-step reasoning and planning, even after training with large-scale reasoning data or existing diffusion RL methods. We attribute these failures to the conventional video training paradigm, which treats a solution as a fixed-length clip rather than a chain of decisions. We present ViDecide, a decision-centric framework that trains video diffusion models to predict state transitions causally and decide when to stop, with a decision-focused training schedule. We further propose Corrective Fine-tuning (CFT), which corrects failed decisions by mapping their noise to the model's own successful continuations, achieving stable improvement without policy-gradient optimization. Across abstract games, planning tasks, and a new benchmark of multi-step robot planning, ViDecide achieves an average strict success rate of 83.8%, far above 23.3% for standard fine-tuning and 67.8% for the strongest prior method, and generalizes to larger puzzles and unseen layouts. Our framework therefore unlocks greater potential for video generation models as reliable reasoners and planners in the visual world. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: ViDecide 将视频生成训练从"固定长度片段拟合"重构为"决策链学习"：让视频扩散模型因果地预测状态转移并自主决定终止时刻，配合 Corrective Fine-tuning (CFT) 把失败决策的噪声映射到模型自身成功续写轨迹上，实现无需策略梯度的稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型虽能生成高度逼真画面，但在多步推理与规划中频繁违反物理与逻辑约束，即使使用大规模推理数据训练或已有扩散 RL 方法也未解决。作者认为根因在于训练范式把"解"当作定长视频片段，而非一串决策。
AI.method: 提出以决策为中心的框架 ViDecide：训练视频扩散模型因果预测状态转移并学习何时停止，并采用决策导向的训练调度；进一步提出 Corrective Fine-tuning (CFT)，将失败决策对应的噪声显式映射到模型自身生成的正确续写上，用类似监督式修正替代策略梯度优化以获得更稳定的改进。
AI.result: 在抽象博弈、规划任务以及新提出的多步机器人规划基准上，ViDecide 平均严格成功率达 83.8%，显著高于标准微调的 23.3% 和此前最强方法的 67.8%，并能泛化到更大规模谜题与未见布局。
AI.conclusion: 该框架表明把视频扩散模型当作决策过程而非片段生成器，可显著提升其作为视觉世界可靠推理者与规划者的能力，为视频生成模型通向具身规划与世界模型提供新路径。

title: SpecFlow: Flow Matching in the Acceleration Spectrum for Multi-Agent Trajectory Forecasting
summary: Multimodal trajectory forecasting must cover diverse future behaviors without sacrificing dynamical coherence. Most generative forecasters evolve frame-wise positions directly, leaving the relationships among position, velocity, and acceleration implicit. We present SpecFlow, a conditional flow-matching framework that treats the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) coefficients of future accelerations as its generative state. SpecFlow learns a transport from Gaussian noise to acceleration spectra and reconstructs velocity and position through fixed analytical integration initialized by the last observed state. A joint phase-space objective supervises all three kinematic levels. To represent destination uncertainty without future information, an endpoint predictor produces candidate destinations and confidence scores solely from observed context, and the highest-confidence candidate conditions the spectral denoiser. Alternating attention over trajectory hypotheses and agents captures multimodality and interaction. Under best-of-20 evaluation, SpecFlow achieves average minADE/minFDE of 0.15/0.22 on ETH/UCY, 0.69/0.86 at four seconds on NBA, and 7.38/11.57 on SDD. It establishes state-of-the-art results across all five ETH/UCY scenes and achieves the lowest four-second ADE on NBA with a tied-best FDE, while remaining competitive on SDD. Together, these results demonstrate that acceleration-spectrum flow matching provides an effective structured generative state across smooth pedestrian motion, coordinated multi-agent sports dynamics, and heterogeneous outdoor trajectories. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: SpecFlow用DCT加速度谱作为流匹配的生成状态，经固定解析积分重建速度与位置，结合仅依赖观测的终点预测器条件化频谱去噪器，在ETH/UCY、NBA、SDD上取得SOTA或竞争力结果。
AI.motivation: 多数生成式轨迹预测器直接逐帧生成位置，使位置—速度—加速度之间的动力学关系隐含、缺乏动力学一致性。作者希望在保证多模态覆盖的同时显式维护运动学的物理结构。
AI.method: 条件流匹配框架：生成状态为未来加速度的DCT系数，学习从高斯噪声到加速度谱的输运；由最后观测状态初始化，通过固定解析积分恢复速度与位置；采用联合相空间目标监督三个运动学层级；终点预测器仅从观测上下文输出候选终点及置信度，最高置信度者作为频谱去噪器的条件；对轨迹假设与智能体做交替注意力以建模多模态与交互。
AI.result: best-of-20评估下：ETH/UCY平均minADE/minFDE为0.15/0.22，NBA四秒0.69/0.86，SDD为7.38/11.57；在ETH/UCY全部五个场景达到SOTA，NBA四秒ADE最优、FDE并列最优，SDD保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 以加速度谱作为结构化生成状态并进行流匹配，可有效覆盖平滑行人运动、多智能体协同体育动力学与异构户外轨迹三类场景，说明该表示具有跨域的通用性。

title: TacInno: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models the Contact Dynamics Beyond Vision and Action
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently been equipped with tactile sensing to perceive visually subtle contact events in contact-rich manipulation. However, adding tactile input yields inconsistent gains, and some visuo-tactile VLA models rely little on tactile input, because much of the tactile change, such as the gel deformation during gripper closure, is predictable from visual observations and executed actions. To address this problem, we introduce TacInno, which isolates the contact dynamics that vision and executed actions cannot explain, termed tactile innovation, and uses tactile innovation only as a training target. Specifically, the TacInno tokenizer, conditioned on visual observations and executed actions, compresses the future tactile change into a discrete code, and the policy, TacInno-VLA, learns to predict the code, adding no module for the code at deployment. TacInno-VLA achieves average success rates of 87.5% across six simulation tasks and 70.5% across four real-world tasks, outperforming the strongest visuo-tactile baseline by 10.7 and 9.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies validate the contributions of visual and action conditioning, multi-frame encoding, and auxiliary code prediction. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of tactile innovation as a supervision signal for contact-rich manipulation.

AI.tldr: TacInno 以视觉与已执行动作为条件，把未来触觉变化中"不可预测"的部分（tactile innovation）压缩为离散码，仅作训练监督目标，部署时无需额外模块，在仿真与真机上均显著超越最强视触 VLA 基线。
AI.motivation: 现有视触 VLA 引入触觉后收益不稳定，部分模型几乎不依赖触觉，原因是触觉变化的大量成分（如夹爪闭合时的凝胶形变）可由视觉观测与已执行动作预测，导致触觉信号冗余、缺乏信息量。
AI.method: 提出 TacInno：以视觉观测和已执行动作为条件训练一个 tokenizer，将未来触觉变化压缩为离散 code；策略 TacInno-VLA 学习预测该 code 作为辅助训练目标，从而迫使模型关注视觉—动作无法解释的接触动力学；部署时不增加任何额外模块或计算开销。含消融验证视觉/动作条件、多帧编码、辅助码预测的必要性。
AI.result: 六个仿真任务平均成功率 87.5%，四个真实任务平均 70.5%，分别比最强视触基线高 10.7 与 9.0 个百分点；消融实验证实各组件贡献。
AI.conclusion: 将"触觉残差/创新量"作为监督信号可有效筛选信息量高的接触动态，是接触丰富操作中一种低成本、可即插即用的触觉利用范式，且不增加推理负担。

title: Training Vision Models for LLM-Driven Weight-Space Programming
summary: It has been demonstrated that, in certain settings, large language models can perform weight-space programming to directly modify the weights of neural networks. However, it is unknown how dedicated training of these networks can contribute to the successes of weight-space programming. We present a benchmark of LLM-driven weight-space programming on vision models, in which five LLMs edit convolutional networks and vision transformers on relabeling and error-correction tasks on Waterbirds, CIFAR-100, PACS and Entity-30. We report more than 2,600 such edit processes, whereby each edit is scored on held-out images for success, side effects and accuracy loss. We compare standard training with label smoothing, gradient-based editable training, and our Edit-Ready Training (ERT), a novel method that rehearses the direct, closed-form weight edits LLMs perform. We show that preparing networks for editing raises the success of LLM edits substantially where standard networks are hard to edit. ERT further achieves the highest mean score for GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 across all evaluated baselines. We will release our LLM testing framework alongside all tasks, editing trajectories and scores. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 论文给出LLM驱动权重空间编程（直接改网络权重）的视觉模型基准，覆盖5个LLM、CNN/ViT,4个数据集，共2600+次编辑，并以成功率/副作用/精度损失打分；提出Edit-Ready Training(ERT)通过演练LLM的直接闭式权重编辑来提升可编辑性。
AI.motivation: 已有工作显示LLM可在权重空间"编程"直接修改网络权重，但网络自身的训练方式如何影响这种编辑的成功率尚不清楚，缺乏系统性评测与针对性训练方法。
AI.method: 构建LLM驱动权重空间编程基准：5个LLM对卷积网络与ViT在Waterbirds、CIFAR-100、PACS、Entity-30上执行重标注与纠错任务；对比标准训练、标签平滑、基于梯度的可编辑训练，以及新提出的ERT——在训练中预先演练LLM所执行的直接闭式权重编辑。
AI.result: >2600次编辑过程逐条在留出图像上评估成功率、副作用与精度损失；为编辑而准备的训练显著提升原本难以编辑的标准网络的编辑成功率；ERT在GPT-6 Astra与Claude Opus 5.5上取得所有基线中的最高平均分。
AI.conclusion: 可编辑性本身可作为训练目标显式优化，ERT使LLM权重空间编程更可靠；作者将公开评测框架、任务、编辑轨迹与分数。

title: WeMM-Video: Pushing the Frontiers of Open-Source Omni-Modal Video Understanding
summary: Video understanding, particularly with accompanying audio, remains a central challenge in multimodal intelligence. In this report, we introduce \textbf{WeMM-Video}, a family of Chinese-English bilingual omni-modal foundation models spanning 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B-A3B variants. Centering on joint audio-visual perception and reasoning, WeMM-Video unifies text, image, audio, and video processing within a hybrid-thinking paradigm, seamlessly supporting both a non-thinking instruct mode for fast, direct responses and a thinking mode for explicit step-by-step reasoning. The models are trained on a large-scale multimodal corpus of approximately 1.2 trillion tokens through progressive pre-training and a multi-stage post-training pipeline incorporating multi-teacher OPD, anti-repetition MrDPO, and specialist RL. Evaluated across more than 120 benchmarks, WeMM-Video demonstrates superior performance in omni-modal video understanding and reasoning, while maintaining highly competitive capabilities across general audio, silent video, image, and text tasks. Specifically, in omni-modal video evaluations, our flagship WeMM-Video-35B-A3B establishes a new open-source state of the art, substantially outperforming proprietary models such as Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash and Seed2.0-Mini-0428 while narrowing the gap with the strong Gemini-3.0-Flash, and our compact WeMM-Video-9B surpasses the larger open-source Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct. We publicly release the WeMM-Video family along with our evaluation and reproduction pipeline to foster further research and development in the open-source community.

AI.tldr: WeMM-Video: 中英双语全模态基础模型系列（2B/4B/9B/35B-A3B），统一文本、图像、音频、视频，采用非思考指令模式与显式思考推理混合范式，1.2T token渐进式预训练+多阶段后训练（多教师OPD、MrDPO防重复、专家RL），120+基准评测，旗舰35B-A3B在开源全模态视频理解上达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 带音频的视频理解是多模态智能的核心难点；现有全模态模型在音视频联合感知与推理、以及"快回答/慢推理"混合能力上仍有欠缺，且开源侧与闭源旗舰存在差距。
AI.method: 构建2B/4B/9B/35B-A3B四档MoE/稠密混合模型族；统一文本-图像-音频-视频输入；混合思考范式（instruct非思考模式 + thinking逐步推理模式）；约1.2T token大规模语料渐进式预训练；后训练含多教师OPD蒸馏、MrDPO抗重复偏好优化、专家RL；公开评测与复现流水线。
AI.result: 在120+基准上，全模态视频理解与推理表现领先，通用音频、无声视频、图像、文本任务保持竞争力；WeMM-Video-35B-A3B刷新开源SOTA，显著超过Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash与Seed2.0-Mini-0428，缩小与Gemini-3.0-Flash的差距；9B版本超过更大的Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct。
AI.conclusion: 报告级技术文档，给出一个完整可复现的开源全模态视频理解模型族与训练配方，证明了混合思考+多阶段后训练在音视频联合推理上的有效性，并开源模型与评测流程。

title: Awaken-HI: Scaling Humanoid Intelligence with Whole-Body Human Experience
summary: A central goal of humanoid robotics is for robots to perform the everyday work people do in homes and workplaces. Existing egocentric video datasets cover many of these activities but provide little synchronized whole-body motion data for learning loco-manipulation at scale. We build Awaken-Human, which pairs approximately 50,000 hours of egocentric stereo video with synchronized whole-body human motion and covers more than 100 skills. Building on this, we also introduce Awaken-HI (Humanoid Intelligence), a vision-language-action model for humanoid loco-manipulation that jointly predicts original human motion and retargeted robot actions through a shared action expert. We show that loco-manipulation skills transfer more effectively from people to humanoids when human trajectories directly supervise the shared action expert. Increasing human pretraining data reduces held-out robot action prediction error according to an empirical scaling law and raises the mean success rate on downstream real-robot tasks. After full-corpus pretraining and T800 adaptation, Awaken-HI achieves a mean success rate of 93.75% across eight individual tasks and outperforms GR00T N1.7 and $\pi_{0.5}$ in both individual and long-horizon evaluations. The same policy generalizes to objects unseen during robot post-training and to new pairings of familiar objects and destinations.

AI.tldr: Awaken-Human 构建了约 5 万小时、含同步全身人体运动的自中心立体视频数据集（覆盖 100+ 技能），并据此训练 Awaken-HI 人形机器人视觉-语言-动作模型，通过共享动作专家同时预测原始人体运动与重定向机器人动作。
AI.motivation: 现有自中心视频数据集缺乏同步全身运动数据，难以规模化学习人形机器人的移动-操作（loco-manipulation）技能；核心问题是人类运动数据能否直接迁移到人形机器人控制。
AI.method: 大规模自中心立体视频与全身人体运动同步采集；VLA 模型中设置共享 action expert，联合预测人体运动与重定向后的机器人动作，使人类轨迹直接监督该专家；在全量语料上预训练后做 T800 机器人适配。
AI.result: 人体轨迹直接监督共享动作专家时迁移效果最佳；人类预训练数据量增加可降低留出机器人动作预测误差（呈经验缩放律）并提升真机成功率；八项任务平均成功率 93.75%，在单项与长程评测中优于 GR00T N1.7 与 π0.5，并能泛化到未见物体及新物体-目的地组合。
AI.conclusion: 人类全身运动数据可作为人形机器人 loco-manipulation 的高效可扩展监督信号，共享动作专家的联合预测设计是实现人→机器人技能迁移的关键，且性能随人类数据规模呈现可预测提升。

title: MemFolder: Structure-Guided Memory Folding for Efficient Agent Memory Management
comment: Code is available at this https URL
summary: Long-term agents accumulate large external memory stores as interactions unfold, increasing the costs of storage, retrieval, and response generation. Efficiency is constrained by two coupled factors: a growing record count increases retrieval overhead, while longer retrieved contexts increase prefill computation and decoding-time attention costs. Existing methods prune or consolidate records, but pruning can discard useful evidence, whereas consolidation may produce fewer yet longer retrieval units. We introduce MemFolder, a structure-guided memory folding framework that sequentially reduces record count and context length. The framework comprises two core components that share memory groups, using cross-record structure to guide both evidence consolidation and compact representation. RecordFolder grounds entity mentions, progressively selects representative yet complementary anchors, and combines semantic and entity affinity with temporal chaining to consolidate compatible records into fewer retrieval units. ContextFolder encodes the original records within these groups into compact text and uses verification feedback to revise encodings when key facts cannot be recovered. Experiments on the three text-based memory benchmarks LoCoMo, PersonaMem, and LongMemEval and the two multimodal benchmarks M3-Bench-web and M3-Bench-robot demonstrate the strong performance of our methods. Notably, on Mem0, RecordFolder retains 99.0% of the original average performance across the three text-based benchmarks with 50% fewer records, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.9 percentage points in performance retention. Combined with ContextFolder, existing record compression methods further shorten their output records while retaining most of their performance.

AI.tldr: MemFolder 提出结构引导的记忆折叠框架，分 RecordFolder（利用跨记录实体结构将多条记录合并为更少检索单元）与 ContextFolder（将组内原始记录编码为紧凑文本并用验证反馈修正）两级，依次降低记录数与上下文长度。
AI.motivation: 长期智能体的外部记忆不断累积，导致存储、检索与生成成本上升：记录数增长抬高检索开销，检索上下文变长抬高 prefill 计算与解码期注意力成本。现有剪枝会丢失有用证据，而合并式压缩又会得到更少但更长的检索单元，二者都未同时解决记录数与上下文长度两个耦合瓶颈。
AI.method: MemFolder 共享同一套记忆分组：RecordFolder 先对实体提及做 grounding，渐进式选取具有代表性且互补的锚点，结合语义亲和度、实体亲和度与时间链式关系，将兼容记录合并为更少的检索单元；ContextFolder 在此基础上把组内原始记录编码为紧凑文本，并利用验证反馈在关键事实无法恢复时修正编码。
AI.result: 在 LoCoMo、PersonaMem、LongMemEval 三个文本记忆基准以及 M3-Bench-web、M3-Bench-robot 两个多模态基准上表现良好；在 Mem0 上，RecordFolder 在记录数减少 50% 的情况下保留原始平均性能的 99.0%，性能保持率比最强基线高 1.9 个百分点；与 ContextFolder 结合后，已有记录压缩方法可在保留大部分性能的同时进一步缩短输出记录。
AI.conclusion: 以跨记录结构同时引导证据整合与紧凑表示，可在不牺牲（或极少牺牲）性能的前提下同时压缩记录数与检索上下文长度，并与现有压缩方法互补；主要局限在于摘要未给出多模态基准的定量结果与效率（时延/算力）实测。

title: FFGaussType: Feed-Forward Conversion of Glyph and SVG Geometry into Compact Gaussian Assets
comment: 20 pages. Project page: this https URL
summary: Immersive 3D content allows text and graphical elements, such as subtitles, annotations, and icons, to be placed inside a scene rather than displayed as flat overlays. Placed this way, they respect occlusion and perspective and take on user-assigned materials and lighting while preserving their original shapes. In Gaussian scenes, however, each new glyph or icon requires its own iterative optimization, which limits scalable content creation. We present FFGaussType, which converts extruded glyph and SVG outlines into Gaussian assets in a single forward pass. A point encoder maps anchors sampled on the known surface to a single feature plane, from which a decoder shared by all assets predicts neural Gaussians carrying surface normals. This separates geometric conversion from material and lighting choices, and the feature plane supports image and video coding for compact delivery. We construct a paired dataset of 27,221 glyph and SVG icon assets with anchors and calibrated normal and silhouette renderings, holding out font families for evaluation. Conversion from prepared anchors takes 9.1 ms per asset, at a fraction of the compute and memory of prior baselines. On unseen font families and test icons, FFGaussType achieves $1.62^\circ$ normal error and $0.985$ silhouette IoU, the best among the compared feed-forward converters, matching the fidelity that per-asset fitting needs thousands of steps to reach. The code and dataset will be released after publication.

AI.tldr: FFGaussType 将挤出的字形与 SVG 轮廓在单次前向传播中转换为带表面法向的高斯资产，用于沉浸式 3D 场景内的文字与图标放置。
AI.motivation: 高斯场景中每个新增字形或图标都需独立的逐资产迭代优化，严重限制规模化内容创作；同时几何转换与材质/光照耦合，难以复用与压缩传输。
AI.method: 在已知表面上采样锚点，点编码器将锚点映射到单一特征平面，由所有资产共享的解码器预测携带表面法向的神经高斯；几何转换与材质光照选择解耦，特征平面支持图像/视频编码以紧凑传输。构建 27,221 个字形与 SVG 图标配对数据集，按字体族划分留出测试。
AI.result: 单资产转换耗时 9.1 ms，算力与内存远低于基线；在未见字体族与测试图标上达到 1.62° 法向误差与 0.985 轮廓 IoU，优于对比的前馈转换器，并达到逐资产拟合需数千步才能获得的精度。
AI.conclusion: 前馈、可泛化的高斯字形/矢量资产转换方案，显著提升 3D 文本与图标内容的创建效率与可扩展性。

title: AdaPixFlow: Learning Continuous-Time 3D Dynamics Across Scenes from Sparse Multi-view Observations
summary: Understanding how objects move in dynamic scenes requires recovering their 3D motion from visual observations and predicting their positions at unobserved times. Existing methods either optimize scene-specific velocity fields or impose predefined physical and kinematic assumptions. We instead study learning a continuous-time dynamics operator across scenes, mapping multi-view visual observations to 3D object kinematics. We introduce Adaptive Pixel Flows (\ours{}), which learns this operator from multi-view RGB-D observations without per-scene optimization or predefined motion models. The method fuses observations from all cameras into a shared voxel grid in world coordinates, from which the network predicts a continuous-time velocity field. Because the operator is trained across scenes, it learns motion priors that carry over to unseen scenes. The field can then be integrated from observed states to predict object positions between observations and beyond the observed sequence. On held-out PhysInOne scenes, \ours{} improves F1 over the strongest competing method by 2.5\% for in-between prediction and 15\% for future prediction. Compared with per-scene velocity-field methods, the improvements are 30\% and 85\%, respectively. Applied zero-shot to Spring-Gaus, it improves future-prediction F1 by 12\%.

AI.tldr: 提出 Adaptive Pixel Flows，把多视角 RGB-D 观测直接映射为世界坐标系下的连续时间 3D 速度场算子，无需逐场景优化或预设物理/运动模型，可跨场景泛化并积分预测中间与未来时刻位姿。
AI.motivation: 动态场景中的物体运动理解需要从视觉观测恢复 3D 运动并预测未观测时刻的位置。现有方法要么做场景特定的速度场优化（不泛化），要么强加预设的物理/运动学假设（先验受限），缺乏可跨场景复用的连续时间动力学算子。
AI.method: 将全部相机观测融合到世界坐标下的共享体素网格，网络从该统一表示预测连续时间速度场；算子跨场景训练以获得可迁移的运动先验；再对场从已观测状态做积分，外推至观测间与观测序列之外。无需 per-scene 优化或预定义运动模型。
AI.result: 在留出 PhysInOne 场景上，F1 相对最强对比方法：中间时刻预测提升 2.5%，未来预测提升 15%；相对 per-scene 速度场方法分别提升 30% 和 85%。零样本迁移到 Spring-Gaus，未来预测 F1 提升 12%。
AI.conclusion: 跨场景学习的连续时间动力学算子可作为通用运动先验，显著优于场景特定优化与刚性运动假设，并具备零样本泛化能力；但摘要未给出真实机器人闭环验证，属离线感知/预测层面的贡献。

title: HumanCOIN: A 12,500-Hour Dataset for Human Intent in Egocentric Manipulation
comment: 41 pages, 10 figures, Project page: this https URL
summary: First-person manipulation datasets treat the observation-action pair as the atomic unit and compress the generation and execution of an action into a policy network's weights, rendering the intent state behind the action unobservable. Human motor control research shows that intent mediates between observation and action and leaves observable traces along the intent pathway from decision to effect: gaze reaches the target before the hand, muscle load builds before contact, and cortical activity precedes the motor command. To record this pathway at scale, we present HumanCOIN, a first-person manipulation dataset built around human intent: 12,500 hours across 38 scene classes with three tiers of proxies. At the output end, the L1 attention tier (10,000 h) infers gaze from headband camera video, exposing the operator's next object of attention and reach before the hand moves. Midway, the L2 exertion tier (2,000 h) records surface EMG from armbands, making load expectations readable before execution is complete. At the origin, the L3 cognition tier (500 h) records scalp EEG, giving early readouts of task decisions and monitoring. Each tier inherits all proxies from the tiers below. The dataset further provides multi-view RGB images, depth maps and point clouds, 6-DoF head and wrist pose, and step-level action and object annotations. The controlled L3 setting additionally measures gaze, hand pose and finger kinematics directly. Clock and calibration data are released with the dataset so that any read rate can be re-aligned. The three tiers cover three stations, from visual orienting to cortical preparation, making the process behind visual-action pairs available for modeling at dataset scale. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: HumanCOIN：以人类意图为组织原则的第一人称操作数据集，12500小时、38个场景类，设L1注视（1万h）、L2表面肌电（2千h）、L3头皮脑电（500h）三层意图代理信号，附多视角RGB/深度/点云、6-DoF头腕位姿、步骤级动作与物体标注。
AI.motivation: 现有第一人称操作数据集把"观测-动作"对当作原子单元，将动作的生成与执行压缩进策略网络权重，使动作背后的意图状态不可观测，限制了从意图层面对视觉-动作映射建模的可能。
AI.method: 基于人类运动控制中"意图中介观测与动作并沿决策→效应路径留下可观测痕迹"的假设，构建三层代理信号采集体系：L1由头带相机推断注视以暴露下一注意/抓取目标；L2用臂环表面肌电记录发力预期；L3用头皮脑电记录决策与监控的早期读数。层间继承（高层含低层全部代理），并提供时钟与标定数据以支持任意读取率的重新对齐；L3受控环境还直接测量注视、手部位姿与手指运动学。
AI.result: 发布12500小时、38类场景的大规模数据，含多模态第一人称视觉（RGB多视角、深度、点云）、6-DoF头与腕位姿、步骤级动作/物体标注，以及可复现的三层意图代理信号。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将数据集的组织单元从"观测-动作对"上移到"意图路径"，使视觉-动作对背后的过程可在大规模数据上建模，为意图感知、意图条件策略学习与人机交互提供新的数据基础。

title: Asuka-FM: A System-Architectural Co-Design Framework for Efficient Text-to-Image Pretraining on Consumer Hardware
comment: 40 pages, 19 figures, 17 tables. Project page: this https URL ; Code: this https URL
summary: Frontier text-to-image (T2I) foundation models predominantly rely on multi-billion parameter Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) pretrained across massive compute clusters, creating an accessibility barrier for academic laboratories. When training DiTs from scratch on single consumer GPUs (e.g., an NVIDIA RTX 4090 with 24\,GB VRAM), practitioners encounter three primary bottlenecks: quadratic attention sequence costs, Just-In-Time (JIT) compilation graph breaks induced by variable aspect-ratio bucketing, and an autoencoder throughput wall where frozen Variational Autoencoder (VAE) operations dominate step latency. In this work, we introduce \textbf{Asuka-FM}, an end-to-end system and architectural framework demonstrating that competitive dual-stream DiTs ($\sim$206M parameters) can be pretrained from scratch on a single consumer GPU in $\sim$160 GPU hours for under \$55. Asuka-FM integrates four core designs: (i) an AdaLN-free dual-stream DiT backbone reducing parameter count; (ii) structured sequence sparsification via Sparse-Dense Residual Fusion (SPRINT) to cut attention FLOPs by over 50\%; (iii) continuous aspect-normalized Rotary Position Embeddings (RoPE) coupled with shifted square crop training, guaranteeing static tensor shapes while unlocking zero-shot virtual camera control; and (iv) a pixel adaptation phase utilizing a lightweight (10M parameter) Patch Detailer Head operating under velocity regression ($v$-prediction). Evaluated on open-domain benchmarks without benchmark-specific fine-tuning, Asuka-FM achieves GenEval 0.588 / DPG 78.96 scores at 256px and GenEval 0.609 / DPG 78.51 scores at 512px, setting a new Pareto-optimal efficiency standard for democratic foundation modeling.

AI.tldr: Asuka-FM：在单张消费级RTX 4090上约160 GPU小时、成本低于55美元从零预训练约206M参数的免AdaLN双流DiT文本到图像模型，256px取得GenEval 0.588/DPG 78.96，512px取得0.609/78.51。
AI.motivation: 前沿T2I基础模型依赖数十亿参数DiT与大规模算力集群，学术实验室难以复现；单卡24GB从零训练面临三大瓶颈：注意力二次复杂度、变长宽比分桶引发的JIT编译图断裂、冻结VAE吞吐墙导致步延迟被编码解码主导。
AI.method: 四项设计：(i) 免AdaLN双流DiT主干，降低参数量；(ii) SPRINT稀疏-稠密残差融合的结构化序列稀疏化，注意力FLOPs降幅超50%；(iii) 连续宽高比归一化RoPE＋平移方形裁剪训练，保证张量形状静态、消除重编译，并获得零样本虚拟相机控制；(iv) 像素适配阶段：10M参数轻量Patch Detailer Head以速度回归(v-prediction)训练。
AI.result: 无基准特定微调的开放域评测：256px GenEval 0.588 / DPG 78.96；512px GenEval 0.609 / DPG 78.51；约160 GPU小时、<55美元完成预训练，形成效率维度的Pareto最优。
AI.conclusion: 表明竞争性双流DiT可在单张消费级GPU上从零预训练，降低了T2I基础建模的门槛；稀疏化、形状静态化与低成本像素适配可有效缓解单卡训练的系统瓶颈。

title: Risk-Controlled Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Retrieval-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) models enable efficient test-time adaptation by leveraging expert demonstrations as additional context without updating model parameters. However, even when retrieved demonstrations are relevant to the current task, the VLA may fail to effectively utilize the retrieved information, ultimately leading to task failure. To address this challenge, we propose R2-VLA, a risk-controlled retrieval-augmented VLA framework that enables reliable test-time adaptation by satisfying a user-specified task success rate requirement with minimal expert assistance. Specifically, R2-VLA learns an uncertainty predictor that estimates the uncertainty of the VLA's predicted actions given the retrieved demonstrations, guiding when to act autonomously or request expert assistance. We further introduce a task-level risk-control procedure that calibrates the uncertainty threshold to satisfy a user-specified task-failure risk requirement. Moreover, R2-VLA continually incorporates expert corrections into its retrieval memory to improve future adaptation while preserving the prescribed task-level risk guarantee. Experiments across three VLA backbones and four LIBERO benchmark suites demonstrate that R2-VLA improves average task success by 9.2--11.2 percentage points, achieving the desired target with fewer expert requests. These results highlight the effectiveness of connecting the usefulness of retrieved demonstrations with task-level risk control to enable successful robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: R2-VLA：为检索增强VLA引入不确定性预测器与任务级风险控制校准，按用户指定失败率阈值决定自主执行或请求专家纠正，并将纠正持续写入检索记忆。
AI.motivation: 检索增强VLA虽可在推理时利用专家示范作为上下文而无需更新参数，但即使检索到的示范与当前任务相关，模型也可能无法有效利用这些信息而导致任务失败。因此需要一种机制判断“检索知识是否可信可用”，并在有风险时以最小专家干预代价保障任务成功率。
AI.method: 学习一个不确定性预测器，基于检索到的示范估计VLA预测动作的不确定性；以此门控决定自主执行还是请求专家辅助。引入任务级风险控制流程，校准不确定性阈值以满足用户指定的任务失败风险要求。同时将专家纠正增量式写入检索记忆以提升后续适应，同时保持规定的任务级风险保证。
AI.result: 在3种VLA骨干网络与4个LIBERO基准套件上，平均任务成功率提升9.2–11.2个百分点，且以更少的专家请求次数达到预定目标成功率。
AI.conclusion: 将“检索示范的有用性”与任务级风险控制相连接，是实现可靠测试时自适应与成功机器人操作的有效途径；但验证限于LIBERO仿真，缺少真实机器人部署证据。

title: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a failure comes from reasoning, execution, or their composition. We introduce Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark of 30 simulated manipulation tasks from five real-world application domains. Each task has three difficulty levels and two scene settings (Clean and Random), yielding 180 configurations. The tasks form three views: Mind tests decisions based on past observations, Act tests precise and timely execution, and Mind2Act combines both in closed-loop tasks where action outcomes guide later decisions. Comparing the three views shows whether a system lacks a capability or fails to compose capabilities it already has. A diagnosis harness further attributes the failed episodes of three representative systems to Mind, Act, or their composition and summarizes each system in a profile card. Our evaluation of multimodal agents, vision-language-action models (VLAs), and world-action models (WAMs) shows that competence in a single view does not carry over to Mind2Act tasks. Even the strongest agent succeeds in 52.7% of Mind and 39.0% of Act episodes but in only 12.0% of Mind2Act episodes. The strongest agent retains task state but struggles with sustained contact, whereas end-to-end policies execute practiced motions but retain little task state. These findings point to composing reasoning and execution through environmental feedback as the main open problem.

AI.tldr: Mind2Act World：30个仿真操作任务、180种配置的诊断基准，用 Mind/Act/Mind2Act 三视图区分“能力缺失”与“组合失败”，并附失败归因harness。
