AI.motivation: 现有基准或把推理与执行放在同一任务里评，或分开评而不评其组合，无法判断失败来源于推理、执行还是二者的组合。
AI.method: 构建30个仿真操作任务（5个应用域×3难度×Clean/Random场景=180配置），设计三个视图：Mind（基于历史观测的决策）、Act（精确及时执行）、Mind2Act（闭环中动作结果反馈指导后续决策）；另设诊断harness，将失败轨迹归因到Mind、Act或组合，并生成profile card。评测多模态agent、VLA与WAM。
AI.result: 单视图能力不能迁移到Mind2Act：最强agent在Mind 52.7%、Act 39.0%，但Mind2Act仅12.0%。最强agent能保持任务状态但难以维持持续接触；端到端策略能执行熟练动作但任务状态保持差。
AI.conclusion: 通过环境反馈组合推理与执行是当前主要开放问题；单一维度的高分不足以预测闭环具身任务表现。

title: Fixing the Last Mile: Failure-Aware Image Restoration with Region-Specific Guidance
summary: Recent advances in image restoration have greatly improved global image fidelity, producing visually plausible results across most regions of an image. Nevertheless, even high-quality restorations often exhibit localized failures, including artifacts in semantically important regions such as faces and text, structural inconsistencies, and texture mismatches. Although these errors typically affect only a small portion of the image, they often dominate the overall perceptual quality of the result. In this work, we propose Failure-Aware Image Restoration (FAIR) to address the "last-mile" problem in image restoration. Rather than applying one uniform generative prior over the whole image, we condition a single-pass restoration model on both where local failures are likely to occur and what corrective guidance each region requires. This region-bound conditioning enables fine-grained and controllable restoration that improves semantic accuracy and stylistic consistency in critical regions while maintaining faithful, high-quality restoration elsewhere. Our method complements existing restoration pipelines by shifting the emphasis from global fidelity to local perceptual acceptability. Extensive experiments show that the proposed approach resolves common failure cases and improves perceptual quality, bridging the gap between technical accuracy and practical usability.

AI.tldr: 提出失败感知图像修复（FAIR），用区域绑定条件（失败定位+纠正引导）驱动单次修复模型，聚焦局部感知失败，改善关键区域语义与风格一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有图像修复虽在全局保真度上大幅提升，但人脸、文字等语义关键区域仍存在伪影、结构不一致与纹理失配等局部失败；这些区域面积虽小却主导整体感知质量，即修复的“最后一公里”问题。
AI.method: 不再对全图施加统一生成先验，而是在单次（single-pass）修复模型上引入区域绑定条件：同时编码“何处可能发生局部失败”与“该区域需要何种纠正引导”，实现细粒度、可控的区域级条件生成，并可与现有修复流程互补。
AI.result: 大量实验表明该方法能化解常见失败案例，提升感知质量，在关键区域改善语义准确性与风格一致性，同时在其他区域保持忠实高质量修复。
AI.conclusion: 将修复重心从全局保真转向局部感知可接受性，弥合技术精度与实际可用性之间的差距，是“最后一公里”修复的有效范式。

title: SHUSH: Emission-Aware Reward Design for Proactive Video Assistants
summary: Proactive video assistants must decide not only what to say, but also when to speak. Existing reinforcement-learning objectives can reward timely, correct responses without accounting for response volume, thereby encouraging unnecessary or repeated emissions. We identify this failure mode in MMDuet2, whose proactive area-under-the-curve (PAUC) reward promotes timely responses but does not price the number of emissions. We show analytically that this makes additional responses weakly penalized or effectively free, systematically encouraging over-emission. We then propose an emission-aware F1 reward for interval-valued annotations, using exclusive span--emission matching to price false emissions and missed spans. Under MMDuet2's training recipe, our policy on the visual subset of OmniPro replies 2.5x less often than MMDuet2 while raising timing F1 from 0.259 to 0.396 and content-aware F1 from 0.103 to 0.154; a more conservative variant cuts replies by 82.5% and raises precision from 0.161 to 0.418. On ProactiveVideoQA, the same reward adds replies where the baseline is nearly silent, and PAUC ranks a heavily over-emitting policy second despite near-last F1, because it is insensitive to response count. Our results indicate that proactive assistants should be trained and evaluated with objectives that price emissions.

AI.tldr: 分析MMDuet2主动视频助手的PAUC奖励不看发射次数，导致"过度说话"；提出区间标注下的发射感知F1奖励，减少冗余回复并提升时序与内容F1。
AI.motivation: 主动视频助手的RL奖励可鼓励及时正确响应，却不计响应条数，使额外/重复发言几乎无惩罚，系统性诱导过度发射。作者想在MMDuet2中定位并修正该失效模式。
AI.method: 解析证明PAUC对额外响应的惩罚弱或为零；设计针对区间标注的发射感知F1奖励，用独占的span–发射匹配同时计价误发射与漏span；沿用MMDuet2训练配方，并给出更保守的变体。
AI.result: OmniPro视觉子集上回复量降2.5倍，时序F1由0.259升至0.396，内容F1由0.103升至0.154；保守变体减82.5%回复，精度0.161→0.418。ProactiveVideoQA上同一奖励在基线近乎沉默处补出回复；PAUC把严重过度发射策略排第二。
AI.conclusion: 主动助手应以"为发射计价"的目标来训练与评测；PAUC等仅看时序曲线的指标不足以约束响应量。

title: An Open-Source ROS 2 Framework for Shared Control in Surgical Teleoperation: Integrating the Haply Inverse3 with the da Vinci Research Kit
summary: Surgical teleoperation deprives surgeons of touch, forcing visual inference of tissue forces; the commercial platforms now restoring force feedback remain closed, preventing open research on haptic shared control. This paper provides a system contribution: it presents an open-source, ROS 2-native framework that integrates the compact, three-degree-of-freedom (3-DOF) Haply Inverse3 haptic device with the da~Vinci Research Kit (dVRK). The framework includes a novel mapping strategy that combines 3-DOF translational device input with separately tracked VerseGrip orientation into 6-DOF patient-side manipulator commands. Two virtual-fixture-inspired guidance modes serve as reference implementations to evaluate the framework in a within-subjects user study on a teleoperated hot-wire benchmark task in simulation, and the architecture is further demonstrated on physical dVRK hardware. Relative to unassisted manual control, linear guidance significantly reduced both the number of wire contacts and the task completion time, whereas the progressive-stiffness guidance produced consistent but statistically non-significant trends in the same direction. Subjective ratings of workload, agency, and satisfaction showed favorable descriptive trends for the guidance modes. The results demonstrate the feasibility of haptic shared control with a compact device coupled to the dVRK and provide an openly available, reproducible platform for future research. They further suggest that simpler linear feedback may be more robust for inexperienced operators than more complex profiles.

AI.tldr: 开源ROS 2框架将3-DOF Haply Inverse3力反馈设备与dVRK集成，并用虚拟夹具式线性/渐进刚度引导在热丝基准任务中验证触觉共享控制可行性。
AI.motivation: 手术遥操作缺乏力觉反馈，现有商用力反馈平台封闭，阻碍触觉共享控制的开放研究；需要低成本紧凑设备的开源集成方案。
AI.method: ROS 2原生开源框架，融合Haply Inverse3三自由度平动输入与单独跟踪的VerseGrip姿态，生成6-DOF患者侧机械臂指令；实现线性与渐进刚度两种虚拟夹具引导模式作为参考；在仿真热丝任务中做被试内用户研究，并在实体dVRK上演示架构。
AI.result: 相比无辅助手动控制，线性引导显著降低导线碰撞次数与任务完成时间；渐进刚度引导呈一致但统计不显著的趋势；工作负荷、能动感与满意度主观评分呈有利描述性趋势。
AI.conclusion: 证明了紧凑力反馈设备与dVRK耦合实现触觉共享控制的可行性，提供可复现的开放平台；并提示对经验不足的操作者而言，简单线性反馈可能比复杂力曲线更稳健。

title: SGAR: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction via Sparse Geometry-Guided Attention
summary: Feed-forward models have been very successful in 3D reconstruction with ad hoc attention designs that relate all view patches densely. However, the cost of this dense global attention grows quadratically with the number of views, preventing the model from applying to larger-scale reconstruction settings. In this paper, we argue that most dense attention computations are unnecessary from a classical structure-from-motion perspective: 3D structures stem from geometrically matching regions in 2D. We bring this principle to learning-based feed-forward reconstruction with our Sparse Geometric Attention Reconstruction (SGAR) method. In SGAR, each patch token attends to only a small set of patch tokens from other views, chosen by a lightweight learned key selection module trained to predict cross-view 3D proximity of tokens. Thus, dense global attention is replaced by much more efficient geometric-similarity-guided sparse attention. SGAR is a general method that can be applied to different feed-forward models by fine-tuning. In our experiments, we show that SGAR is the fastest among both state-of-the-art dense and sparse methods and the most accurate sparse one. It runs up to 12-times faster than dense attention at 1,000 views with stable pose accuracy where existing sparse methods fail, and shows the best performance in reconstructing more complete geometries on the same time budget.

AI.tldr: SGAR用学习到的关键帧/关键token选择模块预测跨视角3D邻近性，将前馈三维重建中的稠密全局注意力替换为几何相似性引导的稀疏注意力，可在1000视角下比稠密方法快约12倍且保持稳定位姿精度。
AI.motivation: 前馈式三维重建模型依赖逐视角patch的稠密全局注意力，计算量随视角数二次增长，难以扩展到大规模重建场景；而SfM视角下大部分稠密注意力计算是冗余的，因为三维结构本质上来自二维几何匹配区域。
AI.method: 提出SGAR：每个patch token只与来自其他视角的小部分token交互，由轻量级可学习的key选择模块选取，该模块经训练预测token间的跨视角3D邻近度；以此用几何相似性引导的稀疏注意力替代稠密全局注意力。SGAR为通用方法，可通过微调接入不同的前馈重建模型。
AI.result: 在稠密与稀疏SOTA方法中SGAR速度最快、稀疏方法中精度最高；1000视角下比稠密注意力快至多12倍，位姿精度稳定（现有稀疏方法在该规模失效），同等时间预算下重建几何更完整。
AI.conclusion: 几何原则指导的稀疏注意力是实现可扩展前馈三维重建的有效途径，兼顾速度与精度，并具通用性。

title: JARVIS: An Agent That Designs, Builds, and Tests Circuit Boards on Its Own
summary: Power electronics is central to the energy transition, but developing new hardware still relies on human-led design, fabrication, testing, and iteration. We present JARVIS, an embodied AI agent that autonomously closes this loop for circuit boards. JARVIS maintains machine-specific capabilities and constraints, scans its workspace using a robot-mounted 3D scanner, and constructs an executable digital twin in which it rehearses robot motions, fabrication steps, and circuit behavior before consuming materials. A single text instruction initiates the physical experiment. Using unmodified desktop equipment, the agent coordinates a robot arm, a PCB printer that deposits conductive silver ink and solder paste, and a pick-and-place machine. It verifies progress using cameras and sensors, then tests the fabricated circuit with an OPAL-RT real-time simulator and an oscilloscope. Based on the measurements, JARVIS diagnoses deviations from the design and generates a revised design in KiCad for subsequent rehearsal. In a demonstration involving a 60 Hz notch filter for grid-connected converter sensing, JARVIS completed a first-run experiment in 2 h 39 min without human intervention, achieving 50.6 dB attenuation at 60 Hz. Its digital-twin rehearsal identified five issues before fabrication, including a test criterion that would have incorrectly rejected a functioning board. During execution, the agent also resolved encountered faults autonomously. These results demonstrate an integrated agent-driven workflow for physical design, fabrication, measurement, and iterative improvement of power-electronic circuitry. To our knowledge, JARVIS is the first system in power electronics in which an agent closes the physical design-build-test-learn loop for circuit boards.

AI.tldr: JARVIS是一个具身AI智能体系统，能自主完成电力电子电路板的"设计-制造-测试-学习"闭环：机器人3D扫描构建可执行数字孪生并预演动作与电路行为，驱动PCB打印/贴装机与机械臂，用示波器与OPAL-RT实时仿真器测量，再依据偏差在KiCad中改版重做。
AI.motivation: 电力电子硬件迭代高度依赖人工完成设计、制造、测试与改进，缺乏自动化闭环手段，制约能源转型相关的硬件研发效率。
AI.method: 提出具身智能体JARVIS：维护机器特定能力与约束知识；用机载3D扫描仪扫描工作空间并构建可执行数字孪生，在消耗材料前预演机器人运动、制造步骤与电路行为；以单条文本指令启动物理实验，协调机械臂、沉积导电银浆与锡膏的PCB打印机及贴片机；通过相机与传感器核验进度，用OPAL-RT实时仿真器与示波器测试电路；基于测量诊断设计偏差并在KiCad中生成修订设计进行下一轮预演。
AI.result: 在60 Hz陷波滤波器（并网变流器采样）演示中，JARVIS无人干预于2小时39分钟内完成首轮实验，60 Hz处衰减达50.6 dB；数字孪生预演在制造前发现5个问题（含一个会误判合格板为不合格的测试判据），执行过程中还自主解决了遇到的故障；使用未改装的桌面级设备。
AI.conclusion: JARVIS展示了集成化的智能体驱动电力电子电路物理设计、制造、测量与迭代改进工作流，据称是电力电子领域首个由智能体闭合电路板物理设计-制造-测试-学习回路的系统。

title: Visual Attribution Limits and Graded Provenance Auditing in Commercial Video-Generation APIs
summary: Commercial video-generation APIs bill by model and tier, while intermediaries could substitute cheaper models, lower tiers, or cached clips. What can a delivered file establish about its origin? We combine measurements of passive attribution and cryptographic provenance into a graded audit. We test attribution probes and zero-shot detectors under re-encoding, downscaling, and frame-rate changes, and survey C2PA and GB 45438 metadata across 19 commercial endpoints. Only authenticated provenance supports accusations: tier contradictions or duplicate signed instances under fresh-generation contracts, excluding retries and idempotent returns. Unverifiable signed-endpoint deliveries trigger original-file demands under pass-through clauses; archive-reuse and delivery-parameter screens support review only. Six-model container and bitstream accuracy falls from 83.9% on raw files to 45.3% after uniform re-encoding, using different feature sets. Subsampling real references from 24 to 3 fps raises pooled D3 AUROC from 0.845 to 0.988. Only BytePlus authenticates tier claims under our pinned policy, including 187/187 audited deliveries across three Seedance tiers; tested remuxing and re-encoding leave processed Seedance files unverifiable. The audit identifies authenticated contradictions in 100/100 raw 720p signed tier-swap cases, with zero observed false flags on the tested honest pools.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个分级审计框架，将被动归因测量与密码学来源认证（C2PA/GB 45438）结合，用于判断商业视频生成API交付文件的来源；实验表明仅认证来源可支撑指控，多数端点的来源可验证性脆弱。
AI.motivation: 商业视频生成API按模型与档位计费，中间商可替换为更便宜模型、低档位或缓存片段，因此需要明确“交付文件能证明什么关于其来源的信息”，并区分可用于指控的证据与仅可提示复核的线索。
AI.method: 1) 对19个商业端点做被动归因测量，测试归因探针与零样本检测器在重编码、降采样、帧率变化下的鲁棒性；2) 系统调查C2PA与GB 45438元数据；3) 构建分级审计规则：仅认证来源支持指控（档位矛盾、在全新生成合约下出现重复签名实例，排除重试与幂等返回）；无法验证的签名端点交付则依据直通条款要求原始文件；档案复用与交付参数筛查仅支持复核；4) 在24→3 fps参考子采样下评估D3 AUROC，并检验BytePlus各档位的认证一致性及720p签名档位替换案例的检出率。
AI.result: 六模型容器/比特流准确率在均匀重编码后从83.9%降至45.3%；参考子采样从24 fps降至3 fps使合并D3 AUROC由0.845升至0.988；仅BytePlus在其固定策略下可认证档位声明，包括三个Seedance档位共187/187次审计交付；重新封装与重编码后的Seedance文件不可验证；审计在100/100原始720p签名档位替换案例中识别出认证矛盾，且测试的诚实池中零误报。
AI.conclusion: 被动取证在常规处理后迅速失效，密码学来源认证是唯一可支持来源指控的依据；分级审计设计可区分“可指控”与“仅可复核”证据，并暴露当前商业视频生成API来源透明度的普遍不足。

title: Direct3D-V3: Latent-Free Diffusion Transformers in the Native Voxel Domain
comment: The Project Page is: this https URL . The Paper is published in ACM TOG (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026)
summary: Native 3D generation has largely been built around latent diffusion, with recent advances concentrating on stronger variational autoencoders (VAE) and increasingly elaborate latent representations, from vecset and triplanes to structured sparse voxels. Despite their architectural differences, these methods all share the same premise: geometry is first compressed into a latent space and only then modeled by the generator. We take a different route and propose Direct3D-V3, a latent-free diffusion transformer (DiT) framework that discards the VAE altogether and operates in the native voxel domain, directly modeling raw SDF voxel grids during both training and sampling. To make this direct voxel formulation geometrically reliable, we introduce an implicit manifold regularization over neighboring voxels to suppress non-watertight surfaces, and convert predicted SDF grids into meshes via Marching Cubes so that rendered normal losses can supervise the model directly from its predicted SDF. To improve alignment between the conditioning image and generated geometry, Direct3D-V3 also predicts the camera parameters of the conditioning image as an auxiliary task, encouraging the DiT to learn the mapping from image observations to 3D shape. This latent-free design removes the reconstruction bottleneck, brings training under an objective in the native voxel domain, and yields meshes with substantially richer local detail. The predicted camera and native SDF voxel output further make Direct3D-V3 extensible to generative reconstruction, where diffusion is interleaved with normal-guided refinement to improve alignment with the observed view while the generative prior completes unseen regions. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: Direct3D-V3去掉VAE，在原生SDF体素域上用DiT直接扩散生成3D形状，配合流形正则与法向渲染损失提升几何质量。
AI.motivation: 现有原生3D生成普遍依赖潜空间扩散，瓶颈在于VAE重建精度与潜表示设计（vecset/triplane/稀疏体素等）复杂却仍受压缩损失限制，导致细节丢失。作者希望彻底移除VAE，直接在原生体素域建模几何。
AI.method: 提出无潜变量的DiT框架，直接对原始SDF体素网格做扩散训练与采样；引入邻域体素的隐式流形正则抑制非水密表面；通过Marching Cubes将预测SDF转为网格，用渲染法向损失由预测SDF直接监督模型；附加相机参数预测作为辅助任务，增强图像条件与几何的对应；并可将扩散与法向引导细化交替用于生成式重建。
AI.result: 消除重建瓶颈，训练目标直接作用于原生体素域，生成网格具有明显更丰富的局部细节；生成式重建中扩散先验补全未观测区域，法向引导细化提升与观测视角的对齐。
AI.conclusion: 无潜变量的原生体素扩散是一条可行的原生3D生成路线，配合流形正则与法向监督可在保证水密性与表面质量的同时提升细节与条件对齐，并可自然扩展到生成式重建。

title: Plan4D: Generative Plannable 4D Worlds
comment: NeurIPS 2026, Project Page: this https URL
summary: Most world models for future prediction prioritize aestetic quality of generated videos, but offer only weak physical grounding and limited geometric consistency over time, due to the lack of explicit 4D modeling. In this paper, we introduce plan4d, a possible next milestone towards building a generative plannable 4D world model that predicts future RGB videos together with dense 4D geometry, including depth, cameras, point clouds, and scene flow from an observed scene context and text-specified actions. Since training data with paired actions and dense 4D annotations is inherently scarce, plan4d leverages the complementary priors of foundational video generators and 3D reconstructors. Specifically, we propose a model-stitching architecture that couples Depth Anything 3 with LongCat-Video and augments it with an auxiliary DPT head for scene-flow prediction. The resulting model allows us to plan and generate complex, long-horizon, and fine-grained actions in a dynamic 3D scenes, while substantially improving both visual fidelity and geometric accuracy of the generated future videos. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that plan4d achieves state-of-the-art performance in generative 4D modeling of environmental reactions. Project Page: this https URL

AI.tldr: plan4d：一个可规划、可生成的4D世界模型，根据观测场景上下文与文本动作，同时预测未来RGB视频与稠密4D几何（深度、相机、点云、场景流）。通过"模型拼接"方式耦合Depth Anything 3与LongCat-Video，并加一个DPT头做场景流预测，从而在数据稀缺下利用视频生成器与3D重建器的互补先验。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型偏重视觉美观，缺乏显式4D建模，导致物理接地弱、时序几何一致性差，无法支持细粒度、长时程、可规划的动态场景预测。同时，配对"动作—稠密4D标注"的训练数据稀缺。
AI.method: 模型拼接架构：将Depth Anything 3（3D重建先验）与LongCat-Video（视频生成先验）耦合，并附加辅助DPT头预测场景流；以文本指定的动作为条件，从场景上下文生成未来视频与稠密4D几何。
AI.result: 在合成与真实数据集上，生成视频的视觉保真度与几何精度均有显著提升，在环境反应的生成式4D建模上达到SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 显式4D建模结合基础模型先验拼接，是迈向可规划生成式4D世界模型的可行路径；但其真实世界泛化与下游具身应用仍待验证。

title: ACE-Brain-0.7: Learning Execution-Grounded Reasoning for Embodied Agents
summary: Reliable reasoning for long-horizon embodied tasks requires predictions grounded in the observed execution state. We present ACE-Brain-0.7, a 9B vision--language model that combines spatial grounding, task understanding, and progress estimation. To train the model, we curate 3.7 million question--answer pairs, drawing execution supervision from egocentric human videos, robot episodes, and simulation. These questions span different stages of an execution and connect task-level judgments with observed progress and outcomes. We then fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on this collection together with additional task, spatial-grounding, and progress-estimation data. Across six public task-reasoning benchmarks, ACE-Brain-0.7 achieves an average score of 76.5, ahead of GPT-6 Astra at 72.7 and Claude Opus 5.5 at 73.5. Our model also leads the evaluated models in spatial grounding, averaging 75.90 across seven benchmarks and reaching 91.25 Acc@0.5 on RefCOCOg. Controlled evaluations further indicate that our task-only model makes more effective use of visual history and more accurately distinguishes execution states. Together, these results show that ACE-Brain-0.7 effectively combines spatial perception with temporal understanding, delivering strong execution-grounded reasoning and comparing favorably with closed-source models.

AI.tldr: ACE-Brain-0.7：9B 视觉语言模型，融合空间定位、任务理解与进度估计，用 370 万 VQA 对（自我中心人类视频、机器人片段、仿真）微调 Qwen3.5-9B。
AI.motivation: 长时程具身任务需要基于执行状态的可靠推理，现有 VLM 缺乏对执行进度与结果的时间性监督。
AI.method: 构建 370 万问答对，覆盖执行不同阶段，将任务级判断与观测到的进度/结果关联；辅以任务、空间定位、进度估计数据，微调 Qwen3.5-9B。
AI.result: 6 个任务推理基准平均 76.5（GPT-6 Astra 72.7、Claude Opus 5.5 73.5）；7 个空间定位基准平均 75.90，RefCOCOg Acc@0.5 达 91.25；对照实验显示仅任务模型更有效利用视觉历史、更准确区分执行状态。
AI.conclusion: 空间感知与时间理解的有效结合带来执行落地的推理能力，可媲美闭源模型；但为纯 VLM 数据+微调路线，无真实机器人部署证据。

title: Deterministic Temporal Embedding for Calcium Imaging Trace Extraction
summary: Reliable extraction of calcium-dependent fluorescence traces in calcium imaging sequences requires identifying pixels whose fluorescence intensity reflects the same underlying cellular activity. We present a deterministic temporal embedding framework that maps pixel-wise fluorescence traces to a low-dimensional representation in which temporally coherent sources form spatially coherent regions. Starting from a fuzzy-neighborhood graph and spectral initialization, we optimize a class-balanced cross-entropy objective using exact sparse attraction and a deterministic particle-mesh decomposition of the dense repulsive interaction with sparse edge compensation, avoiding stochastic negative sampling. The resulting latent representation is spatially decoded into reliable source supports for trace extraction without imposing an explicit cellular shape prior. Experiments on synthetic and in vivo two-photon calcium imaging data demonstrate robust recovery of irregular and spatially touching sources together with efficient deterministic embedding optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出确定性时序嵌入框架，将像素级钙荧光轨迹映射到低维表示，使时间相干源形成空间相干区域，从而无细胞形状先验地提取可靠源支撑并提取轨迹。
AI.motivation: 钙成像序列中可靠提取荧光轨迹，需先找到反映同一细胞活动的像素集合；传统方法依赖形状先验或随机负采样，噪声与重叠源下不稳定。
AI.method: 以模糊邻域图与谱初始化构建嵌入；用精确稀疏吸引项 + 稠密排斥的确定性 particle-mesh 分解（含稀疏边补偿）做类平衡交叉熵优化，规避随机负采样；再将潜表示空间解码为源支撑，用于轨迹提取。
AI.result: 在合成数据与活体双光子钙成像数据上，稳健恢复不规则与空间相互接触的源，嵌入优化高效且完全确定性。
AI.conclusion: 确定性、无形状先验的嵌入式源分离对钙成像轨迹提取有效，可推广为通用时空相干源分割工具；但属神经科学专用成像分析，非机器人与3D视觉核心方向。

title: AURA: AUdio-dRiven streaming Avatar
comment: BMVC 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: Current audio-driven video diffusion models can synthesize realistic talking-head videos but generally require dozens of diffusion denoising steps over multi-second video chunks, making them unsuitable for streaming applications such as voice assistants and virtual avatars, where low-latency and online causal generation are required properties. AURA generates video chunk by chunk with a rolling KV cache, requiring only the audio of the current chunk to start generating, rather than a multi-second audio look-ahead like bidirectional models. It comes in two sizes: AURA 1.3B streams 576p video in real time on a single GPU (20.7 fps for a 16 Hz playback rate), making it suited to interactive avatar applications, and AURA 5B streams 720p video at 9.7 fps. Our two-stage distillation pipeline first aligns the causal student with the teacher, by training it to match the teacher's trajectories with fewer diffusion steps and a chunk-wise sliding window causal attention mask, then applies Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) with backward simulation to close the remaining quality gap. On standard talking-head benchmarks, AURA 1.3B runs 23x faster than its own bidirectional teacher and reaches a quality comparable to TalkVerse at a lower resolution, and AURA 5B matches its TalkVerse teacher at 720p while running 17x faster. To support reproducibility and further research on streaming avatar generation, we release the weights of both models along with a dataset of 30K synthetic videos and their precomputed teacher trajectories.

AI.tldr: AURA 是一个流式音频驱动说话头视频扩散模型，采用滚动 KV cache 逐块生成，配合两阶段蒸馏（教师轨迹对齐 + 带反向模拟的 DMD），1.3B 模型单卡实时输出 576p（20.7 fps），5B 模型 720p 达 9.7 fps。
AI.motivation: 现有音频驱动视频扩散模型需对多秒视频块执行数十步去噪，且依赖多秒音频前瞻，无法满足语音助手、虚拟人等场景的低延迟在线因果生成需求。
AI.method: 1) 因果学生模型以滚动 KV cache 逐块生成，仅用当前块音频即可起播；2) 两阶段蒸馏：先以更少扩散步数 + 块级滑动窗口因果注意力掩码对齐教师轨迹，再用 Distribution Matching Distillation（DMD）结合反向模拟（backward simulation）缩小残余质量差距；3) 提供 1.3B 与 5B 两种规模。
AI.result: 标准说话头基准上，AURA 1.3B 比其双向教师快 23 倍，低分辨率下质量接近 TalkVerse；AURA 5B 在 720p 匹配 TalkVerse 教师质量，速度快 17 倍；同时开源两模型权重、30K 合成视频数据集及预计算教师轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 通过滚动缓存因果架构与轨迹对齐+DMD 蒸馏，可将多步双向视频扩散教师压缩为实时流式生成器，实现在线因果说话头合成且质量损失可控。

title: Multi-institutional grading of Barrett's esophagus dysplasia without stain normalization using a pathology foundation model and multiple instance learning
summary: Barrett's esophagus dysplasia grading suffers substantial inter-observer variability, particularly for low-grade dysplasia, complicating clinical decision-making. We conducted a retrospective multi-institutional diagnostic accuracy study of a foundation model-based deep learning system for dysplasia grading, using 969 H\&E-stained whole slide images from four institutions. Patch-level classifiers trained on expert annotations identified diagnostically relevant regions, followed by attribute-aware multiple instance learning for slide-level classification as non-dysplastic Barrett's esophagus (NDBE), low-grade dysplasia, or high-grade dysplasia. On a held-out test set (n = 130), macro-averaged AUC was 0.96 (95\% CI 0.93--0.98). For binary dysplasia detection, sensitivity was 98\% (80/82) and specificity 81\% (39/48), with a negative likelihood ratio of 0.030 and quadratic-weighted \kap{} of 0.83 against expert consensus. No high-grade dysplasia case was misclassified as NDBE. Performance was consistent across institutions without stain normalization, indicating that stain-robust foundation-model representations may remove the site-specific preprocessing that has constrained prior systems to institution-specific deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出基于基础模型的深度学习系统用于Barrett食管异型增生分级：先用斑块级分类器定位诊断相关区域，再用属性感知多实例学习实现全切片三分类。
AI.motivation: Barrett食管异型增生分级（尤其低级别异型增生）观察者间一致性差，影响临床决策，需要客观、跨机构可用的辅助诊断工具。
AI.method: 回顾性多中心诊断准确性研究，4家机构共969张H&E全切片。两阶段流程：专家标注训练斑块级分类器筛选诊断相关区域，再用属性感知多实例学习（attribute-aware MIL）做切片级NDBE/低级别/高级别三分类；未使用染色归一化。
AI.result: 留出测试集（n=130）宏平均AUC 0.96（95%CI 0.93–0.98）；二分类检测敏感度98%（80/82）、特异度81%（39/48），阴性似然比0.030，与专家共识的二次加权κ=0.83；无高级别病例误判为NDBE；跨机构性能一致且无需染色归一化。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型的染色鲁棒表征可免除机构特定的预处理，使系统具备跨站点部署潜力，有望减少异型增生分级的主观变异性。

title: PhyDEX: A Benchmark for Physical Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models via Dynamic Extrinsic Dexterity
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly in language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks mainly evaluate gripper--object contact and largely ignore how objects interact with the environment through gravity, friction, inertia, and mass distribution. As a result, it remains unclear whether current policies truly understand physics or merely interpolate from their training data. We address this gap through the lens of dynamic extrinsic dexterity and introduce PhyDEX, a throwing benchmark in which a robot must infer an object's mass, center of mass, and friction to send it to a destination beyond its kinematic workspace. PhyDEX contains 35K trajectories (143 hours) across nine tasks and 100 scenes, covering uniform, irregular, and dynamic-mass objects with static, multiple, and moving destinations. All data are generated by a scalable, fully automatic pipeline that combines grasp generation, motion planning, and closed-loop throw optimization under randomized physical properties. We evaluate three representative VLAs, GR00T N1.7, DynamicVLA, and ForceVLA, and find that all achieve success rates below 3\%. Our analysis reveals two key bottlenecks: limited robustness of pretrained models, which causes most failures before the throw, and physical blindness, as providing ground-truth physical properties roughly doubles success. Experiments on a humanoid robot and in the real world show the same failure patterns. We hope PhyDEX will drive the development of physically grounded robot policies.

AI.tldr: 提出 PhyDEX 抛掷基准，用动态外在灵巧性考察 VLA 是否真正理解物理（质量、质心、摩擦），发现 GR00T N1.7、DynamicVLA、ForceVLA 成功率均低于 3%，瓶颈在于预训练鲁棒性与"物理盲"。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 基准主要评测夹爪-物体接触式操作，忽视重力、摩擦、惯性、质量分布等物理交互，无法判断策略是真懂物理还是在训练分布内插值。抛掷任务天然要求超出运动学工作空间的动态推理，是检验物理理解的理想探针。
AI.method: 构建 PhyDEX：35K 轨迹（143 小时）、9 任务、100 场景，涵盖均匀/不规则/动态质量物体与静态、多目标、移动目标；数据由全自动可扩展流水线生成，融合抓取生成、运动规划与随机物理属性下的闭环抛掷优化。评测三个代表性 VLA，并做注入真值物理属性的对照实验，另在人形机器人与真机上验证失效模式。
AI.result: 三个 VLA 成功率均 <3%；失败多发生在抛掷前的抓取/接近阶段（预训练鲁棒性不足）；提供真值物理属性后成功率约翻倍，说明存在明显物理盲。人形机器人与真实世界实验复现相同失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 抛掷这类动态外在灵巧任务暴露了当前 VLA 的物理理解缺失，PhyDEX 可作为推动物理落地策略发展的基准；未来需在鲁棒性与物理属性感知/推理两方面改进。

title: Text-Aware, Vision-Blind: How Multimodal Image Editing Systems Handle Unsafe Inputs
summary: Multimodal image generation systems have made rapid progress and increasingly emphasize content safety. However, their safety mechanisms tend to rely on a single modality and lack joint consideration of both visual content and text prompts, particularly in instruction-guided image editing, where the uploaded image may itself carry risk. We thus introduce EditSafetyBench, a benchmark that measures system-level safety awareness of advanced image editing systems, containing 5,940 image-instruction pairs, covering safe and unsafe images across 11 risk categories and three edit intents. We then probe the benchmark dataset on four systems, including Gemini, GPT, Qwen API, and Qwen Local. Based on our evaluation, we observe a systematic text-vision safety mismatch: Gemini and GPT refuse 87.1\% and 81.6\% cases containing unsafe-intent editing prompts, while only refusing 24.2\% and 22.4\% cases with both unsafe images and neutral instructions. At the category level, most risks are considered inconsistently by different systems, e.g., GPT allows 70.4\% editing attempts of unsafe political content while Gemini only allows 34.8\%. Notably, sexual content shows the strongest visual sensitivity, likely benefiting from mature NSFW identification works. Our findings highlight the need for safety guardrails that jointly reason over both visual and textual modalities in image editing systems.

AI.tldr: 提出 EditSafetyBench，含 5,940 组图像-指令对（11 类风险、3 种编辑意图、覆盖安全与不安全图像），用于评测图像编辑系统的系统级安全感知；在 Gemini、GPT、Qwen API、Qwen 本地模型上的评测揭示出系统性的"文本-视觉安全错配"：模型对含不安全意图的提示拒绝率高（87.1%/81.6%），但对"不安全图像+中性指令"仅拒绝 24.2%/22.4%。
AI.motivation: 多模态图像生成/编辑系统的安全机制多依赖单一模态，缺乏对视觉内容与文本指令的联合考量；在指令引导的图像编辑中，上传的图像本身可能携带风险，现有评测无法衡量系统级安全感知。
AI.method: 构建基准 EditSafetyBench：5,940 个图像-指令对，覆盖 11 个风险类别、3 种编辑意图，同时包含安全图像与不安全图像；在此基准上对四个系统（Gemini、GPT、Qwen API、Qwen Local）进行系统性探测与拒绝率/放行率统计，并按风险类别做细粒度分析。
AI.result: 发现系统性文本-视觉安全错配：Gemini 与 GPT 对含不安全编辑意图的样本拒绝率分别为 87.1% 与 81.6%，而对"不安全图像+中性指令"仅拒绝 24.2% 与 22.4%；类别层面各系统判断不一致（如政治类不安全内容 GPT 放行 70.4%，Gemini 仅 34.8%）；性相关内容视觉敏感度最高，可能得益于成熟的 NSFW 识别方法。
AI.conclusion: 图像编辑系统的安全护栏需同时对视觉与文本模态进行联合推理，仅依赖文本层面的拒绝机制会系统性漏检图像侧风险。

title: Probing the "Conscious" Mind: Selective Access and Global Workspace in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual and textual information, but their outputs do not reveal internal concept representations. Global workspace theory (GWT) proposes that information is selected from parallel brain processes, integrated in a shared workspace, and made available to specialised processes. We introduce the Multimodal Concept Lens (MC-Lens), a multimodal Jacobian lens, to study these functions in VLM concept processing. Its vision encoder and language decoder lenses map intermediate states to a shared semantic space defined by the decoder's output vocabulary to compare concept accessibility across modalities. MC-Lens supports internal concept interventions to examine the role of accessed concepts in downstream computation. (i) Accessibility and selective access. Multimodal concept information is readable in intermediate states and selectively accessible as tasks require. We extend "readout carriers" from one name token to a token set to better capture and express concept information and support counterfactual experiments. (ii) Concepts in downstream computation. Counterfactual experiments show that accessed concept information participates in downstream computation and reasoning. (iii) Development of cross-modal alignment and selective access. We develop two J-space metrics tracking the development of cross-modal concept alignment more clearly than hidden state cosine in controlled VLM training. The experiment also shows that reliable selective access develops later than concept accessibility. (iv) Shared functions across models. Across VLM families and sizes, we find shared patterns of concept accessibility, query-dependent selectivity and cross-task intervention effects despite differences in internal organisation. These findings offer an experimental basis to study GWT in multimodal artificial systems and how it can guide cross-modal alignment improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出多模态雅可比透镜 MC-Lens，将 VLM 视觉编码器与语言解码器的中间状态映射到共享语义空间，用于探测、干预与分析概念的可访问性、选择性访问及跨模态对齐。
AI.motivation: VLM 的输入输出均为模态信息，但内部概念表征不可直接观测；作者希望借用全局工作空间理论（GWT）的框架，为"信息选择—共享工作空间整合—向专门过程广播"这一功能在人工多模态系统中提供可实验检验的度量工具。
AI.method: 构建多模态雅可比透镜：对视觉编码器与语言解码器的中间层状态施加雅可比映射，投影到由解码器输出词表定义的共享语义空间，从而跨模态比较概念可访问性；将"readout carrier"从单一 name token 扩展为 token 集合以更完整表达概念并支撑反事实实验；支持对已访问概念做内部干预；提出两个 J-space 指标追踪跨模态概念对齐与选择性访问的发展过程；在受控 VLM 训练与跨模型族/规模上做对比实验。
AI.result: (i) 多模态概念信息在中层状态可读，且随任务需要被选择性访问；(ii) 反事实干预显示被访问的概念参与下游计算与推理；(iii) 所提 J-space 指标比隐状态余弦相似度更清晰地刻画跨模态概念对齐的发展，且可靠的选择性访问晚于概念可访问性出现；(iv) 不同 VLM 族与规模在内部组织上存在差异，但概念可访问性、查询相关选择性与跨任务干预效应呈现共享模式。
AI.conclusion: MC-Lens 为在多模态人工系统中研究全局工作空间理论提供了实验基础，并可为改进跨模态对齐提供可操作的诊断信号；但其价值主要在可解释性分析层面，未提供具身/物理任务上的方法增益或真实世界验证。

title: Coda-DaVinci: Reimagining Video Generation with Code2Video
summary: Code2Video uses agent-authored 3D proxies to guide video generation, enabling explicit control over structure and dynamics. However, how to construct proxies and prompts for optimal downstream quality remains underexplored, as do the capabilities and limitations of this paradigm. Through controlled experiments and blinded human evaluation, we study proxy granularity, physics simulation, and prompting. The results reveal task-dependent trade-offs: coarse proxies favor natural motion, while medium-grained proxies favor consistency. Physics simulation and proxy-aligned prompting further improve average quality. Guided by these findings, we introduce Coda-DaVinci, a task-adaptive agentic framework for Code2Video generation that selects between proxy-guided and direct generation, adapts modeling granularity to each entity, and coordinates simulation with proxy-grounded prompting. Its multi-agent harness preserves scene assets and guides repairs through visual inspection and independent review. Experiments demonstrate leading instruction following on VTR and scene consistency on R2M, improved physical plausibility over direct generation, and higher visual realism than the compared Code2Video baselines. Long-video evaluations further show gains in event structure and consistency across successive interactions, while revealing limitations in transition stability and adherence to scene settings.

AI.tldr: 系统研究 Code2Video 代理（proxy）构建中粒度、物理仿真与提示策略的权衡，并提出任务自适应多智能体框架 Coda-DaVinci。
AI.motivation: Code2Video 通过智能体编写 3D 代理来引导视频生成，实现对结构与动态的显式控制，但如何构造代理与提示以获得最优下游质量、以及该范式的能力边界尚不清楚。
AI.method: 受控实验 + 盲测人类评估，考察代理粒度（粗/中/细）、物理仿真开关、代理对齐提示的影响；据此设计 Coda-DaVinci：按任务在代理引导与直接生成间选择、按实体自适应建模粒度、协调仿真与代理接地提示，并用多智能体执行框架通过视觉检查与独立评审保留场景资产并指导修复。
AI.result: 发现任务相关权衡：粗粒度代理利于自然运动，中粒度利于一致性；物理仿真与代理对齐提示提升平均质量。在 VTR 上指令遵循领先、R2M 上场景一致性领先，物理合理性优于直接生成，视觉真实感优于 Code2Video 基线；长视频在事件结构与跨交互一致性上提升，但在转场稳定性与场景设定遵循上存在局限。
AI.conclusion: 代理粒度、仿真与提示需按任务自适应配置；任务自适应多智能体框架可系统性提升可控视频生成质量，但长视频转场稳定性仍是待解瓶颈。

title: PGX: Physically Grounded Execution for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Robotic vision-language-action (VLA) models can execute diverse individual manipulation skills, yet they still struggle with long-horizon loco-manipulation tasks, where temporal structure, skills, and precision are tightly coupled within a monolithic model. We propose Physically Grounded Execution (PGX), a framework that offloads temporal and precision control to two classical training-free components, allowing the VLA to focus on stage-specific skill dynamics. PGX decomposes long-horizon loco-manipulation into three layers: (i) a predicate-based state machine governs task progression, using physical predicates to gate phase transitions, trigger recovery, and coordinate navigation and waiting. Shared predicate semantics connect offline demonstration segmentation, online execution, and stage-wise evaluation; (ii) VLA skills operate within active manipulation phases, with flat or stage-trained models concentrating on task-relevant actions; and (iii) world-coordinate locking (WCL) maintains spatial consistency through base station keeping, object-relative positioning, and world-anchored contact targets. We demonstrate the effectiveness of PGX with extensive experiments conducted on three simulated tasks and one real-world task using a Unitree G1 humanoid robot for long-horizon loco-manipulation, showing improvements in stage progression and task success rates. Project page is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: PGX框架将长程loco-manipulation任务的时序与精度控制下放给无训练的状态机与坐标锁定模块，VLA仅负责阶段内技能执行。
AI.motivation: 单体VLA模型难以处理长程loco-manipulation中时序结构、技能切换与精度耦合的问题。
AI.method: 三层结构：(i)基于物理谓词的状态机控制任务推进、恢复触发与导航/等待协调，谓词语义打通离线示教分割、在线执行与阶段评估；(ii)VLA技能仅在主动操作阶段内运行（扁平或分阶段训练）；(iii)世界坐标锁定WCL通过基站保持、物体相对定位与世界锚定接触目标维持空间一致性。
AI.result: 在三个仿真任务与Unitree G1人形机器人上的真实任务中验证，阶段推进与任务成功率均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 将长程时序与精度控制交给经典无训练组件、让VLA专注阶段技能，是提升人形长程loco-manipulation的有效且低成本范式。

title: A Tutorial on Complementarity-Based Contact Models for Robotics
summary: Simulating rigid-body dynamics with contact is fundamental to robotics, from motion synthesis and control to mechanism design. Many widely used simulators rely on cone complementarity formulations, whose physical assumptions and numerical solution require substantial background. While excellent surveys, monographs, and course notes exist, they mostly address computational mechanics or computer graphics or document a single simulator. To the best of our knowledge, a self-contained pedagogical treatment for robotics, bringing these formulations and their solvers together with complete derivations and a unified notation, does not yet exist. This tutorial addresses this gap by connecting rigid-body dynamics, conic optimization, and frictional contact. In particular, we explain how complementarity conditions encode non-penetration and frictional dissipation, determining separation, sticking, and sliding without prescribed contact modes. We distinguish equivalent transcriptions from convex relaxations, showing how the latter can introduce artifacts such as lift-off and creep. We examine the existence and uniqueness of motion and contact forces, including the solver's role in selecting among multiple solutions. We then compare first-order and Newton-based methods, explain regularization and proximal strategies, and discuss trade-offs between computational cost, robustness, and physical fidelity. Connections to widely used simulators, optimal control, and differentiable simulation help readers interpret simulation results, choose suitable formulations and solvers, and develop their own contact dynamics routines.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇面向机器人学的刚性体接触动力学自包含教程，统一梳理锥互补（互补/锥优化） formulations 与摩擦接触，强调理论推导、求解器比较与物理保真度权衡。
AI.motivation: 机器人仿真中广泛使用的锥互补接触模型与求解器分散于计算力学、图形学和单个模拟器文档中，缺乏面向机器人、符号统一且推导完整的教学性综述。
AI.method: 以教程形式，将刚性体动力学、锥优化与摩擦接触联系起来：推导互补条件如何编码非穿透与摩擦耗散（分离/粘着/滑动无需预设接触模式）；区分等价重构与凸松弛，并分析后者引入的 lift-off 与 creep 伪影；讨论运动与接触力的存在唯一性及求解器在多解选择中的作用；比较一阶法与牛顿类方法，讨论正则化与近端策略及其在计算成本、鲁棒性与物理保真度间的权衡。
AI.result: 提供统一记号下的完整推导与求解器对比分析，阐明不同 formulation 的物理假设、数值行为与伪影来源，并连接常用模拟器、最优控制与可微仿真。
AI.conclusion: 为读者解读仿真结果、选择合适 formulation 与求解器以及实现自有接触动力学例程提供教学性基础；但属于综述/教程性质，未提出新方法或实证验证。

title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
comment: Code and weights available at this https URL
summary: We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution. Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming prior work in all of these dimensions. We release a family of models that define a new Pareto frontier in terms of metric accuracy, sharpness, temporal consistency, and runtime. We release code and weights at this https URL

AI.tldr: Depth Pro 2：单一可扩展网络统一处理图像与视频，原生分辨率输出稠密度量深度，同时具备度量精度、锐利边界与时间一致性。
AI.motivation: 既有单目深度方法存在"时间一致性 vs 边界锐利度"的取舍：多帧方法偏一致、单帧方法偏锐利。作者希望用一个模型同时克服该权衡。
AI.method: 训练单一可扩展网络，同时输入图像与视频，在原生分辨率下预测稠密度量深度图（metric depth），发布模型族以覆盖精度/锐度/一致性/运行时间的Pareto前沿。
AI.result: 据摘要，在度量准确性、边界锐利度和时间一致性三个维度上均优于先前工作，并给出新的Pareto前沿模型族；代码与权重开源。
AI.conclusion: 视频-图像联合训练可消除一致性与锐度之间的权衡，为下游3D重建、机器人与视频生成提供高质量稠密度量深度先验。

title: AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
comment: 28 pages. Project page: this https URL
summary: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgentRoboCritic 意图接地的动作级批评框架，对 12 个操作基准上前沿多模态智能体的直接机器人控制进行系统动作级分析，并发布 12,844 条标注动作数据集与微调开源批评模型 Muse-Glimmer-30B。
AI.motivation: 现有基准只报告 episode 级成功率，无法解释智能体如何成功、在何处失败；需要动作级诊断来定位直接低层数值动作控制的失效机制。
AI.method: 策略智能体在执行每个低层动作时给出局部意图；批评器（critic）对照该意图评估动作结果与失败模式；在 12 个操作基准上做系统动作级统计，并用 400 条人工标注动作验证批评器，再蒸馏微调开源模型。
AI.result: 揭示前沿智能体具备闭环局部故障恢复、跨场景可靠语义 grounding、零样本操作能力；瓶颈集中在抓取与对齐等物理执行环节，且不同失败模式的恢复能力不均衡。Muse-Glimmer-30B 失败模式准确率从 32.58% 提升至 74.24%。
AI.conclusion: 动作级意图批评是评估直接机器人控制的有效低成本范式，可作为 episode 级指标的补充诊断工具，并开源数据与批评模型。

title: ScaleWorld: High-Resolution World Generation through Shared Prediction and Refinement
summary: High-resolution generation enables video world models to render fine-grained scene structures and textures, but directly generating high-resolution video incurs substantial computational and memory costs. We present ScaleWorld, a causal video model that unifies low-resolution world prediction and high-resolution refinement within a single shared backbone. By refining its own predictions, ScaleWorld produces high-resolution world videos without requiring a separate refinement model. For each video chunk, the shared backbone first completes a low-resolution prediction and then performs one-step high-resolution refinement conditioned on that prediction. To support efficient streaming generation, we maintain separate causal states with a long low-resolution history for prediction and a short high-resolution history for refinement. To address task interference during distillation, we separate specialist optimization from capability consolidation and introduce task-asymmetric on-policy distillation (TA-OPD). This procedure transfers prediction and refinement behaviors from specialized teachers into a shared student through local velocity matching under their respective sampling and history policies. {Extensive experiments demonstrate that ScaleWorld achieves high-quality world generation with improved computational and memory efficiency.

AI.tldr: ScaleWorld：用单一共享骨干统一低分辨率世界预测与高分辨率精炼的因果视频世界模型，配合任务非对称在线策略蒸馏解决蒸馏中的任务干扰。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率视频世界模型能呈现细粒度场景结构与纹理，但直接生成高分辨率视频的计算与显存开销巨大；引入独立精炼模型又会增加系统复杂度和成本。
AI.method: 单一因果骨干按视频分块先做低分辨率预测，再以该预测为条件做一步高分辨率精炼（自精炼）。流式生成时维护分离的因果状态：预测用长低分辨率历史，精炼用短高分辨率历史。蒸馏阶段将专家优化与能力整合相分离，提出任务非对称在线策略蒸馏（TA-OPD），在各自采样与历史策略下通过局部速度匹配把预测与精炼行为从专家教师迁移到共享学生模型。
AI.result: 实验表明可获得高质量世界视频生成，同时在计算与显存效率上有明显改善（摘要未给出具体数值指标）。
AI.conclusion: 自精炼式共享骨干+双因果状态+TA-OPD 为高效高分辨率视频世界模型提供了一条免额外精炼模型的可行路径，对实时交互式世界模型与流式生成有参考价值。

title: One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
comment: Project page: this https URL Code: this https URL
summary: Videos reveal how the world changes, but rarely the actions that cause those changes. Latent action learning recovers such supervision from visual transitions, yet often learns the underlying dynamics largely from scratch. We ask whether a pretrained video generator can instead provide the prior for both inverse and forward dynamics. We introduce O$^{2}$LaF, built on a simple principle: one prior, two dynamics. We initialize both models from the same pretrained video DiT and adapt them to their distinct roles: a feed-forward transition encoder with learnable action queries for inverse dynamics, and a causal, action-conditioned video generator for forward dynamics. By controlling information access and optimizing both dynamics end-to-end through a compact bottleneck, O$^{2}$LaF learns transferable actions from unlabeled videos. Across navigation and robotic manipulation, O$^{2}$LaF sets a new state of the art in few-shot action probing and enables stronger zero-shot action transfer across visual contexts and embodiments. Beyond generative video priors, we further extend our framework to predictive representation priors such as V-JEPA2, achieving competitive performance. Our findings suggest a broader paradigm for latent-action learning: repurposing pretrained video models to discover transferable actions and predict their consequences.

AI.tldr: O²LaF: 用同一个预训练视频 DiT 初始化逆动力学与正动力学两个模型（前馈动作查询编码器 + 因果动作条件视频生成器），在无标注视频上通过紧凑瓶颈端到端学习可迁移的潜在动作。
AI.motivation: 潜在动作学习能从视觉变化中恢复动作监督，但通常从头学习动力学；作者希望利用预训练视频生成器的先验同时服务于逆动力学与正动力学。
AI.method: 以同一预训练视频 DiT 为共享先验，微调出两个角色：带可学习 action query 的前馈过渡编码器（逆动力学），与因果、动作条件的视频生成器（正动力学）；通过控制信息可见性并在紧凑瓶颈上联合端到端优化，实现无标签视频中的动作发现；并扩展至 V-JEPA2 等预测性表示先验。
AI.result: 在导航与机器人操作任务上，few-shot 动作探测取得 SOTA，并在跨视觉情境与跨具身零样本动作迁移上更强；以 V-JEPA2 为先验时也具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 复用预训练视频/表示模型来同时发现可迁移动作并预测其后果，是一种更广义的潜在动作学习范式。

title: PlayCraft: Designing Engaging Games from Agent Play Experience
summary: Recent AI agents can generate playable games, but these games are not necessarily engaging. Mastery is a key source of engagement, yet designing for it requires extensive human play and tuning. We propose PlayCraft, an automated framework that uses a vision-based agent to play games and draws on its detailed play experience to revise them for mastery. Starting from an initial game, PlayCraft alternates between playing and crafting. In the playing stage, a player agent watches the game screen, uses the controls, and pursues the game objective over repeated episodes while retaining memory. After each episode, it reports its progress, outcomes, decisions, and reflections. In the crafting stage, a crafter agent uses these reports to revise the game. It estimates player abilities, predicts performance at different proficiency levels, and compares those predictions with a target learning progression. It diagnoses the game and addresses the gaps by giving players meaningful opportunities to improve through better decisions and execution. We evaluate games in fresh runs with player agents across three intelligence settings, measuring learning gain and learning slope. Compared with the initial games, PlayCraft yields larger learning gains and steeper learning slopes in most games. It also outperforms the baselines on the macro-average of each metric at every intelligence setting.

AI.tldr: PlayCraft：用视觉智能体反复游玩游戏并输出进度/反思报告，再由"制作者"智能体据此诊断难度并改写游戏，以提高学习增益与学习斜率，达成"精通型"参与度。
AI.motivation: AI 生成的游戏虽可玩但缺乏参与度；"精通"（mastery）是参与度的关键来源，但为之设计需大量人类试玩与调参，成本高、难自动化。
AI.method: 自动化"游玩—制作"闭环：游玩阶段，视觉玩家智能体观察画面、操作控制、跨多个 episode 追求目标并保留记忆，每局后输出进度、结果、决策与反思；制作阶段，crafter 智能体依据报告估计玩家能力、预测不同熟练度水平下的表现，与目标学习曲线比较，诊断差距并通过提供"有意义的改进机会"（更优决策与执行）修订游戏。评估采用新开局的玩家智能体，在三种智能水平设置下测学习增益与学习斜率。
AI.result: 相较初始游戏，PlayCraft 在多数游戏中获得更大学习增益与更陡学习斜率；在每个智能水平设置下，两项指标的宏平均均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 以智能体自主试玩经验驱动游戏迭代改写，可自动实现面向"精通"的关卡/机制设计；为智能体驱动的设计与评估闭环提供了可复用范式。

title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training substantially improves the visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy of diffusion transformers. Because capabilities such as rendering requested text or composing multiple objects are inherently prompt-dependent, a natural hypothesis is that improving them requires learning complex, input-dependent transformations. To isolate how much of these gains an input-independent shift explains, we probe each RL-tuned model with a deliberately simple parameterization: a fixed set of steering vectors added to the block outputs of the frozen base model. On SD3.5-M, these vectors hold 65x fewer parameters than the RL-tuned LoRA (0.29M against 18.8M). We fit them to match the velocity predictions of public RL-tuned checkpoints, with no reward in the objective. Although the vectors are identical for every prompt, token, and sampling seed, they recover 90.0-96.3% of the reward gains of six RL-tuned image models, and 89.8% and 111.9% on two RL-tuned video models. Initialized at zero and trained with online RL, the vectors alone exceed the reward gains of weight-based RL on text rendering (OCR) and human preference (PickScore) on SD3.5-M. A constant shift thus suffices for most of the gain of policy-gradient RL post-training: without new input-dependent transformations, it steers the pretrained generator toward what it can already compute.

AI.tldr: 通过在冻结扩散Transformer的block输出上加一组输入无关的固定steering向量，可复现RL微调（RLHF/OCR奖励）增益的90%-96%，说明RL后训练收益主要是"全局常量平移"而非依赖提示的学习。
AI.motivation: RL后训练能显著提升扩散/流模型在视觉质量、文字渲染与组合准确性上的表现，通常被归因于学习了复杂的、依赖输入的变换。作者希望量化：这些提升中有多少可由一个与输入无关的简单参数化偏移来解释。
AI.method: 在冻结基模型每个transformer block输出上叠加一小组固定steering向量（SD3.5-M上0.29M参数，比RL LoRA的18.8M少65倍）；用回归匹配公开RL微调checkpoint的速度（velocity）预测来拟合，不使用奖励；另做零初始化+在线RL训练steering向量的对照实验。覆盖6个图像模型与2个视频模型。
AI.result: 固定向量对每个prompt、token、采样种子都相同，仍恢复6个RL图像模型奖励增益的90.0–96.3%，2个视频模型上为89.8%与111.9%；在SD3.5-M上仅用steering向量的OCR与PickScore增益超过权重级RL。
AI.conclusion: 策略梯度类RL后训练的收益大部分可由常数偏移实现：它并非引入新的依赖输入的能力，而是把预训练生成器导向其本身已具备的能力。

title: Posterior Matching Distillation
summary: Diffusion distillation accelerates image and video generation by compressing a pretrained teacher's iterative sampling process into a few network evaluations. Distribution-based methods achieve this by matching the student's output distribution to the teacher's. This matching is often driven by reverse-KL objectives, whose mode-seeking bias favors dominant teacher modes at the expense of diversity across samples. We introduce Posterior Matching Distillation (PMD), a new member of the distribution-based distillation family that combines mode-covering posterior sampling with any-step generation. At zero population loss, PMD recovers the teacher's full posterior of clean images at each trained noise level. Its stochastic student supports any-step sampling budgets within the trained timestep grid without further training. To learn these posteriors, PMD matches exponentially reweighted averages of student samples conditioned on a fixed noisy state to corresponding teacher posterior means. Under Gaussian corruption, exponentially tilted posterior mean is a single teacher evaluation at a shifted input. We prove that, matching tilted means over an open neighborhood uniquely identifies the full posterior. PMD thus supervises the entire conditional distribution through a family of mean constraints, without any auxiliary student-score network. Experiments on SDXL and FLUX.2 [klein] 4B demonstrate that PMD achieves the best FID among 4-step methods on both models, while maintaining competitive or leading performance across prompt-alignment and perceptual-quality metrics.

AI.tldr: PMD（Posterior Matching Distillation）提出一种基于分布匹配的扩散蒸馏新方法：通过匹配指数重加权（tilted）后验均值来约束完整后验分布，零总体损失时精确恢复teacher在每一噪声level的干净图像后验，且支持训练时间步网格内任意步数采样。
AI.motivation: 现有分布型扩散蒸馏依赖reverse-KL目标，其mode-seeking偏置偏向teacher主导模态，牺牲样本多样性。作者希望获得兼具mode-covering（保持多样性）与少步/任意步生成的蒸馏方法。
AI.method: 在固定噪声状态条件下，将student样本的指数重加权平均与teacher对应后验均值对齐；在高斯退化假设下，指数tilted后验均值可用一次偏移输入的teacher前向计算，无需辅助student-score网络。理论上证明：在开邻域上匹配tilted均值可唯一确定完整后验，因此用一族均值约束等价监督整个条件分布。随机性student在已训练时间步网格内可直接支持任意步数采样。
AI.result: 在SDXL与FLUX.2 [klein] 4B上，PMD在4步方法中取得最佳FID，并在prompt对齐与感知质量指标上保持竞争力或领先。
AI.conclusion: 以后验均值族约束替代reverse-KL，可避免mode collapse同时实现少步与任意步蒸馏；该框架具有理论唯一性保证且无需额外score网络，在主流文生图模型上验证有效。
